jobs.title: Metsäkoneenkuljettaja
jobs.description:
Motokuljettajia kansainväliseen puunkorjuutyöhön – Suomi & Ruotsi

Etsimme kahta kokenutta motokuljettajaa vakituiseen työhön puunkorjuuyritykseen, Nurmelan konetyö. Tässä tehtävässä työskentelet sekä Suomessa että Ruotsissa: työrytmi muodostuu lähtökohtaisesti kahden viikon työjaksosta Ruotsissa ja sitä seuraavasta kahden viikon työjaksosta Suomessa.

Tehtävä sopii sinulle, jos olet ammattitaitoinen metsäkoneenkuljettaja, pidät itsenäisestä työstä ja olet valmis työskentelemään kansainvälisessä ympäristössä.

Työ alkaa heti tai sopimuksen mukaan. Perehdytys ja työn käynnistys tapahtuvat Suomessa. Palkka TESin mukaan.

Työ toteutetaan säännöllisesti kahdessa maassa:

Ruotsi: Työmaat sijaitsevat Falunin alueella. Ruotsin työjaksojen ajaksi työntekijälle järjestetään majoitus sekä auto työkäyttöön.

Suomi: Työmaat sijaitsevat laajasti Lounais-Suomen alueella, Salon ja saariston suunnalta Euran seudulle saakka. Yrityksen päätoimipiste sijaitsee Paimiossa.

Työrytmi: 2 viikkoa Ruotsissa + 2 viikkoa Suomessa.

Myös pidemmistä työjaksoista voidaan tarvittaessa sopia. Työ edellyttää joustavuutta, sillä työmaat ja työmatkojen pituudet vaihtelevat. Erityisesti Lounais-Suomen saaristossa työmatkoihin voi sisältyä myös lauttayhteyksiä.

Mitä odotamme sinulta?

Etsimme ammattitaitoista ja luotettavaa motokuljettajaa, jolla on hyvä asenne työhön ja valmius työskennellä kahdessa eri maassa.

Toivomme sinulta:

kokemusta motokuljettajan työstä

tarkkaa, vastuullista ja itsenäistä työotetta

joustavuutta ja valmiutta työskennellä vuorotellen Suomessa ja Ruotsissa

asiakaslähtöistä ja palveluhenkistä asennetta

hyviä vuorovaikutustaitoja

kykyä sopeutua vaihtuviin työympäristöihin

Työ vaatii hyvää englannin tai ruotsin kielen taitoa.

Työssä olet ajoittain tekemisissä suoraan asiakkaiden kanssa. Siksi meille on tärkeää, että hoidat työsi ammattimaisesti ja jätät omalla toiminnallasi hyvän kuvan yrityksestä.

Ikä ei ole meille ratkaiseva tekijä. Työyhteisössä työskentelee tällä hetkellä hyvin eri-ikäisiä ammattilaisia. Ammattitaito, asenne ja motivaatio ratkaisevat.

Mitä tarjoamme?

Tarjoamme sinulle monipuolisen työn vakavaraisessa puunkorjuuyrityksessä sekä mahdollisuuden tehdä metsäkoneenkuljettajan työtä aidosti kansainvälisessä ympäristössä.

Saat:

työn, jossa työskentelet sekä Suomessa että Ruotsissa

selkeän työrytmin: lähtökohtaisesti 2 viikkoa Ruotsissa ja 2 viikkoa Suomessa

majoituksen Ruotsin työjaksojen ajaksi

auton työkäyttöön Ruotsissa

TES:n mukaiset palkan, päivärahat ja muut lisät

perehdytyksen ja työn käynnistyksen Suomessa

kokeneen työyhteisön tuen

Suomen työmaat sijaitsevat Lounais-Suomessa, joten tehtävä sopii erityisen hyvin alueella asuvalle kuljettajalle.

Kiinnostuitko?

Tehtävä täytetään heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä, joten jätä hakemuksesi mahdollisimman pian osoitteeseen laura.enckell@foresttrainers.com

Kerro hakemuksessasi aikaisemmasta kokemuksestasi motonkuljettajana, käyttämistäsi koneista sekä kielitaidostasi.

Rekrytoinnista vastaa ForestTrainersin rekrytointikonsultti Laura Enckell +358442778664, laura.enckell@foresttrainers.com

jobs.title: Sykepleier
jobs.description:
Ønsker du å jobbe med noen av sykehusets mest komplekse og spennende pasientforløp?

Ved Akuttgeriatrisk sengepost møter du eldre pasienter med sammensatte medisinske, kognitive, psykiske og sosiale utfordringer. Hos oss får du utvikle bred klinisk kompetanse, samtidig som du blir en del av et sterkt tverrfaglig fagmiljø.

Vi søker sykepleier til en 100 % fast stilling. Stillingen har for tiden tredelt turnus med arbeid hver tredje helg p.t. Oppstart etter avtale.

Akuttgeriatrisk sengepost er en akutt indremedisinsk sengepost med 20 senger og spesialkompetanse på utredning og behandling av eldre pasienter med akutt funksjonssvikt og sammensatte prblemstillinger.

Vi arbeider helhetlig og tverrfaglig for å avdekke årsaker, behandle sykdom, forebygge komplikasjoner og legge til rette for best mulig funksjon og livskvalitet. Dette gir en spennende og variert arbeidshverdag hvor du får brukt hele bredden av din sykepleiefaglige kompetanse.

Sammen bidrar vi til trygge og helhetlige pasientforløp

Oslo universitetssykehus er en arbeidsplass med stort mangfold. Vi mener dette er avgjørende for å løse våre oppgaver på best mulig måte. Vi ønsker at dette mangfoldet skal gjenspeiles blant søkerne til våre stillinger, og oppfordrer alle kvalifiserte kandidater, uavhengig bakgrunn, til å søke!
Arbeidsoppgaver

Arbeidsoppgaver

  • Kartlegging, observasjon og oppfølging av akutt syke geriatriske pasienter
  • Identifisere risikofaktorer og iverksette målrettede sykepleietiltak
  • Ivareta pasienter og pårørende gjennom hele pasientforløpet
  • Samarbeide tett med det tverrfaglige teamet og primærhelsetjenesten
  • Bidra til helhetlige og trygge pasientforløp
Kvalifikasjoner

For å trives med arbeidsoppgaver hos oss, ser vi etter deg som har følgende kvalifikasjoner:

  • Norsk autorisasjon som sykepleier
  • Interesse for geriatri og eldre pasienters helseutfordringer
  • Erfaring fra geriatri, palliasjon eller hjemmetjenesten er en fordel
  • Erfaring fra tverrfaglig samarbeid er ønskelig
  • Må kunne være gruppeleder

Vi ber om at relevant dokumentasjon legges ved søknaden.

Personlige egenskaper

Hva ser vi etter hos deg:

  • Er faglig trygg og ansvarsbevisst
  • Har gode samarbeids- og kommunikasjonsevner
  • Trives med både selvstendig arbeid og teamarbeid
  • Er initiativrik, lærevillig og løsningsorientert
  • Bidra positivt til arbeidsmiljøet
  • Setter pasientens behov i sentrum
Vi tilbyr

Vi er opptatt av at du skal trives og utvikle deg, les under hva vi kan tilby deg:

  • En spennende og variert arbeidshverdag
  • Et inkluderende arbeidsmiljø med høy faglig kompetanse
  • Tett samarbeid i et tverrfaglig team med høy kompetanse
  • Individuelt tilpasset opplæring og gode utviklingsmuligheter
  • Nyansattprogram og attraktive velferdstilbud 

    Hvis du motiveres av faglige utfordringer, teamarbeid og helhetlig behandling av eldre pasienter, ønsker vi å høre fra deg.
    Vi gleder oss til å motta søknaden din!
KontaktinformasjonMarianne Evenstad, Enhetsleder , +4722118641
ArbeidsstedKirkeveien 166
0450 Oslo
Nøkkelinformasjon:Arbeidsgiver: Oslo universitetssykehus HF

Referansenr.: 5181826837
Stillingsprosent: 100%
Fast

Sammen med pasienten utvikler vi morgendagens behandling
Oslo universitetssykehus med våre 25 000 medarbeidere skal være en lærende og skapende organisasjon med evne til å tenke nytt. Vi skal ha en ledende rolle i utvikling av forskning og innovasjon, samt utvikling av morgendagens helsetjeneste, medisinsk behandling og presisjonsmedisin. Hos oss finner du noen av landets ledende eksperter innen sine fagfelt, og her blir du en del av Norges største helsefaglige arbeidsplass. Et inkluderende arbeidsmiljø preget av åpenhet og respekt er svært viktig for oss. jobs.title: Bus Drivers / Bus Sjåfør
jobs.description:
Enter Tromsø is seeking reliable and safety-focused Bus Drivers to join our transportation team in Tromsø. The successful candidate will be responsible for transporting passengers safely and efficiently along assigned routes while providing excellent customer service. The position requires compliance with Norwegian transport regulations and a strong commitment to passenger safety.

Temporary position: The position is temporary and will run until 31 March 2027.
Start date: As soon as possible.


Key Responsibilities

  • Safely operate a passenger bus along scheduled routes.

  • Ensure passenger safety during boarding, travel, and disembarking.

  • Perform pre-trip and post-trip vehicle inspections.

  • Follow all traffic laws and company safety procedures.

  • Provide friendly and professional customer service to passengers.

  • Maintain accurate logs and report any incidents or maintenance issues.

  • Assist passengers with accessibility needs when required.

Required Qualifications

Applicants must meet the legal requirements for operating a bus in Norway:

  • Valid Category D Driver's License (Bus License) issued in Norway or recognized within the EEA.

  • Driver Certificate of Professional Competence (CPC / Yrkessjåførkompetanse -- YSK) for passenger transport.

  • Valid Driver Qualification Card (YSK card).

  • Clean driving record and ability to pass a background check.

  • Ability to communicate effectively in Norwegian or English.

  • Minimum age requirements as required for professional bus drivers in Norway.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous experience operating buses or heavy vehicles.

  • Good knowledge of local routes in Tromsø and surrounding areas.

  • Customer service experience.

  • Basic mechanical awareness for vehicle inspections.

Working Conditions

  • Shift work including early mornings, evenings, weekends, and holidaysas our company operates every day during the peak winter season (1 October -- 31 March).

  • Shifts include bus transfers between Tromsø & Malangen Resort, as well as Northern lights trips

  • Operation in winter and Arctic driving conditions.

  • Both full-time and part-time positions may be available.

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary according to Norwegian transport industry standards.

  • Pension and insurance benefits.

  • Training and onboarding support.

  • Stable employment with a growing transportation company.

  • Opportunities for additional route assignments or overtime.

How to Apply

candidates must submit all documents listed bellow in order to be considered.

  • Resume / CV

  • Copy of Category D driver's license

  • Copy of YSK certificate

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Enter Tromsø is a fully-owned family company in Northern Norway that is growing, with over 150,000 guest nights per year and approximately 100 employees. Enter Tromsø is part of a group that develops values in property and tourism in Northern Norway. We are driven by making a difference in society and providing extraordinary customer experiences through innovation and sustainable choices. With us, you have the opportunity to create golden moments in encounters with our guests from various customer groups. We offer good career opportunities, training and development, as well as favorable employee benefits and discounts.

jobs.title: Factory Training & Development Specialist
jobs.description:
**The opportunity**

Join Hitachi Energy in shaping the future of learning and growth! We're looking for a dynamic Factory Training & Development Specialist to lead impactful programs at our Transformers Factory in Vaasa.

The Transformers Business Unit is a core part of Hitachi Energy, enabling reliable power transmission and distribution worldwide. Over the years, the Vaasa factory has become one of Finland's largest and most important transformer manufacturing plant, contributing significantly to national energy security. Today, the factory develops and manufactures transformers that ensure electricity flows to millions of homes worldwide. The site operates in a complex manufacturing environment with high safety standards and a strong focus on sustainability, quality, and continuous improvement, serving customers globally both within and outside Hitachi Energy.

In this role, you will design and deliver innovative training experiences that empower teams, foster leadership, and drive operational excellence. If you're passionate about helping people unlock their potential and thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative environment, this is your chance to make a real difference.

**How you'll make an impact**

· Drive factory training activities according to the agreed training roadmap, production needs and HUB guidance.

· Lead the practical implementation of Structured-On-The-Job training for direct workforce, including schedules, participants, trainers and documentation.

· Maintain course assignments, training records, certifications and completion data in the appointed Learning Management System (LMS).

· Prepare regular training status reports, dashboards or data extracts to support follow-up and decision-making.

· Coordinate with trainers and SMEs to prepare, update and validate training materials and work instruction related content.

· Follow up overdue, mandatory or certification-related trainings and escalate gaps when needed.

· Collect feedback from participants, trainers and stakeholders and drive agreed improvement actions.

· Communicate training schedules, requirements and practical instructions to relevant employees and managers.

· Provide accurate training records and evidence for audits, compliance checks and training documentation requests.

· Contribute to and drive continuous improvement of training processes, tools and ways of working within the factory.

**Your background**

· A B.Sc., M.Sc. or equivalent degree in Engineering, Industrial Management, HR, Education, Business Administration or another relevant field

· Relevant experience in training coordination, production training, technical instruction, LMS administration or manufacturing support roles.

· Good understanding of manufacturing environment, shopfloor operations and competence development needs for direct workforce.

· Experience with Learning Management Systems, training data maintenance and reporting tools such as Excel and PowerBI is an advantage.

· Ability to coordinate multiple training activities, follow up details and maintain accurate documentation.

· Strong collaboration, communication and stakeholder service mindset.

· Structured, proactive and quality-oriented way of working with a continuous improvement mindset.

· Familiarity with transformer manufacturing is an advantage.

· Fluency in both Finnish and English, written and spoken.

I denne rollen blir du en tydelig og trygg voksenperson for barna, og en aktiv del av planlegging og gjennomføring av det pedagogiske arbeidet. Hverdagen hos oss er variert, naturpreget og full av lek – og vi lover at ingen dager er helt like.

Du vil blant annet:

  • Delta i planlegging, gjennomføring og vurdering av pedagogiske aktiviteter
  • Skape gode relasjoner til barna og bidra til et trygt og inkluderende læringsmiljø
  • Legge til rette for lek, mestring, utforsking og vennskap både inne og ute
  • Bidra til naturbaserte aktiviteter og turer i nærmiljøet
  • Samarbeide tett med kollegaer for å sikre helhetlig oppfølging av hvert enkelt barn
  • Ha dialog med foresatte og bidra til godt samarbeid hjem–barnehage
Hvem vi ser etter

Vi ser etter deg som er barnehagelærer og som har lyst til å bruke kompetansen din i et miljø som er både faglig fokusert og litt uformelt på en hyggelig måte. Du trives sammen med barn, liker å være ute, og er til stede i øyeblikkene – både de små og de store.

Vi ser etter deg som:

  • Har barnehagelærerutdanning
  • Har 1 års erfaring fra arbeid i barnehage, praksis eller lignende
  • Liker å jobbe i team og bidra aktivt inn i samarbeid og felles ansvar
  • Er trygg, varm og tydelig i møte med barn, foresatte og kollegaer
  • Er nysgjerrig, reflektert og opptatt av faglig utvikling
  • Har gode norskferdigheter muntlig og skriftlig
Hvorfor du vil trives hos oss

Hos oss har vi tydelig fokus på kvalitet, faglig utvikling og et positivt barnesyn. Vi ser hvert barn som unikt og kompetent, og vi jobber sammen for å skape et miljø der lek, relasjoner og mestring er i sentrum.

Her får du blant annet:

  • Gode lønns- og pensjonsvilkår gjennom tariffavtale
  • Muligheter for faglig utvikling og kompetanseheving gjennom interne kurs og opplæring
  • Veiledning og ekstra støtte for deg som er nyutdannet barnehagelærer
  • Et inkluderende, humørfylt og støttende arbeidsmiljø med engasjerte kollegaer
  • Autonomi i arbeidshverdagen og rom til å bruke egne ideer og ferdigheter
Slik søker du

For å søke på stillingen som barnehagelærer i 40% vikariat i Sandnes ber vi deg sende inn søknad og CV via vårt digitale søknadsskjema i stillingsannonsen. Legg gjerne ved relevante attester og vitnemål, og skriv kort hvorfor du ønsker å jobbe hos oss og hva du kan bidra med i barnehagen. Vi behandler søknader fortløpende, så vi anbefaler at du søker så snart du har mulighet.

jobs.title: Solution Architect - LangGraph & Agentic AI
jobs.description:
We are looking for an experienced Solution Architect with hands-on experience designing and deploying LangGraph-based AI solutions to lead the architecture of enterprise agentic AI platforms and applications.

You will work with business and technology stakeholders to identify high-value AI opportunities and translate them into secure, scalable, and production-ready architectures.

The role combines AI architecture, enterprise integration, cloud engineering, agentic AI, security, governance, and stakeholder leadership.

You will be expected to understand LangGraph at a practical level and be able to challenge architectural decisions, guide engineering teams, and ensure that AI solutions can operate reliably at enterprise scale.

Requirements

AI Solution Architecture

  • Lead the architecture and design of enterprise AI agent and agentic workflow solutions.
  • Design LangGraph-based architectures for single-agent and multi-agent applications.
  • Translate business requirements, processes, SLAs, security requirements, and technical constraints into solution architectures.
  • Evaluate architectural alternatives and document key technical decisions and trade-offs.
  • Define reusable architecture patterns for agentic AI solutions.

Enterprise Agent Architecture

  • Design architectures incorporating:
    • LLMs
    • LangGraph
    • RAG
    • Enterprise data
    • APIs and business systems
    • Workflow engines
    • Human approval processes
    • Observability
    • Security and governance
  • Define appropriate boundaries between AI reasoning and deterministic business logic.
  • Design state management, persistence, recovery, and long-running agent workflows.
  • Determine when to use single-agent, multi-agent, or conventional application architectures.

Cloud and Platform Architecture

  • Design scalable AI application architectures on AWS, Azure, or GCP.
  • Define compute, networking, storage, API, security, and platform requirements.
  • Design architectures suitable for enterprise-scale production workloads.
  • Evaluate cloud services and AI platform capabilities based on performance, security, scalability, and cost.
  • Work with platform engineering and DevOps teams to establish deployment standards.

Integration Architecture

  • Design integration between AI agents and enterprise applications, APIs, databases, and SaaS platforms.
  • Define secure mechanisms for agent tool access and business-system interactions.
  • Design authentication, authorisation, secrets management, and access-control approaches.
  • Ensure AI-driven actions are traceable, auditable, and appropriately governed.

AI Security and Governance

  • Establish security and governance principles for enterprise AI agents.
  • Address risks including:
    • Prompt injection
    • Data leakage
    • Unauthorised tool usage
    • Excessive agent permissions
    • Inaccurate or unsafe actions
    • Sensitive-data exposure
  • Define appropriate human-in-the-loop controls.
  • Ensure solutions comply with organisational security, privacy, regulatory, and responsible-AI requirements.

AI Evaluation and Observability

  • Define architecture for AI application monitoring and observability.
  • Establish approaches for evaluating agent accuracy, reliability, latency, cost, and task completion.
  • Define appropriate logging, tracing, metrics, and alerting.
  • Establish operational processes for monitoring and continuously improving production agents.

Stakeholder and Technical Leadership

  • Work directly with senior business and technology stakeholders to define AI strategies and roadmaps.
  • Lead architecture workshops and technical design sessions.
  • Communicate complex AI concepts and architectural trade-offs to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Provide technical direction to AI engineers, developers, data teams, and platform engineers.
  • Review solution designs and ensure alignment with enterprise architecture standards.
  • Mentor engineering teams and promote reusable AI architecture patterns.

Required Experience

  • Significant experience in solution architecture, software architecture, AI architecture, or a related role.
  • Hands-on experience designing and deploying LangGraph-based AI applications or agentic workflows.
  • Strong understanding of LLM application architectures.
  • Experience with enterprise AI/ML solutions in production.
  • Strong understanding of RAG, tool calling, agent orchestration, and human-in-the-loop patterns.
  • Strong experience with at least one major cloud platform: AWS, Azure, or GCP.
  • Strong understanding of enterprise integration patterns and APIs.
  • Experience with security, governance, observability, and operational requirements for production systems.
  • Strong technical understanding of Python and modern software engineering practices.

Desirable Experience

  • LangChain / LangSmith
  • Multi-agent architectures
  • Enterprise RAG platforms
  • Vector databases
  • Kubernetes
  • Event-driven architectures
  • Microservices
  • Infrastructure as Code
  • CI/CD
  • MLOps / LLMOps
  • AI security
  • Responsible AI
  • Large-scale enterprise transformation
  • Experience working directly with senior client stakeholders

jobs.title: Area IT Manager Finland and Europe
jobs.description:
Ruukki Construction aims to drive the construction industry towards carbon neutrality with its products. Our 1,350 employees in 10 European countries and 14 specialized manufacturing sites provide steel-based building products and services for roofs and walls in sustainable buildings. We serve our customers locally under our main brands Ruukki and Plannja. Our net sales in 2024 were approximately EUR 481 million. We are of Nordic origin and share our values and long experience in the steel and construction industry with our parent company SSAB.

Do you want to be part of building a more sustainable future and be part of a professional and successful team in an international company? Maybe this is your new challenge!

We are looking fora strategic minded and hands-on Area IT Manager to manage local IT development and support activities in Finland and to oversee our regional IT operations across Ruukki locations in Central Eastern Europe. This role combines leadership, operational responsibility, and strategic execution in a dynamic international environment.

We are looking for a strategic minded and hands-on Area IT Manager to manage local IT development and support activities in Finland and to oversee our regional IT operations across Ruukki locations in Central Eastern Europe. This role combines leadership, operational responsibility, and strategic execution in a dynamic international environment.

The role has two main managerial responsibility areas; Firstly, oversee local IT development and support activities in Finland, ensuring business continuity from the IT perspective. And in this context act as line manager for the area IT team: manage performance, recruitment, budgeting, and other HR responsibilities. Secondly, you will lead a team of regional IT managers in Central and Eastern Europe: you will set goals, monitor progress, optimize resource allocation and ensure that best practices are evaluated and implemented as part of the knowledge sharing process.

All in all, you will contribute to the implementation of Ruukkis IT and business strategies and roadmaps. And when fit for purpose act as project manager for selected initiatives, such as IT and production capability development, acquisitions, and carve-outs.

The preferred location is Alajärvi, or any of our location in South Ostrobothnia, Finland.

Key Responsibilities

Ensure day-to-day IT support and development activities are aligned with Ruukki and SSAB IT policies (executed by internal teams and external vendors).

Lead the development of the Area Europe IT roadmap and resource planning.

Manage team-level IT costs, including annual budgeting and development proposals.

Oversee contracts and vendor management, including invoicing.

Collaborate with SSAB common IT on infrastructure and application development.

Define and implement collaboration models with business stakeholders across Europe.

Act as a general point of contact for infrastructure-related topics within Ruukki Construction IT management.

What we are looking for

· Strong knowledge of business applications and IT infrastructure (including security).

· Experience in strategy and roadmap execution.

· Solid understanding of business process development.

· Strong project management skills.

· Familiarity with agile methodologies and service delivery frameworks (e.g., ITIL).

· Proven vendor management skills.

· Strong leadership and team management capabilities.

· Has excellent communication and interpersonal abilities.

· The ideal candidate communicates fluently in Finnish and in English both written and oral.

We Offer

Our workplace fosters collaboration and personal growth, and everything we do is guided by our commitment to sustainability. Safety, innovation and reliability are at the heart of our business and ensure that everyone in our community thrives. Great colleagues and a supportive work community. Healthy work-life-balance and flexibility (hybrid working model). Lunch and wellbeing benefits. Occupational health services and much more!

Location

Your home base will be Ruukki Alajärvi (South Ostrobothnia) Finland. Some domestic and international travel is required.

jobs.description:
We are a spa hotel dedicated to delivering an wellness experience for our guests. We’re currently seeking a passionate and experienced Massage Therapist to join our growing team and help us elevate our guest experience to the next level.

Hva vi ser etter

We are looking for a massage therpist to join our team for the season in temporarly position.

You will have the opportunity to contribute to both the creative development and the execution of our services. We value innovation and actively encourage our team to share their ideas and passions. Enter Tromsø is part of a group that develops values in property and tourism in Northern Norway. We are driven by making a difference in society and providing extraordinary customer experiences through innovation and sustainable choices. With us, you have the opportunity to create golden moments in encounters with our guests from various customer groups. jobs.title: Directeur d'établissement hôtelier (H/F)
jobs.description:
Nous recherchons un(e) Directeur(trice) d'établissement hôtelier pour piloter l'exploitation et contribuer au développement de l'activité. Le poste s'inscrit autour de deux priorités : pérenniser et accroître l'activité hôtelière, puis remettre en place une activité bar dans des conditions adaptées à l'établissement.
Vos responsabilités
Management et ressources humaines
- Observer l'organisation existante, puis mettre en place des outils de gestion RH et optimiser les plannings.
- Optimiser l'utilisation des heures de travail et développer la polyvalence des équipes, notamment pendant les périodes plus calmes.
- Encadrer les opérations de nettoyage de fond et les actions d'amélioration de la qualité.
- Préparer et transmettre les éléments variables de paie au cabinet comptable, rédiger les contrats de travail si nécessaire et assurer les alertes administratives utiles.
- Construire et suivre le plan de formation, avec une priorité donnée à la sécurité incendie.
Exploitation et maîtrise des coûts
- Suivre la pertinence des commandes de petits déjeuners, consommables de bureau et produits d'entretien.
- Identifier les possibilités de réduction du gaspillage et de valorisation des surplus.
- Étudier les regroupements de commandes ou de contrats avec les établissements partenaires.
Expérience client, communication et e-réputation
- Encourager la collecte d'avis clients et systématiser les réponses aux avis publiés.
- Animer le site internet : offres, actualités et informations pratiques.
- Veiller à la qualité de l'accueil et à la cohérence de l'expérience client sur l'ensemble du parcours.
Qualité, maintenance, sécurité et gestion des déchets
- Mettre en place une méthode efficace d'identification et de suivi des pannes ou détériorations dans les chambres.
- Déclencher et suivre les réparations nécessaires avec les interlocuteurs concernés.
- Réaliser des contrôles qualité aléatoires de 5 à 10 chambres par semaine.
- Contribuer à la coordination avec le référent sécurité de l'immeuble et aux échanges avec les autorités compétentes.
- Organiser l'évacuation et le traitement des déchets non collectés dans les filières habituelles : verre, cartouches d'encre, appareils hors service et autres déchets spécifiques.
Développement commercial et optimisation du chiffre d'affaires
- Mener des actions de prospection auprès des entreprises locales et des organisateurs d'événements.
- Assurer une veille concurrentielle et contribuer à l'optimisation des tarifs hôteliers.
- Mettre en œuvre les principes de base du yield management avec l'appui des outils de réservation et de facturation existants.
Reporting et relation avec la direction
- Participer à une réunion mensuelle avec la présidente.
- Signaler sans délai tout dysfonctionnement important concernant le personnel, les clients, la sécurité ou les investissements à prévoir.
- Scanner et transmettre les factures papier, ainsi que les états mensuels nécessaires aux déclarations de TVA et de taxe de séjour.
Le profil recherché
- Expérience confirmée dans la direction ou la gestion d'un hôtel, d'un établissement d'hébergement ou d'une activité HCR.
- Solides compétences en management, organisation des plannings et accompagnement des équipes.
- Maîtrise des outils de réservation et de facturation ; une première expérience en yield management est appréciée.
- Rigueur administrative, sens du suivi budgétaire et capacité à travailler avec des partenaires comptables.
- Très bon relationnel, sens du service client, autonomie et capacité à prendre des décisions pragmatiques.
- Goût du terrain, esprit d'initiative et capacité à évoluer dans un cadre de collaboration souple et proche de la direction.
Ce que nous proposons
- Un poste central dans un établissement à taille humaine et à forte identité locale.
- Une réelle autonomie dans la structuration de l'exploitation et l'amélioration des méthodes

jobs.description: - ΕΞΥΠΗΡΕΤΗΣΗ ΥΦΙΣΤΑΜΕΝΩΝ ΚΑΙ ΝΕΩΝ ΠΕΛΑΤΩΝ ΜΕΣΩ ΤΗΛΕΦΩΝΟΥ, ΗΛΕΚΤΡΟΝΙΚΟΥ ΤΑΧΥΔΡΟΜΕΙΟΥ ΚΑΙ ΠΡΟΣΩΠΙΚΩΝ ΣΥΝΑΝΤΗΣΕΩΝ ΟΠΟΥ ΑΠΑΙΤΕΙΤΑΙ.   - ΑΝΑΠΤΥΞΗ ΠΕΛΑΤΟΛΟΓΙΟΥ, ΔΙΕΥΘΕΤΗΣΗ ΡΑΝΤΕΒΟΥ, ΠΑΡΑΚΟΛΟΥΘΗΣΗ ΠΡΟΣΦΟΡΩΝ ΚΑΙ ΕΠΙΚΟΙΝΩΝΙΑ ΜΕ ΠΕΛΑΤΕΣ.   - ΠΑΡΟΧΗ ΔΙΟΙΚΗΤΙΚΗΣ ΚΑΙ ΓΡΑΜΜΑΤΕΙΑΚΗΣ ΥΠΟΣΤΗΡΙΞΗΣ, ΔΙΑΧΕΙΡΙΣΗ ΑΡΧΕΙΩΝ ΚΑΙ ΑΛΛΗΛΟΓΡΑΦΙΑΣ, ΟΡΓΑΝΩΣΗ ΠΡΟΓΡΑΜΜΑΤΟΣ ΠΡΟΣΩΠΙΚΟΥ ΚΑΙ ΣΥΝΕΡΓΕΙΩΝ, ΚΑΘΩΣ ΚΑΙ ΥΠΟΣΤΗΡΙΞΗ ΒΑΣΙΚΩΝ ΔΙΑΔΙΚΑΣΙΩΝ ΑΝΘΡΩΠΙΝΟΥ ΔΥΝΑΜΙΚΟΥ (HR).   - ΕΚΤΕΛΕΣΗ ΛΟΙΠΩΝ ΣΥΝΑΦΩΝ ΚΑΘΗΚΟΝΤΩΝ ΠΟΥ ΣΧΕΤΙΖΟΝΤΑΙ ΜΕ ΤΗ ΘΕΣΗ. , ΟΡΓΑΝΩΤΙΚΟ ΚΑΙ ΕΠΙΚΟΙΝΩΝΙΑΚΟ ΑΤΟΜΟ ΜΕ ΑΡΙΣΤΗ ΓΝΩΣΗ ΕΛΛΗΝΙΚΩΝ ΚΑΙ ΑΓΓΛΙΚΩΝ, ΚΑΛΗ ΓΝΩΣΗ Η/Υ. ΕΜΠΕΙΡΙΑ ΣΕ ΕΞΥΠΗΡΕΤΗΣΗ ΠΕΛΑΤΩΝ, ΠΩΛΗΣΕΙΣ Ή ΔΙΟΙΚΗΤΙΚΗ ΥΠΟΣΤΗΡΙΞΗ ΘΑ ΘΕΩΡΗΘΕΙ ΕΠΙΠΡΟΣΘΕΤΟ ΠΡΟΣΟΝ.  ΜΕ ΑΔΕΙΑ ΟΔΗΓΟΥ ΚΑΙ ΙΔΙΟΚΤΗΤΟ ΟΧΗΜΑ.  ΓΙΑ FULL-TIME + PART-T , Please note that copy of the letter and CV sent to the employer should also be sent to the (EURES ADVISOR , PRODROMOS CHRYSANTHOU , pchrysanthou@dl.mlsi.gov.cy). Please include the national vacancy reference number

jobs.description:
Specialist Doctor in Psychiatry, North Denmark Region

Become part of a multidisciplinary psychiatry service where collaboration and professional development are at the centre of patient care. North Denmark Region is looking for specialist doctors in psychiatry to join our adult psychiatry services, primarily based in Brønderslev.
You will work in a professionally ambitious environment with strong opportunities for both professional and personal development.

Why join us?
  • Multidisciplinary collaboration with psychiatrists, nurses, social workers, physiotherapists and occupational therapists.     
  • Strong focus on supervision, collegial support and continuous learning.
  • The opportunity to contribute to the continued development of mental healthcare in a region with a need for specialist expertise.

Working and Living in North Denmark
Positions are primarily based in Brønderslev. North Denmark offers excellent opportunities for a balanced professional and personal life, with easy access to nature, the city of Aalborg and Aalborg Airport with connections to several European destinations.
Danish working culture supports collaboration, professional autonomy and a healthy work-life balance.

International Candidates
Many of our psychiatrists have an international background. Danish is the working and clinical language and is essential for patient care. Support with authorization, language training and relocation is provided through our recruitment partners.

What We Offer     
  • Exciting opportunities for professional and personal development.
  • A supportive learning environment with a strong supervision culture.
  • A collaborative workplace where quality of care and professional growth go hand in hand.
  • The chance to build a meaningful career in one of Denmark’s leading psychiatric services.

Contact and Application

Anders Magnusen
HR Consultant

  • A short introduction of yourself, including your name, country of residence and professional background.·

Ajoneuvovarustelija tekniseen kokoonpanotyöhön - tuo osaamisesi asiakkaamme tiimiin!

Etsimme asiakasyrityksellemme ajoneuvovarustelijaa. Tässä työssä pääset mekaanisessa kokoonpanossa ja osavalmistuksessa yhdistämään kädentaitosi, teknisen osaamisesi sekä tarkkuutesi osana tuotantotiimiä.

Työpäiväsi koostuvat ajoneuvojen varustelusta sekä sisustus- ja kalusterakenteiden valmistuksesta. Tehtäviin kuuluu myös erilaisia osavalmistuksen ja kokoonpanon työvaiheita. Työssä tarvitaan hyvää silmää yksityiskohdille ja kykyä tehdä siistiä sekä mittatarkkaa jälkeä.

Aikaisempi kokemus ajoneuvojen varustelusta tai ajoneuvoteollisuuden kokoonpanotehtävistä antaa hyvän pohjan tehtävässä onnistumiselle. Myös esimerkiksi puusepän, rakennusalan tai teknisen alan koulutuksesta ja työkokemuksesta on hyötyä. Tärkeää on, että tekniset piirustukset ovat sinulle tuttuja ja pystyt työskentelemään niiden mukaan.

Etsimme tekijää, joka ottaa työnsä tosissaan, mutta pitää rempseän tekemisen meiningin mukana arjessa. Huolellinen työote ja tarkka kädenjälki ovat tässä työssä tärkeässä roolissa.

Työtä tehdään yhdessä vuorossa ja palkkaus alan työehtosopimusta noudattaen sinun osaaminen ja kokemus huomioon ottaen. Mikäli yhteistyö sujuu, on sinulla mahdollisuus työllistyä asiakkaan omille kirjoille tulevaisuudessa.

jobs.title: 26-år gammel mann søker flere BPA-assistenter i 100% stilling
jobs.employer: PRIMA ASSISTANSE AS AVD MØRE OG ROMSDAL
jobs.description:
BPA-assistent søkes til sosial, aktiv og eventyrlysten 26-åring

Er du en trygg, positiv og aktiv person som liker en variert arbeidshverdag? Da kan dette være jobben for deg!

Jeg er en sosial, aktiv og eventyrlysten mann på 26 år som søker en ny BPA-assistent til teamet mitt.

Jeg er glad i å være på farten og liker blant annet trening, sykling, ski, turer, reiser og ulike aktiviteter. Samtidig setter jeg pris på rolige dager hjemme og hyggelige stunder sammen med menneskene rundt meg.

Jeg har ikke verbalt språk, og trenger derfor hjelp og tilrettelegging i alle dagligdagse gjøremål. Som BPA-assistent blir du en viktig del av hverdagen min og bidrar til at jeg kan være aktiv, delta på det jeg liker og ha en innholdsrik hverdag.

En jobb med mye variasjon

Jeg har ledig 100 % fast stilling i turnus, med vakter på dag og kveld og arbeid hver tredje helg. Dersom du ønsker en lavere stillingsprosent, kan det også være mulig å finne en løsning.

Arbeidsdagene vil variere. Noen dager er vi hjemme og tar det med ro, mens andre dager kan vi være på trening, på tur, på aktiviteter eller på ulike utflukter.

Familien min og jeg er mye på farten, og det kan derfor også bli aktuelt med helgeturer og lengre reiser, både i Norge og utlandet.

Du bør derfor like en jobb hvor du aldri helt vet hva dagen kan bringe!

Hvem ser jeg etter?

Jeg trenger en assistent som er trygg, tålmodig, oppmerksom og omsorgsfull, og som kan se hva som trengs i løpet av dagen.

Det er viktig at du er komfortabel med å hjelpe til med personlig stell og andre praktiske gjøremål, og at du kan være en trygg støtte gjennom hele dagen.

Jeg håper du:

  • har godt humør og en positiv innstilling
  • er rolig, trygg og tålmodig
  • er pålitelig og ansvarsfull
  • er oppmerksom på mine behov og signaler
  • liker aktivitet og å være på farten
  • trives med både rolige dager og dager med mer aktivitet
  • er fleksibel og komfortabel med en variert arbeidshverdag
  • har god fysisk kapasitet

Personlig egnethet er svært viktig. Du trenger ikke å ha erfaring som BPA-assistent fra før. Det viktigste er at du er motivert, lærevillig og ønsker å bidra til en trygg og god hverdag.

Arbeidsoppgaver

Som BPA-assistent vil du blant annet hjelpe meg med:

  • personlig stell og hygiene
  • måltider
  • på- og avkledning
  • daglige rutiner og gjøremål
  • aktiviteter og trening
  • turer og utflukter
  • praktiske oppgaver i hjemmet
  • reiser og helgeturer ved behov

Opplæring vil selvfølgelig bli gitt, slik at du blir trygg på oppgavene og rutinene.

Kvalifikasjoner

  • flytende norsk, både muntlig og skriftlig
  • førerkort klasse B
  • plettfri vandelsattest

Dette kan jeg tilby deg

  • 100 % fast stilling i turnus
  • mulighet for lavere stillingsprosent etter avtale
  • arbeid hver tredje helg
  • gode lønns- og arbeidsvilkår gjennom tariffavtale
  • grundig opplæring og tett oppfølging
  • en variert og aktiv arbeidshverdag
  • mulighet til å bli med på turer, aktiviteter og reiser
  • et hyggelig og inkluderende arbeidsmiljø
  • en jobb hvor du blir en viktig del av hverdagen min

Høres dette ut som deg?

Hvis du er en trygg og positiv person som liker mennesker, aktivitet og variasjon, håper jeg du vil søke.

Her får du en jobb hvor du kan være med på både hverdagslige gjøremål og spennende opplevelser – og hvor du virkelig blir en viktig person i en annens hverdag.

Jeg gleder meg til å høre fra deg!

Søknader vurderes fortløpende, og oppstart skjer etter avtale.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

BPA er en forkortelse for brukerstyrt personlig assistanse. Det er i hovedsak en alternativ måte å organisere praktisk bistand på for funksjonshemmede. BPA skiller seg fra mer tradisjonelle tjenester ved at det er personen med assistansebehov som selv bestemmer hvordan assistansen skal være. BPA er et frigjørings- og likestillingsverktøy som bidrar til at den med assistansebehov får frihet til å leve et selvstendig og aktivt liv - på lik linje med andre i samfunnet. Prima Assistanse har spesialisert seg på BPA, og er i dag en betydelig leverandør i hele Norge. Vi jobber hver dag for å bidra til at funksjonshemmede får den friheten og assistansen som er nødvendig for å kunne leve et selvstendig liv. Vi er opptatt av å levere et godt konsept, kvalitet i alle ledd, å ha profesjonelle medarbeidere og gode rutiner, slik at vi sammen bidrar til en suksessfull hverdag. Nysgjerring på hvordan det er å jobbe hos oss? Les mer på vår karriereside: https://prima-assistanse.no/karriere/jobbe-som-bpa-assistent/

jobs.title: Specification Engineer
jobs.description:
Wärtsilä Marine Power, Global Planning, is looking fora Specification Engineer to join the Specification Management team. This opportunity is offered permanently and is located in Vaasa, Finland.
Specification Management is an internal function of Global Planning. Our common target is to ensure that produced engines include sold options, and all deliveries will be completed according to the delivery schedules. We can provide a great supportive working atmosphere with highly motivated professionals in a solid cooperative team where you can also always feel free to discuss and share your ideas. You will work as one of the key persons in the middle of order to delivery process where you can see your personal performance results in practice. We are developing as a company and improving our processes and way of working all the time, so we can ensure that you will also have a role in continuous improvement actions and other development streams.

As a Specification Engineer, your work will focus on:
Creating and maintaining engine technical specifications and bill of materials according to the inputs from separate stakeholders and organizations for customer deliveries
Close cooperation with Project Management, Production, Material Management, Technology and other supportive functions
Engine specifications and bill of materials to be created and maintained according to the production program
Provide As-Manufactured bill of materials of completed deliveries for Service use
Design release implementation process


To meet the below requirements will enable you to shine in this role:

B.Sc. in Engineering, or equivalent
Demonstrable knowledge of MS-office, ERP systems (SAP) and PDM systems (Teamcenter)
Design for manufacturing and manufacturing bill of material experience
Ability to read and understand technical drawings
Knowledge of Project management
Previous experience with 4-stroke engine products
Fluency in English and Finnish, both written and verbal
Team player who engages and collaborates with others to deliver results

Why you and us?
We at Wärtsilä believe in empowerment, ownership and taking responsibility of our work. We support each others growth, and co-creation is the true basis of our innovation. We have courage to see opportunities and take initiative.
We are authentic and honest, and we strongly believe in that by being your own true self you can accomplish so much more. We dont always get it right the first time, and if mistakes are made, we make sure to learn and grow from them. We want everyone to voice their opinions freely. That is why we have built an environment that empowers you and everyone around you, and where you can feel safe and cared for. Are you eager to be part of this ambition?
We have an amazing team, and we are excited about our work and the impact it has on building sustainable societies. We are looking to find a colleague with this shared passion for smart technologies and a sustainable future.

Contact & next steps

We hope to hear from you soon by submitting your application through our careers portal. We aim to keep you updated on the process throughout.
Welcome to join us in shaping the decarbonisation of marine and energy!

jobs.title: Power System Delivery Engineer - Kognitwin Grid
jobs.description:
About Falkor

We build industrial intelligence software for heavy-asset sectors. As a KONGSBERG company backed by over 200 years of heritage, Falkor helps the energy, chemicals, utilities and other industrial sectors operate with absolute clarity, confidence, and control.

Our AI-enabled platform connects people, systems, and workflows—expanding human capability by turning complex data into real-time, actionable decisions.

We help leading organisations improve safety, efficiency and performance while redefining how heavy assets are designed and operated.

About the Position

We're looking for an experienced Power System Delivery Engineer to join our Power & Utilities team and play a key role in scaling Kognitwin Grid. Kognitwin Grid helps transmission and distribution utilities better understand, model and operate increasingly complex energy networks. As electrification accelerates and grid operators face new challenges, digital technologies are becoming critical to enabling smarter planning and operational decision-making.

This role sits at the intersection of power systems engineering, customer delivery and digital transformation. You will lead customer projects from proof-of-concept through operational deployment, working closely with utilities, engineers, data specialists and product teams to ensure our solutions deliver meaningful value for customers.

This is an opportunity to combine deep domain expertise with project leadership while helping shape the future of grid digitalisation.

What You'll Be Doing

Lead Customer Delivery

  • Lead delivery of Kognitwin Grid projects from project initiation through operational rollout.

  • Manage scope, schedules, risks, stakeholders and project governance activities.

  • Coordinate multidisciplinary teams across software engineering, data engineering and power systems experts.

  • Ensure successful execution of customer commitments and business outcomes.

Provide Power Systems Expertise

  • Act as a trusted technical advisor for transmission and distribution utility customers.

  • Apply expertise in grid planning and operations including load flow analysis, contingency analysis, hosting capacity studies and network modelling.

  • Validate and assure quality of grid models built from customer source systems.

  • Support customers in applying digital technologies to operational and planning challenges.

Understand Customer Challenges

  • Work closely with engineering, planning and operational teams to understand customer use cases and business needs.

  • Facilitate workshops and requirements-gathering sessions.

  • Translate customer challenges into practical technical solutions.

  • Build trusted relationships with key customer stakeholders.

Collaborate Across Product and Engineering Teams

  • Work with product and engineering teams to ensure customer requirements are understood and effectively addressed.

  • Provide customer feedback and market insights that help improve the product.

  • Support identification and evaluation of new use cases and future opportunities.

  • Contribute to continuous improvement of customer delivery approaches.

What We Are Looking For

Must-Have Experience

  • MSc or equivalent qualification in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems or a related discipline.

  • Experience working within power system planning, operations or grid engineering.

  • Experience working with utilities, TSOs, DSOs, consultancies or energy technology providers.

  • Knowledge of power system modelling and simulation tools such as PowerFactory, PSS®E, PandaPower, PSCAD or equivalent.

  • Experience leading technical projects involving multiple stakeholders.

  • Strong communication skills with the ability to engage both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Fluent English language skills.

Nice-to-Have Experience

  • Experience supporting grid digitalisation, advanced analytics or operational technology initiatives.

  • Experience working with digital twin platforms, grid software solutions or ADMS/DERMS technologies.

  • Exposure to product organisations, requirements management or software delivery environments.

  • Familiarity with Azure, APIs or modern data integration approaches.

  • Project management certification (PMP, PRINCE2, Agile or equivalent).

  • Additional European language capability, including Norwegian.

Why Join Falkor?

You'll be joining a company helping to redefine how utilities and industrial organisations operate through industrial intelligence.

At Falkor, you'll have the opportunity to:

  • Help accelerate the energy transition through digital innovation.

  • Work with some of the world's leading utilities and power system operators.

  • Solve complex technical challenges with real-world impact.

  • Collaborate with experts across engineering, software, product and industry domains.

  • Influence the future direction of a growing product offering.

  • Develop your expertise within a company that combines industrial heritage with advanced digital technology.

What We Offer

  • A key role within a high-growth business area.

  • Exposure to leading utilities and critical energy infrastructure.

  • Competitive compensation and benefits.

  • Flexible working arrangements.

  • Professional development and learning opportunities.

  • An inclusive and collaborative international environment.

  • The opportunity to help shape the future of grid digitalisation.

Ready to Apply?

If you're excited about combining power systems expertise, customer engagement and digital innovation to help modernise the electricity grid, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply with your CV and tell us about a project where you helped solve a complex grid planning, operational or digital transformation challenge.

Agency Notice

Falkor occasionally partners with selected recruitment agencies for specific hiring requirements. We do not accept unsolicited candidate submissions and will not be responsible for associated fees unless terms have been agreed in advance through our Procurement team.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

At Kongsberg Digital, our mission is to transform the world’s most complex and asset-intensive industries through world-leading, AI-powered digital twin technology. As a pioneer in industrial digitalization, we provide a comprehensive suite of software solutions that empower organizations to manage the full lifecycle of their assets—more efficiently, safely, and sustainably than ever before. The industry is on the cusp of a digital revolution—and we’re leading the charge. From early adoption of AI to building trusted partnerships with some of the world’s largest industrial players, we are redefining how work gets done. With domain expertise baked into every line of code and a high-calibre team united by a clear mission, we’re not just keeping pace with change—we’re setting the standard. As we expand rapidly across the Middle East and Africa, deepen our end-to-end offerings, and push the boundaries of AI, now is the perfect time to join a company that’s growing fast, thinking bold, and delivering real impact.

jobs.title: Leken, trygg og omsorgsfull? Bli med og utgjør en forskjell!

📍 Arbeidsgiver: Mio BPA
📅 Oppstart: Fortløpende
📌 Stilling: Fast 60 % og tilkallingsvikar
⏰ Arbeidstid: Dag, kveld og helg

Hei!

Jeg er en 18 år gammel jente på jakt etter en trygg, tålmodig og omsorgsfull assistent som ønsker å bli en viktig del av hverdagen min. Nå ser jeg etter en person som kan bidra til at dagene mine blir forutsigbare, innholdsrike og gode.

På fritiden liker jeg blant annet å se filmer og serier, høre på musikk, dra på byturer og kjøre små utflukter. Jeg setter pris på rolige og hyggelige stunder sammen med menneskene rundt meg. Jeg har mye humor, er glad i tøys og moro, og elsker å dele både latter og gode klemmer med dem jeg er trygg på.

Som assistent vil du være en viktig støtte i hverdagen min. Du vil hjelpe meg med alt fra struktur og planlegging til aktiviteter, kommunikasjon og personlig stell. Det viktigste er at du er en person som skaper trygghet, ser behovene mine og ønsker å bygge en god relasjon over tid.

Jeg kommuniserer med tegnspråk og andre kommunikasjonsformer. Du trenger ikke å kunne tegnspråk fra før, men du må være motivert for å lære og bruke det aktivt i arbeidshverdagen.

Stillingens art gjør at kvinner oppfordres til å søke.

Hvem ser jeg etter?

Kanskje kjenner du deg igjen i dette:

  • Du er rolig og tålmodig i møte med andre mennesker

  • Du trives med å skape struktur og forutsigbarhet

  • Du er pålitelig og møter opp som avtalt

  • Du er fleksibel når planer endrer seg

  • Du ønsker å bidra til at andre får en god hverdag

  • Du ser løsninger fremfor begrensninger

Personlig egnethet vil bli tillagt stor vekt.

Dette kan arbeidsdagen din bestå av

  • Bistand med personlig hygiene og stell

  • Skape struktur og oversikt i hverdagen

  • Aktivisering og deltakelse i aktiviteter

  • Hjelp til regulering og trygghet i ulike situasjoner

  • Lett husarbeid

  • Planlegging og tilrettelegging av aktiviteter

  • Lære og bruke tegnspråk og andre kommunikasjonsformer

Ingen dager er helt like, og derfor passer stillingen godt for deg som liker en variert og meningsfull arbeidshverdag.

Arbeidstid og stillingsstørrelse

Jeg søker nå:

Fast assistent i 60 % stilling. Stillingen innebærer arbeid i ukedager og annenhver helg.

  • Dagvakt: 08.00-15.00

  • Kveldsvakt: 15.00-21.00

Tilkallingsvikarer Som tilkallingsvikar kan du stille opp ved sykdom, ferieavvikling og annet fravær.

Kvalifikasjoner

  • Førerkort klasse B

  • Ikke allergisk mot katt eller hund

  • Gyldig politiattest må fremlegges før oppstart

  • Interesse for og motivasjon til å lære tegnspråk

Hva kan jeg tilby?

Hos meg blir du en del av et trygt og stabilt assistentteam hvor relasjoner, tillit og samarbeid står i fokus. Du får en variert arbeidshverdag hvor du virkelig kan utgjøre en forskjell, samtidig som du får muligheten til å lære nye kommunikasjonsformer og bygge verdifull erfaring.

Høres dette ut som noe for deg? Da håper jeg å høre fra deg!

Ved spørsmål angående stillingen, kontakt rekrutterer Tilde Sandvand på epost: tilde.sandvand@mio.no. Søknader sendes inn via eget søknadsskjema.

Vi tilbyr:

  • En meningsfylt jobb

MSCA Doctoral Network EMANAIRE, DC06: AI Co-Creation, Morality, and the Inner Good in Creative Industries

Position details

Recruiting institution: Hanken School of Economics, Department of Management and Organisation

Work location: Helsinki, Finland · one position

Contract: four-year, full-time doctoral scholarship · 48 months

Apply: https://hanken.rekrytointi.com/paikat/index.php?o=A_LOJ&list=1&lang=en&rspvt=bx32qk756igw8ww08c0k4sgg0w8w48c

Hanken School of Economics, Department of Management and Organisation invites applications for this four-year doctoral scholarship in the EMANAIRE project, PhD project: AI Co-Creation, Morality, and the Inner Good in Creative Industries.

About EMANAIRE

EMANAIRE is a Marie Skłodowska-Curie Actions Doctoral Network bringing together 15 doctoral candidates at nine European universities to study how AI is changing work. Its projects examine what happens when generative and agentic AI enters leadership, everyday workflows, team communication, professional learning and career decisions. Across the network, human agency means the practical ability to understand AI-supported decisions, exercise judgement, question outputs and shape how work is organised. Each researcher joins an international cohort, receives supervision across institutions and takes part in three residential schools, methods workshops, monthly research seminars and joint work with organisations beyond academia. Every project includes extensive engagement with industrial partner (e.g. in terms of data collection and development of practice).

The doctoral project

What happens to the value and purpose of creative work when people create alongside AI? This project studies how AI agents, AI-mediated processes and platform algorithms reshape co-creation and moral questions in creative industries. It follows employees, freelancers and studios as they negotiate changes to their work and business models. Through ethnographic fieldwork you will research what practitioners value within the activity of making creative work, and how that changes across human, hybrid and automated practices. The project aims to develop a practice-based account of co-creation and offer guidance for organisations and policymakers seeking equitable, responsible and sustainable creative work.

Your work

- Study how AI agents and platform algorithms reshape co-creation, moral questions and business models in creative industries.
- Conduct ethnographic fieldwork with employees, freelancers and studios.
- Examine what practitioners value in creative work across human, hybrid and automated practices.
- Develop a practice-based account and guidance for equitable, responsible and sustainable creative work.
- Refine the research questions and design with the supervision team and prepare ethics, data-management and open-science materials.
- Complete a doctoral thesis and related research outputs under the host doctoral programme and EMANAIRE plan.
- Take part in local and network-wide training, cohort activities, reviews, dissemination and practitioner engagement.
- Participate in teaching related activities at the Department of Management and Organisation.
- Undertake collaboration with the industry partner and a separate academic mobility visit.
- Contribute to research integrity, equality, responsible AI, open science and FAIR data practices.

Supervision, training and mobility

Project contact: Mikko Vesa (mikko.vesa@hanken.fi).

Main supervisor: Professor Mikko Vesa (Hanken School of Economics).

Current DoA plan: The Doctoral researcher is expected to spend a period of time at an industrial partner conducting the ethnographic research and contributing to practice.

Academic mobility visit: At least three months at another partner institution of the EMANAIRE network.

The researcher will complete at least 60 ECTS of doctoral coursework, including at least 10 ECTS through network-wide provision. EMANAIRE combines local doctoral courses with three residential schools, monthly paper-development seminars, work-package workshops and network reviews. A Personal Career Development Plan will be agreed within the first three months and reviewed every six months.

About Hanken School of Economics

Hanken School of Economics is one of the leading business schools in the Nordic countries. It is located in Finland, with campuses in Helsinki and Vaasa. Hanken offers a range of B.Sc., M.Sc., EMBA, PhD, and Executive Development programmes taught mainly in English and Swedish. The School has close ties to the business community and an active alumni network with over 13 800 alumni working in more than 70 countries. The School is accredited by AACSB, AMBA, and EQUIS. The Hanken Masters in Management programme was ranked #56 by the Financial Times in 2026. Hanken is recognized for its research quality, its international orientation, and its focus on sustainability.

Hanken is part of the European ENGAGE.EU European university alliance, that collaborates in the area of doctoral education by creating common practices and offering courses across member universities. The Department of Management and Organisation is recognized for its outstanding research in areas such as organisation studies, human resource management, business ethics and strategic entrepreneurship. The doctoral programme at Hanken is designed as a four-year full-time education, consisting of coursework, thesis work and teaching. Hanken provides comprehensive support throughout the doctoral journey, including supervision, study administration, performance monitoring, and assistance with funding. There is also support for applying for postdoctoral research funding.

Who we are looking for

Applicants should hold, or be close to completing by the start date, a relevant master's degree or equivalent and demonstrate the potential to undertake independent doctoral research. Research, policy or industry experience relevant to the project is advantageous.

In order to be accepted as a Doctoral Researcher at Hanken, applicants must fulfill the formal admission requirements for PhD studies#_msocom_1: https://www.hanken.fi/en/apply/application/phd-programme/attachments . A Masters

Hanken School of Economics, Department of Management and Organisation invites applications for this four-year doctoral scholarship in the EMANAIRE project, PhD project: AI-Mediated Communication and Collaboration Norms at Work.

About EMANAIRE

EMANAIRE is a Marie Skłodowska-Curie Actions Doctoral Network bringing together 15 doctoral candidates at nine European universities to study how AI is changing work. Its projects examine what happens when generative and agentic AI enters leadership, everyday workflows, team communication, professional learning and career decisions. Across the network, human agency means the practical ability to understand AI-supported decisions, exercise judgement, question outputs and shape how work is organised. Each researcher joins an international cohort, receives supervision across institutions and takes part in three residential schools, methods workshops, monthly research seminars and joint work with organisations beyond academia. Every project includes extensive engagement with industrial partner (e.g. in terms of data collection and development of practice).

The doctoral project

As AI becomes embedded in everyday work, employees increasingly interact with AI agents, but also encounter AI-mediated contributions from colleagues. Messages may be written, filtered or delivered with AI, while autonomous agents increasingly participate in work processes and collaboration.

This doctoral project examines how these developments shape relational aspects of work, (which may include authenticity, trust, social connection, and experiences of loneliness), as people negotiate emerging norms around AI use, disclosure, and appropriate forms of interaction. Through ethnographic research in AI-intensive settings, you will follow relational practices as they evolve over time and identify the mechanisms behind change.

The project will develop evidence-based guidance that supports transparency, social connection and responsible AI use in organisational life. Practitioner outputs include AI- aware communication norms, guidance on disclosure and authenticity in AI-assisted exchanges, and leadership practices that protect social connection and prevent relational deterioration. In addition, the doctoral project is expected to advance scientific knowledge in relation to the doctoral topic.

Your work

- Examine how interactions among people, AI agents and AI-mediated communication shape workplace relationships and collaboration.
- Conduct ethnographic research on how employees make sense of and negotiate AI use in workplace interactions, including norms of disclosure and transparency, and how these processes shape relational aspects of work.
- Identify the mechanisms through which AI-mediated contributions and autonomous agents reshape relational dynamics, and develop evidence-based guidance for responsible and socially sustainable AI use.
- Develop AI-aware communication norms and leadership guidance that protect social connection at work.
- Refine the research questions and design with the supervision team and prepare ethics, data-management and open-science materials.
- Complete a doctoral thesis and related research outputs under the host doctoral programme and EMANAIRE plan.
- Take part in local and network-wide training, cohort activities, reviews, dissemination and practitioner engagement.
- Participate in teaching related activities at the Department of Management and Organisation.
- Undertake collaboration with the industry partner and a separate academic mobility visit.
- Contribute to research integrity, equality, responsible AI, open science and FAIR data practices.

Supervision, training and mobility

Project contact: Emma Nordbäck (emma.nordback@hanken.fi).

Main supervisor: Associate Professor Emma Nordbäck (Hanken School of Economics).

Current DoA plan: The Doctoral researcher is expected to spend a period of time at an industrial partner conducting the ethnographic research and contributing to practice.

Academic mobility visit: At least three months at another partner institution of the EMANAIRE network.

The researcher will complete at least 60 ECTS of doctoral coursework, including at least 10 ECTS through network-wide provision. EMANAIRE combines local doctoral courses with three residential schools, monthly paper-development seminars, work-package workshops and network reviews. A Personal Career Development Plan will be agreed within the first three months and reviewed every six months.

About Hanken School of Economics

Hanken School of Economics is one of the leading business schools in the Nordic countries. It is located in Finland, with campuses in Helsinki and Vaasa. Hanken offers a range of B.Sc., M.Sc., EMBA, PhD, and Executive Development programmes taught mainly in English and Swedish. The School has close ties to the business community and an active alumni network with over 13 800 alumni working in more than 70 countries. The School is accredited by AACSB, AMBA, and EQUIS. The Hanken Masters in Management programme was ranked #56 by the Financial Times in 2026. Hanken is recognized for its research quality, its international orientation, and its focus on sustainability.

Hanken is part of the European ENGAGE.EU European university alliance, that collaborates in the area of doctoral education by creating common practices and offering courses across member universities. The Department of Management and Organisation is recognized for its outstanding research in areas such as organisation studies, human resource management, business ethics and strategic entrepreneurship.
