REJOIGNEZ TECHNOSWISS À LA CHAUX-DE-FONDS (SUISSE) POUR UN POSTE DE MÉCANICIEN MONTEUR AU CŒUR DE LA MICROTECHNIQUE.

Technoswiss recrute un Mécanicien Monteur (H/F) pour son site de La Chaux-de-Fonds. C'est l'opportunité d'évoluer au sein d'une équipe experte dans le domaine passionnant de la microtechnique et de l'horlogerie de précision.

PRENEZ EN CHARGE LE MONTAGE COMPLET ET LA MISE AU POINT D'ÉQUIPEMENTS DE HAUTE PRÉCISION.

Sous l'autorité du responsable de site, vous réaliserez l'assemblage de pièces mécaniques dans le plus grand respect des tolérances.
Vos missions principales :
- Réaliser l'assemblage, le montage et la mise en géométrie d'ensembles mécaniques ou de structures à partir d'un plan.
- Participer à la mise en route et au SAV (maintenance) chez les clients, principalement en Suisse Romande (20% à 40% du temps).
- Effectuer le câblage et le raccordement des équipements hydrauliques et pneumatiques.
- Mettre au point les systèmes mécaniques et réaliser les retouches sur machines traditionnelles.
- Réaliser les tests de fonctionnement ainsi que les contrôles visuels et dimensionnels pour garantir la conformité.
- Transmettre vos compétences et former les nouveaux collaborateurs au poste.
- Saisir vos temps d'activité sur CLIPPER et assurer l'emballage des machines avant expédition.

INTÉGREZ UNE ENTREPRISE EXPERTE EN SOLUTIONS DE PRÉCISION POUR LES SECTEURS DE L'HORLOGERIE ET DU MÉDICAL.

Spécialisée dans la microtechnique, Technoswiss conçoit et fabrique des machines à tailler numériques et des équipements d'usinage spécifiques. Implantée à La Chaux-de-Fonds, elle s'appuie sur un bureau d'étude et un atelier de 400 m² pour répondre aux besoins exigeants des industries horlogères et médicales (productions unitaires et petites séries).

POURQUOI VOUS ALLEZ AIMER CE POSTE ? ÉVOLUEZ DANS UN ENVIRONNEMENT TECHNIQUE STIMULANT ET DÉVELOPPEZ VOTRE SAVOIR-FAIRE SUR DES PROJETS MÉCANIQUES VARIÉS.

Ce poste offre un cadre de travail stimulant centré sur la précision. Vous interviendrez sur des projets complets, de l'étude à la mise au point d'équipements complexes comme des transferts rotatifs multi-axes. Vous rejoindrez une petite équipe passionnée au sein d'un atelier moderne, idéal pour les professionnels de la mécanique fine.

HORAIRES ET RYTHME DE TRAVAIL

- Contrat de 42h/semaine.
- 20% à 40% du temps en maintenance chez les clients (Suisse Romande).

PROFIL RECHERCHÉ

Formation : Formation technique en lien avec le poste.
Expérience : Au moins 3 ans sur un poste similaire.

SAVOIR-FAIRE

- Lecture et interprétation de plans industriels et dossiers de fabrication.
- Maîtrise de l'ajustage, du montage mécanique, du réglage de géométrie et de l'assemblage.
- Réalisation de raccordements hydrauliques et pneumatiques ; utilisation de commandes numériques.
- Contrôles dimensionnels et géométriques selon les côtes tolérancées.
- Utilisation de la bureautique (Pack Office), de Solidworks et du logiciel Clipper.
- Anglais technique et maîtrise des techniques de manutention/emballage.

SAVOIR-ÊTRE

- Pédagogie et capacité à transmettre son savoir.
- Rigueur et précision dans le respect des procédures.
- Polyvalence et sens du service lors des interventions chez le client.

jobs.title: Begeleider wonen WBC Aan de Pas in Bunde
jobs.description:
Grensarbeid zoekt voor Stichting Wonen Plus een begeleider wonen WBC Aan de Pas.

Onze cliënten
Je werkt of gaat naar school, je gaat op vakantie, maakt heerlijke uitjes, voedt kinderen op. Je leidt het leven dat je wilt en je maakt daarin jouw keuzes. En dan opeens gebeurt er iets waardoor alles niet meer vanzelfsprekend is. Een auto-ongeluk, een hersenbloeding, een ziekte; je mogelijkheden zijn opeens beperkt door het hersenletsel dat je hebt opgelopen. Van de ene op de andere dag is er een breuk in jouw levenslijn.
Al onze cliënten hebben iets gemeenschappelijks. Vanuit het “normale” leven dat iedereen leefde, is er dat moment geweest dat alles drastisch veranderde en er ineens een beroep gedaan moest worden op professionele zorg. SGL is de NAH expert die juist deze mensen helpt in hun stap om weer regie terug te krijgen. Fysieke ondersteuning, mentale ondersteuning, begeleiding en professionele zorg, allemaal afgestemd op elke cliënt afzonderlijk.
Voor ons is het vanzelfsprekend dat iedereen dromen, wensen en doelen heeft. Dus ook als je een beperking hebt. Iedereen wil actief meedoen in de samenleving, zich kunnen ontwikkelen en keuzes maken. Bij SGL helpen we mensen daarbij.

Onze medewerkers
Je ziet de mens achter de beperkingen en je wilt je erin verdiepen om hem of haar goed te begeleiden en te verzorgen. Iedere mens is anders, jij stemt daarom jouw handelen af op de behoefte van deze unieke persoon. Je bent nieuwsgierig naar zijn of haar mogelijkheden ondanks de breuk in de levenslijn en zoekt hoe je hem of haar zoveel mogelijk de eigen regie kan geven. Ook begeleid je de client in het contact met mede cliënten. Groepsdynamiek vind je interessant, conflictsituaties ervaar je als een uitdaging. Uitvoeren van verzorgende taken vind je vanzelfsprekend.
Je denkt in mogelijkheden, durft grenzen te stellen, je bent daadkrachtig en een no-nonsense type.
Met collega’s bespreek je je eigen handelen en hoe je als team nog betere begeleiding kan bieden. Waar nodig stem je af met collega’s van behandeling & expertise of met andere professionals zoals de huisarts, apotheek, zorgpartners. Samen zijn jullie verantwoordelijk voor de acties die beschreven staan in het ondersteuningsplan. Krachten van het hele team worden gebundeld en op maat ingezet voor onze cliënten. De cultuur waarin we samenwerken is te beschrijven als een grote familie.

Waar ga je aan de slag?
Woonbegeleidingscentrum Aan de pas is een thuis voor mensen met een lichamelijke beperking. Binnen Aan de pas wordt niet alleen gewoond, maar wordt ook gelogeerd en er worden verschillende vormen van dagbesteding aangeboden in en uit huis en leuke variërende vrijetijdsactiviteiten.
Er wonen 20 volwassen met een niet aangeboren hersenletsel en er zijn 2 logeerplekken. Naast begeleiding hebben zij ook persoonlijke verzorging nodig.
Ook verpleegtechnische handelingen zijn aan de orde. Specifiek in WBC Aan de Pas is dat een aantal bewoners met spierziekte ook afhankelijk zijn van beademing.
Cliënten beschikken allen over een eigen appartement en kunnen gebruik maken van een gezamenlijke huiskamer.
Een werkdag start met bewoners uit bed halen, douchen en verzorgen zodat zij op tijd klaar staan voor de taxi naar het activiteitencentrum of werk. Je zorgt voor een zinvolle dag voor alle bewoners. Deze locatie kent een “wakkere” nachtdienst van twee SGL medewerkers.

Wat breng jij mee

  • Je hebt een vakgerichte mbo 3 opleiding afgerond ,Verzorgende IG, verpleegkundige, MMZ persoonlijk begeleider gehandicaptenzorg of SPW
  • Je bent in staat om snel te kunnen schakelen in verschillende ondersteuningsvragen
  • Je hebt een zelfstandige werkhouding, bent initiatiefrijk en kunt tevens goed werken in teamverband
  • Je bent bereid tot het werken in een onregelmatig dienstrooster, vaste voorkeur is mogelijk
  • Je herkent jezelf in de drie kerncompetenties samenwerken, eigenaarschap en zelfreflectie
  • Je hebt een proactieve houding, werkt vanuit de ondersteuningsvraag en bent in staat om cliënten vertrouwen te geven in hun eigen kunnen
  • Je hebt lef, bent nieuwsgierig, enthousiast, en krijgt mensen mee.

jobs.title: Project Engineer, ABB Marine & Ports
jobs.description:
We are looking for a motivated Project Engineer to join ABB Marine & Ports and support the delivery of advanced marine electrical, propulsion, and control system projects.

This is an excellent opportunity for a recent graduate or an early-career engineer who wants to develop technical expertise within a global engineering organization and gain hands-on experience in international delivery projects.

Your responsibilities

As a Project Engineer, you will:

- Support Lead Engineers in delivery project engineering and design activities
- Assist in technical problem-solving throughout the project lifecycle
- Participate in Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT) and related engineering activities
- Prepare and maintain technical documentation
- Collaborate with multidisciplinary engineering teams on system integration and troubleshooting
- Contribute to the development and improvement of engineering processes and ways of working
- Support project teams in ensuring successful project execution and delivery

You will have the opportunity to work with systems such as:

- Generators
- Main switchboards and power distribution systems
- Transformers
- Converters and drives
- Propulsion Control Systems (PCS)
- Remote Control Systems (RCS)
- Dynamic Positioning (DP) systems
- Marine automation and control systems

What we are looking for

To succeed in this role, we hope you have:

- Degree in Electrical Engineering, Automation Engineering, or a related field
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
- Good written and spoken English communication skills
- Ability to work effectively in an international project environment
- A proactive attitude and willingness to learn
- Interest in electrical systems, automation, and engineering projects

Considered an advantage

- Familiarity with EPLAN or other electrical design tools
- Knowledge of IEC or IEEE standards
- Previous project, internship, or thesis experience related to electrical engineering or automation
- Interest in marine technology and power systems

What we offer

- Opportunity to work with world-leading marine technologies
- Exposure to challenging international delivery projects
- Great opportunities for professional growth and development

Submit your application as soon as possible, as we will review applications and interview suitable candidates during the application period. The position will be filled once a suitable candidate has been found.

Please note that, for GDPR and data security reasons, we are unable to process applications submitted by email or through other channels. To be considered for the position, please submit your application through our recruitment system on our website.

jobs.title: Product Manager | Intch
jobs.description:
About Intch

Intch is a professional social network with a marketplace for part-time work. You can think of it as a professional network built for senior specialists who take on meaningful contracts alongside their main work. A typical contract lasts from three to six months. The product is used in 140 countries and is available in up to 20 languages. Intch has fewer than 40 people and four product areas, with three already live and one preparing to launch. Intch is rethinking how people and companies find each other and build trust online.

What you’ll do

  • Own the B2C product end to end, including its P&L.

  • Set the product direction and own the 3–6 month roadmap across strategy, experimentation, and delivery.

  • Drive growth through hypothesis-driven experiments and measurable improvements in acquisition, activation, and retention.

  • Own the product metrics and use data to guide decisions and prioritisation.

  • Conduct CustDev interviews and build a deep understanding of user behaviour across a global, multilingual audience.

  • Partner with the B2B product teams to make the B2C product the connective layer across Intch’s product ecosystem.

  • Report directly to the founder and take over the product vertical they currently lead.

What you need to succeed

  • 5+ years of experience in product management.

  • A strong B2C growth track record, including experiments, acquisition, and measurable results.

  • Proven experience scaling a product that already has strong product–market fit.

  • A strong record of improving key metrics such as growth, activation, and retention.

  • Strong product sense and a hypothesis-driven approach to problem-solving.

  • Comfort working with data and translating insights into action.

  • Experience working in a startup or another fast-moving, high-ownership environment.

  • High autonomy, accountability, and comfort working without micromanagement.

  • Fluent Russian.

What you get

  • Full ownership of a profitable, fast-growing product and its P&L, reporting directly to the founder.

  • A deliberately compact team (under 40 people) where everyone has a large area of ownership and streamlined collaboration.

  • Metrics-driven culture: every function, including support and payments, owns numbers. Your P&L is your scoreboard.

  • Flat, cross-pollinating structure: anyone in the company can bring a validated idea to your product. You can do the same across other verticals.

  • Paid vacation and sick leave.

jobs.title: Payment Performance Analyst Intern
jobs.description:
Hi, we’re Back Market.

We’re here to help make tech reliable, affordable, and better than new. We're a global marketplace for refurbished devices, helping lower our collective environmental impact by providing trustworthy, affordable tech with 92% less carbon emissions than new.

Yep, you read that right. Turns out refurbished tech is way better for the planet than new. In fact, With every device purchased on Back Market, our positive impact on the planet grows. From our Customer Care representatives to our software engineer, every individual at Back Market cuts the planet — and consumers — a break. Our mission is simple: to do more with what we already have.

Are you ready to join us?

As our Payment Analyst Intern, you will be responsible for conducting AD HOC analysis on the payments performance and risks of Back Market globally, help the team for projects by providing rigor analysis and automate internal processes. This role also involves monitoring our payment metrics, assisting with reporting and benchmarking best practices.

YOUR MISSION (IF YOU ACCEPT IT): 🥇

  • Conduct ad hoc analysis on the payment performance, build dashboards regarding performance metrics.

  • Help build several processes to automate the seller payment process and operations (debt monitoring, KYB, seller’s associated risks).

  • Participate in the construction of new products & services on the platform and support the technical team in charge of payment to successfully implement them (Card payment optimization, alternative payment methods, etc).

  • Monitor and report our payment and KYB/deposit metrics: performance, adoption, costs.

  • Benchmark best practices of current and future markets regarding local payment methods, and consumer buying habits.

YOU ARE IN THE RIGHT PLACE IF: ⭐

  • Looking for a 6-month internship from July 2026

  • English is a no-brainer (fully professional capability). If you’re extra cool and speak more languages, bonus points for you!

  • You have a first experience in e-commerce, ideally, you already know the world of payment.

  • You are familiar with (and love) numbers and have an excellent command of SQL, Excel, Tableau (or any other Data Visualization tool).

  • You are a Swiss Army knife, you are adaptable and enthusiastic about tackling a variety of tasks, embracing challenges.

ABOUT THE INTERNSHIP ℹ️

  • Starting date: January 2027

  • Duration: 6 months (until June 2027)

  • Schedule: Full-time (35H/week)

  • Location: Paris, France

  • Contract: Internship agreement from your French school required

RECRUITMENT PROCESS: 📅

  • Video-call Skills fit interview and Live case study with another person in the team (45min)

  • Video-call Interview with the Talent Acquisition Specialist (30min)

At Back Market, we’re committed to hiring and supporting diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives — it’s one of the reasons we’re such a high-scoring certified B Corp company (93.2).

No matter your role and seniority level, you’ll enjoy impact-driven work with hands-on career development in an innovative, driven, and fast-paced environment — with benefits to match, like:

- A mission driven work environment where your day to day makes an impact on the planet. Seriously.

- Hybrid work environment, with 2 remote days a week and 1 remote work week per quarter, plus 3 flex days.

- Employee Resource Groups, including mentorship programs, comprehensive accessibility policies, and cultural competency training.

At Back Market, we strive to create a workplace that embodies the world we’re trying to change. We’ve embedded our diversity, equity, and inclusion principles into our DNA — from dedicated staff to employee resource groups to our company values.

We know that the perfect background for a role doesn’t mean the perfect fit — we encourage you to apply for a role even if you think you may not have all the qualifications.

If reasonable accommodations are needed for the interview process, please do not hesitate to discuss this with the Talent Acquisition Team.

jobs.title: Director, Business Development
jobs.description:
About TransPerfect

TransPerfect is the world's largest privately held provider of language services and technology solutions. With over 100 offices globally and more than 5,000 full-time employees, we work with the world's leading organisations across Legal, Corporate, Life Sciences, Financial, and Creative sectors to help them communicate, operate, and grow across languages, cultures, and markets.

 

Following our acquisition of The Mill — one of the world's most acclaimed creative studios — TransPerfect now offers an expanded suite of creative production services, including Artistic Direction, VFX, and Motion Design, serving luxury, fashion, beauty, and lifestyle brands globally.

Role Overview

We are looking for a Director of Business Development to join our Corporate vertical in France. This is a pure new business hunter role — your mission is to identify, prospect, and close net new accounts across TransPerfect's full portfolio of services.

You will be selling into mid-to-large corporate accounts across a broad range of industries, with a particular focus on sectors where TransPerfect's expanded capabilities — including creative production via The Mill — create strong differentiation and cross-sell opportunity.

This role is ideal for a commercially driven professional who combines structured B2B sales discipline with genuine curiosity about creative, digital, and linguistic services.

What You Will Sell

You will represent TransPerfect's full Corporate service portfolio, including:

  • Translation & Localisation** — documents, marketing, legal, technical, and digital content

  • Interpretation** — simultaneous, consecutive, remote (RSI)

  • Technology & AI Solutions** — GlobalLink TMS, MT/MTPE, AI-powered workflows

  • Digital & Multimedia** — subtitling, dubbing, voice-over, e-learning localisation

  • Creative Production (The Mill)** — Artistic Direction, VFX, Motion Design for luxury, fashion, beauty, and lifestyle brands

  • Globalisation Consulting** — content strategy, workflow optimisation, language asset management

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Build and manage a pipeline of net new business across the French and European corporate market

  • Identify and engage key decision-makers — CMOs, Heads of Communication, Procurement Directors, Creative Directors, and Heads of Production

  • Develop tailored pitches and proposals that draw on the full breadth of TransPerfect's service offering, including creative capabilities

  • Lead the full sales cycle from prospecting to close, including RFP/RFI responses, commercial negotiation, and contract finalisation

  • Collaborate with internal teams (Solutions, Operations, The Mill creative teams) to design compelling, client-specific solutions

  • Represent TransPerfect at industry events, trade shows, and networking forums

  • Contribute to market intelligence — identify trends, competitor movements, and emerging client needs

  • Report pipeline, forecast, and activity accurately


Experience

  • Minimum 3–7 years of B2B sales experience, with a strong track record in new business development

jobs.title: PhD Candidate in AI-Assisted Software and Systems Engineering
jobs.description:
This is NTNU

NTNU is a broad-based university with a technical-scientific profile and a focus in professional education. The university is located in three cities with headquarters in Trondheim.

At NTNU, 9,000 employees and 43,000 students work to create knowledge for a better world.

You will find more information about working at NTNU and the application process here.

   

Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_KHQjc4ndas&t=41sAbout the position

Are you motivated to take a step towards a doctorate and open up exciting career opportunities? As a PhD candidate with us, you will work to achieve your doctorate, and at the same time gain valuable experience that qualifies you for a further career in higher education and research, in and outside academia. 

The Software Engineering group conducts research in a wide range of topics related to design, development, verification, and operation of complex software systems, including emerging technologies and their relation to Software Engineering. You will join a diverse research environment and an exciting Doctoral Programme.

Your immediate leader will be the Leader of the Software Engineering unit.


About the project

Software is today prominent in many critical systems and infrastructures, such as power distribution systems, railway infrastructure, or flight control systems. These systems are subject to complex development and verification processes, including certification and audits, and in general different activities that span the Software Engineering and the Systems Engineering disciplines.

Generative AI and AI agents are rapidly changing how software-based systems are being designed, developed, and evaluated. While AI agents have become common in certain Software Engineering tasks, such as programming, documentation, and vulnerability detection, their adoption for other tasks such as software architecture design, or safety and hazard analysis, is still limited. 

The objective of this position is to investigate and evaluate solutions for software engineering and systems engineering tasks in critical systems and infrastructures. Within this context, the project can be tailored to the interests and background of the successful candidate.


Duties of the position
  • Complete the doctoral education until obtaining a doctorate
  • Carry out research of good quality within the framework described above
  • Author academic publications and popular science dissemination material
  • Participate in the Software Engineering research group
  • Participate in international activities such as conferences and/or research stays at foreign educational institutions
  • Support to education activities in courses within the Software Engineering area
  • Other career-promoting work, such as learning grant preparation fundamentals

Be prepared for changes to your work duties after employment.


Required selection criteria
  • You must meet the requirements for admission to the Doctoral Programme in Computer Science, see Section 6-1 of the PhD regulations for more information.
  • You must have a relevant Master's degree in Computer Science or equivalent. Your degree must include a major independent project (minimum 30 ECTS) equivalent to a master’s thesis.
  • Master students can apply, but the master's degree must be obtained and documented before starting the position and no later than 30.10.2026.
  • You must have a strong and relevant academic background from your previous studies and have an average grade from your Master's degree study, or equivalent education, which is equal to B or better compared to NTNU's grading scale. If you do not have letter grades from previous studies, you must have an equally good academic foundation. If you have a weaker academic background, you may be considered if you can document that you are exceptionally suited for a PhD education, for example through relevant work experience and/or peer-reviewed academic works.
  • Good programming skills.
  • Good oral and written presentation skills in English.
     

The appointment is to be made in accordance with NTNUs guidelines for recruitment positions for general criteria for the position.


Preferred selection criteria

The following characteristics will be considered an advantage during the selection process:

  • Good understanding of Software Engineering or Systems Engineering fundamentals
  • Experience with modeling of software and/or system architecture
  • Experience with agentic frameworks (e.g., LangChain, Microsoft Agent Framework)
  • Good knowledge of AI concepts, particularly Generative AI
  • Knowledge of aspects related to critical systems and infrastructures

Personal characteristics

To complete a doctoral degree (PhD), it is important that you are able to: 

  • Work in a structured way, set goals and make plans to achieve them
  • Present and discuss your research with other professionals
  • Work constructively under pressure or in the face of adversity 
  • Be good at anticipating problems and identifying logical solutions as well as contradictions and inconsistencies  
  • Be flexible and open to adjusting the plan for the project as needed
     

Emphasis will be placed on personal qualities.


We offer

.

  • An exciting job with an important mission in society
  • Developing tasks in a strong and international professional environment
  • Career guidance and follow-up during the PhD period
  • Open and inclusive working environment with committed colleagues
  • Working capital that can be used to implement the project
  • Mentor programme as a new employee at NTNU
  • Favorable terms as a member of the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund (SPK)
  • Free Norwegian language training at a basic level (A2)

As a PhD Candidate at NTNU, you will have access to employee benefits.


Diversity

Diversity is a strength, and at NTNU we aim to be an employer that reflects the diversity in society and that makes use of the potential of the population's collective skills. Our vision is Knowledge for a better world and our values ​​are creative, critical, constructive and respectful. We believe that an organization that is equal, diverse and gender-balanced is essential for us to achieve our goals. 

We strive to attract employees with different skills, life experiences and perspectives to contribute to even better problem solving of our societal mission in research and education. 

If you think this position is relevant and interesting, we encourage you to apply, regardless of gender, functional ability and cultural background, or whether you have been out of work for a period of time.

At NTNU we want to increase the proportion of women in scientific positions. We have a number of measures to promote equality. 


Salary and conditions

In the position of PhD Candidate, code 1017, your gross salary will normally be NOK 580 000,-per annum depending on qualifications and seniority. A 2% statutory contribution to the State Pension Fund is deducted from the salary. 

The employment period is 3 years for the doctoral work in addition to 1 year of career promotion work.

For employment as a PhD Candidate, it is a prerequisite that you gain admission to the PhD programme in Computer Science within three months of your employment contract start date, and that you participate in an organized doctoral programme throughout the period of employment.

As an employee at NTNU, it is important that you keep yourself up to date with academic and organizational changes and adapt to them.

For the necessary professional and social interaction, it is a prerequisite that you are physically present and available to the institution on a daily basis.

The appointment is carried out in accordance with the principles of the State Employees Act, and Export control (legislation that regulates the export of knowledge, technology and services). Candidates who, after assessment of the application and attachments, are considered to be in conflict with the criteria in the latter act, will not be able to be employed.


About the application

The attachments (including a description of your scientific work) must accompany the application as these documents form the basis of the application assessment. The documents must be in English.

Please note: the application will only be assessed on the basis of the information we have received by the application deadline. Therefore, make sure that your application clearly shows how your skills and experience meet the criteria described above. The application and all attachments must be sent electronically via Jobbnorge.no. If you are invited to an interview, you must bring certified copies of certificates and diplomas upon request.

The application must include:

  • Transcripts and diplomas for Bachelor's and Master's degrees.
  • CV.
  • Copy of Master's thesis. If you have recently submitted your Master's thesis, you can attach a draft of the thesis. Documentation of a completed Master's degree must be presented before taking up the position.
  • Project outline containing your own research proposal within the topics of this position, including a description of research questions, methodological design for the project and progress plan (maximum 1500 words/4 pages).
  • Short motivation letter (cover letter) (maximum 400 words/1 page).
  • Scientific publications if you have, or other relevant work that fits the position topics.
  • Names and contact information of three references.
     

If all, or parts, of your education has been taken abroad, we also ask you to attach documentation of the scope and quality of your entire education, both Bachelor's and Master's education, in addition to other higher education. If your institution uses “diploma supplement” (normal for most European institutions), you must attach this. A description of the documentation required can also be found here. If you already have a statement from Norwegian Directorate for Higher Education and Skills (HK-dir), please attach this as well.

Joint work will be considered. If it is difficult to identify your contribution to joint work, you must attach a brief description of your participation.

When assessing the best qualified, we emphasize necessary qualifications such as education, experience and personal suitability. Motivation for the position, ambitions, and potential for research will also count when assessing the candidates.

NTNU recognizes a wide range of academic contributions and has committed itself to The San Francisco Declaration on Research Assessment and CoARA (responsible assessment of research and recognition of a greater breadth of academic contributions in accordance with NTNU's social mission).


General information

A public list of applicants with name, age, job title and municipality of residence is prepared after the application deadline. If you wish to be exempt from entry on the public applicant list, this must be justified. Assessment will be made in accordance with current legislation. You will be notified if the exemption is not granted.

If you think this position looks interesting and in line with your qualifications, you are welcome to apply.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Associate Professor Leonardo Montecchi, +47 734 12 964, leonardo.montecchi@ntnu.no. 

If you have any questions about the recruitment process, please contact our HR hiring team at HR@IDI.ntnu.no.

Application deadline: 08.10.2026

For practical information about working at NTNU, please visit this webpage. 

The city of Trondheim is a modern European city with a rich cultural scene. Trondheim is the tech capital of Norway with a population of 200,000. The Norwegian welfare state, including healthcare, schools, kindergartens and overall equality, is probably the best of its kind in the world. Professional subsidized day-care for children is easily available. Furthermore, Trondheim offers great opportunities for education (including international schools) and possibilities to enjoy nature, culture and family life and has low crime rates and clean air quality.

NTNU - knowledge for a better world

The Norwegian University of Science and Technology (NTNU) creates knowledge for a better world and solutions that can change everyday life.

We are the leading academic IT environment in Norway, and offer a wide range of theoretical and applied IT programmes of study at all levels. Our subject areas include hardware, algorithms, visual computing, AI, databases, software engineering, information systems, learning technology, HCI, CSCW, IT operations and applied data processing. The Department has groups in both Trondheim and Gjøvik. The Department of Computer Science is one of seven departments in the Faculty of Information Technology and Electrical Engineering .

jobs.title: Associate Director, Medical Affairs
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Associate Director, Medical Affairs based in France.

As Associate Director, Medical Affairs, you will serve as a scientific leader and subject-matter expert across a broad range of Medical Affairs activities. You will independently lead high-value workstreams spanning thought leader engagement, scientific congresses, medical communications, publications, literature surveillance, and insight generation. The role combines external scientific engagement with strategic ownership of programs that support the product lifecycle. You will translate clinical evidence and stakeholder insights into practical recommendations that shape Medical Affairs priorities. You will also collaborate closely with cross-functional teams and provide trained backup support for selected Pharmacovigilance, Medical Information, and Product Complaint activities. This is a remote opportunity within a purpose-driven, collaborative healthcare environment, with approximately 20% travel for congresses and external engagements.


Accountabilities

  • Serve as a scientific subject-matter expert, translating clinical evidence, stakeholder insights, and emerging scientific developments into balanced, actionable recommendations for Medical Affairs strategy.

  • Develop and maintain compliant relationships with key thought leaders (KTLs), healthcare professionals, and other external scientific experts.

  • Plan and conduct scientific exchanges, advisory boards, roundtables, consensus initiatives, and other external engagements aligned with Medical Affairs objectives.

  • Develop KTL engagement plans, define interaction objectives, document scientific insights, and coordinate appropriate follow-up with Medical Affairs leadership.

  • Provide scientific coverage at national and selected regional congresses, including program assessment, session prioritization, coverage planning, KTL preparation, insight capture, and post-congress reporting.

  • Lead the scientific strategy and execution of Medical Affairs booths, including educational content, scientific exchange, medical inquiry routing, insight collection, and post-congress analysis.

  • Partner with Medical Affairs Operations on congress logistics, vendors, contracts, and budget administration.

  • Lead or support scientific communications, including medical education materials, congress resources, presentations, standard response letters, FAQs, and other non-promotional materials.

  • Support publication activities such as publication planning, literature reviews, abstracts, posters, manuscripts, and white papers in accordance with applicable governance processes.

  • Conduct literature surveillance and synthesize relevant scientific, clinical, safety, and competitive developments, identifying implications for evidence generation, education, and stakeholder engagement.

  • Aggregate and analyze insights from KTL interactions, congresses, advisory boards, Medical Information, surveys, and research activities to identify evidence gaps, educational needs, stakeholder barriers, and strategic opportunities.

  • Represent Medical Affairs on cross-functional teams and provide scientific expertise to Regulatory, Quality, Commercial, and other internal stakeholders as appropriate.

  • Serve as a trained and designated backup for defined Pharmacovigilance, Medical Information, and Product Complaint activities, including medical inquiry review or escalation, safety information escalation, and selected product complaint assessments.

  • Support continuous improvement across Medical Affairs processes while maintaining high standards of scientific quality, compliance, and risk management.

    • Requirements

    • Advanced scientific or healthcare degree such as a PharmD, PhD, MD, DO, or another relevant advanced degree.

    • Four or more years of relevant pharmaceutical industry experience preferred, including experience within Medical Affairs.

    • Strong scientific and clinical acumen, including knowledge of medical terminology, clinical study design, biostatistics, evidence appraisal, and interpretation of clinical and real-world evidence.

    • Demonstrated ability to critically evaluate and synthesize complex scientific, clinical, safety, and technical information and translate findings into clear, balanced recommendations.

    • Strong scientific writing and communication capabilities, including experience developing medical education materials, evidence summaries, abstracts, posters, manuscripts, presentations, and other scientific content.

    • Working knowledge of publication standards, copyright requirements, scientific exchange principles, and applicable Medical Affairs laws, regulations, industry guidance, and internal requirements.

    • Ability to establish credible and compliant relationships with KTLs, healthcare professionals, and external scientific experts.

    • Strong presentation skills and the ability to adapt complex scientific information for scientific, executive, and cross-functional audiences.

    • Strategic thinking, sound judgment, and the ability to connect scientific evidence and stakeholder insights with broader Medical Affairs priorities.

    • Demonstrated ability to collaborate and influence cross-functional stakeholders while maintaining appropriate Medical Affairs independence.

    • Strong project and program management skills, including the ability to manage multiple priorities, complex workstreams, and time-sensitive deliverables.

    • Ability to aggregate and synthesize insights to identify evidence gaps, educational needs, stakeholder barriers, and strategic opportunities.

    • Strong awareness of quality, compliance, and risk, including the ability to recognize and appropriately escalate safety, product quality, and compliance information.

    • Prior experience in Pharmacovigilance, Medical Information, or product complaints is preferred; the ability to complete role-based training and provide designated backup support is required.

    • Experience with KTL engagement, scientific exchange, congress planning or coverage, and scientific communications is preferred.

    • Strong organizational, stakeholder-management, communication, and presentation skills.

    • High degree of accountability, adaptability, integrity, discretion, and commitment to continuous improvement.

    • Ability to work independently within a lean, cross-functional environment and exercise sound judgment when managing competing priorities and potential risks.

    • Fluent English communication skills and willingness to travel overnight up to approximately 20%, including for scientific congresses and external stakeholder engagements.

    • Flexibility to occasionally work evenings or weekends when required by congress schedules or external engagements.

      • Benefits

      • Competitive base salary range of $150,000–$180,000, depending on experience, education, skills, and geographic location.

      • Eligibility for an annual performance bonus.

      • Comprehensive employee benefits package.

      • Remote working arrangement.

      • Approximately 20% travel, providing opportunities for scientific congress participation and external stakeholder engagement.

      • Opportunity to take visible ownership of high-impact Medical Affairs programs.

      • Exposure to scientific strategy, evidence generation, external engagement, and the full product lifecycle.

      • Opportunity to work alongside experienced professionals in a collaborative, purpose-driven healthcare environment.

      • Meaningful opportunity to contribute to the development and support of potentially life-saving healthcare products.

      • Strong scope for scientific leadership, cross-functional influence, and professional growth.

jobs.title: Process Engineer (Surface Treatment)
jobs.description:
Type: permanent, full-time

Location: Perniö, Turku, Tampere, Helsinki, Espoo, Vantaa, Oulu, remote

Application deadline: 28.9.2026

Want to develop surface treatment processes in an international environment and impact production quality and efficiency? Wipro is looking for a Process Engineer!

**What will you be doing?**

We are looking for a Process Engineer to join Wipro Infrastructure Engineering as a technical expert in surface treatment. You will develop and evaluate new and existing surface treatment methods at Wipros manufacturing sites and support production, R&D, and other teams in technical matters. Your work will focus especially on industrial painting and pretreatment processes, corrosion testing, and improving process quality and efficiency.

Your projects may include reducing paint and energy use, improving cycle times, and finding more environmentally friendly solutions. You will also support equipment investments by defining technical requirements and taking part in testing and commissioning. In addition, you will help investigate production issues, support the technical handling of customer complaints, and work with customers, suppliers, and Wipro teams at the manufacturing sites in Perniö, Sweden, and Romania.

**What makes you a great fit?**

You have a strong practical and technical understanding of industrial surface treatment processes and experience in developing them. You understand not only individual process steps but also the whole process and how different changes can affect quality, costs, efficiency, and production. You are interested in improving processes and finding better technical solutions.

This is an independent and international role, so we value an accurate, organized, and proactive way of working as well as good communication and negotiation skills. Working with different teams, suppliers, and customers comes naturally to you, and you can adapt to changing situations. A practical and cost-conscious approach will help you succeed in this role.

**We expect you to have:**

- A relevant technical degree, for example in chemical, materials, process, production, or mechanical engineering

- Several years of relevant experience in industrial surface treatment and process development

- Strong knowledge of industrial painting and pretreatment processes, as well as electrolytic surface treatment methods

- Experience with AutoCAD and/or other technical design tools such as SolidWorks, Creo, or similar software

- Good English skills and willingness to travel to Wipros sites within Europe


**Additionally valued:**

- Experience with different surface treatment methods, such as nitrocarburizing or chromium processes

- Experience with equipment investments, commissioning, or technical development projects

- Knowledge of surface treatment testing, process requirements, or quality development


**Wipro offers you:**

- The freedom to develop surface treatment processes and make a real impact on quality, efficiency, and sustainability

- An international environment where you work across manufacturing sites and develop your technical skills

- The opportunity to develop new solutions and help shape the future of surface treatment at Wipro

- A varied expert role combining technical development, projects, and practical problem-solving

- The flexibility to work remotely from anywhere in Finland


**Practicalities:**

This is a full-time and permanent position, and you will be employed directly by Wipro Infrastructure Engineering Oy. We hope you are available to start as soon as possible, depending on your notice period.

You can work either at Wipros Perniö site or remotely from anywhere in Finland. The position includes approximately 50–60 travel days per year, mainly to Wipros sites in Finland, Sweden, and Romania. Salary in this position is 4500-5500 €/month (gross), depending on the level of your experience, and will be negotiated individually.

**How to apply?**

Please submit your CV and application in PDF format in English by Monday 28th of September via aTalents application system: https://emp.jobylon.com/applications/jobs/382498/create/ .

Remember to use the application system as we do not accept applications by email. We want to ensure an equal recruitment process for all applicants and will take individual accessibility needs into account where necessary.

You can learn more about Wipro Infrastructure Engineering here: https://hydraulics.wiproinfra.com/.

For more information about the position and recruitment process, please contact aTalents Recruitment Consultant Säde Juntunen (+358 44 901 2283, sade.juntunen@atalent.fi). If Im unable to answer your call right away, please leave a text message and Ill get back to you as soon as possible.

**Company description**

_Wipro Infrastructure Engineering Oy develops, manufactures, and markets high-quality hydraulic cylinders and hydraulic components under the Nummi trademark. The company is also a well-known OEM manufacturer of double-acting hydraulic cylinders. Wipro operates internationally, and about 70% of its turnover comes from exports. In addition to Finland, its main markets are Scandinavia, Poland, the Netherlands, Germany, Austria, and Switzerland._

_Wipro Infrastructure Engineering Oy is a subsidiary of the Indian company Wipro Enterprises. Its parent company, Wipro Ltd, is an international multi-business corporation listed on the New York and Mumbai stock exchanges. The company is headquartered in Bangalore, India. Wipro Infrastructure Engineering has manufacturing facilities in Finland (Perniö), Sweden, Romania, Brazil, India, Canada, and the United States._

jobs.title: Sairaanhoitaja kotihoitoon
jobs.description:
**Sairaanhoitaja – tule tekemään merkityksellistä työtä kanssamme kotihoitoon**

**Haluatko sairaanhoitajan työn, jossa sinulla on aikaa kohdata asiakas ja mahdollisuus vaikuttaa omaan työhösi?**

Etsimme sairaanhoitajaa vakituiseen työsuhteeseen. Toivomme sinulta oma-aloitteista ja kehitysmyönteistä työotetta, hyviä organisointitaitoja sekä ennen kaikkea halua tehdä laadukasta hoitotyötä yhdessä muun tiimin kanssa.

Tässä tehtävässä et ainoastaan suorita työlistaa, vaan pääset ottamaan vastuuta, tukemaan muuta tiimiä ja osallistumaan toiminnan kehittämiseen. Työskentelet tiiviissä yhteistyössä esihenkilön kanssa ja olet tärkeä osa tiimin päivittäistä toimintaa.

**Mitä työpäivääsi kuuluu?**

- hoitotyön suunnittelua ja koordinointia

- lähihoitajien tukemista arjen työssä

- asiakaskäyntejä, kuten lääkehoitoa, haavanhoitoa ja asiakkaan voinnin arviointia

- hoidon laadun ja sujuvuuden varmistamista

- yhteistyötä asiakkaiden, omaisten ja moniammatillisen työryhmän kanssa

- toiminnan ja toimintatapojen kehittämistä yhdessä tiimin kanssa

- tiivistä yhteistyötä esihenkilön työparina


**Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?**

Tarjoamme **vakituista työtä**, jossa työvuorot sijoittuvat pääosin arkipäiviin. Käytössä on joustava ja autonominen työvuorosuunnittelu, joten pääset vaikuttamaan omiin työvuoroihisi.

Lisäksi tarjoamme:

- TES mukaisen palkan – kuulemme mielellämme myös palkkatoiveesi

- yrityksen auton asiakaskäynteihin

- työterveyshuollon

- mahdollisuuden kehittää omaa työnkuvaasi

- mahdollisuuden kasvaa ja kehittyä yrityksen mukana

- työyhteisön, jossa yhteistyö ja hyvä arki ovat tärkeässä roolissa


**Mitä odotamme sinulta?**

Tehtävä sopii sairaanhoitajalle, jolla on hyvä asenne, organisointikykyä ja valmiutta ottaa vastuuta. Aikaisempi kokemus vastaavanlaisista tehtävistä katsotaan eduksi.

Edellytämme:

- sairaanhoitajan tutkintoa

- voimassa olevia lääkehoitolupia (LOVE)

- ajokorttia

- sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa


Tehtävään valitulta edellytetään rikosrekisteriotteen esittämistä ikäihmisten kanssa työskentelyä varten.

**Kiinnostuitko?**

Jos etsit sairaanhoitajan työtä, jossa saat yhdistää käytännön hoitotyön, vastuun ja toiminnan kehittämisen, **haluamme kuulla sinusta!**

**Staffgate Oy** on suomalainen henkilöstövuokraus- ja rekrytointipalveluja tarjoava yritys. Asiakkaamme toimivat monilla eri toimialoilla. Autamme työntekijöitä löytämään työtä ja onnistumaan työelämässä mahdollisimman hyvin.

jobs.title: Vikariat som psykolog
jobs.description:
Om familievernet

Ved familievernkontoret Oslo nord har vi ledig et 12-14 mnd vikariat med mulighet for forlengelse i 100 % stilling som psykolog. 

Familievernkontoret Oslo nord ligger sentralt på Økern, og betjener bydelene Bjerke, Grorud og Stovner. Kontoret har fokus på å gi et likeverdig tjenestetilbud til innbyggere med innvandrerbakgrunn og øke deres bruk av tjenesten. Vi er tverrfaglig sammensatt med til sammen 15 medarbeidere. Familieverntjenesten er en spesialtjeneste som har familierelaterte problemer som sitt fagfelt.

Familievernkontoret gir gratis lavterskeltilbud om behandling og rådgiving til par eller familier, uavhengig av livssyn og religion. Vi tilbyr familiesamtaler, foreldreveiledning, parterapi og ulike kurs- og gruppetilbud.

Familievernet utfører også lovpålagt mekling etter barneloven og ekteskapsloven.


Arbeidsoppgaver
  • Du vil arbeide med terapi og rådgiving for familier, par med samlivs- og relasjonsvansker, mange med flerkulturell bakgrunn og behov for tolk.
  • Du vil arbeide med mekling for foreldre etter ekteskaps- og barneloven.
  • Du vil jobbe med utadrettet og forebyggende arbeid i grupper og gjennom veiledning, undervisning og
    kurs.
  • Du vil jobbe med inntaksarbeid på telefon og med fagutviklingsarbeid.

Hvilken bakgrunn har du?
  • Det kreves profesjonsutdannelse i psykologi og godkjenning som psykolog.
  • Stillingen krever normalt gode datakunnskaper og gode ferdigheter i norsk.
  • Det kreves gode kliniske ferdigheter og erfaring fra relevant terapeutisk arbeid med par og familier, også med bruk av tolk.
  • Det kreves god mangfoldskompetanse og kultursensitiv tilnærming da de fleste av våre
    brukere har flerkulturell bakgrunn.
  • Det er ønskelig at du har erfaring med familievernets dokumentasjonssystem og familievernets kurs.
  • Det er ønskelig at du har erfaring med familievernets inntakssystem, da dette vil blir en del av stillingens innhold.

Personlige egenskaper
  • har et spesielt engasjement for arbeid med befolkningen med innvandrerbakgrunn og engasjement for å nå flere.
  • er genuint opptatt av familieterapeutiske temaer og relasjonelt arbeid ønsker å gjøre en god jobb for klienter.
  • er fleksibel og et ja- menneske som påtar deg de arbeidsoppgavene du blir tildelt.
  • har gode team- og samarbeidsevner, og en som vil være en aktiv bidragsyter i vårt team.

For oss er det også svært viktig hvordan du som person egner deg til jobben og hva du tilfører tilsammensetningen av teamet. Personlig egnethet vil derfor bli tillagt stor vekt i den totale vurderingen.


Hva får du hos oss?
  • Stillingen er plassert i statlig lønnsregulativ i stillingskode 0794 som psykolog, p.t. fra kr 650 000 - 800 000 pr. år.
  • Medlemskap i Statens pensjonskasse med gode låne-, pensjons- og forsikringsordninger (http://spk.no). Fra lønnen trekkes 2 % pensjonsinnskudd.

Vi kan også tilby:

  • Varierte arbeidsoppgaver og høy grad av autonomi.
  • Mulighet til trening i arbeidstiden (en time per uke).
  • Godt faglig miljø med gode støttespillere i arbeidshverdagen.

Opplysninger til deg som søker
  • Vi søker etter de beste hodene uavhengig av kulturell bakgrunn, alder, hull i CV eller funksjonsevne, og oppfordrer alle kvalifiserte kandidater til å søke jobb hos oss.
  • Stillingen er for tiden lagt til Familievernkontoret Oslo nord
  • Politiattest må fremlegges ved ansettelse, jf. Familievernkontorloven § 2 a, og forskrift om politiattest § 7. Denne attesten skal ikke legges ved søknaden.
  • Du kan be om å ikke bli oppført på den offentlige søkerlisten. Dette må i så fall begrunnes. Vi kontakter deg dersom ønsket ditt ikke tas til følge.
  • Prøvetid i henhold til statsansatteloven.
  • Opplever du tekniske utfordringer når du fyller ut søknaden, anbefaler vi at du tar kontakt med teknisk support hos Grade Jobbnorge.

Hva skal søknaden din inneholde?

For å bli vurdert som søker må du fylle ut feltene for utdannelse og arbeidserfaring, samt legge ved relevante vitnemål og attester med bekreftet stillingsstørrelse.

Vitnemål for utdanning tatt i Norge skal lastes opp fra Vitnemålsportalen. 

Har du utdanning fra utlandet må du legge ved godkjenning fra Direktoratet for høyere utdanning og kompetanse.


Om arbeidsgiveren:

Barne-, ungdoms- og familieetatens fem regioner har som hovedoppgave å drive etatens institusjoner og familievernkontor. 

I tillegg har regionene ansvar for fosterhjemsrekruttering og oppgaver knyttet til adopsjon. 

Barn, unge og deres familie skal få riktig hjelp til rett tid uansett hvor de bor i Norge. 

Bufetat sine fem regioner​ rapporterer til Barne-, ungdoms- og familiedirektoratet som er underlagt Barne- og familiedepartementet.

jobs.title: Zelfstandig werkende (instellings)kok /begeleider
jobs.description:
Als zelfstandig werkende kok kook je, samen met je keukenploeg -een club bewoners/deelnemers aan de dagbesteding die jij begeleidt- elke weekdag een gezonde, lekkere maaltijd voor zo’n 60 bewoners. In de keuken houd je het overzicht over de werkzaamheden van de keukenploeg en begeleid je hen daarbij. Voor bewoners die zelfstandig koken, bereiden jullie een maaltijdbox voor. Met hulp van de hospitality medewerker worden op dinsdag en donderdag lekkere taarten en high-tea arrangementen voor de theeschenkerij verzorgd. Ook voor (jaar)feesten, verjaardagslunches, vergaderarrangementen of de maandelijkse aanschuifmaaltijd doen we graag een beroep op jou en de keukenploeg. Je werkt op onze locatie in Putte (Nederland, grens met Stabroek België).

Opleiding (instellings)kok, bij voorkeur bekend met HACCP richtlijnen. Pedagogische kwaliteiten zijn een pré of de bereidheid om je daarin te ontwikkelen.

Wij vinden het belangrijk dat je als zelfstandig werkende kok goed het overzicht weet te houden en een geduldige teamplayer bent. Liefst heb je ervaring of affiniteit met pedagogische begeleiding of wil je je graag ontwikkelen op het gebied van pedagogische begeleiding.
Je voelt je als een vis in het water in de keuken; je bent flexibel en creatief in de samenstelling van menu’s en houdt graag rekening met diverse behoeften/diëten. Je verzorgt zelfstandig de inkoop voor de keuken en bewaakt daarbij het afgesproken budget. Een werkdag met de keukenploeg sluit je af met een korte rapportage in het zorgregistratiesysteem.

jobs.title: Er du ferie -og tilkallingsvikaren jeg ser etter?
jobs.description:
Jeg er en dame i tredveårene som bor i Hamar kommune.

Jeg har bakgrunn innen musikk og jeg liker å være aktiv og ute i naturen. Jeg er også glad i å lage mat og utforske nye retter. Jeg har mye glede av å lete etter gode brukt kjøp og små oppussingsprosjekter. Jeg er en vitebegjærlig person som liker å lære nye ting, og gir meg sjelden før jeg har funnet det svaret jeg er på jakt etter. Jeg er glad i å spøke og tulle og tar ikke meg selv så høytidelig. Det kan derfor være en fordel om du deler disse kjennetegnene. 


Jeg ser etter deg som:

·       Liker å være aktiv og engasjert.

·       Setter pris på humor i hverdagen.

·       Er nysgjerrig og liker å finne ut av ting og å forstå mennesker.

·       Setter pris på prosjekter uten bruksanvisning.

·       Genuint ønske om å hjelpe meg til å få en bedre hverdag.

·       Er opptatt av detaljer og liker systemer.

·       Ikke synes husarbeid er det kjedeligste som finnes.

·       Er fleksibel og takler forandringer.

·       Er trygg på deg selv i dialog med både meg og arbeidsleder, og er åpen for å finne løsninger i kommunikasjon rundt oppgaver og arbeidstider.

·       Er serviceinnstilt og opptatt av å være imøtekommende

 

Arbeidsoppgaver og rollen som assistent:

Å være assistent i en BPA-ordning er en ganske unik jobb, da det er et serviceyrke selv om du jobber med helserelaterte utfordringer.

Dine oppgaver vil i hovedsak være rettet mot husarbeid og andre praktiske oppgaver, men du burde likevel takle, og vise forståelse rundt utfordringene jeg lever med. Som assistent skal du utføre de oppgavene jeg selv ville gjort hvis jeg kunne, på den måten jeg selv ville gjort det. Det er derfor viktig å reflektere over hvordan du evner å sette deg inn i andres systemer og levemåter. 

Du vil være tett på meg og mitt liv, både på gode og mindre gode dager. Derfor er det viktig at du er trygg på deg selv og evner å opprettholde god kommunikasjon uavhengig av situasjon.

En av mine utfordringer er at jeg er svaksynt og derfor er jeg helt avhengig av at mine systemer og plassering av ting i hjemmet blir opprettholdt. Det er derfor viktig at du er god på å sette deg inn i og å memorere slikt. Lurer du på hva det vil si å være svaksynt anbefaler vi å lese mer på Norges Blindeforbund: https://www.blindeforbundet.no

Jobben som BPA er et litt annerledes serviceyrke. Sjekk gjerne andres erfaringer med assistent yrket i linken her: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VJIjulno-8I

Jobben krever ingen utdannelse eller tidligere erfaring med assistent yrket da nødvendig opplæring og veiledning vil bli gitt. Du vil få innføring i mine utfordringer og opplæring i hvordan å legge til rette for meg både inne og ute.


Arbeidstider:

Tilkallingsvikar

Dette er en tilkallingsstilling uten fast stillingsprosent. Arbeidet vil i hovedsak være knyttet til ferieavvikling og annet fravær, og arbeidsmengden vil variere gjennom året. Stillingen passer derfor best for deg som ønsker en fleksibel ekstrajobb, og har mulighet til å møte på kort varsel, og som har tid og kapasitet til å jobbe planlagte vakter i skoleferier.


Krav til stillingen:

·       På grunn av mine utfordringer er det et krav at du har gode norskkunnskaper, skriftlig og muntlig.

·       Det må fremvises politiattest.

·       Førerkort klasse B.

·       Det er en fordel om du har egen bil du kan disponere i ordningen. Det gis kjøregodtgjørelse.

·       Hvis du røyker må du kunne stille på jobb i klær uten røyklukt da jeg er følsom på lukt. Av samme grunn kan du bli bedt om å møte på jobb uten sterk parfyme.

·       På grunn av arbeidets art ønsker jeg kun kvinnelige søkere.

·       Personlig egnethet vil vektlegges.


Søknader behandles fortløpende og aktuelle kandidater vil bli kontaktet for intervju.

Høres dette ut som en passende jobb for deg, søk da vel! Jeg gleder meg til å høre fra deg.

PS! Jo mer du skriver om deg selv i søknaden jo lettere blir det for meg å bli kjent med deg på forhånd.

Min mor vil være arbeidsleder, mens du tilbringer tiden med meg.

Prima Assistanse er arbeidsgiver.


Hva kan Prima Assistanse tilby:

·      Egen kontaktperson i Prima Assistanse

·       En meningsfull jobb

·       Kurs gjennom Prima Assistanse

·       Lønn og andre vilkår ihht. Landsoverenskomsten for BPA

·       God opplæring og oppfølging

·       Varierte arbeidsoppgaver hvor ingen dag er helt lik

·       Snarlig oppstart

Om arbeidsgiveren

BPA er en forkortelse for brukerstyrt personlig assistanse. Det er i hovedsak en alternativ måte å organisere praktisk bistand på for funksjonshemmede. BPA skiller seg fra mer tradisjonelle tjenester ved at det er personen med assistansebehov som selv bestemmer hvordan assistansen skal være. BPA er et frigjørings- og likestillingsverktøy som bidrar til at den med assistansebehov får frihet til å leve et selvstendig og aktivt liv - på lik linje med andre i samfunnet. Prima Assistanse har spesialisert seg på BPA, og er i dag en betydelig leverandør i hele Norge. Vi jobber hver dag for å bidra til at funksjonshemmede får den friheten og assistansen som er nødvendig for å kunne leve et selvstendig liv. Vi er opptatt av å levere et godt konsept, kvalitet i alle ledd, å ha profesjonelle medarbeidere og gode rutiner, slik at vi sammen bidrar til en suksessfull hverdag. For mer informasjon: www.prima-assistanse.no

jobs.description:
Vélvirki / Viðhaldsmaður á verkstæði

Airport Associates leitar að jákvæðum, áhugasömum og liðlegum starfsmanni til starfa á vel búnu verkstæði fyrirtækisins á Keflavíkurflugvelli. Um er að ræða fjölbreytt og krefjandi starf í öflugu starfsumhverfi þar sem öryggi, fagmennska og góð þjónusta eru í fyrirrúmi.

Helstu verkefni:
Almennt viðhald og viðgerðir á flugafgreiðslutækjum
Bílaviðgerðir og almennt viðhald ökutækja
Viðhald á verkfærum og búnaði verkstæðis
Önnur tilfallandi verkefni tengd rekstri verkstæðis

jobs.title: Vil du jobbe med å forebygge utenforskap? Nav Sandnes søker veiledere!
jobs.description:
Trives du med å finne gode løsninger i samhandling med mennesker som er i en krevende livssituasjon? Da kan dette være riktig jobb for deg!

Vi har nå ledig tre vikarstillinger som veileder hos oss fordelt på avdelingene jobb og avklaring og jobb og informasjon. Jobben som veileder innebærer blant annet å jobbe med å motivere, følge opp og avklare innbyggers muligheter til å delta i arbeidslivet. Saksbehandling, veiledning og samarbeid med arbeidsgivere, utdanningsinstitusjoner, helsetjenestene, og øvrige kommunale tjenester. Vårt hovedoppdrag er å gi mennesker muligheter til å skaffe en varig tilknytning til arbeidslivet.

Nav Sandnes er det største Nav-kontoret i Rogaland med omtrent 220 ansatte som er fordelt på 7 avdelinger. Nav er et partnerskap mellom stat og kommune, og leverer tjenester til kommunens innbyggere. Selv om vi har litt ulike oppgaver i avdelingene så er målet vårt det samme: Vi skal bidra til sosial og økonomisk trygghet for den enkelte, og fremme overgang til arbeid og aktiv deltakelse i samfunnet.

Vi er lokalisert sentralt i Sandnes i nye, moderne lokaler. Det er kort vei til både buss og togstasjon. I tillegg mulighet for bruk av bysykkel og innvendig sykkelparkering for egne sykler.
Arbeidsoppgaver
  • Kartlegging av personers ressurser, muligheter og hjelpebehov. 
  • Veilede og motivere personer mot arbeid og utdanning. 
  • Utarbeide arbeidsevnevurderinger og aktivitetsplaner. 
  • Saksbehandling i forbindelse med arbeidsrettede ytelser. 
  • Anvendelse av regelverk i oppfølging og saksbehandling etter aktuelle lover (folketrygdloven, forvaltningsloven, lov om sosiale tjenester i Nav m.m). 
  • Informere om rettigheter og plikter på en god og enkel måte, skriftlig og muntlig. 
  • Samarbeid, samhandling og relasjonsbygging med ulike aktører som næringslivet, tiltaksarrangører, kommunale tjenester, helsevesen etc. 

Nav er i stadig utvikling, så endring av arbeidsoppgaver må påregnes. 

Kvalifikasjoner

Du må ha: 

  • Fullført utdannelse tilsvarende bachelor. Relevant arbeidserfaring og/eller fagbrev kan kompensere for utdanningskrav. 
  • God muntlig og skriftlig fremstillingsevne (språknivå må tilsvare minimum C1 for søkere med annet morsmål enn norsk). Du må kunne formidle informasjon klart og lett. 
  • Stillingene vil innebære krevende arbeid i tett dialog med mennesker som står i en vanskelig livssituasjon. Du må derfor være en relasjonsbygger med erfaring fra veiledning og oppfølging. 
  • Gode digitale ferdigheter og interesse for å ta i bruk nye IKT verktøy. 

Legg ved attester og vitnemål i søknaden (lastes inn som vedlegg i Webcruiter).

Du har: 

  • Interesse og engasjement for målgruppen. 
  • Erfaring med å veilede mennesker som står i en endring- og omstillingsprosess. 
  • Er serviceinnstilt, løsningsorientert og trives med et høyt arbeidstempo. 
  • Har gjennomføringsevne og er resultatorientert. 
  • Du tåler å møte motgang og arbeider konstruktivt under press. 

Det er en fordel at du har: 

  • Erfaring med saksbehandling og lovanvendelse fra veiledningsarbeid i Nav. 
  • Erfaring eller høy grad av motivasjon for å jobbe med utadrettet arbeid med arbeidsgivere. 
  • Erfaring fra inkluderingsarbeid.  
  • Erfaring eller et sterkt ønske om å jobbe med veiledning av mennesker som står i endring- og omstillingsprosesser. 
Personlige egenskaper

For at du skal kunne trives og oppleve mestring i rollen, er det viktig at: 

  • Du er motstandsdyktig: Å jobbe med mennesker i utfordrende situasjoner over tid kan være krevende. Derfor er det viktig at du også klarer å se muligheter, er positiv og har pågangsmot, også i slike situasjoner. 
  • Du er en nettverksbygger: I rollen din som veileder vil du kommunisere og samhandle med mennesker i ulike situasjoner. Du vil samarbeide med kolleger, arbeidsgivere og andre aktører både internt og eksternt i Nav. Derfor er det viktig at du har evnen til å kommunisere godt og tydelig med menneske både i og utenfor organisasjonen. For deg er det naturlig å oppsøke andre for å utvikle nye relasjoner og samtidig ivaretar eksisterende relasjoner til næringsliv og arbeidsgivere.   
  • Du er en lagspiller: Du jobber godt i team, men tar også selvstendige initiativ for å drive prosesser fremover. Du motiverer til samhandling på en positiv måte. Du fremmer effektivitet i grupper ved å legge til rette for andres ideer og kompetanse. 
  • Du er resultatorientert: Du evner å drive prosesser fremover, strukturere og prioritere riktige oppgaver. Du jobber selvstendig og strukturert for å egne og virksomhetens mål. 

Personlige egenskaper vektlegges sterkt.  

Vi tilbyr
  • Hjem-jobb-hjem avtale.
  • Gratis svømming for alle ansatte i kommunens svømmehaller.
  • Bedriftsidrettslag og bedriftskunstforening.
  • Gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger.
  • Parkering er tilgjengelig med årsavgift, gjennom Sandnes kommune.
  • Lønn følger tariffavtale, personal- og lønnspolitikk for Nav og harmoniseringsvedtak mot statlig vilkår. 
KontaktinformasjonKjersti Botnen, Avdelingsleder, 47377210
ArbeidsstedHoveveien
 Sandnes
Nøkkelinformasjon:Arbeidsgiver: Sandnes kommune

Referansenr.: 5178300698
Stillingsprosent: 100%
Vikariat
Søknadsfrist: 23.09.2026

Om arbeidsgiveren:

I Sandnes kommune ser vi framover med glød og optimisme. Vi er i sterk vekst. Vi er unge. Vi søker nye løsninger og legger til rette for en bærekraftig utvikling. Vi har også spennende langsiktige planer for byutvikling og er det geografiske midtpunktet i en dynamisk region. Det er ikke tilfeldig at visjonen vår lyder slik den gjør: Sandnes – i sentrum for framtiden.

Sandnes kommune ligger sentralt på Nord-Jæren, er Norges 11. mest folkerike kommuner og kjennetegnes av mange, varierte kvaliteter. Kommunen består av etablerte storby- og tettstedsområder og er en av fylkes største landbrukskommuner. Vi har idrettsmiljø i norgestoppen, et yrende kulturliv og friluftsområder for hele regionen. Kommunen har et aktivt og innovativt næringsliv og en sterk kulturhistorie. Sandnes er alt dette og mer!

Vi tilbyr våre ansatte utfordrende arbeidsplasser hvor verdiene romslig, modig og sunn står i fokus. Vi søker stadig aktive, engasjerte og selvstendige medarbeidere.

Vi ønsker å være en arbeidsgiver som gjenspeiler mangfoldet i samfunnet. Derfor oppfordrer vi alle kvalifiserte til å søke - uansett alder, kjønn, funksjonsevne, seksuell orientering, religion, etnisitet eller hull i CV'en.

Vi gjør oppmerksom på at søkere kan føres opp på offentlig søkerliste selv om søkeren har bedt om anonymitet, men dette vil du i tilfelle få varsel om.

jobs.title: MIG/MAG-welder, Salo Region
jobs.description:
Are you a MIG MAG welder in the Salo Region? You could be the right fit for the role!

Location: Salo Region, Finland
Employment Type: Fixed-term contract, a possibility of permanent employment
Salary: 14 - 18 € / hour

We are looking for a MIG/MAG Welder for our client company for a long-term position in the Salo region. Our client is a manufacturer specializing in steel structures, turning their customers' ideas into finished products – from design and production to assembly and delivery. In this role, you will work with bigger metal products in a modern industrial environment.

Your role

You will get to MIG MAG weld in project that consists of large metal components with material thicknesses ranging from 5 to 25 mm. The work is performed in a clean and safe production environment in a two-shift system, Monday to Friday, 40 hours per week.

You will have access to high-quality tools and equipment and receive a thorough introduction to the company's products and working methods. If you are relocating from another area, we can assist with accommodation arrangements when needed.

As part of the recruitment process, candidates will complete a welding test at the client's premises.

What we expect from you

* Proven experience in MIG/MAG welding

* An unwavering commitment to attention to detail and quality

* Flexibility to work both morning and evening shifts

* English and/or Finnish language skill

* A valid work permit for Finland is a must

* Ability to read technical drawings

Considered an advantage

* Previous experience with welding heavy products and thick materials.

What we offer

* A stable, long-term position with a respected company in the metal industry

* Competitive hourly pay based on your experience and skills

* Salary and employment conditions based on the Finnish Technology Industry Collective Agreement

* Clean and safe working facilities with high-quality equipment

* Comprehensive onboarding and opportunities to further develop your skills

* Assistance with accommodation arrangements if needed

* Salary 14-18 € / hour depending on skills

About Wellpack

You will be employed by Wellpack, a personnel services company established in 2013. Wellpack is known as a trusted partner, particularly within the industrial and defence industry sectors. We connect skilled professionals with quality employers and contribute to building sustainable employment in Finland.

Apply now!

Submit your application through the "Apply" link in the job advertisement. Your application will be stored in our recruitment system. Interviews will be conducted during the application period, and the position will be filled as soon as a suitable candidate is found. In your application, be sure to tell about your previous work experience and skills.

For more information about the position, please contact Wellpack's recruitment team by email at wellpack@wellpack.fi [wellpack@wellpack.fi].

jobs.title: Henkilökohtainen avustaja
jobs.description:
Tulisitko sinä töihin Spesiolle henkilökohtaisen avun pariin? Haemme lämminhenkistä ihmistä, joka haluaa tehdä merkityksellistä työtä asiakkaidemme kanssa. Tutkintoa tärkeämpää on hyvä asenne sekä sosiaaliset taidot.

Haetaan henkilökohtaista avustajaa 27-vuotiaalle iloiselle ja puheliaalle miesasiakkaallemme Varkauden keskustan tuntumaan. Asikkaalla on downin oireyhtymä. Työtehtäviin kuuluu asiakkaan avustaminen vapaa-ajan puuhissa. Asiakas tykkää käydä avustajan kanssa mm. kuntosalilla, keilaamassa, uimassa, frisbeegolfaamassa, pyöräilemässä, lenkkeilemässä ja muutoinkin ulkoilemassa, kirjastossa ja ostoksilla. Käytössä olevina apuvälineinä kuulolaitteet ja tukipohjalliset.

Avustustunteja käytettävissä 30t/kk. Työtä tehdään pääsääntöisesti iltapäivisin, iltaisin ja viikonloppuisin tarpeen mukaan. Asiakas käy työtoiminnassa viitenä päivänä viikossa (ma-pe), jonka vuoksi avustustunteja voi olla vähemmän kuukaudessa, esim. 15-20t/kk voisi aluksi olla riittävä.

Lupaamme sinulle:

- mahdollisuuden tehdä työsi hyvin ja asiakasta kunnioittaen

- työyhteisön, jossa saat rohkeasti olla oma itsesi

- lähiesihenkilön tuen

- monipuolisen työnkuvan

- työehdot yksityisen sosiaalipalvelualan työehtosopimuksen mukaan

- palkkaluokka on G16A eli palvelusvuosien mukaan 13,20 € - 14,51 € / tunti (+TES:n mukaiset lisät)


Tule mukaan rakentamaan pykälää parempaa maailmaa: Spesio on toiminut sosiaali- ja hyvinvointipalvelualalla pitkään, jo yli 20 vuotta. Työntekijöitä meillä on tällä hetkellä yhteensä reilut 700 ja toimipisteemme sijaitsevat Kuopiossa, Joensuussa ja Tampereella. Palvelutarjontaamme kuuluu henkilökohtainen apu, omaishoidon vapaa, vammaisten kotihoito, vammaisten päivätoiminta, lapsiperheiden kotipalvelu sekä kotiin vietävät palvelut yksityisasiakkaille. Me haluamme, että kaikilla on mahdollisuus omanlaiseensa elämään, ja uskomme että omalla työllä voimme tehdä maailmasta paremman paikan. jobs.title: Hands-on Data Center Deployment Engineer
jobs.description:
**About the role**

Nordecon Oy is converting a former industrial bakery building in Riihimäki into a data centre designed for AI and high performance computing workloads. Repurposing an existing industrial site brings interesting engineering problems a new build never has.

We are looking for a hands-on Data Center Deployment Engineer to help us build it and then run it. You will be part of the core team in this role, which means you will not inherit someone else's procedures, you will build them.

Founded in 2006, Nordecon is an OEM and solution provider with nearly two decades of experience in mobile, server and custom-built desktop systems. The data centre is the next phase of that business.

**What you will do**

- Plan and oversee the installation of data centre infrastructure: servers, storage, networking and power systems

- Coordinate with vendors and contractors on procurement, installation, commissioning and acceptance testing

- Configure, integrate and troubleshoot systems to keep them performing

- Work with environmental and monitoring systems — cooling, power distribution, alarms

- Carry out site assessments and make sure we meet safety and industry standards

- Write and maintain the documentation: design records, installation procedures, and the operating procedures the site will run on

- Take part in our ISO/IEC 27001 certification work. Building the operational procedures and controls that certification is based on, not just following them

- As the team grows, support and guide our data centre technicians


**What helps you succeed in this role**

- Hands-on experience deploying and operating data centre infrastructure

- Solid understanding of network and data cabling, and of network and power capacity planning

- Strong Linux skills

- Working knowledge of HVAC and cooling dynamics in a data centre context

- Fluent Finnish and good English

- A degree in computer science, computer engineering or a related field or equivalent experience earned on the job

- Willingness to be on site in Riihimäki, and to take part in an on-call rotation once the site is live


**Nice to have**

- Experience converting or retrofitting an existing building for data centre or other critical facility use

- Experience commissioning a new site or a major capacity expansion

- Liquid-cooled or high-density deployments

- Exposure to ISO 27001, ISO 9001 or similar management systems

- Electrical or HVAC qualifications


We offer you a permanent full-time position with interesting and versatile tasks with the opportunity to have a real influence on the development of the data center. The applicant must speak Finnish. If you got interested and would like to know more please send your questions, introductions and CV with salary request to applications@nordecon.fi

We read every application, but we are a small team and receive a high volume of them. We will only contact candidates we invite to interview. If you have not heard from us within two weeks of applying, the role has moved forward with other candidates. We know applying takes real effort, and we appreciate the time you put into it.

L'équipe couvre un périmètre fonctionnel varié, au travers de solutions techniques (API, intégrations, providers) couvrant notamment :

*

   le paiement (rigueur requise sur la gestion financière)

*

   une brique événementielle

*

   du développement front

*

   de l'intermédiation de système

*

   de la livraison / logistique

Exemples concrets de sujets traités par l'équipe :

*

   intégration d'une carte cadeau sur un site e-commerce

*

   intégration d'un nouveau moyen de paiement avec le provider correspondant

*

   facturation interne : génération des factures envoyées aux vendeurs tiers

*

   interconnexions avec le SAP de filiales du groupe (ex. Jardiland)

*

   brique de notifications (envoi de SMS / email)

*

   intégration des bases de données magasins (horaires, etc.)

ÉQUIPE & ENVIRONNEMENT

Équipe de 4 développeurs : un lead dev et un autre profil senior (plus de 10 ans d'expérience chacun), un profil junior (2-3 ans d'expérience), et le poste à pourvoir. Équipe distribuée géographiquement (Île-de-France, Drôme, Landes...).

STACK TECHNIQUE

*

   Node.js / TypeScript, VueJS : indispensable

*

   PostgreSQL, MongoDB : très important

*

   Bonne aisance avec les outils d'IA, en particulier Claude : important

*

   Kubernetes, Docker : important

*

   RabbitMQ : bonus (utilisé pour la brique événementielle)

PROFIL RECHERCHÉ

*

   5 à 6 ans d'expérience en développement Node/TypeScript

*

   Expérience confirmée sur VueJS

*

   À l'aise avec Docker/Kubernetes et les bases de données PostgreSQL/MongoDB

*

   Une expérience RabbitMQ est un plus

PROCESS DE RECRUTEMENT

*

   Entretien(s) mené(s) par le Lead Dev ou le CTO

jobs.title: Tukiperhe
jobs.description:
Tukiperhetoiminta on tarkoitettu tueksi lapsiperheelle, jossa tarvitaan apua arjen helpottamiseksi kuormittavassa elämäntilanteessa tai johtuen lapsen erityisen tuen tarpeista.

Tukiperhe voi olla lapseton pariskunta, pariskunta, jolla on kotona asuvia lapsia tai yksinasuvan aikuisen perhe, jolla on resursseja ja halua tarjota huolenpitoa sekä turvaa lapsille ja nuorille. Koska lasten ja perheiden tilanteet ja tukitarpeet ovat erilaisia, toimintaan tarvitaan eri-ikäisiä, kulttuuritaustaltaan vaihtelevia ja monenlaisia taitoja omaavia tukiperheitä, jotka voivat vastata lapsen ja perheen tarpeisiin.

Etsimme tukiperheitä erityisesti Uudenmaan alueelta sekä Mikkelin seudulta. Myös muualla asuvat olkaa yhteydessä niin pohditaan tilannettanne.

Lapsi viettää tukiperheessä yleensä yhden viikonlopun kuukaudessa ja loma-aikoina sovitulla tavalla. Tukiperheessä tehdään tavallisia, turvallisen arkisia asioita. Tukiperheen aikuisilla tulisi olla mahdollisuus kuljettaa lasta tukiviikonlopuille ja takaisin kotiin. Tukiperheen oma elämäntilanne on vakaa, perheessä ei ole akuutteja kriisejä tai muita suuria huolia.

AVA valmentaa tukiperheet ja antaa vahvaa tukea koko lapsen tukisuhteen ajan.

- säännöllinen yhteydenpito sekä 24 h puhelinpäivystystuki

- kasvatuskumppanuus arjen haastaviin tilanteisiin

- sosiaalityöntekijän ohjaus- ja konsultaatiopalveluja

- täydennys- ja lisäkoulutuksia 1 – 2 x vuodessa


Edellytämme asiointikieleksi suomenkielen hyvää osaamista.
