jobs.title: Pomocní pracovníci inde neuvedení
jobs.description:
Túžiš po práci, ktorá by ti dávala zmysel? Staň sa súčasťou nášho Deapul tímu a maj prácu, ktorá inšpiruje a pomáha! Ako pomáhajúci pracovník/pomáhajúca pracovníčka budeš s tímom skúsených kolegov a kolegýň pracovať v nízkoprahovej Nocľahárni sv. Vincenta de Paul. Na starosti budeš mať najmä: - pomocné činnosti pri poskytovaní sociálnych služieb a zabezpečovania chodu prevádzky nocľahárne - administratívne činnosti spojené s registráciou klienta, vedenie požadovanej evidencie - pripravovanie hygienických potrieb, pranie uterákov, výdaj čistých plachiet pre klientov, pranie oblečenia - upratovacie práce priestorov počas dennej služby a príprava služby na nočnú zmenu - vo výnimočných prípadoch asistencia pri sprevádzaní imobilného klienta v zariadení, pomoc pri presúvaní, atď - výdaj a/alebo príprava stravy (raňajky), výdaj potravín a ošatenia Pozri si, ako vyzerá práca za dverami nocľahárne: https://www.facebook.com/share/r/1AfN4dSNk5/ :) Rozvrh pracovného času Ide o prácu na nočné (18:45h – 7:45h) a denné zmeny (7:30h – 20:00h) v nepretržitej prevádzke s týždennou pracovnou dobou 37,5h. Mesačný priemer je spravidla 9 nočných služieb a 4 denné služby. Rozvrhnutie zmien môže byť aj individuálne podľa dohody so zamestnancom​ Kto sme? Nocľaháreň sv. Vincenta de Paul je najväčšou nízkoprahovou nocľahárňou v strednej Európe. Funguje nepretržite už 20 rokov, bez prestávky každý deň v roku. Denne poskytne nocľah, teplé jedlo, sociálne poradenstvo a ďalšie služby pre 200 ľudí v núdzi. Nocľaháreň je jedným z 10 zariadení a projektov neziskovej organizácie Depaul Slovensko, ktorá poskytuje komplexné služby ľuďom bez domova. Pre činnosť našej organizácie sú najdôležitejší naši zamestnanci – Depaul ľudia – profesionáli s veľkým srdcom, trpezlivosťou a empatiou. Pracujeme v priateľskom kolektíve, podporujme vzdelávanie, supervízie a teambulidingové aktivity. Láka ťa práca v nocľahárni, ale premýšľaš, či máš dostatok skúseností? Počas zaúčacieho procesu ťa bude v práci sprevádzať skúsený tím kolegov. Postupne budeš mať príležitosť absolvovať školenia a supervízie, ktoré ti pomôžu pri práci s klientmi. Pozícia je vhodná aj pre študentov sociálnej práce alebo príbuzných humanitárnych odborov, ktorí by radi svoje doterajšie vedomosti preniesli do praxe. Náš tím tvorí viacero pomáhajúcich pracovníkov a počas dňa stretneš aj skvelých sociálnych pracovníkov, koordinátorky dobrovoľníkov a komunitné organizátorky či vedúcu nocľahárne s jej zástupkyňami. Viac informácií o nocľahárni a útulku nájdeš na našej webovej stránke https://depaul.sk/, v časti Naše služby, alebo vo video vizitke: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9IufpprxiqU Tešíme sa na teba :) !

Nevrlková Eva, tel.: +420 720 985 432, e-mail: kariera@labs1503.cz

Možno práce i na zkrácený pracovní úvazek.

ÚČEL PRACOVNÍHO MÍSTA Odborné plánování léčby v rozsahu způsobilosti k výkonu zdravotnického
povolání pod odborným dohledem garanta v oboru ortodoncie, komunikace s klienty.
Při zkráceném úvazku s jiným počtem hodin bude mzda vypočítána poměrnou částí.
PRACOVNÍ NÁPLŇ
• zdravotní péče v zubním lékařství - ortodoncii dle stanovených pracovních postupů a pod odborným
dohledem garanta v oboru ortodoncie, v rozsahu stanoveném právním předpisem, dle interní směrnice o
výkonu dohledu při poskytování zdravotních služeb;
• diagnostika, prevence a léčba vad v postavení chrupu a čelisti pomocí ortodontických aparátů;
• odborné konzultace s klienty a ostatními kolegy na klinice, zejm. s týmem 3D Clinical Specialistů
(příprava léčebných plánů);
• elektronické plánování ortodontické léčby v 3D software pro modelaci léčebných plánů;
• komunikace s klienty, odborné konzultace a výchovná činnost v rámci zubní prevence a péče o rovnátka,
motivovat klienty rovnátka nosit a pečovat o ně;
• práce na PC v programu Xdent, administrativa, MS365.
POŽADAVKY K VÝKONU PRACOVNÍHO MÍSTA
• ukončené VŠ vzdělání (odborná způsobilost na pozici Zubního lékaře nebo Stomatologa); členství v
České stomatologické komoře;
• dobré komunikační schopnosti v ČJ a AJ na profesionální úrovni;
• profesionální a empatický pro-klientský přístup;
• zodpovědnost, schopnost týmové spolupráce.
V případě zájmu nám zašlete svůj životopis na e-mail kariera@labs1503.cz. Pohovory probíhají výhradně
po předchozí domluvě a konají se na hlavní pobočce firmy, nikoliv na klinice. Bez domluveného termínu
vás není možné zařadit do výběrového řízení. Děkujeme za pochopení a budeme se na vás těšit!

Práce v moderním prostředí s nejnovějšími technologiemi, příspěvek na vzdělávání a rozvoj zaměstnanců,
Multisport karta, Jazykové kurzy, zaměstnanecké slevy na firemní produkty a služby, příspěvek na penzijní
připojištění a životní pojištění, firemní auto, přátelský kolektiv.

Pracovní poměr na dobu určitou s možností prodloužení.

Co u nás budete dělat?
- příjem letáků od dopravce a kontrola jejich počtu

- roznos letáků ve svěřené lokalitě do poštovních nebo hromadných schránek či na odkladná místa (s pomocí naší tašky nebo vozíku na kolečkách)

Co od Vás požadujeme?
- požadujeme pouze svědomitost a zodpovědnost, zkrátka někoho, na koho se můžeme spolehnout

Co Vám nabízíme?
- dlouhodobou spolupráci na hlavní pracovní poměr (nárok na nemocenskou a dovolenou)

- zkrácený úvazek na 10, 15 nebo 20 hodin týdně - dle velikosti sektoru a počtu schránek
- flexibilní rozvržení práce dle svých potřeb

- zaměstnáním u nás nepřicházíte o nárok na invalidní důchod

Jste osoba se zdravotním postižením a nevíte, zda je pro Vás práce vhodná?

Otestujte se na www.testdistributora.cz. Více informací najdete na www.distribucni.cz.

Kontakt e-mailem nebo telefonicky pondělí - čtvrtek v čase od 9:00 -15:00 h.

jobs.description:
Společnost Maxent, s.r.o. hledá nového kolegu/kolegyni na kombinovanou obchodně-technickou pozici.

Jsme menší dynamická IT společnost poskytující komplexní služby v oblasti správy počítačových sítí, dodávek hardwaru a IT infrastruktury. Hledáme někoho, kdo se s námi zapojí do naší mise poskytovat spolehlivá IT řešení.

Náplň práce:
Obchodní činnost a akvizice: Vaším hlavním úkolem bude aktivní vyhledávání nových klientů v regionu Sušicka a Klatovska, především úřady, školy a komerční subjetky. Očekáváme, že povedete celý proces od vytipování a prvotního kontaktu až po uzavření smluv.

Marketing a propagace: Budete se také podílet na zvyšování povědomí o naší značce. Výhodou je znalost základů online marketingu (Google Ads, sociální sítě) a schopnost navrhnout efektivní propagační materiály či porozumět tomu, jak správně prezentovat firmu online.

Technická a servisní podpora: Kromě obchodních aktivit budete pravidelně pečovat o menší zákazníky (např. malé obecní úřady, školy). Zahrnuje to jednoduchou správu sítí, dodávky hardwaru a řešení základních IT požadavků.

Co od vás očekáváme:

Přirozené a zdravě sebevědomé vystupování, ideálně s několikaletou zkušeností v obchodní sféře.
Základní technické povědomí a ochotu učit se nové věci.
Samostatnost, spolehlivost a schopnost zvládat obchodní, marketingové i jednodušší technické úkoly.

Co nabízíme:
Přátelský kolektiv a podporu při zaškolení.
Možnost profesního růstu a dalšího vzdělávání.
Flexibilní pracovní náplň s různorodými úkoly a odpovídajícím platovým ohodnocením.
Moderní pracovní prostředí.

Rámcová pracovní náplň:

"    komplexní zajištění údržby a správy městské zeleně na svěřeném majetku (ve smyslu zadání, kontroly a přebírání prací)
"    zpracovávání běžné dokumentace ke správě majetku, provádění administrativně technické práce,

"    účast na jednáních s orgány MMP (Magistrátu města Plzně), ÚMO (Úřadu městského obvodu) a organizacemi v rozsahu svého pracovního zařazení

"    samostatně provádění průzkumu, monitoringu zdravotního stavu stromů, zajištění odborných posudků a navrhování arboristických zásahů tak, aby byla zajištěna bezpečnost a vitalita stromů,

"    vypracovává rozbory, metodiky provozních činností, vztahující se k zajištění stability dendrologického potenciálu města Plzně,
"    projednávat a schvalovat požadavky jiných subjektů na zásahy do dřevin,

"    vzdělání - preferujeme VŠ obor zahradnictví, arboristika, krajinářská architektura, správa zeleně, zahradní a krajinářské realizace, lesnictví, zemědělství případně SŠ obdobného zaměření s praxí v oboru
"    řidičský průkaz skupiny B,
"    znalost práce na PC (MS office).

Nabízíme:
"    zajímavá, koncepční práce a perspektivní zaměstnání,
"    motivující osobní příplatek, mimořádné odměny a další zaměstnanecké výhody (příspěvek na penzijní připojištění, stravenkový paušál, 5 dní indispozičního volna, výhodnější paušály na volání, 5 týdnů dovolené).

Bij Medicalhunt zoeken wij een Verzorgende IG'er die op zoek is naar een veelzijdige, afwisselende baan in de ouderenzorg.

Werkervaring in de functie is mooi meegenomen, maar geen vereiste. Wel is het belangrijk dat je beschikt over een zorgdiploma van minimaal helpende niveau.

Ben jij een Verzorgende IG die houdt van afwisseling, nieuwe uitdagingen en vrijheid in je werk? Dan hebben wij de baan voor jou!


Als Verzorgende IG via detachering spring jij in bij verschillende zorginstellingen: van verpleeghuizen en thuiszorg tot revalidatiecentra. Geen dag is hetzelfde! Je ondersteunt cliënten met hun dagelijkse zorg, voert verpleegtechnische handelingen uit en zorgt voor een warme en veilige omgeving.

Het is natuurlijk belangrijk om een vertrouwd gezicht te zijn voor de bewoners. Daarom duurt een detachering minimaal 2 tot 3 maanden, maar het kan ook een half jaar of zelfs een jaar zijn. In die tijd draai je volledig mee in het team. Na deze periode ga je door naar een nieuwe, uitdagende opdracht. Je kan kiezen voor afwisseling tussen verschillende doelgroepen, hebt de mogelijkheid om een opdracht te verlengen wanneer deze goed bevalt of je kiest voor een doelgroep die jou het meeste aanspreekt.


Bij Medicalhunt sta je er niet alleen voor: je krijgt een vaste contactpersoon en we bieden je persoonlijke begeleiding en ondersteuning, zodat jij je kunt focussen op wat je het beste doet: zorgen voor anderen!


Wat maakt detacheren nou zo leuk?

Afwisseling: Jij bepaalt waar en wanneer je werkt. Dit geeft je vrijheid in je werk, maar zorgt er ook voor dat je een goede werk-privé balans kan behouden;

Zekerheid: Een arbeidscontract bij ons voor een x aantal uren in de week, mét de flexibiliteit van detachering;

Ontwikkeling: Wij investeren in jouw groei met trainingen en opleidingen;

Teamspirit: Ook al werk je op verschillende locaties, je maak echt deel uit van team Medicalhunt. We staan altijd voor je klaar en zetten jouw werkgeluk op nummer 1!

Industrial plant care requires daily monitoring and weekly maintenance - discover optimal scheduling strategies for reliable operations.
Categories: Process IT
- https://conet.nl/news/process-it/how-often-should-you-perform-plant-care/
Regular plant care in industrial settings should be performed according to a structured maintenance schedule that varies by system type and operational demands. Critical systems require daily monitoring, while comprehensive maintenance typically occurs weekly to monthly. The frequency depends on equipment complexity, operating conditions, and regulatory requirements. Effective plant care combines preventive maintenance, routine inspections, and system optimization to ensure reliable operations. What does regular plant care actually involve?
Regular plant care encompasses comprehensive maintenance activities, including preventive maintenance, routine inspections, equipment servicing, and system optimization. This approach focuses on identifying and addressing potential issues before they cause operational disruptions or safety concerns.
The fundamental difference between reactive and proactive maintenance approaches defines successful plant care strategies. Reactive maintenance responds to equipment failures after they occur, often resulting in costly downtime and emergency repairs. Proactive plant care involves scheduled maintenance activities, continuous monitoring, and systematic inspections that prevent failures before they happen.

jobs.title: Postdoc AI in psychiatry
jobs.description:
In this position you will develop AI models to improve the lives of patients with psychiatric disorders. Interested? Apply now! In this project, you will develop predictive AI models that support clinically actionable outcomes for psychiatric disorders such as depression and schizophrenia. Working closely with (neuro)scientists and clinicians, you will translate cutting-edge AI methods into solutions for real-world clinical challenges. Your research will span a broad range of modelstopics, including deep learning, causal machine learning, distributed learning, unsupervised learning, foundation models, natural language processing, and explainable AI. A key challenge is that psychiatric research often relies on relatively small datasets, that while biomedical data are limited, and that data are subject to strict privacy requirements. You will work with a rich variety of data sources, including clinical data, (unstructured) electronic health records, MRI, time-series data (such as EEG, functional MRI, speech, and video), omics data, and mobile sensing. Amsterdam UMC offers access to extensive large datasets for model development and diagnostics, while also providing a unique opportunity to develop AI models for actionable problems for methods that remain effective in the small-data settings that are common in psychiatric research. You will develop innovative AI tools to improve the diagnosis, prognosis, and treatment of psychiatric disorders such as depression and schizophrenia. You will initiate and lead AI research projects in close collaboration with clinicians and researchers, combining cutting-edge AI methods with pressing clinical challenges. In addition to conducting your own research, you will (co-)supervise PhD candidates and initiate research projects for AI _tudents, helping to foster the next generation of researchers. You will also (co-)lead the department’s data science interest group, contribute to regional collaborations on data sharing, and actively

acquire funding to expand and sustain this line of research. You have a (nearly completed) PhD in AI and a strong scientific track record; You have experience with biomedical data analysis, image analysis, time-series analysis and/or unstructured data; You have excellent communication skills and command of written and oral English. Basic command of Dutch is preferred; You enjoy working in a multidisciplinary environment together with clinicians and are dedicated to developing clinical applications for psychiatry. One-year contract with possible extension for one more year. Further extension is dependent on additional funding. Classification in salary scale 10 or 11: € 3.724 to € 6.825 gross for full-time employment (depending on education and experience). In addition to a good basic salary, we offer 8.3% end-of-year bonus. Calculate your net salary here. If you travel by foot, bicycle, or car, a mileage allowance of €0.21 per km applies (up to a maximum of 40 km one way by car). Do you prefer walking or cycling? Take advantage of our good bike scheme. Pension accrual with the ABP, of which we pay 70% of the premium. Free and unlimited access to our online learning environment GoodHabitz. Als Magazijn Medewerker werk je in een nieuw magazijn van 4.200 m² met circa 20.000 verschillende onderdelen in voorraad. Over Vending@Work
Vending@Work (V@W) is opgericht in 1994 te Groningen en begon destijds met het plaatsen van zogeheten honestyboxen bij bedrijven en instellingen. Het concept was gebaseerd op de eerlijkheid van de mens. Consumenten konden betalen met een gulden voor elk artikel dat zij uit de box haalden, maar konden dit ook niet doen. Vooral bij grotere organisaties hield dit concept niet lang stand, zodat in 1998 werd besloten tot het plaatsen en exploiteren van frisdrank-, snack- en versautomaten. Vandaag de dag bedient V@W vanuit drie distributiecentra (Groningen, Nieuwegein en Nijmegen ) circa 5.000 automaten in Nederland. Daarnaast verzorgt V@W in meerdere school- en bedrijfskantines de catering. Met de inzet van circa 250 medewerkers is V@W daarmee één van de grootste landelijke spelers in de markt van vending.
Voor onze vestiging in Groningen zijn wij op zoek naar een plaatser / medewerker Technische Dienst in de buitendienst.

In deze functie ga je zelfstandig op pad met de bestelbus om storingen te verhelpen aan automaten bij onze opdrachtgevers. Daarnaast ben je verantwoordelijk voor het (gebruiksklaar) plaatsen en ophalen van de automaten. Ook voer je technisch onderhoud uit zodat de automaten perfect blijven functioneren. jobs.title: Director – International Relations and Diplomacy Programs
jobs.description:
Your mission

The Director of International Relations and Diplomacy (IRD) Programs, based at the Paris Campus, will provide academic leadership for Schiller International University’s undergraduate, graduate and online International Relations and Diplomacy programs across all campuses. The Director will be responsible for ensuring program currency and curriculum quality, faculty hiring and performance, and achieving student outcomes within the International Relations and Diplomacy discipline. In addition, the Director will provide Academic Leadership at the Paris Campus for all academic programs.
  
 The role encompasses the oversight of program design, curriculum development, course content, syllabi, course delivery, assessment and continuous improvement processes, ensuring compliance with U.S. accreditation standards, local regulatory requirements, and dual-degree and articulation agreements with various partners. The Director will work closely with academic leaders across campuses to recruit, evaluate, and support faculty teaching International Relations and Diplomacy courses, ensuring consistency in academic standards and learning outcomes throughout the institution. The director will also work with academic team, student experience and data team to monitor key performance indicators and help design interventions to ensure achieving student outcomes set by the university.
  
 In collaboration with Associate Deans, Directors of other academic areas, and the Paris Campus Director, the Director of International Relations and Diplomacy Programs will provide academic leadership for the Paris Campus and oversee faculty hiring and management, course allocations and academic operation. 
 
The successful candidate will work closely with faculty, staff, and other university stakeholders to foster student engagement, academic success, preparation for employment and career success, and deliver a transformative, student-centered educational experience aligned with Schiller’s experiential and challenge-based learning model.


Tasks and Responsabilities

  • Lead International Relations and Diplomacy programs design, review, and continuous improvement in collaboration with Academic team and other university offices. 
  • Participate in the review and assessment of program and course learning outcomes for International Relations and Diplomacy and other academic areas.
  • Engage actively in innovation within the area(s) of knowledge to update teaching and learning methodologies and educational technology in collaboration with the Educational Technology team and industry professionals.
  • Assess instructional needs and lead the effort to identify, hire and assign qualified faculty to all International Relations and Diplomacy courses across campuses in collaboration academic leaders on other campuses in a timely manner.
  • Collaborate with academic leaders on other campuses to identify, hire and assign qualified faculty to all courses on the Paris campus in a timely manner.
  • Lead annual evaluations of faculty in IRD across campuses and contribute to faculty annual performance evaluations at the Paris campus. 
  • Conduct course observations as needed, both online and onsite. 
  • Collaborate with the Educational Technology team to offer faculty development activities.
  • Support the growing Distance Learning Master’s program in International Relations and Diplomacy.
  • Collaborate with Dean of Institutional Effectiveness to ensure program quality and compliance with all regulations and accreditation requirements. 
  • Monitor student outcomes data weekly and to identify students at risk. Work with faculty and student services to design interventions to support their retention and success.
  • Collaborate with Employability team and devise and implement measures and initiatives to boost students’ employability and career success. 
  • Coordinate the effective implementation of VLE templates and uniform content within International Relations and Diplomacy offerings.
  • Manage faculty workload and faculty assignment in collaboration with the other academic leaders.
  • Any other duties assigned by the Provost, President or Campus Director.


Your Profile

  • An earned Doctorate degree in International Relations and Diplomacy or related field from an accredited institution or close to completion.
  • Proven experience and demonstrated excellence in higher education, administration, and industry experience.
  • Academic program design and review and managing faculty and staff.
  • Passion and commitment to student support and success.
  • Knowledge and experience in distant leaning and online instruction.
  • Knowledge of the American and/or French higher education systems is a plus.
  • Either native English speaker or proficiency level of English competency
  • Local language (French, German, Spanish), desirable
Competencies
  • Communication Connection and Service 
  • Global Mindset 
  • Achieving Results

jobs.title: Digital Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
At No Isolation, your work has real purpose. We’re on a mission to bring learning and belonging to every child — and we need a sharp digital mind to help us get there. You'll be part of an international and inspiring team making a real impact on society, and playing a key role in how we show up online.


⭐️ Your role and impact.

As our Digital Marketing Manager, you'll take the lead in building and optimising our digital presence — from paid ads to SEO and social media. You’ll run campaigns, follow the data, and keep levelling up performance, making sure No Isolation shows up in a meaningful way wherever people are searching, scrolling or clicking.

We’re growing fast, entering new markets, and reaching more educators and children than ever before, and you’ll be a key part of that momentum, helping us cut through the noise and get our message to the right people in the right way. You’ll work closely with the rest of the Marketing and Sales team, and you’ll be our in-house go-to for anything digital — guiding and inspiring with your knowledge, and helping the team stay digitally sharp.


🛠 What you'll be creating.

  • Run performance-driven campaigns across Google Ads, Facebook, LinkedIn and other platforms 

  • Own our SEO efforts — from keyword research to on-page/off-page improvements

  • Analyse user data and run A/B tests to improve conversion rates (CRO)

  • Collaborate with UX and creative designers to optimise landing pages and campaign creatives

  • Identify and manage direct ad placements on relevant industry sites

  • Plan and schedule organic social content tailored to different platforms

  • Write and publish website articles together with the wider marketing team

  • Maintain and optimise website content, including landing pages for regional

  • Track and report on key metrics, media spend, and campaign ROI campaigns


🎯 Who are we looking for?

You’re someone who gets excited about digital marketing, data, and finding smart, creative ways to drive results. You know your way around campaign tools and analytics dashboards, and you’re not afraid to dive into the details and make things happen. You’re curious, up-to-date on the latest digital marketing solutions, and you love testing out new things to see what works.


Your skill set includes.…

  • Hands-on experience with Google Ads, Meta Business Manager, and LinkedIn Campaign Manager

  • Solid understanding of SEM, SEO, CRO, A/B testing and analytics tools (e.g., Hotjar, Piwik Pro)

  • Proven track record in B2B digital marketing, preferably in a tech or digital agency environment

  • Experience managing direct media buys and negotiating placements

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills in English — and ideally fluency in another language from our core markets (Scandinavian or DACH)


🚀 What will make you stand out?

  • You’ve worked in high-performing teams or top digital agencies

  • You balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution

  • You bring a collaborative mindset and enjoy juggling a few things at once

  • You're passionate about meaningful work and using your skills for something that matters


What’s in it for YOU? 

🌍 Impactful work. Help us reach educators and decision-makers across Europe to bring learning and belonging to every child.

🎨 Autonomy and trust. Take ownership of our digital strategy and bring your ideas to life.

📈 Growth and development. You’ll be part of an exciting scale-up journey where the pace is fast and the opportunities are wide open — new markets, new roles, new ideas. There's plenty of room to grow.

🤝 Incredible colleagues. Work with smart, inspiring people who are truly passionate about what they do.

💻 Flexible setup. Core hours are 10–15, with a hybrid work model that allows you to split your time between home and the office.

🌱 Wellness support. We offer therapy sessions, mobile/internet reimbursements, wellness hours, and PJ days. 

📍 Location: Oslo or London (hybrid). You'll work closely with both the sales team and the rest of the global marketing team. 💰 Salary: NOK 550,000–700,000 / £40,000-50,000. This range is an estimate; the actual salary will depend on experience, skills, and other factors.


🤖 Who Are We?

No Isolation was founded in 2015 when we developed AV1, a telepresence robot that helps children and young people stay connected to their education during long-term absences due to illness. Our mission is to help educators bring learning and belonging to every child.

Today, there are over 3,500 active AV1 robots used across 18 European countries. Positioned in the EdTech sector, AV1 is a unique solution to the growing issue of persistent absence, supporting both the academic and social needs of students.


nclusion And Diversity

At No Isolation, we value diversity and inclusion in our workplace. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and experiences. If you require adjustments during the application process, please contact us at below email.

Positioned in the EdTech sector, AV1 is a unique solution to the growing issue of persistent absence, supporting both the academic and social needs of students. jobs.description:
At Oda, we come to work every day with the goal of creating affordable grocery services to make the logistics of living surprisingly easy for our customers in Norway and Sweden. That’s what gets us fired up. First, we built Norway’s leading online grocery store and now, partnered with Mathem in Sweden, we’re on our way to becoming the world’s most effective retail system. With our wide selection and competitive prices, we deliver to the doorsteps of thousands of Scandinavian homes every week.

As a driver with us, you play an essential role in representing Oda to our customers. You will be part of our dedicated team of drivers and report to the Delivery Operating Manager and Delivery Team Leaders on site. You’ll be delivering groceries and packages to our many customers in the area. We believe you'll like working as a driver at Oda if you can manage your time effectively, work independently and in a team, and approach challenges with a solution-oriented mindset. Additionally, it would be best to enjoy being active, as this job involves a lot of physical activity, not only driving.


What you’ll be doing as a Driver 🚚

  • Delivering food and packages to our customers.

  • Maintain efficiency and quality in our work by loading and unloading goods, handling customers, and implementing routines and processes.

  • Ensuring Customer service at the highest level.

  • Be responsible for simple maintenance of the car fleet, such as changing light bulbs, topping up liquids, and keeping the cars clean and presentable at all times.

  • Training new drivers on the road.

  • Contributing to the improvement of driver routines and processes.


What you’ll need to succeed 🌟

  • Driving license (Class B) with a minimum of 2 year's driving experience.

  • Speaking English is required, and familiarity with Norwegian or another Nordic language is a plus.


What would be nice to have 💡

  • Are active and like it, as this is a physically demanding job

  • Likes working independently and with a team

  • Have a good work ethic

  • Are service-oriented and solution-oriented.

  • Have a genuine desire to succeed and make customers happy

  • Responsible and prioritizes safe behaviour in traffic


What we offer 🚀

This is your chance to make a real impact as a Driver in a fast-moving company with a product people love—while shaking up the grocery industry. You’ll experience:

  • Teammates who aim high and have each other’s backs. We care about people, and that means supporting each other every step of the way.

  • A flat structure where we team up across disciplines to solve exciting challenges. Big ideas come from everywhere!

  • A transparent way of working. We use Slack to stay in the loop—less email, fewer meetings, more getting things done.

  • Discounted lunch and a free gym to stay fueled and energized.


Practical informationℹ️

  • Application deadline: Assessed on an ongoing basis

  • Starting date: As soon as possible

  • The position is based on a turnus schedule (rotational shift work)

  • Location: Drammensveien 189, 3420 Lierskogen


At Oda, you’ll join a passionate, ambitious team working to change the future of grocery shopping. We’re all different—just like you—and we wouldn’t have it any other way. If you need any adjustments or support during the application process, just let us know, and we’ll do our best to help. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and want everyone to have an equal shot at landing the job.

Come build the future of grocery with us! Want to know more about how we work? Check out these posts on Medium!


We can’t wait to hear from you! 🧡


As part of our work to ensure a fair and open-minded recruitment process, we have chosen to collaborate with Hubert.ai, a virtual recruitment assistant that helps with the selection process. Oda is the leading online grocery retailer in Norway, but as a company, we’re first and foremost an ambitious tech and logistics company - not a classic retailer. We’re one of the fastest-growing startups in the Nordics, working with huge, complex challenges to make the lives of our customers simpler and easier. Want to join us? Our goal is to create the world's most efficient retail system. Through smart work, passionate customer focus and our own technology we make a difference in the lives of thousands of customers and change society for the better through a completely re-imagined value chain for grocery shopping. Our customers save more than 60 hours a year, time we believe can be better spent than going to the store. jobs.description:
About the team

OpenAI’s mission is to build safe artificial general intelligence (AGI) which benefits all of humanity. This long-term undertaking brings the world’s best scientists, engineers, and business professionals into one lab together to accomplish this.

In pursuit of this mission, our Go To Market (GTM) team is responsible for helping customers learn how to leverage and deploy our highly capable AI products across their business. The team is made of Sales, Solutions, Support, Marketing, and Partnership professionals that work together to create valuable solutions that will help bring AI to as many users as possible.

About the role

Our Sales team has a unique mission to help customers understand the deep impact that highly capable AI models can bring to their business and users. This role is a mixture of technical understanding, vision, partnership, and value-driven strategy.

You’ll be a key driver of opportunities through the entire sales cycle, from pipeline generation to closure. You’ll work with researchers, engineers, and solution strategists to help customers evolve their industry with AI.

This role is based in Paris. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week.

 

In this role, you'll:

  • Manage ~dozen key accounts, developing and executing strategies for a comprehensive account plan

  • Lead our enterprise prospects’ journeys from consideration to succesful deployment

  • Partner with solutions and research engineering to build and execute complex customer programs and projects

  • Own a consumption revenue target

  • Manage consumption revenue forecasts

  • Analyze key account metrics to create reports and provide insights to internal and external stakeholders

  • Closely monitor the industry landscape (people, competitors, partners, etc.) to contribute to product roadmap and other corporate strategies

  • Collaborate with solutions, marketing, communications, business operations, people operations, finance, product management, and engineering

  • Support the recruitment and onboarding of other teammates

  • Support the development of company culture

We're seeking someone with experience including:

  • 5-7+ years selling platform-as-a-service and/or software-as-a-service

  • Supporting the growth of fast-growing, high-performance companies

  • Leading high-visibility customer events (CAB, conferences, product launches, etc.)

  • Gathering, distilling, and processing complex market (industry, competitor, customer, prospect) intelligence

 

You might thrive in this role if you:

You build strong relationships with executives and professionals across functions and serve as a trusted advisor.

jobs.description:
About Airwallex

Airwallex is the only unified payments and financial platform for global businesses. Powered by our unique combination of proprietary infrastructure and software, we empower over 250,000 businesses worldwide – including Brex, Navan, Qantas, SHEIN and many more – with fully integrated solutions to manage everything from business accounts, payments, spend management and treasury, to embedded finance at a global scale.

Proudly founded in Melbourne, we have a team of over 2,300 of the brightest and most innovative people in tech across 27 offices around the globe. Valued at US$11 billion and backed by world-leading investors including T. Rowe Price, Visa, Mastercard, Robinhood Ventures, Sequoia, Salesforce Ventures, DST Global, and Lone Pine Capital, Airwallex is leading the charge in building the global payments and financial platform of the future. If you’re ready to do the most ambitious work of your career, join us.

 

Attributes We Value

We hire successful builders with founder-like energy who want real impact, accelerated learning, and true ownership. You bring strong role-related expertise and sharp thinking, and you’re motivated by our mission and operating principles. You move fast with good judgment, dig deep with curiosity, and make decisions from first principles, balancing speed and rigor.

You're humble and collaborative; turn zero‑to‑one ideas into real products, and you “get stuff done” end-to-end. You use AI to work smarter and solve problems faster. Here, you’ll tackle complex, high‑visibility problems with exceptional teammates and grow your career as we build the future of global banking. If that sounds like you, let’s build what’s next.

 

About the role...

As Partnerships Director, France & Spain, you will lead and develop a team of four partnership managers:

  • Two Accounting Partnerships Managers

  • One Venture Capital Partnerships Manager

  • One Travel & E-commerce Partnerships Manager

You will own the partnerships strategy and commercial performance across both markets, building a channel-led growth engine that generates qualified introductions, partner-sourced pipeline and net-new business for Airwallex.

This is a strategic, hands-on player-coach role. You will set direction, develop the team and build the operating model, while personally sourcing, negotiating, activating and growing strategic partnerships.

The role is focused on commercial partnerships and lead generation—not technical integrations. The initial priority is to build the Accounting and Travel & E-commerce channels across France and Spain. The broader scope includes Payments and Venture Capital and may evolve with business priorities.

The role is based in either France or Spain, with a minimum of three days per week in the relevant Airwallex office.

What you’ll do...

  • Own the France and Spain partnerships strategy, aligned with the SME & Growth GTM.

  • Set partner ICPs, commercial priorities, account plans, pipeline expectations and operating standards across the team.

  • Lead, coach and develop the four partnership managers.

  • Personally source and progress a portfolio of strategic partnerships in at least one priority vertical.

  • Build repeatable referral, reseller, co-selling and partner-led outbound motions across Accounting, Travel, Payments, E-commerce and VC.

  • Ensure signed partnerships become active commercial channels, not passive logos.

  • Work with Sales on account mapping, lead routing, qualification, follow-up and conversion of partner-sourced opportunities.

  • Track active partners, referrals, opportunities, sourced and influenced pipeline, conversion, time to first referral and revenue contribution.

  • Test partner segments and commercial motions; scale what creates quality pipeline and stop what does not.

  • Work cross-functionally with Marketing, RevOps, Product, Solutions, Risk and Compliance to remove friction from the partner journey.

What you’ll bring...

  • 8+ years in partnerships, channel sales, indirect sales, partner sales, strategic business development or a comparable commercial role.

  • A successful 0-to-1 partnership motion or vertical launch in Accounting or Travel & E-commerce, with measurable commercial outcomes.

  • Strong channel-led execution and a personal track record of partner-sourced referrals, pipeline, opportunities or revenue.

  • Commercial experience across at least two of these verticals: Accounting, Travel, Payments, E-commerce or Venture Capital.

  • A deep, activatable network in at least one priority vertical, with access to senior decision-makers.

  • Strong strategic judgement and hands-on execution: you can define the strategy and personally open the first doors, lead key meetings and progress strategic partnerships.

  • Experience designing partner ICPs, activation motions, attribution and channel performance management.

  • Experience leading, coaching or developing partnership professionals is preferred. Formal people-management experience is valuable, but not the only indicator of leadership potential.

  • Experience in accounting, payments, fintech, ERP, financial software or another competitive B2B environment.

  • Professional English plus native or bilingual French or Spanish. Native or bilingual proficiency in the other local language is a strong advantage, but not required.

  • Comfortable with CRM, funnel metrics, partner economics and basic business cases.

Who you are...

  • Strategic and hands-on: you can set direction while staying close to partners, pipeline and commercial details.

  • Channel-led: you care about net-new business and revenue, not only signed agreements or ecosystem visibility.

  • A builder: you create structure from zero, test quickly and learn without waiting for a perfect playbook.

  • Commercially accountable: you use data to decide where to invest, coach or stop.

  • A player-coach: you develop people while continuing to win strategic partnerships yourself.

What success looks like...

  • The four partnership managers have clear mandates, partner ICPs, account priorities and measurable pipeline objectives.

  • Accounting and Travel & E-commerce have prioritised partner strategies and active channel motions in France and Spain.

  • Partner cohorts are recruited, activated and connected to repeatable referral, reseller or co-selling motions.

  • You personally own strategic partnerships that contribute materially to Airwallex’s growth.

  • Partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline is accurately tracked and converted with clear Sales ownership.

  • The team scales the highest-performing partner segments and quickly deprioritises inactive or low-potential relationships.

Why join Airwallex...

You will own a strategic growth engine across France and Spain and shape how Airwallex builds channel-led growth in the region.

  • Director-level ownership across two European markets

  • Strategic and hands-on player-coach role

  • Direct ownership of partner-sourced growth and strategic partnerships

  • Opportunity to build scalable channels across Accounting, Travel, E-commerce, Payments and VC

  • Hybrid role in France or Spain: minimum three days per week in the relevant office

  • Competitive salary, commission and equity

All official communication will come from an @airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page.

Equal opportunity

jobs.description:
🌀 The Company

Filigran, founded in October 2022, stands out in the cybertech ecosystem for its commitment to revolutionizing cyber threat management with a proactive approach. Its mission is to develop innovative open-source solutions designed to anticipate cyber threats, identify security gaps, and strengthen organizational security posture.

Filigran solutions are now trusted by over 6,000 public and private organizations worldwide.

🎯 The Role

We’re looking for a DPO & Compliance Officer to design and implement Filigran’s practical, scalable compliance program.

You will be Filigran’s formal Data Protection Officer, ensuring strong privacy governance across our products, operations and international footprint. You will also lead the day-to-day design and delivery of broader compliance workstreams, including AI governance, cybersecurity regulation, operational resilience, export controls and sanctions.

You will work closely with the General Counsel, CEO, CISO, People, Product, Engineering and Sales teams, helping Filigran meet regulatory expectations in a business-minded attitude.

💼 Your Responsibilities

  • Act as Filigran’s Data Protection Officer and primary point of contact for supervisory authorities, including the CNIL, and for data subjects.

  • Design and operate Filigran’s privacy program, including ROPAs, DPIAs, privacy by design, retention, data-subject rights, breach assessment and international data transfers.

  • Lead the design and operational implementation of compliance controls across AI governance, NIS2, operational resilience, export controls and economic sanctions, under the General Counsel’s leadership.

  • Maintain a proportionate compliance framework, including policies, risk mapping, monitoring plans, internal controls and clear reporting.

  • Partner with Security to translate regulatory requirements into practical, business-enabling policies and controls that work for a fast-growing cybersecurity company.

  • Partner with Security, Product and Engineering to embed privacy, AI and regulatory requirements into product development, vendor management and customer assurance.

  • Monitor regulatory developments across the EU, UK, US and other relevant markets, and provide clear recommendations to the General Counsel and executive team.

  • Support enterprise sales and procurement by responding to privacy, AI governance and compliance requirements.

  • Leverage AI tools and methodologies to boost productivity and impact

  • Contribute to building AI capabilities into internal workflows

🤝 Who You’ll Work With

You will have a split reporting line:

  • For your statutory DPO responsibilities, you will report directly to the CEO. You will have the independence and access to senior management required to carry out those responsibilities.

  • For all other compliance responsibilities, you will report to the General Counsel, who retains ultimate accountability for Filigran’s wider compliance programme and material compliance decisions.

You will work closely with the General Counsel, CISO, Security, Product, Engineering, Sales, People and Finance teams. You will lead delivery across the programme while knowing when to escalate decisions and draw on internal or external specialists.

🧬 Profile We’re Looking For

  • 7 to 10 years’ experience as a DPO, data privacy lead or compliance officer, ideally in a fast-growing technology or SaaS company.

  • Demonstrable expert knowledge of data protection law and practice. A recognized DPO certification or IAPP qualification, such as CIPP/E, is strongly preferred.

  • Experience with a company-wide implementation of the EU AI Act.

  • Deep, hands-on command of GDPR and UK GDPR, including ROPAs, DPIAs, breach management, data-subject rights and international transfers.

  • Demonstrable ownership of at least two adjacent regulatory programmes, such as AI governance, cybersecurity regulation, operational resilience, export controls or economic sanctions.

  • Able to lead unfamiliar workstreams with sound judgement and appropriate specialist internal or external support.

  • Comfortable translating complex legal and regulatory requirements into proportionate controls that work operationally.

  • Able to build strong relationships and credibility with technical, commercial and executive stakeholders.

  • Comfortable working in a remote, async-first environment.

  • Autonomy, ownership and team spirit.

  • Strong interest in AI and its applications in the privacy & compliance function

  • Comfortable working with and leveraging AI-powered tools (LLMs, automation, copilots, etc.) to improve workflows and productivity

  • Bonus: experience in cybersecurity, threat intelligence or a technical B2B SaaS environment; fluency in English and French.

🌱 Why Join Filigran? More than just a job.

We’re a fast-growing, global, and fully remote company building open-source cybersecurity solutions, increasingly powered by AI, to help defense teams anticipate threats and act faster.

⭐ What we believe

We believe we do work that matters, uniting defenders into a global community to make security more open, resilient & collaborative.

💻 How we work

We do work that matters by combining strong engineering standards with emerging technologies, including AI, to move faster and smarter.

🧭 What guides us

We make our work matter by building a culture grounded in our CORE values of Cohesion, Openness, Responsibility, and Equity. The principles that guide how we make decisions, treat people, and grow together, especially when no one’s watching.

💰 Compensation & Benefits

  • Competitive pay + equity - everyone shares in our success

  • Remote-first, flexible, and balanced - work that fits your life

  • Your setup, your choice - pick the gear that works for you

  • Twice-a-year gatherings - we meet in person for regional and global offsites to connect, collaborate, and strengthen our culture beyond the screen

🌍 Equal Employment Opportunity

We enable cybersecurity through inclusion - from code to culture.

At Filigran, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We believe diversity of our people make our products and our team stronger. We welcome talent of every background, identity, and lived experience, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status.

What matters here is what you bring, not what you look like, where you’re from, or how you identify.

Minimum 3 lata doświadczenia w utrzymaniu instalacji elektrycznych, w tym co najmniej 1 rok w środowisku data center lub obiekcie klasy Tier III/IV. Znajomość topologii zasilania data center: UPS, STS/ATS, PDU, generator, busbar. Umiejętność czytania schematów elektrycznych jedno- i wieloliniowych. jobs.title: IT Senior Consultant - Internal Audit (m/f)
jobs.description:
IT Senior Consultant - Internal Audit

Locations Luxembourg
time type Full time
job requisition id JR100150

Operating as an internationally integrated partnership in over 100 countries and territories, Forvis Mazars Group specialises in audit, tax and advisory services. The partnership draws on the expertise and cultural understanding of over 40,000 professionals across the globe to assist clients of all sizes at every stage in their development.

Our Internal Audit practice supports leading financial institutions in Luxembourg in strengthening their IT governance, internal control frameworks, and digital risk management capabilities.

Within a fast-evolving regulatory and technological environment, we assist Boards, Authorized Management, CIOs, CISOs, and Heads of Internal Audit in addressing regulatory expectations, enhancing operational resilience, and managing technology-related risks.
Join a dynamic and growing practice where innovation, collaboration, and professional excellence drive our ambition to become a leading Consulting & Advisory player in Luxembourg.

Your role:

As an IT Senior Consultant, you will play a key role in delivering IT Internal Audit engagements across the Luxembourg financial sector.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Leading and executing IT Internal Audit engagements covering IT General Controls (ITGC), application controls, IT governance, cybersecurity, and operational resilience.
• Supporting financial institutions (banks, asset managers, ManCos, AIFMs, payment institutions, PSFs) in strengthening their IT control environment and internal audit functions.
• Assessing compliance with Luxembourg and European regulatory frameworks including CSSF circulars, DORA, EBA Guidelines, ICT Risk Management and outsourcing regulations.
• Performing IT risk assessments, control design reviews, testing activities, maturity assessments, and remediation follow-ups.
• Acting as a trusted advisor to clients by translating complex IT risks into pragmatic business recommendations.
• Managing day-to-day delivery of engagements, monitoring timelines, and ensuring high-quality outputs.
• Contributing to the development of Internal Audit methodologies and innovative service solutions.
• Coaching and mentoring junior consultants while fostering a collaborative team environment.
• Supporting business development initiatives through proposal preparation, client presentations, and market eminence activities.
• Collaborating with multidisciplinary teams across Risk Advisory, Cybersecurity and Regulatory Consulting practices.

Your profile:

• Master's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Engineering, Finance, or a related discipline.
• A maximum of 3 to 4 years of professional experience in IT Internal Audit, IT Risk Advisory, Technology Consulting, or External/Internal Audit, gained within a consulting firm or financial institution.
• Strong knowledge of IT control frameworks and standards such as COBIT, ISO 27001, NIST, COSO, and ITIL.
• Good understanding of Luxembourg regulatory expectations impacting IT environments (CSSF, DORA, ICT risk, outsourcing, operational resilience). PSD2 may be an added advantage.
• Ability to interact confidently with senior stakeholders including CIO, CISO, Internal Audit and Risk functions.
• Strong analytical mindset combined with business acumen and consulting attitude.
• Proven project coordination and team mentoring capabilities.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
• Fluency in English is mandatory; French and/or German are strong assets.

We offer:

• Exposure to tier-1 financial institutions and complex IT risk environments in Luxembourg.
• A strong focus on personal development and professional growth, including continuous learning environment with structured training programs and certification support (CISA, CIA, CRISC, ISO 27001, CISSP).
• A dynamic, multicultural, and collaborative work environment with competitive remuneration and benefits.
• The advantages of working in a human-sized international firm that combines professional excellence with a commitment to societal impact as well as global reach with a personal and collaborative working culture.
• A young, energetic, and supportive team culture where your contribution is valued, and where you can make a tangible difference for both clients and the firm.
• The opportunity to contribute to international projects or work with cross-border teams, while your base will be in Luxembourg.

Forvis Mazars is an equal opportunities employer and is committed to building a diverse and inclusive culture in which each individual feels welcomed.

We consider candidates based on their skills, abilities or experiences as we believe everyone brings their own talents with them.
The diversity of our talents is what makes our work environment multicultural, innovative and enriching.

Afin de renforcer notre équipe, nous recherchons un chargé achat bétail (H/F/X). Si vous êtes passionné par le secteur de
l'élevage, que vous avez le sens de la négociation et souhaitez contribuer au développement de notre entreprise, nous vous

MISSIONS

PROFIL

jobs.description:
Description:

Fiche de poste

Responsable d'un rang, c'est-à-dire d'un groupe de tables, le chef de rang doit veiller au bon déroulement du service sur l'ensemble de ces tables.

En cas d'absence du maître d'hôtel prise de commande le chef de rang fait le service à table et débarrassé aidé par des commis.

Lors de la mise en place des tables, il vérifie que rien ne manque; au moment du service, il doit parfaitement bien connaître la carte et les plats pour être en mesure de répondre aux questions des clients, connaître, maîtriser toutes les techniques de présentation et de découpage, voire de flambage.

À la fin du repas, il s'assure de la satisfaction des clients, effectue l'addition et encaisse leur règlement.

Activités principales

• Assurer un excellent service
• Relations avec la clientèle
• Mise en place
• Accueil et accompagnement du client
• Prise de commande et service
• Encadrer le travail des commis

Coordination et contrôle

• effectuer la mise en place des tables avant chaque service,
• vérifier la propreté et l'intégrité de la vaisselle et des couverts,
• mettre en place les consoles de service,
• accueillir et accompagner le client jusqu'à sa table,
• présenter la carte et la carte des vins (en cas d'absence du sommelier)
• prendre la commande et la transmettre à la cuisine,
• connaître parfaitement les plats à la carte ainsi que les éventuels plats du jour,
• expliquer aux clients la composition des plats au moment du service,
• répondre aux questions des clients,
• maîtriser les différentes techniques de découpage et de présentation,
• adapter le service à table en fonction du travail des cuisiniers,
• vérifier le bon déroulement du service,
• encadrer le travail des commis de salle et des serveurs,
• s'enquérir de la satisfaction du client au cours et à la fin du repas,
• éditer l'addition,
• réaliser l'encaissement,
• débarrasser les tables.

Compétences principales

• Analyser rapidement le besoin du client et le conseiller dans ses choix
• Gérer les réclamations et les remarques négatives
• Adopter les gestes et postures permettant de travailler en toute sécurité
• Placer le client au centre de son activité et de sa mission
• Connaissance d'une à plusieurs langues étrangères

Savoir Etre

• Accueillir les clients avec une excellente maîtrise des gestes, de l'expression du visage et du langage
• Adapter son comportement, sa présentation générale à l'image et à la culture de l'établissement
• Assurer la cohésion de l'équipe
• Faire reconnaître et accepter son autorité
• Installer dès la réservation un climat de convivialité en appliquant les codes de l'établissement
• Relever les dysfonctionnements de service et en parler hors présence client

Autres avantages:  Parking, Repas.

Job Description

We are seeking a Finance Business Partner (Business Services) based in Luxembourg (hybrid). You will partner with Business Services leadership to drive lean accounting, process optimization and AI-driven reporting, lead budgeting and forecasting cycles, and deliver actionable financial insights that improve performance. The role suits a senior, pragmatic finance professional (10+ years) with SAP and BI experience, a strong process orientation, and a proven ability to deliver under pressure.

As Senior Finance Business Partner (Business Services) you will be the finance lead embedded with Business Services, acting as a change agent to drive lean accounting, process optimization and data-driven decision making. You will tightly partner with COO (Head of Business Services) and the business services leaders to translate operational needs into actionable financial insights, streamline processes through automation and AI-enabled tools, and support performance improvement across cost, quality and delivery. This replacement role requires a senior, hands-on professional who thrives under pressure, prioritizes effectively, and contributes as a collaborative team player.

What you will be working on

• Act as the trusted finance partner to CFO, Head of Finance, COO and Business Services leadership: deliver financial insight, challenge assumptions and influence decisions.
• Act as a sparring partner to the Director of FP&A contributing to robust discussions on financial performance, forecasting assumptions, business plans, controlling model and strategic priorities.
• Lead process improvement and lean accounting initiatives to simplify workflows, reduce waste and strengthen internal controls.
• Design, develop and maintain reporting and analysis that support operational decisions — move towards near real-time, KPI-driven dashboards.
• Drive automation and AI adoption across finance processes (reporting, forecasting, reconciliations, controls), identifying opportunities for AI.
• Support monthly close activities and ensure accuracy and timeliness of financial data.
• Lead budgeting, forecasting and budgetary control processes for Business Services; provide scenario analysis and actionable recommendations.
• Translate business change needs into finance requirements and support implementation of new tools, systems or processes (working closely with Digital Accelerator team  and Finance peers).
• Deliver ad hoc financial analysis and sponsor small-to-medium projects that enhance financial performance or operating model.
• Promote financial and business awareness across the Business function and within Finance through coaching and clear communication.

What we look for

• Strong accounting and controlling background with a minimum of 10 years' relevant experience.
• Advanced Excel; experience with SAP finance modules and Reporting tools.
• Hands-on familiarity with automation/AI tools or demonstrable appetite and experience driving such initiatives.
• Solid budgeting, forecasting and financial modelling skills.
• Excellent communication and presentation skills in English; other languages an asset.
• Proven track record in a finance business partnering role supporting shared services, central functions or similar.
• Demonstrable experience running process improvement projects and delivering automation/AI-driven efficiencies.
• Comfortable operating independently, handling ambiguous situations and escalating appropriately.
• Behavioral skills and competencies: growth mindset, change agent, process-oriented, detail focused, pressure management, team work, decision quality and uphold KPMG firm standars.

jobs.title: Directeur amélioration continue (m/f)
jobs.description:
Description des tâches:

Director, Continuous Improvement and Industry 4.0

• Zone Industrielle P.E.D, BP 38, Rodange, Luxembourg, Luxembourg Employees work in a hybrid mode
• Full-time
• Compensation: EUR 116,340 - EUR 186,144 - yearly

Job Description

Are you ready to architect the future of Advanced Manufacturing?
At the Materials Group (MG), we are not just optimizing operations, we are redefining them. We are seeking a visionary and dynamic Director, Continuous Improvement and Industry 4.0  to lead our central Enterprise Lean System (ELS) function.
This is a high-impact, regional executive role designed for an operational architect who can bridge the gap between world-class, foundational Lean Six Sigma methodologies and cutting-edge Industry 4.0 technologies (AI, Predictive Analytics, and Cognitive Automation). Based in our Rodange facility, you will hold the keys to regional standardization, capability building, and digital supply chain transformation across Europe.

The Challenge & The Vision

As the Director of Central ELS, you will play two pivotal roles: the Guardian of Standards and the Pioneer of Innovation.
You will lead a high-performing central team to drive continuous improvement, establishing a high-margin production environment. Concurrently, you will orchestrate the transition from manual Lean frameworks to an AI-driven "Lighthouse Factory" footprint, leveraging predictive models, virtual environments, and connected systems.

Key Responsibilities

1. Guardian of Operational & Supply Chain Standards

• Act as the regional "Center as Guardian," serving as the sole architect of operational standards in the Regional Playbook.
• Govern all core manufacturing work standards (5S, Standard Work Audits, Daily Tier Meetings, Kaizen, SMED, TPM, and OEE Tracking/Loss Analysis).
• Establish robust supply chain standards, covering Production Planning Logic, Inventory Buffer Protocols, Freight Spend Governance, and S&OP Integration.
• Govern and standardize Data Science & AI models across the region.

2. Capability Builder & Training Academy Leader

• Standardize regional workforce mindsets and skillsets through a centralized regional training engine.
• Maintain the end-to-end certification pathway for Yellow, Green, and Black Belt mastery, alongside modern Digital Literacy pathways.
• Design functionally deep training curricula and scale execution through "Train-the-Trainer" initiatives with local site leaders.

3. Orchestrator of Strategy Deployment

• Lead the Yearly Strategic Deployment process ensuring 100% functional alignment between Sales, Marketing, Operations, Supply Chain, Finance, HR, and IT.
• Utilize the Annual Operating Plan (AOP) and key performance metrics to establish regional breakthrough targets.
• Facilitate the collaborative "Catchball" process to negotiate and lock departmental action plans.
• Manage the monthly governance framework for PDCA reviews at executive and functional levels.

4. Pioneer of ELS 4.0 & Digital Twin Innovation

• Drive the shift to automated, AI-driven operations, implementing predictive models that empower local sites to preempt issues.
• Lead shopfloor IoT integration, ensuring machines feed real-time performance data directly into core IT systems.
• Deploy a Regional Control Tower live-dashboard to visualize the entire end-to-end supply chain.
• Deploy advanced solutions for AI-Driven Predictive Quality, Maintenance, Cognitive Automation, and dynamic 3D Digital Twin simulations.

5. Champion of the Hub & Spoke Model

• Serve as the central regional filter and amplifier for operational innovation.
• Capture best-in-class local site innovations directly from the Gemba, codifying validated successes into the "Gold Standard" regional playbook for network-wide deployment.

6. High-Performing Team Leader

• Cultivate an inspiring team culture rooted in high performance, psychological safety, and radical accountability.
• Mentor and coach a dedicated central team, providing clear career development pathways and fostering cross-functional collaboration.

Qualifications

Who You Are

• The Expert: You possess extensive experience leading Lean, Six Sigma, and Continuous Improvement functions on a regional or global scale.
• The Digital Native: You have a proven track record of implementing Industry 4.0 solutions (IoT, Predictive Maintenance, AI, or Digital Twins) within a manufacturing environment.
• The Architect: You excel at designing, documenting, and scaling operational systems and standards from scratch.
• The Communicator: You are an expert at navigating Hoshin Kanri / Strategic Deployment, bringing diverse stakeholders (from the shopfloor to the C-suite) along on the transformation journey.
• The People Developer: You love building capability, leading academies, and mentoring future operational leaders.

• Location: We welcome candidates residing near any of our major manufacturing hubs in Luxembourg, France, the UK, Germany, or Belgium.

Additional Information

Why join Avery Dennison:  We are a global materials science and digital identification solutions company with locations in over 50 countries, and approximately 35,000 employees worldwide. As a science and innovation company, we believe that diverse teams are stronger teams. jobs.title: Senior Business Development Manager (m/f)
jobs.description:
Senior Business Development Manager – Multi Family Offices & Professional Intermediaries (M/F)

Luxembourg | req786

Founded in 1856, Banque Internationale à Luxembourg is the oldest multi-business bank in the Grand Duchy. From its foundation, the BIL has always played an active role in the development of the Luxembourg economy. It currently operates in retail, private and corporate banking, as well as on major capital markets. Employing more than 2 000 people, BIL is present in the financial hotspots that are Luxembourg, Switzerland, and China.

As a major player in Luxembourg's finance industry and as a signatory of the UN Principles of Responsible Banking, BIL is committed to handing over a responsible and sustainable bank to future generations.

We are seeking a dynamic and results-driven Business Developer to join our team, focusing on Multi/Single Family Offices & Professional Intermediaries. In this role, you will be responsible for identifying and cultivating relationships with professional intermediaries and clients, driving business growth, and ensuring the delivery of exceptional service. The position is based in Luxembourg and you will report to the Head of Multi Family Offices & Professional Intermediaries.

Your next challenge:

• Contribute to the growth strategy and to the development of the value proposition of the bank
• Conduct research to identify business opportunities with new customers
• Develop a growth strategy, foster and build both long-term and trustworthy customer relationships with professional intermediaries, including law firms, fiduciaries, and family offices (B2B and B2C)
• Maintain an extensive knowledge of the current market conditions to detect and/or anticipate possible commercial opportunities for the customers
• Collaborate across business lines to help you develop new business leads
• Attend and coordinate events (seminars, conferences)
• Make use of the internal CRM to keep track on your business development activities

Your skills:

• Minimum of 10 years of experience in a front function within the banking or financial services sector
• A strong international network of MFO/SFO & Professional Intermediaries
• Strong analytical skills, particularly in KYC/AML compliance
• Solid understanding of wealth structuring, wealth management product and services
• Excellent interpersonal skills, an entrepreneurial spirit and the ability to build sustainable relationships
• Proven negotiation skills and the ability to close deals
• A high level of integrity and ethics
• Strong analytical skills, particularly in KYC/AML compliance.
• A relevant University background in Finance
• Fluent in English and French, any other language is seen as an advantage (for example : German, Italian)
• Strongly client- and results-oriented
• Rigorous, organized and methodical in customer approach actions
• Motivated to be part of a great team
• Willing and able to travel

BIL offers a broad range of challenging projects and a huge choice of career paths .We will assist you in finding the one that best meets your skills and expectations. Your personal development is our priority and we greatly encourage you to dive into different business areas for the broadest possible experience.

BIL is firmly of the opinion that diversity & inclusion contribute towards increasing the collective performance of the Bank. We are committed to creating a culture of inclusion that encourages individual development with equal opportunities for all.

jobs.title: GIO - Application Administrator / Support Engineer (m/f)
jobs.description:
We are looking for an Application Administrator / Support Engineer to take ownership of our business systems and provide second-level support to users across the organization. You will configure and maintain business applications, resolve escalated support issues, manage user access, build reports and automations, and ensure our tools run smoothly as we grow.


This role offers growth opportunities with hands-on experience in system integrations, automation, and technical operations. You will start as a power user and develop into a technical administrator who builds workflows and connects systems.


Responsibilities
Second-Level Support :

    Handle escalated support tickets requiring deeper technical investigation.

    Diagnose and resolve complex application issues across business systems.

    Communicate solutions clearly to users in French, English, and German.

    Document recurring issues and create knowledge base articles.

    Identify patterns in support requests and address root causes.

User & Access Management :

    Manage user accounts, permissions, and roles across all business applications.

    Own onboarding and offboarding processes for system access.

    Implement and maintain security policies and access controls.

System Configuration :

    Configure applications to match business processes and workflows.

    Build and maintain custom fields, objects, and automation rules.

    Set up and maintain integrations between systems.

Data & Reporting :

    Create and maintain reports and dashboards that support decision-making.

    Ensure data quality and consistency across platforms.

    Handle data imports, exports, and migrations.

Teamwork :

    Gather requirements from stakeholders and translate them into system configurations.

    Train team members on system features and best practices.

    Write clear documentation for configurations and procedures.

    Proactively suggest improvements to tools and processes.



Profile

What Matters Most :

    Genuine curiosity: you enjoy figuring out how systems work.

    Problem-solving mindset: you dig until you find the root cause, not just the quick fix.

    Fast learner: comfortable picking up new tools and platforms independently.

    Clear communicator who can explain technical concepts to non-technical users.

Required Skills :

    Professional working proficiency in French, English, and German (or Luxembourgish).

    Ability to troubleshoot issues methodically and document solutions.

    Basic understanding of how applications store and organize data.

    Strong written communication skills for support responses and documentation.

Nice to Have :

    Experience administering Salesforce, HubSpot, or similar platforms.

    Basic scripting or automation knowledge/interest (JavaScript, Python, or no-code tools like Zapier/Make).

    Familiarity with APIs or system integrations.

    Background in IT support, helpdesk, or technical support.

    Understanding of SQL or database concepts.

Soft Skills

    Strong sense of ownership for system reliability and user satisfaction.

    Clear and helpful communication style.

    Self-management skills: ability to prioritize tickets and projects independently.

    Collaborative mindset and willingness to assist team members.

    Proactive approach to identifying and fixing recurring problems.

jobs.title: Strategic Projects Manager – Executive Office (m/f/x)
jobs.description:
Paperjam, founded in 1994 by Mike Koedinger, has become Luxembourg's most influential independent media and business platform. Beyond being a trusted source for economic, financial, and political journalism, Paperjam acts as a catalyst for innovation, community, and the country's development.

Its main activities:
• Paperjam News: reliable and relevant coverage of economic, financial, and political topics.
• Paperjam Club: Luxembourg's leading private business club, offering conferences, workshops, networking, and an academy.
• Paperjam Advertising: an advertising agency specializing in targeted, high-impact campaigns.
• Paperjam Studio: a creative agency helping brands with storytelling and visual communication.

In short: Paperjam positions itself as an independent, influential, and forward-looking player, shaping a progressive Luxembourg.

We are looking for a Strategic Project Manager (m/f/x). Reporting directly to the CEO and supporting the entire Executive Committee, the Strategic Project Manager helps turn Paperjam's strategic priorities into structured action plans and tangible results.

Your responsibilities

• Lead strategic, cross-functional projects from scoping through to implementation;
• Translate Management decisions into action plans and ensure effective follow-up;
• Coordinate internal and external stakeholders to drive projects forward;
• Analyse and structure strategic topics and prepare the information and materials required to support decision-making;
• Monitor priorities, deadlines and roadblocks, and actively contribute to resolving them;
• Facilitate coordination between the CEO, the Executive Committee and Paperjam's various business functions.

Your profile

• You hold a Master's degree from a business school or university;
• You have a proven track record in managing strategic or cross-functional projects, ideally within executive management, consulting, or a demanding entrepreneurial environment;
• You combine strong analytical skills with a hands-on approach to execution and can quickly move from strategy to action;
• You stand out for your rigour, autonomy and ability to prioritise, as well as your capacity to manage several topics simultaneously. An excellent communicator, you know how to engage a wide range of stakeholders and drive projects forward without direct reporting authority;
• You demonstrate curiosity, sound judgement and discretion, and are comfortable working in a fast-paced environment with direct exposure to senior management;
• Fluency in French and English is essential.

What we offer

• A dynamic environment, a committed team, and a positive working atmosphere;
• A full-time permanent contract;
• Start date to be agreed.

How to apply

jobs.description:

locations Luxembourg
time type Full time
job requisition id JR000659

Arendt is your legal, tax and business services firm in Luxembourg.

At Arendt we combine the entire value chain of services dedicated to asset managers, banks, insurers, public institutions, commercial companies and private clients operating in Luxembourg.

Arendt offers specialist advice, that encompasses all legal, regulatory, taxation and advisory aspects of doing business in Luxembourg. The driving force behind our work is what our clients need and our commitment to supporting their success.

Given the ongoing development of our firm, we are currently recruiting for our Technology department Arendt Digital Services:
‎
Senior Security Monitoring & Response Officer
Based in our Hamm Office

As a Senior Security Monitoring & Response Officer, you will report to the head of Risk & Control for implementing and overseeing IT Security operations activities as well as analyzing responses to threats for Arendt Digital Services in a multi-tenant shared services center environment.

Your role:

Lead Vulnerabilities Management & Patching activities:

• Act as practice leader for detecting, assessing Critical and high vulnerabilities;
• Coordinate the remediation plan within all IT departments for urgent response;
• Oversight patching activities within IT organization;
• Feed KPIs/KRIs for Vulnerabilities & patching management processes;
• Automation: Propose and lead project of automation of vulnerabilities & patch management activities.

Lead SOC management activities:

• Act as practice leader for Log & SOC management activities;
• Keeping up to date process, workflow and procedure for SOC alerting (level 1 to level 3);
• Security by design: identify and maintain Playbooks and SIEM correlations requirements trigger by new project;
• Supplier management: lead supplier performance review for our third-party SOC suppliers;
• Automation: Propose and lead project of automation for SOC activities.

Incident management response activities:

• Act as main contact point for Security incident coordination in collaboration with Incident manager;
• Participate to root cause analyses and security reporting as security expert;
• Keeping up to date Security Incident process and procedure documentations;
• Feed KPIs/KRIs for security incident management.

Support for Request Fulfillment:

• Manage standard request about security topics from IT and Clients;
• Validate Request Fulfillment on our IT ticketing tools.

Your profile:

• You hold a bachelor's degree or a master's degree in information/security systems or related field;
• You have a sound experience in IT security with a successful experience as ITSO, SOC senior analyst or blue-team security analyst;
• You have solid IT knowledge;
• You have strong interpersonal and communication skills;
• You have problem-solving skills and a proactive attitude;
• You are organized, proactive and customer oriented;
• You are recognized as a team player and able to work autonomously;
• You have a perfect command of English and French, both spoken and written.

Technical skills:

• You have a very good experiences with SIEM / Log management tools (Splunk, Sentinel, Elastic,..), certification in such domain is a real added value;
• ITIL process and vulnerability management;
• Threat Intelligence and Analysis;
• You have a very good knowledge of IT security concepts and solution (Firewall, Waf, Proxies, end point security);
• Knowledge of cloud environments and/or shared services center is an asset;
• DORA, ISO27001 and PSF requirements.

We offer a vibrant social life with numerous events, embracing sports and art, our culture encourages openness and discovery beyond the professional realm. With over 50 nationalities represented, Arendt is committed to the well-being of its staff, serving the best interests of its clients, protecting the environment, and supporting education.

Arendt promotes equal opportunities and value each employee for what they bring to the community. For more information, please refer to our diversity and inclusion policy on our website.

All applications will be treated confidentially.
