•najmanje jedna godina radnog iskustva na odgovarajućim poslovima •poznavanje jednog stranog jezika •poznavanje rada na računalu Uz prijavu kandidati su dužni dostaviti: •životopis •dokaz o stručnoj spremi (preslika diplome ili drugog jednakovrijednog dokumenta, napomena: kandidati koji su stručnu spremu stekli u inozemstvu trebaju priložiti i rješenje o nostrifikaciji odnosno priznavanju inozemne kvalifikacije iz kojega je vidljivo koji je to stupanj obrazovanja i razina obrazovanja i s kojim je stupnjem odnosno razinom obrazovanja to u Republici Hrvatskoj izjednačeno) •dokaz o ispunjavanju navedenog uvjeta) •dokaz o ukupnom radnom stažu (ispis elektroničkog zapisa podataka HZMO-a ili potvrda o podacima evidentiranim u matičnoj evidenciji HZMO-a koji, između ostaloga, sadrži podatke o poslodavcu, trajanju radnog odnosa, stvarnoj i potrebnoj stručnoj spremi ili drugi dokazi kojima se može utvrditi radni staž) •dokaz o traženom radnom iskustvu na odgovarajućim poslovima u (preslika osobne iskaznice, putovnice ili domovnice) •uvjerenje nadležnog suda da se protiv kandidata ne vodi kazneni postupak, ne starije od 6 mjeseci Prijavu je potrebno vlastoručno potpisati. Isprave se prilažu u preslici, a izabrani kandidat će po potrebi predočiti dokumentaciju u izvorniku/ovjerenoj preslici. Priložena natječajna dokumentacija se ne vraća. Životopis treba sadržavati najmanje sljedeće podatke: ime i prezime kandidata, adresu, broj telefona, adresu elektroničke pošte za primanje obavijesti, opis dosadašnjeg rada te iz njega treba biti vidljivo da kandidat zadovoljava sve uvjete iz natječaja. Prijavom na natječaj kandidati dopuštaju Hrvatskom kulturnom domu na Sušaku da prikuplja, koristi i obrađuje njihove osobne podatke samo u svrhu provedbe natječajnog postupka, a sukladno propisima koji uređuju zaštitu osobnih podataka. Na natječaj se mogu prijaviti osobe oba spola, a izrazi koji se koriste u ovom natječaju u muškom rodu, koriste se neutralno i odnose na oba spola. Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema posebnim propisima dužan je u prijavi na natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i priložiti svu propisanu dokumentaciju prema posebnom zakonu i ima prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate pod jednakim uvjetima. Kandidat koji može ostvariti pravo prednosti kod prijema sukladno članku 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (NN 121/17,98/19,84/21) dužan se u prijavi na natječaj pozvati na to pravo te ima prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima. Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju sukladno članku 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (NN broj 121/17, 98/19 i 84/21) uz prijavu na natječaj dužan je, osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, priložiti i sve potrebne dokaze o ostvarivanju prava prednosti pri zapošljavanju iz članka 103. citiranog Zakona, koji su navedeni na stranicama Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja https://branitelji.gov.hr/zaposljavanje-4413/4413 Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prilikom zapošljavanja u skladu s odredbom članka 48.f Zakona o zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalid a rata (NN 33/92, 57/92, 77/92, 27/93, 58/93, 02/94, 76/94, 108/95, 108/96, 82/01, 103/03, 148/13, 98/19), uz prijavu na natječaj dužan je priložiti osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta i rješenje, odnosno potvrdu iz koje je vidljivo navedeno pravo. Kandidat koji može ostvariti pravo prednosti kod prijema sukladno članku 48. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata ( NN 84/21), dužan se u prijavi na natječaj pozvati na to pravo te ima prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima. Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju sukladno članku 48. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (NN broj 84/21) uz prijavu na natječaj dužan je priložiti osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta i dokaze o ostvarivanju prava prednosti pri zapošljavanju iz članka 49. navedenog Zakona koji su navedeni na stranicama Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja https://branitelji.gov.hr/zaposljavanje-4413/4413 Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti prilikom zapošljavanja u skladu s člankom 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom (NN 157/13, 152/14, 39/18 i 32/20), uz prijavu na natječaj dužan je, osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, priložiti i dokaz o utvrđenom statusu osobe s invaliditetom. Rok za podnošenje prijava, zajedno s propisanim prilozima, na konkretan natječaj je zaključno do 21. rujna 2026. godine do 16,00 sati. Nepotpune i nepravodobno pristigle prijave neće se razmatrati. Potpunom prijavom smatra se ona koja sadrži sve podatke i priloge navedene u javnom natječaju. Osoba koja ne podnese pravovremenu i potpunu prijavu ili ne ispunjava formalne uvjete iz natječaja, ne smatra se kandidatom u natječaju niti će biti pozvana na dopunu. Za kandidate koji ispunjavaju formalne uvjete natječaja, provesti će se prethodna provjera znanja i sposobnosti putem pisanog testiranja i intervjua. O terminu održavanja testiranja kandidati će biti obaviješteni putem adresa elektroničke pošte koju su dostavili u prijavi na natječaj. S kandidatima koji ostvare najmanje ili više od 50% bodova na provedenom pisanom testiranju, nastavno će biti proveden intervju. Ako kandidat ne pristupi testiranju i/ili intervjuu, smatrati će se da je povukao prijavu na natječaj. O rezultatima natječaja kandidati će biti obaviješteni u roku od 30 dana od isteka roka za dostavu prijava. Radni odnos zasniva se na neodređeno puno radno vrijeme, uz probni rad od šest mjeseci. Na web stranici Hrvatskog kulturnog doma na Sušaku: https://hkd-rijeka.hr/ objavljen je opis poslova i podaci o plaći konkretnog radnog mjesta. Pisane prijave na natječaj s dokazima o ispunjavanju uvjeta dostavljaju se u zatvorenoj omotnici neposredno ili poštom na adresu: Hrvatski kulturni dom na Sušaku, Strossmayerova 1, 51000 Rijeka, s naznakom «Natječaj za radno mjesto: Stručni suradnik za odnose s javnošću i razvoj publike - ne otvaraj». Odluka o rezultatima biti će objavljena na mrežnim stranicama Hrvatskog kulturnog doma na Sušaku, sukladno članku 10. stavku 1. točki 10. Zakona o pravu na pristup informacijama (Narodne novine broj 25/13, 85/15, 69/22). Hrvatski kulturni dom na Sušaku zadržava pravo u svako vrijeme poništiti natječaj, odnosno ne donijeti Odluku o izboru kandidata, bez obveze obrazlaganja odluke i bez ikakve odgovornosti prema kandidatima. Osobni podaci podnositelja prijava koji su dostupni iz prijava, kao i osobni podaci dostupni iz gore navedenih priloga uz prijave na natječaj, prikupljaju se i obraduju isključivo za potrebe provedbe natječaja, i to zbog odabira kandidata na natječaju za zasnivanje radnog odnosa te radi sklapanja ugovora o radu s odabranim kandidatom. Hrvatski kulturni dom na Sušaku će osobne podatke kandidata prikupljene ovim natječajem obrađivati isključivo u skladu s odredbama ovog natječaja, te ih neće prenositi drugim fizičkim ili pravnim osobama, osim u slučaju onog kandidata s kojim će sklopiti ugovor o radu, a čije je podatke po sklapanju ugovora o radu, sukladno pravnim obvezama koje kao poslodavac ima, dužan prenositi drugim tijelima javne vlasti u svrhu prijave na mirovinsko osiguranje, zdravstveno osiguranje i sl. Podnošenjem prijave na natječaj za zasnivanje radnog odnosa temeljem ovog natječaja podrazumijeva se da su kandidati upoznati sa svrhom i pravnim temeljem obrade njihovih osobnih podataka te da su izričito suglasni da Hrvatski kulturni dom na Sušaku može prikupljati, koristiti i dalje obrađivati podatke u svrhu provođenja natječaja, kao i da se o rezultatu izbora obavijesti javnom objavom imena i prezimena izabranog kandidata na mrežnoj stranici Hrvatskog kulturnog doma na Sušaku, a sve sukladno odredbama Uredbe (EU) 2016/679 Europskog parlamenta i Vijeća od 27. travnja 2016. o zaštiti pojedinaca u vezi s obradom osobnih podataka i o slobodnom kretanju takvih podataka te o stavljanju izvan snage Direkti\/e 95/46/EZ (Opća uredba o zaštiti podataka) SL EU L119, i Zakona o provedbi Opće uredbe o zaštiti podataka (NN broj 42/18).

Na temelju članka. 26. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju (“Narodne novine” broj 10/97, 107/07, 94/13, 98/19, 57/22, 101/23, 145/23, 145/24, 146/25, 22/26) i Odluke Upravnog vijeća od 11. rujna 2026. godine Upravno vijeće Dječjeg vrtića „Radost“ Zadar, raspisuje:

JAVNI NATJEČAJ

za obavljanje poslova na radnom mjestu

SPREMAČICA

- jedan (1) izvršitelj/ica - na određeno puno radno vrijeme - do povratka radnice s rodiljnog dopust,

- jedan (1) izvršitelj/ica - na određeno puno radno vrijeme - do povratka radnice s bolovanja.

Radni odnos se zasniva uz obvezni probni rad od 3 mjeseca

UVJETI za radno mjesto spremačice: prema člancima 24., 25. i 26. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju (Narodne novine br. 10/97, 107/07, 94/13,98/19,57/22 , 101/23, 145/23, 145/24, 146/25, 22/26 ), članka 13. Pravilnika o odgovarajućoj vrsti i razini obrazovanja odgojno-obrazovnih i ostalih radnika u dječjem vrtiću, ustanovama te drugim pravnim i fizičkim osobama koje provode programe ranog i predškolskog odgoja i obrazovanja (Narodne novine br. 145/24) te članku 24. Pravilnika o unutarnjem ustrojstvu Dječjeg vrtića „Radost“ Zadar:

- kvalifikacija razine 1 stečena završetkom osnovnog obrazovanja

Uz vlastoručno potpisanu prijavu na natječaj u kojoj kandidat navodi osobne podatke (ime i prezime, adresa stanovanja, broj telefona odnosno mobitel, email adresa) sa naznakom radnog mjesta na koje se prijavljuje, potrebno je priložiti dokaze o ispunjavanju formalnih uvjeta iz natječaja i to kako slijedi:

♦ životopis,

♦ dokaz o vrsti i stupnju stručne spreme (svjedodžba),

♦ dokaz o državljanstvu (osobna iskaznica, putovnica ili domovnica),

Dokaze o nepostojanju zapreka za zasnivanje radnog odnosa sukladno članku 25. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju (Narodne novine br. 10/97, 107/07, 94/13,98/19,57/22 , 101/23, 145/23, 145/24, 146/25, 22/26) (ne stariji od 6 mjeseci):

  1. potvrda nadležnog suda da se protiv kandidata ne vodi kazneni postupak (članak 25. stavak 2. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju (Narodne novine br. 10/97, 107/07, 94/13, 98/19,57/22,101/23, 145/23, 145/24, 146/25, 22/26)
  2. potvrda nadležnog suda da se protiv kandidata ne vodi prekršajni postupak (članak 25. stavak 4. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju (Narodne novine br. 10/97, 107/07, 94/13, 98/19,57/22,101/23, 145/23, 145/24, 146/25, 22/26)
  1. potvrda nadležnog područnog ureda Hrvatskog zavoda za socijalni rad (članak 25. stavak 10. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju Narodne novine, broj 10/97, 107/07, 94/13, 98/19, 57/22,101/23,145/23, 145/24, 146/25, 22/26 ),

Dokaz o radnom iskustvu:

a) elektronički zapis o radno pravnom statusu - ispis iz evidencije Hrvatskog zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje (ne stariji od mjesec dana).

Kandidat koji prema posebnim propisima ostvaruje pravo prednosti, mora se u prijavi na natječaj pozvati na to pravo, odnosno uz prijavu priložiti svu propisanu dokumentaciju prema posebnom zakonu.

Kandidat koji može ostvariti pravo prednosti:

– sukladno čl. 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (Narodne novine br. 121/2017, 98/2019, 84/2021, 156/2023), uz prijavu na natječaj dužna je priložiti osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta i sve potrebne dokaze dostupne na poveznici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja: https://branitelji.gov.hr/zaposljavanje-843/843.

Informacije o dokazima koji su potrebni za ostvarivanje prava prednosti pri zapošljavanju nalaze se na poveznici:

https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages//NG/12%20Prosinac/Zapo%C5%A1ljavanje//POPIS%20DOKAZA%20ZA%20OSTVARIVANJE%20PRAVA%20PRI%20ZAPO%C5%A0LJAVANJU.pdf

– sukladno čl. 47. – 50. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (Narodne novine br. 84/2021, 13/2026), uz prijavu na natječaj dužna je priložiti osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta i sve potrebne dokaze dostupne na poveznici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja: https://branitelji.gov.hr/zaposljavanje-843/843.

Informacije o dokazima koji su potrebni za ostvarivanje prava prednosti pri zapošljavanju nalaze se na poveznici:

https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages//dokumenti/Nikola//popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf

– sukladno čl. 48. f Zakona o zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata (Narodne novine br. 33/1992, 57/1992, 77/1992, 27/1993, 58/1993, 2/1994, 76/1994, 108/1995, 108/1996, 82/2001, 94/2001, 103/2003, 148/2013, 98/2019), uz prijavu na natječaj dužna je, osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, priložiti i rješenje, odnosno potvrdu iz koje je vidljivo to pravo te dokaz o tome na koji način je prestao radni odnos kod posljednjeg poslodavca;

– sukladno čl. 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom (Narodne novine br. 157/2013, 152/2014, 39/2018, 32/2020), uz prijavu na natječaj dužna je osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, priložiti dokaz o utvrđenom statusu osobe s invaliditetom te dokaz o tome na koji način je prestao radni odnos kod posljednjeg poslodavca.

Sukladno članku 13. Zakona o ravnopravnosti spolova („Narodne novine“, broj 82/08, 69/17) na javni natječaj se mogu javiti osobe oba spola.

Izrazi koji se koriste u ovom natječaju, a imaju rodno značenje koriste se neutralno i odnose se jednako na muški i ženski rod.

Izabrani kandidat bit će pozvan da u primjernom roku, a prije sklapanja ugovora o radu, dostavi uvjerenje o zdravstvenoj sposobnosti za obavljanje poslova radnog mjesta kao i izvornike drugih dokaza o ispunjavanju formalnih uvjeta iz javnog natječaja, čiji su preslici priloženi uz prijavu na javni natječaj, uz upozorenje da se nedostavljanje traženih isprava smatra odustajanjem od prijema u službu.

Urednom prijavom smatra se ona koja sadrži sve podatke i priloge tražene u javnom natječaju.

Osoba koja ne podnese pravodobnu i urednu prijavu ili ne ispunjava formalne uvjete iz javnog natječaja ne smatra se kandidatom prijavljenim na javni natječaj i njegova prijava neće biti razmatrana.

Za osobe koje zadovoljavaju formalne uvjete javnog natječaja i stekle su status kandidata prijavljenog na javni natječaj bit će proveden usmeni razgovor (intervju).

Ako kandidat ne pristupi usmenom razgovoru, smatrat će se da je povukao prijavu na javni natječaj.

Na mrežnoj stranici Dječjeg vrtića „Radost“ Zadar www.radost-zadar.hr pod „Obavijest i upute za prijavu“ navest će se opis poslova radnog mjesta i podaci o plaći.

Kandidati će biti obaviješteni o vremenu i mjestu održavanja usmenog razgovora telefonskim putem, najmanje pet dana prije održavanja istog.

O rezultatima javnog natječaja kandidati će biti obaviješteni u roku trideset (30) dana od dana isteka roka za podnošenje prijava dostavom odluke o prijemu izabranog kandidata ili dostavom odluke o poništenju javnog natječaja.

Odluka o izboru kandidata dostavlja se javnom objavom na mrežnoj stranici www.radost-zadar.hr.

Prijave na natječaj s obveznom dokumentacijom dostavljaju se na adresu: Dječji vrtić „Radost“, PO Višnjik III, Domovinskog rata 5, 23000 Zadar s naznakom: „za natječaj“ a zbog mogućih kašnjenja u poštanskoj dostavi, dokumentaciju je potrebno dostaviti na istu adresu osobno ili na e-mail adresu: djecji.vrtic.radost@radost-zadar.hr

Zakašnjele prijave kao i prijave s nepotpunom dokumentacijom neće se razmatrati.

Kandidati dokumente dostavljaju isključivo u neovjerenim preslikama i ne vraćaju se.

Sukladno odredbama Uredbe (EU) 2016/679 Europskog parlamenta i Vijeća od 27. travnja 2016. godine te Zakona o provedbi Opće uredbe o zaštiti osobnih podataka (Narodne novine broj 42/18) prijavom na natječaj smatra se da je kandidat dao privolu za obradu svih podataka iz natječajne dokumentacije, a koja će se obrađivati isključivo u svrhu provođenja natječajnog postupka.

Natječaj traje od 14.09.2026. do 22.09.2026. godine.

Z A D A R

URBROJ: 2198-1-16-07-26-1

Zadar, 11. rujna 2026. godine

OBAVIJEST I UPUTE ZA PRIJAVU

na javni natječaj za radno mjesto SPREMAČICA u Dječjem vrtiću „Radost“ Zadar za:

- jedan (1) izvršitelj/ica - na određeno puno radno vrijeme - do povratka radnice s rodiljnog dopust,

Radni odnos se zasniva uz obvezni probni rad od 3 mjeseca.

Natječaj je objavljen na mrežnim stranicama i oglasnim pločama Hrvatskog zavoda za zapošljavanje, na mrežnoj stranici i Oglasnoj ploči Dječjeg vrtića „Radost“ Zadar i na mrežnim stanicama Grada Zadra dana 14.09.2026. godine.

Prijave na javni natječaj, s dokazima o ispunjavanju uvjeta, dostavljaju se u roku od 8 dana od dana objave javnog natječaja na mrežnim stranicama Hrvatskog zavoda za zapošljavanje, na adresu: Dječji vrtić „Radost“, PO Višnjik III, Domovinskog rata 5, 23000 Zadar s naznakom: „za natječaj“ a zbog mogućih kašnjenja u poštanskoj dostavi, dokumentaciju je potrebno osobno dostaviti na istu adresu, ili dostaviti elektroničkim putem na e-mail adresu: djecji.vrtic.radost@radost-zadar.hr

Prijave se dostavljaju zaključno s danom - 22. rujna 2026. godine.

1.Opis poslova radnog mjesta – spremačica

- održava čistoću prostorija za boravak djece, sanitarnih čvorova i ostalih pratećih prostorija

(predsoblja, garderoba, ureda, terasa, blagovaonica, dvorana i dr.),

- pere i dezinficira igračke,

- pomaže pri prihvaćanju, oblačenju i svlačenju djece,

- vrši dnevno raspremanje i pospremanje krevetića, redovito mijenja posteljinu,

- održava čistoću okoliša, ulaza u područni objekt te dvorišta,

- vodi brigu o cvijeću u prostorijama područnog objekta,

- odgovorna je za otvaranje područnog objekta (u područnim objektima gdje spremačica dolazi u 6,30

sati),

- obavlja i druge poslove i zadatke iz djelokruga svoga rada po nalogu ravnatelja i tajnika.

2. Podaci o plaći

Plaća za radno mjesto spremačice utvrđuje se u visini umnoška koeficijenta složenosti poslova radnog mjesta 1,150 propisanog Dodatkom I. Kolektivnog ugovora za radnike u Dječjem vrtiću Radost, Dječjem vrtiću Sunce i Dječjem vrtiću Latica od 08. travnja 2024. godine, i osnovice za obračun plaće za zaposlenike u javnim službama, određene Zakonom o plaćama u državnoj službi i javnim službama (NN br. 155/23) te Temeljnim kolektivnim ugovorom za zaposlenike u javnim službama (NN br. 29/24), uvećane za 0,5 % za svaku navršenu godinu radnog staža.

3. Način obavljanja provjere znanja i sposobnosti kandidata

Postupak vrednovanja kandidata provest će Povjerenstvo za provedbu postupka natječaja usmeno putem razgovora (intervjua).

Testiranju mogu pristupiti samo osobe koje su ispunile formalne uvjete iz javnog natječaja te stekle status kandidata prijavljenog na javni natječaj.

Kandidati iz prethodnog stavka koji ne pristupe provjeri znanja, smatra se da su povukli prijavu na javni natječaj.

Kandidati će biti obaviješteni o vremenu i mjestu održavanja usmenog razgovora telefonskim putem, najmanje pet dana prije održavanja istog.

Usmenim testiranjem kandidat može ostvariti maksimalno 10 bodova, a minimalno 50% ukupnog broja bodova.

Nakon provjere znanja i sposobnosti, Povjerenstvo utvrđuje konačnu rang listu kandidata prema ukupnom broju ostvarenih bodova na prethodnoj provjeri znanja i sposobnosti.

DJEČJI VRTIĆ „RADOST“ ZADAR

Poslodavac nudi:
  • Rad na autentičnom, vizualno bogatom terenu (proizvodnja sapuna, maslinici, radionice izrade sapuna, konoba), kreativnu slobodu u oblikovanju sadržaja, plaćene edukacije video editinga i marketinga općenito, te dodatni bonus u postotku od konverzije videa.

Night Audit (m/w/d)

Unternehmensbeschreibung

Unser Herz schlägt türkis.

Arbeiten bei Motel One ist wie zu Freunden kommen, wo Wertschätzung und Unterstützung grossgeschrieben werden und die individuelle Persönlichkeit willkommen ist. Wir begegnen uns auf Augenhöhe und verstehen uns als ein Team: von der Geschäftsführung bis zu den Auszubildenden.

Mit unserer gemeinsamen Leidenschaft für modernes Design und hohe Servicequalität schaffen wir für unsere Gäste bei Motel One ein Zuhause für unterwegs. Unsere mehr als 95 Hotels in 13 Ländern überzeugen mit exklusivem Design, hohen Servicestandards und erstklassigen innerstädtischen Standorten zu einem attraktiven Preis.

Als Begründer und Vorreiter des Budget Design Konzepts expandieren wir erfolgreich in den Metropolen Europas und darüber hinaus. Werden Sie Teil unseres Teams und gestalten Sie gemeinsam mit uns Motel One.

Stellenbeschreibung

Die professionelle Betreuung unserer Gäste am Empfang ist zu jeder Zeit sehr wichtig – von der herzlichen Begrüßung beim Check-In bis zur Verabschiedung, bist Du für die Frühaufsteher und Nachtschwärmer unter unseren Gästen da. Dabei kümmerst Du dich ausserdem um:

- Erstellung der Tagesabschlüsse
- Kassenführung und -abrechnung
- Bearbeitung von Reservierungsanfragen
- Frühstücksvorbereitung

Benefits:

- International Karriere machen: Unsere nationalen und internationalen Hotels oder Neueröffnungen eröffnen zahlreiche Karrieremöglichkeiten.
- Günstig übernachten in ganz Europa: Vorteile sichern! Mit günstigen Personalraten in unseren Hotels in ganz Europa und in New York sowie weitere attraktiven Rabatten.
- Sich persönlich und fachlich weiterentwickeln: Mit einer umfangreichen Einarbeitung, jährlichen Schulungen und Coachings an der One University richtig durchstarten.
- Gemeinsam feiern: Ob Sommerfest, Weihnachtsfeier oder unser jährliches internationales Fußballturnier – Erfolge feiern wir gemeinsam mit dem Team.
- Kostengünstig und nachhaltig zur Arbeit: Es kann zwischen einem Zuschuss zum ÖPNV oder einem kostenlosen Fahrrad gewählt werden.

Qualifikationen

Ob als Hotelprofi oder im Quereinstieg – Du passt zu uns! Denn Persönlichkeit und Gastgeberqualitäten stehen bei uns an erster Stelle! Ausserdem zeichnet dich aus:

- Ausbildung im Hotelfach bzw. Berufserfahrung in der Hotellerie/Gastronomie oder Interesse an einem Quereinstieg
- Gastgeberqualitäten und Leidenschaft für die Hotellerie sowie ein hohes Qualitätsbewusstsein und Serviceorientierung
- Offenes, kommunikatives und sicheres Auftreten sowie eine gute Ausdrucksweise in Deutsch & Englisch
- Teamfähigkeit und Bereitschaft abteilungsübergreifend zu unterstützen – Wir erreichen unsere Erfolge gemeinsam

Training online. One week to spend in Varna  after the training for the nesting phase. Afterwards anywhere in Bulgaria!

We are partnering with a leading international customer experience provider to recruit German-speaking Customer Support Advisors for a telecommunications project in Bulgaria.

This is a remote position within Bulgaria, combining customer service, technical troubleshooting, and light sales. You’ll support German-speaking customers with their mobile services, billing questions, and technical issues while identifying opportunities to recommend suitable additional products.

- Interest in troubleshooting and technical support
- Previous customer service or contact centre experience is an advantage, but not required

jobs.title: Account Manager (m/w/d) - Wien (Fachverkäufer/in - Kraftfahrzeuge)
jobs.description:
Was Dich erwartet

Als Account Manager übernimmst du eine Schlüsselrolle im proaktiven Vertrieb an mittelständische Geschäftskunden. Du bist verantwortlich für den Aufbau und die Pflege von Kundenbeziehungen und steuerst die gesamte End-to-End Customer Journey – von der ersten Kontaktaufnahme bis hin zur langfristigen Partnerschaft. Was wir bieten:

- Karriereentwicklung und Weiterbildung: Bei Tesla hast du die Möglichkeit zur persönlichen und beruflichen Weiterentwicklung durch regelmäßige Performance Reviews, gezielte Trainingsmaßnahmen und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten (z.B. Produkt- und Verkaufsschulungen)
- Unternehmenskultur: Tauche ein in unsere inspirierende Unternehmenskultur, in der Innovation, Teamwork und Leidenschaft im Mittelpunkt stehen
- Innovative Projekte und Technologien: Du hast die Chance, an wegweisenden Projekten und Technologien zu arbeiten, die die Zukunft der Automobilindustrie und nachhaltiger Energie mitgestalten
- Vorteile und Zusatzleistungen: Dich erwartet ein wettbewerbsfähiges Gehalts- und Leistungspaket, das neben Tesla Aktien oder einem Cash Award auch den Zugang zu unserem Corporate Benefits Programm umfasst
- Engagiertes Team und positive Arbeitsatmosphäre: Arbeite in einem engagierten und motivierten Team, das sich durch eine tolle Stimmung und hervorragende Teamarbeit auszeichnet. Sei Teil eines Teams, das einen Beitrag zur nachhaltigen Zukunft und zu erneuerbaren Energien leistet

Was zu tun ist

Mittelständische Geschäftskunden:

- Du bist für das Kundenportfolio in deinem Geschäftsgebiet verantwortlich und trägst zu einer hohen Kundenzufriedenheit und zur Erreichung der Verkaufsziele bei
- Du identifizierst und akquirierst mit deiner “Hunter”-Mentalität proaktiv mittelständische Unternehmen als Neukunden
- Du präsentierst unser Unternehmen und die Vorteile unserer Fahrzeuge bei unseren mittelständischen Geschäftskunden und sorgst für reibungslose Geschäftsabläufe und Kundenbeziehungen
- Du fungierst als Bindeglied zwischen unseren Kunden und unserem Unternehmen, um sicherzustellen, dass die Anforderungen und Wünsche unserer Kunden vollständig und zufriedenstellend erfüllt werden
- Du betreust bestehende Kooperationen mit Leasingpartnern und baust sie strategisch aus, um langfristiges Umsatzwachstum zu fördern
- Du erstellst und verwaltest vertragliche Vereinbarungen, kommunizierst unsere Prozesse klar und sicherst deren EinhaltungDeine Aufgaben:
- Du arbeitest aktiv mit dem Business Sales-Lead zusammen, um eine kohärente Strategie für das Wachstum des B2B-Vertriebs in Wien zu entwickeln
- Du optimierst kontinuierlich interne Prozesse, um operative Effizienz sicherzustellen
- Du arbeitest abteilungsübergreifend, um deinen Beitrag zum Gesamtgeschäftsplan zu leisten
- Du besitzt umfassende Produktkenntnisse zu allen Fahrzeugen, Prozessen und Business-Finance-Lösungen und führst regelmäßig Wettbewerbsanalysen durch

Was mitzubringen ist

- Du hast vertriebliche Erfolge erzielt, vorzugsweise im B2B-Bereich, und kannst konkrete Ergebnisse deiner Arbeit nachweisen
- Du arbeitest selbstständig und setzt dich engagiert für deine Kunden und unser Team ein, indem du starke Geschäftsbeziehungen aufbaust und als respektierter, vertrauenswürdiger Partner agierst, mit dem andere gerne zusammenarbeiten
- Du denkst strategisch, handelst vorausschauend und setzt dich mit Leidenschaft für die Mission von Tesla ein
- Du kannst effektiv Prioritäten setzen, mehrere Aufgaben gleichzeitig steuern und Deadlines zuverlässig einhalten
- Du liebst es, den Status quo zu verändern und kannst auch in Situationen mit hohem Druck gut arbeiten
- Du bist verhandlungssicher in Deutsch und hast gute Englischkenntnisse
- Dein Wohnsitz sollte idealerweise in Wien liegen, da die Position eine Reisetätigkeit von etwa 2–3 Tagen pro Woche umfasst – dabei handelt es sich um Tagesbesuche bei Kunden
- Du bist seit mindestens zwei Jahren im Besitz eines gültigen EU-Führerscheins (Klasse B)Für diese Position bieten wir ein jährliches Bruttomindestgehalt von € 62.000 auf Basis des oben angeführten Anforderungsprofils bei Vollzeitbeschäftigung an. Entsprechende Berufserfahrung und Qualifikation werden zusätzlich berücksichtigt. Darüber hinaus bieten wir ein Tesla Aktienpaket an.

Tesla ist ein Arbeitgeber, der Chancengleichheit verwirklicht, und der sich der Diversität am Arbeitsplatz verpflichtet hat. Alle qualifizierten Bewerber für eine Stelle haben die gleiche Chance unabhängig von Herkunft, Hautfarbe, Religion, Geschlecht, geschlechtlicher Orientierung, Alter, Herkunftsland, Behinderung, Veteranenschutzstatus, geschlechtlicher Identität oder anderen Faktoren, die durch die geltenden US-, bundesstaatlichen oder örtlichen Gesetze geschützt sind.

- Prowadzenie i nadzór nad księgowością operacyjną hoteli w Polsce zgodnie z obowiązującymi standardami oraz wytycznymi Centrali;

jobs.description:

SoftwareOne is a global provider of software and cloud solutions. With a presence in over 70 countries and more than 12,000 professionals, we help organizations optimize software investments, modernize applications, and unlock the value of cloud, data, and AI.

Our people are at the core of everything we do. We enable collaboration across borders, continuous learning, and opportunities to grow in a fast-evolving technology landscape. Join a global team where you can build your skills, work with leading technologies, and make a real impact for our customers.

Secruity Engineer (gn) Microsoft Modern Workplace

- Do you want to design modern Microsoft 365 environments holistically and advise customers on everything from collaboration strategy to security, compliance, and Copilot?
- Are you equally comfortable with technical and conceptual topics and ready to take ownership in diverse customer projects?
- Are you looking for an environment where you can work cross-functionally, help shape innovation, and create real value together with Sales, Delivery, and technology partners?

Practical information:
Location: Romandie-Switzerland | Working model: Hybrid | Seniority: Senior | Language requirements: Very good written and spoken French and English

The Role

We are looking for an experienced Senior Security Engineer with strong expertise in Microsoft Security, Identity and/or Compliance and AI-enabled Modern Workplace or Cloud Services. The successful candidate will design, implement and deliver enterprise-scale security transformations across Microsoft 365, Azure and Microsoft Security technologies, helping customers strengthen their security posture while enabling productivity and innovation.

Key Responsibilities

Security & Identity

- Design and implement enterprise security architectures aligned with Zero Trust principles.
- Lead customer engagements around Identity & Access Management, Identity Governance and Privileged Access Management.
- Implement and optimize Microsoft Entra ID, Conditional Access, MFA, Passwordless Authentication, Identity Governance, Access Reviews, Lifecycle Workflows and Privileged Identity Management.

Cloud Security

- Conduct cloud security posture reviews and support customers in improving governance, policy management and secure workload design.
- Threat Protection & SOC Modernization
- Design, implement and optimize Microsoft Defender for Cloud. Defender XDR solutions including Defender for Endpoint, Defender for Identity, Defender for Office 365 and Defender for Cloud Apps.
- Implement and tune Microsoft Sentinel including data onboarding, detection engineering, analytics rules, automation and SOAR use cases.
- Contribute to threat hunting, incident response readiness and security operations process improvement.

Data Security & Compliance

- Design and deploy Microsoft Purview solutions for information protection, sensitivity labels, data classification, DLP, records management and data lifecycle management.
- Support customers in meeting compliance, governance and data protection objectives.
- Translate regulatory and business requirements into practical security and compliance controls.

AI & Security Innovation

- Lead customer discussions around secure AI adoption and responsible use of Microsoft Copilot and Security Copilot.
- Deliver readiness assessments and governance frameworks for Copilot-enabled environments.
- Define controls to protect sensitive data and identities in AI-enabled collaboration and cloud scenarios.

Professional Experience

- Years of experience in enterprise security consulting, engineering or architecture.

- Experience working directly with enterprise customers and senior stakeholders.
- Strong consulting mindset with the ability to translate business requirements into pragmatic security solutions.

jobs.title: Senior Network Engineer L2 / L3 (Third-Level-Supporter/in)
jobs.description:
WE ARE HIRING: Senior Network Hand & Feet Engineer (L2/L3 Physical & Logical Support) – Austria

Excis is a global leader in IT support that is characterized by innovation and collaboration. We are looking for an experienced Senior Network Hand & Feet Engineerwho will be responsible for the end-to-end physical deployment and logical validation of network infrastructures. This position requires in-depth knowledge of OSI layers 1-3to ensure that physical connectivity seamlessly matches logical configurations. Become part of a supportive and growth-oriented company where your technical expertise makes a real difference.

190+ countries | 6,000+ Engineers | 200+ Enterprise Customers

We promote an open, collaborative and growth-oriented corporate culture in which individual achievements contribute to mutual success. From solving complex technical challenges to supporting global enterprise customers, our people are at the heart of it.

Your tasks

- Perform challenging rack and device installations using Rack Elevation Diagrams (REDs) for Cisco Nexus 9k, Catalyst 9500, and other networking components.
- Ensuring mechanical safety, correct power supply and rack integrity.
- Perform structured copper and fiber cabling including SMF/MMF fibers, SFP/SFP+/QSFP+ modules, and ANSI/TIA 606-B cabling.
- Manage patch panels, cross-connect, and coordinate line extensions with telecom providers.
- Configure and troubleshoot out-of-band (OOB) management and console accesses.
- Support for BIOS-based error analysis and on-site boot monitoring.
- Apply in-depth routing and switching knowledge to OSI layers 1-3, including VLANs, STP, EtherChannel/LACP, and protocol validation (BGP, OSPF).
- Collaborate with NOC and infrastructure teams to resolve business-critical network disruptions.

Requirements

- 6-8 years of work experience in a data center or large enterprise campus environment

jobs.description:
Willkommen im Team als

(Senior) Risk Manager

Das Unternehmen:

Die Commerz Real Fundmanagement S.à r.l. (“CRFM“) ist ein Spezialist für die Verwaltung von Alternativen Investmentfonds. Die CRFM trägt hierdurch zum Profil der Commerz Real AG und ihren Konzerngesellschaften (“Commerz Real Gruppe“) als integrierter Investmentdienstleister bei. Die CRFM arrangiert Alternative Investmentfonds, insbesondere für Immobilien, Infrastrukturprojekte, Anlagen zur Erzeugung erneuerbarer Energien sowie Großmobilien (wie z.B.: Flugzeuge, Schiffe und Schienenfahrzeuge). Die CRFM ist eine Tochtergesellschaft der Commerz Real AG, die ihrerseits eine Tochter der Commerzbank Aktiengesellschaft, Deutschland, ist.

Aufgabe:

- Als (Senior) Risk Manager Anlageprodukte und Teil des Risk Management Teams bist Du verantwortlich für die Risikoanalyse, Bewertung und Überwachung von (komplexen) Neu- und Bestandsgeschäften unter Beachtung von wirtschaftlichen, rechtlichen und steuerlichen Rahmenbedingungen hinsichtlich aller relevanten Risikoarten (u.a. Adressausfall-, Objektwertänderungs-, Marktpreis-, Liquiditätsrisiken, spezielle Risiken im Bereich Infrastructure wie z.B. Betriebs- und Projektentwicklungsrisiken, etc.)
- Dabei stellst Du die kompetenzgerechte Genehmigung bzw. Erstellung von Genehmigungsvorlagen für An- und Verkaufstransaktionen der AIF/Spezial-AIF sicher
- Zu Deinen Aufgaben gehört auch die Mitarbeit bei der Strukturierung und Steuerung von AIF/Spezial-AIF zur haftungsmäßigen und wirtschaftlichen Optimierung
- Ebenso verantwortest Du die regelmäßige risikotechnische Überwachung der AIF/Spezial-AIF im Wertschöpfungsprozess inkl. Überwachung der vertraglichen Finanzierungsgestaltung und des Liquiditätsmanagements
- Du unterstützt die Marktbereiche bei Vertragsverhandlungen im Neu- und Bestandsgeschäft sowie bei der Entwicklung von neuen Produkten als Mitglied in Dealteams und/oder Projektgruppen
- Die Leitung von bzw. Mitarbeit in bereichsinternen Projekten zur Optimierung / Digitalisierung der Risikoorganisation, hier insbesondere zur (Weiter-)Entwicklung von gesetzeskonformen Prozessen, Regularien und Risikotools gehört ebenfalls zu Deinen Aufgaben
- Du bringst Deine Expertise und Unterstützung bei übergreifenden Projekten sowie im Rahmen der Digitalisierungsstrategie ein. Dabei übernimmst Du auch die Leitung von übergreifenden Projekten
- Du übernimmst Coaching / Weiterbildungsaufgaben im Risikomanagement sowie die Ausbildung von Nachwuchskräften

Profil:

- Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes (auch berufsintegriertes) Studium mit der Fachrichtung Wirtschaftswissenschaften oder Rechtswissenschaften, idealerweise im Schwerpunkt Risikomanagement
- Langjährige fachbezogene Berufserfahrung im Bereich Risikomanagement eines Asset-Managers, eines Fondsemissionshauses oder eines Kreditinstitutes,
- Umfassende Kenntnisse und mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Assetklasse Infrastructure, idealerweise auch in Private Equity und Debt Strukturen. Grundkenntnisse und Interesse an den Assetklassen Renewable Energies, sowie Real Estate runden Deine Erfahrung ab.
- Erweiterte betriebswirtschaftliche Kenntnisse insbesondere im Bereich Risikomanagement, Bilanzanalyse, Discounted Cash-Flow-Analyse, Sensitivitätsanalyse, Cash-Flow-Modellierung, Liquiditätsrisikomanagement und Portfoliosteuerung
- Sehr gute Kenntnisse der einschlägigen Gesetze, Verordnungen, Vorschriften und Richtlinien (AIFM-Richtlinie, AIFM-VO, ESMA-Leitlinien, Luxemburger Gesetze bzgl. AIFMD, u.a.)

jobs.title: Finance Head (f/m/d) - Discrete Projects Industrial Logistics (Betriebswirt/in (Hochschule))
jobs.description:
We're seeking a Finance Head (f/m/d) for Industrial Logistics within Digital Industries Automation Discrete Projects (DI AUT DP). In this role, you'll lead global financial management for our Industrial Logistics (IL) project business across Europe and Americas – as part of the global Finance function under our new ONE Tech Company structure.
This is your chance to shape financial operations throughout the complete project lifecycle – from bid calculations to project closure – while ensuring IFRS 15 compliance, financial performance analysis, and effective risk management. You’ll drive profitable growth, sustainable margin improvement, stable cash generation, and financial resilience through disciplined risk control across multiple countries. You'll work in a transformation environment with a clear focus on business growth, where your financial expertise directly contributes to our goals of speed, scale, and efficiency.
At Siemens, our Total Rewards approach is designed to inspire innovation, reward impact, and support your well-being at every stage of your career. From competitive pay and benefits to recognition and development opportunities, we help you thrive both personally and professionally.
You’ll make an impact by - Financial Leadership & Strategy: You lead global financial management and controlling for the Industrial Logistics project business, reporting to the Head of Finance of DI AUT DP. You drive growth and productivity initiatives to strengthen its competitive position. You govern the adoption of finance and controlling policies and guidelines based on the overall FIN strategy while ensuring compliance with all relevant financial regulations (external and internal).- Budget Planning, Forecasting & Financial Reporting: You coordinate budget planning and forecasting for the entire IL project business, ensuring IFRS-compliant accounting and timely preparation of financial closings as well as accurate books and records (monthly, quarterly, annual).- Performance Monitoring: You monitor and comment on financial performance (current development and outlook) incl. KPI analyses and performance reporting. You analyze, approve, review and forecast project revenues and costs, and ensure accurate profitability throughout the project lifecycle, as well as initiate early warnings to stakeholders when needed.- Project Finance & Risk Management: You identify and manage financial risks associated with the execution of projects, including currency, credit, and operational risks, ensuring proper risk assessment and provisioning in calculations and financial statements.- Operational Improvement & Innovation: You identify operational improvement potentials in controlling and financial processes, propose solutions and remedial measures, and drive productivity improvements through automation and innovation initiatives.- Collaboration & Transformation: You work with IL management, operational leadership, and central finance functions while supporting organizational transformation by challenging the current processes and collaborating across all stakeholder groups (e.g., FIN, P&O, EHS, GBS, SCM).- Team Leadership & Development: Finally, you manage and develop Finance and Controlling teams supporting the global IL project business. Traveling to its locations and project sites is necessary.

Your success is grounded in- Education: University degree or equivalent experience in Finance, Business Administration, Accounting, or related field - Experience and Skills:- Minimum 8-10 years in Finance, Controlling, and FP&A, preferably in international project business- Minimum 5 years leadership experience leading finance teams across multiple locations and building collaborative relationships - Proven expertise in IFRS 15 revenue recognition for long-term project contracts and commercial contract negotiations with OEM procurement organizations. Familiarity with project business models in automotive or comparable industrial environments is a strong differentiator.- Demonstrated hands-on experience in commercial contract negotiations with OEM procurement organizations, covering pricing structures, risk allocation, liability caps, and penalty/malus clauses. Ability to engage with customer purchasing teams and to represent Finance as a value-creating business partner in complex commercial discussions.- Strong knowledge of financial planning, budgeting, and controlling- Deep understanding of risk management, internal controls, compliance and audit requirements- Proficiency with ERP systems (SAP preferred) and advanced MS Office skills- Experience with organizational transformation and implementation of new business operations is beneficial

- Ways of Working:- Strategic vision meets financial excellence – combining big-picture thinking with process optimization and attention to detail- Collaborative influencer who builds trust across cultures and translates complex financial insights into clear, actionable messages- Proactive, adaptable, and able to thrive in evolving business environments - High integrity with commitment to Siemens Business Conduct Guidelines and compliance requirements
- Languages: Business proficiency in English; German language skills are a plus. Additional languages are highly welcome and beneficial for international collaboration.

jobs.title: Senior Solution Architect IT/OT Security Platforms (f/m/d) (Ingenieur/in - Systems Engineering)
jobs.description:
Siemens IT enables secure, reliable and scalable digital services for Siemens businesses and factories worldwide. Within IT IPS, we develop and operate services that support the transformation of industrial environments towards modern, secure and standardized IT/OT operations.
As a Solution Architect for our IT/OT Security Platforms you will define the technical vision and architecture for strategic service offerings. You will work closely with factories, cybersecurity experts, service managers, product teams, and technology partners to design scalable, secure, and future-ready solutions that support Siemens' Zero Trust and digitalization strategy. Our OT Zero Trust Platform enables secure IT/OT communication through identity-based connectivity concepts, while our OT Patch Management enables centralized endpoint management, patching, hardening and compliance for enterprise and production-related devices.

What we offer you
At Siemens, our Total Rewards approach is designed to inspire innovation, reward impact, and support your well-being at every stage of your career.  From competitive pay and benefits to recognition and development opportunities, we help you thrive both personally and professionally.

You'll make an impact by

- You design and evolve the target architecture for our IT/OT Security Platforms (SINEC Secure Connect and ManageEngine), ensuring alignment with Siemens cybersecurity, operational, and business requirements.- You define secure IT/OT communication concepts based on Zero Trust principles and develop architectures for remote access, machine connectivity, application communication, and future AI-driven use cases.- You support Siemens factories in integrating modern security and management solutions into existing brownfield environments, considering legacy systems, industrial protocols, and operational constraints.- You translate business, security, and operational requirements into scalable platform architectures, governance models, technical standards, and implementation roadmaps.- You collaborate with factories, cybersecurity teams, service owners, vendors, and technology partners to establish architecture standards and drive service adoption across Siemens.- You define integration concepts between connectivity services, endpoint management platforms, monitoring solutions, automation frameworks, and enterprise systems.- You evaluate new technologies and architecture patterns and contribute to the continuous evolution of Siemens' IT/OT security and platform landscape.- You enable data-driven and AI-supported operational use cases by designing architectures that support secure data flows, automation, analytics, and platform interoperability.- You actively shape the journey to AI-native OT security services

This is how you'll win us over

- Education: You have a university degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Cybersecurity, or a comparable qualification.- Experience and Skills:- You possess strong expertise in Zero Trust and OT Security Architecture, including concepts such as identity-centric networking, PKI, certificate lifecycle management, and industry frameworks such as NIST SP 800-207 and IEC 62443.- You have proven experience with OT Infrastructure and Brownfield Integration (of at least 3+ years), including industrial environments, legacy systems, machine-to-machine communication, industrial protocols, network segmentation, and hybrid IT/OT architectures.- You bring solid knowledge of Endpoint, Asset and Service Management Architectures, including endpoint management, asset discovery, software deployment, patch management, CMDB, and IT service management platforms.- You are experienced in Platform and Enterprise Architecture (of at least 3+ years) and can translate business and security requirements into scalable technical solutions, governance models, operating concepts, and technology roadmaps.- You possess strong capabilities in Platform Integration, Automation, AI and Analytics, including API-based integration, monitoring, automation, operational data flows, and AI-ready platform design.

jobs.description:
Sport- und Gesundheitszentrum Zerlach

Als präventiv-medizinisches Konzept ist das SGZ Zerlach eine Antwort auf die steigende gesundheitliche Eigenverantwortung. Das Training des gesamten Körpers steht im Vordergrund unserer Dienstleistung und ist die ideale Möglichkeit, den Gesundheitsbeschwerden aktiv entgegen zu wirken bzw. ihnen vorzubeugen. Mit qualifiziertem Personal, und die auf das Präventivtraining abgestimmte Geräteausstattung, bringt der Fitnessbereich des SGZ die besten Voraussetzungen für erfolgreiches Training auf höchstem Niveau mit sich.

Wir suchen zum sofortigen Eintritt: 1 Fitnesstrainer_in Gesundheitstraining bedeutet, alle wichtigen motorischen und damit lebensnotwendigen Eigenschaften unseres Körpers zu trainieren. Ein maßgeschneidertes Gesundheitstraining muss daher in jedem Fall die Komponenten Kraft (Spannung der Muskulatur), Flexibilität (Dehnfähigkeit), Koordination (Zusammenspiel der Muskulatur) und Ausdauer (Herz-Kreislauf) beinhalten. Nach der Untersuchung aller wichtigen Faktoren müssen die Ergebnisse in das umfassende Regelwerk der Trainingslehre eingebracht werden. Nur wenn diese konsequent befolgt wird, entsteht ein Trainingskonzept, mit dem der Trainierende garantiert sein Ziel erreicht. Der Faktor Zufall wird ausgeschaltet.

Um die oben erwähnten Dinge zu erreichen bzw. umzusetzen ist unser sich über 2 Etagen erstreckender Fitnessbereich mit neuesten Geräten ausgestattet worden! Nach einer gründlichen Befundung und einer von uns empfohlenen ärztlichen Untersuchung wird eine Einschulung durch unsere Fitnesstrainer_innen vorgenommen und ein Trainingskonzept erstellt. Danach steht Ihrem Training nichts mehr entgegen!

Unsere Erwartungen an dich:

* fundierte Ausbildung im Fitnessbereich (Lehre, Diplomausbildung...)

* kundenorientiertes Auftreten

Unser Angebot an dich:

* eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten

* Möglichkeiten von Mehrstunden/Zusatzverdienst bei Leitung von Gruppenkursen

Dein Aufgabengebiet bei uns:

* Einschulung unserer Neukunden an den modernsten Trainingsgeräten

* Betreuung und Beratung unserer Bestandskunden hinsichtlich der Trainingspläne

* idealerweise Erstellung der individuellen Trainingspläne

jobs.title: Contract Manager (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
1 Contract Manager (m/f/d) Job ID 520262

Siemens Mobility location in 1110 Vienna.
You will analyse, draft and evaluate customer and supplier contracts, identify relevant opportunities and risks during project management and advise the project teams competently on contract-related issues.

* In addition, you will support the creation, negotiation and enforcement of amendments vis-à-vis customers and suppliers, ensuring the documentation and prosecution of claims as part of claim management.
* You will analyze project deviations in terms of costs, deadlines and scope of services, carry out delay analyses and evaluate the causes and effects of schedule deviations.
* In doing so, you will identify, document and assert downtime, obstructions and productivity losses and support the project teams in preparing evidence to enforce additional costs and compensation claims.
* You will work closely with the areas of project management, commercial management, engineering, procurement and legal counsel and accompany negotiations as well as the out-of-court or judicial enforcement of claims.


Your qualifications - solid and relevant

* You have successfully completed a university degree in law or an economic/technical university degree with basic legal training.
* You have a special interest and in-depth knowledge of contract law and ideally have already gained 3-5 years of professional experience in contract management, claim management or project management in the context of complex infrastructure or rolling stock projects.
* You have a pronounced willingness to familiarize yourself with the technical details of infrastructure projects in order to form an effective interface between law and technology.
* You are very interested in using AI to increase the quality and efficiency of your work.
* Personally, you are characterized by a structured, analytical way of working, initiative, strong communication skills and enjoyment of interdisciplinary cooperation.
* You are willing to travel nationally and internationally.
* Since you work in an international project environment, you are fluent in both written and spoken German and English. Ideally, you also have excellent knowledge of Romanian or another Eastern European language.

What do we offer you?

* Internationality - We offer an attractive working environment in an innovative, globally active group with diverse and responsible tasks in an international environment
* Purpose - We are pioneers of mobility. With us, you are actively contributing to the transport turnaround and climate protection in a market of the future, because our transport solutions reduce CO2 emissions all over the world.
* Reconciling family and career - With flexible working hours and the possibility of working from home, we help you to concentrate fully on your career without losing sight of the demands of your family life.
* Attractive conditions - You will receive an attractive remuneration package within the framework of the Collective Agreement for the Electrical and Electronics Industry of Austria and other extras such as employee share programmes and company pension schemes.
* Further development - We offer you comprehensive training opportunities for your professional and personal development, both online and offline.
* Team - Become part of our highly committed and collaborative team.

What else do I need to know?We offer an attractive compensation package that reflects your qualifications and professional experience. The gross annual salary for this position, as defined by the applicable collective agreement, is at least EUR 65,041.34. Depending on your education and experience, a higher salary may be offered. As a large international corporation, Siemens also provides additional benefits and social perks.
How can I apply?If you are interested in this position, we look forward to receiving your detailed online application.

jobs.title: Designer (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
What if eyewear could be lighter, smarter, more expressive - and simply better designed? At Silhouette Group, we believe great eyewear starts with a strong idea. Our three brands - Silhouette, evil eye and neubau - explore different ways of shaping the future of eyewear.

We are looking for a curious, creative and ambitious Eyewear Designer to join our international design team in our Headquarter in Linz. 1 Designer (m/w/d)

AUFGABEN UND VERANTWORTUNG

* Explore. Track emerging trends in fashion, design, materials, technology and culture - and turn insights into relevant design directions.

* Create. Develop concepts, moodboards, sketches and 2D/3D designs from the first idea to a tangible product.

* Shape. Work closely with Color Design, R&D, prototyping and construction to transform creative ideas into feasible, high-quality eyewear.

* Communicate. Tell the story behind your designs and inspire colleagues, marketing, sales and opticians.

* Contribute. Become part of the development of future collections across our three distinctive brands.

ANFORDERUNGEN

* A degree in Industrial Design, Product Design or a related field

* A strong portfolio demonstrating original thinking, conceptual strength, sensitivity to form and attention to detail

* The ability to develop ideas from concept and sketch through 2D/3D design to the physical product

* Experience with Adobe Creative Suite and 3D design tools such as Rhino, SolidWorks or equivalent

* A strong understanding of form, proportion, materials and manufacturing processes

* Genuine curiosity for new materials, technologies and production methods

* The confidence to question conventional approaches, explore new ideas and develop your own design point of view

* An independent, hands-on and solution-oriented way of working

* A collaborative mindset and the ability to work effectively with design, engineering and manufacturing teams

* Experience in eyewear, product or industrial design is an advantage - but exceptional potential and a strong portfolio matter just as much

For this full-time position, we offer a minimum gross yearly salary of EUR 60,962.30 in accordance with the Austrian Collective Agreement for the Metal Industry. Depending on your qualifications and professional experience, we are happy to offer a higher salary.

At Silhouette, your ideas have the opportunity to become reality - from the first sketch to prototype and, ultimately, to a finished collection. With three brands and distinct design worlds, you will find a broad playground for creativity, ranging from precision and lightness to performance and contemporary expression. Design and technology go hand in hand. You will work closely with experts from R&D, prototyping and production, gaining first-hand insight into how exceptional eyewear is developed and manufactured. We offer an international and dynamic working environment with room to take ownership, contribute your ideas and grow both professionally and personally. Depending on your preferred location, the position can be based in Linz or Vienna, with flexible hybrid and home-office options. Beyond the role itself, you can look forward to a range of benefits, including team events, fitness offers, professional and personal development opportunities, a subsidized healthy company restaurant, modern office spaces and a unique global company culture. Ready to shape the future of eyewear with us? Upload your application and portfolio via our online career portal at silhouette-international.com/karriere. For any questions, please feel free to contact Katrin Kappelmüller at +43 732 3848-843.

The impact you'll make
As a Process Engineer at Lam, you will operate on cutting-edge technology, harnessing atomicprecision, material science, and surface engineering to push technical boundaries. Your roleinvolves developing new and advanced process formulations, defining equipment hardware tomeet processing requirements, evaluating test data, and coordinating design requirements toensure compatibility of processing methods. Your expertise and knowledge play a crucial roleour customers success, making an impact on the next generation of semiconductorbreakthroughs.

In this role you will directly contribute to panel level processes. This is includes electrochemicalmetal deposition and post plating processes, e.g. metal etching. You will focus on developing process for and with customers around the world and cover smallscale and panel level scale processes.

What you'll do
* Conduct process engineering research, development, and evaluation in support of Lam's cutting-edge semiconductor equipment and systems
* Review and enhance processing techniques and methods applied in the manufacture and fabrication of products
* Develop and sustain new processes and process improvements to reduce production costs and increase yields
* Compile and analyze test data to establish next steps in process development and determine appropriate limits and variables for process specifications
* Collaborate internally to plan, collect data, analyze results, and report on customer demos for existing process applications
* Partner cross-functionally and with customers to understand roadmaps, process flow, inflection points, requirements, and business challenges

Minimum Qualifications:

* Master's degree in Materials Science, Chemical Engineering, Chemistry or Physics or related field with 6+ years of experience; or a PhD with 3+ years' experience; or equivalent experience
* Good English oral and written communication skills

Preferred Qualifications:

* Familiarity with working in a laboratory and on semiconductor equipment with experience in surface preparation and analytical techniques

* Working knowledge of statistical analysis and problem-solving methodologies
* Experience with statistical tools (JMP, Minitab, etc.)

jobs.description:

Founded in 2013, Voodoo is a tech company that creates mobile games and apps with a mission to entertain the world. Our 'Core' games team supports internal and external studios worldwide in creating, developing, and launching new hit games, whilst our 'Live' games team focuses on delivering higher engagement on our existing and successful games.

Paper Party is the multiplayer mode of Paper.io 2. We are looking for a dedicated Game Designer to improve the modes we already have and create new ones from scratch.

All modes will keep the Paper universe, camera and controls. Beyond that, there is a lot of creative freedom. You will explore new rules, objectives, win conditions, pacing and team setups to create a broad range of fun and replayable multiplayer experiences.

You will:

  • Design and prototype new gameplay modes

  • Improve existing Paper Party modes

  • Define simple, readable rules for one-finger controls

  • Iterate quickly through testing, feedback and playtests

  • Balance accessibility, competition, pacing and replayability

  • Identify weak ideas early and confidently cut or reshape them

  • Work closely with the Paper.io 2 team to turn concepts into playable experiences

  • Document your designs clearly

  • Fine-tune modes directly in Unity whenever possible

This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys moving quickly from an idea to a playable prototype, testing it and improving it.

Profile

  • 5+ years of experience in mobile F2P games, designing new games, gameplay modes or prototypes from scratch

  • Experience shipping player-facing content, ideally in mobile games

  • A strong understanding of multiplayer and competitive gameplay

  • A good sense of pacing, clarity and player motivation

  • A pragmatic and iterative approach: prototype, test, cut and retry

  • The ability to work independently and take full ownership

  • Strong English communication and collaboration skills

Nice to have

  • Strong Unity experience

  • Experience with mobile controls, multiplayer or party games

  • Experience working on live games or live content

jobs.title: Erfaren cykelmekaniker med sans for salg søges
jobs.description:
Vi søger ikke bare en mekaniker – vi søger den person, der kan blive butikkens ansigt udadtil og tage ansvar, som var det sin egen forretning.

Er du en dygtig og selvstændig cykelmekaniker med solid erfaring? Trives du med ansvar, kundekontakt og en varieret hverdag, hvor du selv er med til at få butikken til at fungere? Så er det måske dig, vi leder efter.

Om jobbet

Vi søger en erfaren cykelmekaniker, der kan tage ansvar for både butik og værksted i det daglige. Du skal være tryg ved at arbejde selvstændigt og kunne håndtere alt fra almindelige serviceeftersyn til fejlfinding og større reparationer på alle typer cykler, herunder ladcykler - har du erfaring med elcykler, er det et plus.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

* Har flere års erfaring som cykelmekaniker.

* Kan diagnosticere og løse alle typer mekaniske problemer på cykler.

* Er vant til at arbejde alene og tage ansvar for dagens opgaver.

* Er serviceminded og god til at rådgive kunder.

* Arbejder struktureret, effektivt og med fokus på kvalitet.

* Forstår at mersalg er en del af servicen.

Vi tilbyder

* En konkurrencedygtig løn, der matcher dine kvalifikationer.

* En varieret hverdag i en lille, lokal cykelbutik i Søborg.

* Stor frihed under ansvar og mulighed for at præge den daglige drift.

* Et uformelt arbejdsmiljø med korte beslutningsveje.

* Mulighed for at blive en vigtig del af en butik, hvor godt håndværk og god kundeservice er i fokus. Vi sætter pris på vores ⭐️'er.

Otsime hooldustöötajaid, kes soovivad pakkuda hoolt ja tuge meie elanikele Kastre kodus, asukohaga Kastre külas Tartumaal.

Tööülesanded: Milline on sinu roll meie kodudes?
✨ Päeva rõõmuks ja toetuseks: Sa hooldad ja juhendad meie kliente, olles nende jaoks igapäevane tugi ja abiline. ✨ Hoolivus igas pisidetailis: Abistad kliente hügieenitoimingutel, aidates neil säilitada väärikust ja enesekindlust. ✨ Südamega igas hetkes: Toetad meie kliente söömisel ja riietumisel, muutes nende päeva lihtsamaks ja mugavamaks. ✨ Puhtus, mis loob turvatunde: Hoolitsed klientide tubade ja hügieeniruumide puhtuse eest, luues neile mõnusa ja hubase keskkonna. ✨ Tervise hoidmine igas sammus: Tagad hooldus- ja põetusvahendite puhtuse, et meie kliendid saaksid parimat võimalikku hoolt. Kui sinu südames on koht hoolivusele ja soov muuta kellegi päev paremaks, siis ootame sind oma kollektiivi!

Omalt poolt pakume: Meile on oluline, et tunneksid end väärtustatuna. Meie juures ootab sind:
✨ 30 päeva põhipuhkust, et sul oleks aega päriselt puhata. ✨ Sõidukompensatsioon tööle ja koju, kui kasutad isiklikku autot. ✨ Mugavad tööriided ja jalanõud meie poolt – sinu turvalisus on tähtis. ✨ Maitsev toitlustus tööpäeva jooksul. ✨ 30% kõrgem öötöö tasu. ✨ Ka öösiti ei jää sa üksi – tööl on alati kaks hooldustöötajat. ✨ Võimalus areneda – pakume erialaseid koolitusi ja oskuste täiendamist. Kui hoolivus, meeskonnavaim ja arenguvõimalused on sulle olulised, siis sobid meie tiimi suurepäraselt!

Muud nõuded: Oled ideaalne kandidaat, kui sind iseloomustavad:
kannatlikkus ja valmisolek kuulata; täpsus ja kohusetundlikkus igapäevastes tegevustes; hea suhtlemisoskus ja positiivne ellusuhtumine; meeskonnatöö oskus, aga ka iseseisev tegutsemine; füüsiline vastupidavus ja stressitaluvus; tähelepanelikkus ja vastutustunne abivajajate heaolu eest Mida ootame sinult? ✅ Soovitavalt hooldaja kutsetunnistus (või valmisolek õppida meie juures) ✅ Sõiduauto olemasolu on suur pluss ✅ Vähemalt põhiharidus ✅ Kehtiv tervisetõend ✅ Tööle valitud kandidaadil palume enne töölepingu sõlmimist esitada karistusregistri väljavõtte, vastavalt hooldekodus töötamise nõuetele.

Tööülesanded: Otsime oma meeskonda kogemustega laevakorpuse monteerijat/paigaldajat. Töö hõlmab seadmete, pumpade, jahutite, mootorite ja muude laevaseadmete remondi- ja hooldustöid juhendamisel ning laevade ümberehitustöid.

Omalt poolt pakume: - Paindlikku töögraafikut
- Tööd arenevas ja stabiilses ettevõttes - Konkurentsivõimelist töötasu vastavalt kvalifikatsioonile, oskustele ja õppimisvõimele - Arengu- ja karjäärivõimalusi - Tööriideid ning vajalikke isikukaitsevahendeid - Vajadusel väljaõpet ja täiendkoolitusi

Muud nõuded: Võiksid olla sobiv kandidaat, kui Sul on oskused:
- teostada erinevate laevade ja tööstusseadmete remondi- ja hooldustöid; - hooldada ja remontida pumpasid; - hooldada ja remontida diiselmootoreid; - hooldada ja remontida kompressoreid. Ootused kandidaadile: - vähemalt 2-aastane töökogemus laevaehituses, laevaremondis või metallkonstruktsioonide koostamisel; - oskus lugeda tehnilisi jooniseid; - metallkonstruktsioonide märgistamise, lõikamise, sobitamise ja koostamise oskus; - varasem kogemus laevakere detailide paigaldamisel tuleb kasuks; - hea füüsiline vorm ja valmisolek füüsiliseks tööks; - vastutustundlikkus, täpsus ning hea meeskonnatööoskus; - erialane haridus, kutsetunnistused ja varasem tootmistöö kogemus on eeliseks.

Kodus töötamise võimalus: Ei

jobs.title: Betoonitööde brigadir
jobs.description:
Otsime laialdase kogemusega brigadiri, kes meeskonna tööd juhiks platsil.

Tööülesanded: Tööde planeerimine ja juhtimine: Brigaadi igapäevatöö organiseerimine, ülesannete jagamine ja jooksvate probleemide lahendamine.
Kvaliteedi ja tehnoloogia kontroll: Raketiste paigalduse, armeerimise, betoneerimise ja betooni järelhoolduse vastavuse kontrollimine ehitusprojektile ning normidele. Tööohutuse tagamine: Ohutusnõuete täitmise jälgimine ehitusplatsil ja tellingutel. Materjalide ja tööriistade haldus: Vajalike materjalide (betoon, sarrused, raketised) ja seadmete õigeaegse olemasolu ning säästliku kasutamise tagamine. Aruandlus: Tehtud tööde mahu ja töötundide arvestuse pidamine ning info edastamine objektijuhile.

Omalt poolt pakume: Konkurentsivõimelist palka, mis vastab Sinu oskustele ja kogemustele
Alati õigeaegselt laekuvat töötasu ja ametlikku vormistamist. Stabiilset ja aastaringset tööd (meil on objektid olemas ka talveperioodil). Ametiautot või isikliku auto kompensatsiooni objektide vahel liikumiseks.Vajadusel tasuta majutust ja transporti ettevõtte poolt, kui objektid asuvad kodukohast kaugel. Võimalust rääkida kaasa tööprotsesside parendamisel ja meeskonna komplekteerimisel.

Muud nõuded: Vajalikud oskused ja omadused:
Erialane pädevus: Pikaajaline praktiline kogemus betoonitöödel (raketised, armatuur, valu, viimistlus) ja jooniste lugemise oskus. Juhtimisoskus: Võime meeskonda motiveerida, delegeerida ja konflikte lahendada. Pingetaluvus: Ehitusplatsil muutuvad olud kiiresti (ilmastik, tarneajad), mis nõuab kiiret reageerimist. Keeleoskus: lisaks eesti keelele ka vene keele oskus, et suhelda eri rahvusest töölistega.

Kodus töötamise võimalus: Ei

jobs.title: Solutions Architect, Public Sector - East
Design Engineer (Web & Brand)
jobs.description:
At Linear, we're building the product development system for teams and agents. AI is fundamentally changing how software gets built, and we’re shaping the tools this new era requires.

Founded in 2019, Linear has become the platform of choice for more than 40,000 companies (including OpenAI, Coinbase, and Ramp) to plan, build, and ship their products. Today, our team is distributed across North America, Europe, and Australia, and we’re continuing to grow internationally. What unites us is relentless focus, fast execution, and a deep care for software craftsmanship.

We're looking for a Design Engineer with strong visual taste to help drive our creative initiatives across web and brand. When it comes to design and code, we’re looking to work with experienced people who can pick up any problem and solve it. For us, it’s both how it works and how it looks. At its core, Linear is a developer tool where speed, interactions, and small details matter. We expect a broad set of design skills and the ability to create high-quality designs, interactions, and prototypes.

In this role, you will help communicate Linear's story—what we're building and why it matters—as part of our internal creative agency: the Magic Team.

What you'll do

 - You will be responsible for building complex and interactive UI web/app experiences

 - Build beautiful, responsive websites, landing pages, and internal tools

 - Implement creative animations and interactions in code

 - Explore visual design in Figma and translate it to web-native experiences

What we're looking for

 - Eye for good design

 - Strong frontend engineering skills

 - Experience building end-to-end websites and landing pages

 - Experience with React and TypeScript

 - Experience using agentic coding tools as part of the design process (from exploring ideas to building production-quality interactions)

 - A portfolio or Twitter profile showcasing a range of technical skills, a creative use of code, and prototyping skills

What we offer

 - Interesting and challenging work

 - Work life balance

 - Competitive salary and equity

 - Employee-friendly equity terms (extended exercise)

 - Paid lunch and coffee during work days

 - Work remotely, no commuting to the office

 - Paid co-working space/desk at an office

 - Regular team events and offsites

 - 5 weeks paid vacation

 - 4 months paid parental leave

Learn how we think and work

 - Part I https://linear.app/blog/a-design-reset and Part II https://linear.app/blog/how-we-redesigned-the-linear-ui of how we redesigned the Linear UI

 - Read me https://linear.app/readme a story about our mission

 - Why and how we do work trials https://linear.app/blog/why-and-how-we-do-work-trials-at-linear Linear blog post

 - How we use AI in design https://designerfund.substack.com/p/ai-design-linear feature of Linear's design team

 - Crafting quality that endures https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pCil7YNhNCU Config keynote by our Co-founder & CEO, Karri Saarinen

 - Building for quality: Our Investment in Linear https://accel.com/noteworthy/our-investment-in-linear Accel Series B blog post

jobs.title: Senior Engineering Manager (hands-on) - Alan Clinic
jobs.description:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 800+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

🤖 Who we are

Alan Clinic. A health companion and a digital clinic for everyone.

We're a small team within Alan, on a mission to redefine the future of care by democratizing access to medical expertise. The Clinic is two crews building one experience:

  • Mo. An intelligent, empathetic, multimodal LLM-based conversational AI assistant able to prescribe, triage, and proactively follow up on care. We kicked off in 2023 and launched Mo to all our French members (1M) in Q1 2026, making it the first safe AI health companion live at scale in Europe.

  • Clinic Platform. The medical services behind the conversation: chat with health practitioners, teleconsultation, and care programs across primary care, mental health, and physiotherapy.

Imagine giving every person in the world instant, 24/7 access to personalised medical expertise (through chat, voice, or video) with AI agents working in tandem with real doctors and the health system. That's what we are building 🤖🏥.

🚀 What you'll build and who you'll work with

We're building a medical experience that works reliably, safely, and at scale. An AI agent, and the clinic behind it. You'll lead the engineering team and you'll keep building alongside them.

The crews work at the intersection of product engineering, ML engineering, and medical expertise. As their engineering leader, you own:

  • 💬 The team behind the most memorable chatting experience. Hiring, onboarding, honest feedback, and the mix of skills Mo needs as it grows. Talent density is yours to own.

  • ➕ The architecture for Mo's next chapters. More context, new skills, new countries. You guide the calls on our architecture and agentic framework, and you stay close enough to the code to make them well.

  • 🏥 The platform that turns conversations into care. Chat with health practitioners, teleconsultation at national scale, and the tooling doctors and therapists use every day. You drive alignment with the crews and medical teams on the other side, so members get from words to actions.

  • 🛡️ Operational excellence. Mo and teleconsultation are real-time services that have to be live 24/7. Latency, error rates, incident response, and an on-call rotation that doesn't burn people out.

If you're excited by the idea of building the future of healthcare, this is the team for you. We're at the start of the journey. If you're curious, here is a paper we published recently.

⚡ Why this role is special

  • Dual impact: Shape both technical excellence and team growth - your engineers become better while building better products

  • Leadership growth: Influence engineering culture, mentor future leaders, and drive technical strategy that shapes the future of healthcare delivery

  • Startup speed, Alan's platform. Mo operates with the focus of a startup, on top of Alan's infrastructure, distribution, and health expertise. Small team, huge reach.

  • Stakes that make the work matter. In medical AI, reliability and safety are the product. Every call you make on quality, architecture, and evaluation is a call about our members' health.

🔍 What we're looking for

We're looking for an engineering leader who gets excited about building state-of-the-art AI systems and applying them to real-world, high-stakes problems in healthcare.

Leadership experience

  • 3+ years leading engineering teams, with a track record of building high performers.

  • You partner with other product functions as a true equal: you shape the roadmap, name trade-offs honestly, and help the team commit to what it can actually deliver.

Technical foundations

  • Experience establishing engineering excellence standards, with the ability to guide architectural decisions.

  • First-hand experience shipping AI or LLM products to production is a big plus.

  • You're excited and eager to keep writing code. You still review it, and you still ship some yourself.

  • Comfortable with modern development practices and AI-assisted development tools.

What we value

  • Curious, self-starting, humble, collaborative, and eager to grow.

  • You develop people as much as you develop products.

  • Ex-founders are typically a great fit in our team.

Mission alignment

  • Healthcare technology and innovation excite you

  • You understand that great engineering teams are built on psychological safety and continuous learning

But above all, we are looking for high potential and curiosity: make sure to show us this when you apply!

🎯 Important note: we hire people, not roles.

If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply, as it can only bring learnings or success.

If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist. We'll be thrilled to receive your application!

🔖 Check out our About Alan and Career pages, as well as our Medium, blog and Glassdoor page for more info.
