jobs.title: Construction workers for renovation projects – Holbæk / Zealand, Denmark
jobs.description:
BN Group ApS is recruiting 1–10 experienced construction workers for building and renovation projects around Holbæk and across Zealand (Sjælland), Denmark. Individuals and small teams are welcome. There is potential for a long-term working relationship.

THE WORK

Depending on your experience, tasks may include bricklaying, plastering and filling, tiling, concrete work, basement renovation, excavation, demolition, ceilings, doors, skirting boards and small carpentry jobs.

You do not need to do everything. Tell us which tasks you can carry out independently and which require support. We are looking for practical experience, reliable attendance and careful work. English, a driving licence and your own vehicle are advantages.

WORKING IN DENMARK

Applicants of all nationalities are welcome. You must have the legal right to carry out the proposed work in Denmark before starting. Any restrictions must be clarified before an agreement.

The company is registered at Gl. Præstebrovej 24, 4532 Gislinge, in Holbæk municipality. The work takes place on construction and renovation sites around Holbæk and across Zealand.

Accommodation may be available through the company. Availability, rent and utilities are agreed separately. Pay, working hours, start date, transport and other employment terms will be agreed individually.

HOW TO APPLY

Email bn@bygge-gruppen.dk with the subject “Construction worker Holbæk – [your name]”. Please include:

• Your practical experience and the tasks you can carry out independently.

• A few photographs of your own work and any relevant references.

• Your current location, earliest availability and, if applying as a team, the number of people.

• Languages spoken and whether you have a driving licence or vehicle.

• Your expected GROSS hourly wage before tax, stating the currency.

• Whether you need accommodation and your current work authorisation status for Denmark. Do not send identity documents with the initial application.

Contact: Bjørn Nielsen, BN Group ApS

Email: bn@bygge-gruppen.dk

Telephone: +45 31 61 00 80

jobs.title: Technicien(ne) Informatique Junior - CDI Genève (Suisse) (H/F)
jobs.description:
NovaLib SA, société genevoise spécialisée dans les services informatiques aux PME et PMI, recherche un(e) futur(e) collaborateur(trice) souhaitant construire une véritable carrière dans les métiers du service informatique.
Nous recherchons avant tout une personne passionnée par l'informatique, motivée, sérieuse et désireuse d'apprendre. L'expérience professionnelle n'est pas le critère principal. Nous privilégions le potentiel, le savoir-être et l'envie de s'investir durablement dans ce métier.
La personne intégrera une petite équipe de spécialistes qui l'accompagnera dans un parcours de formation structuré de 12 mois. Durant cette période, elle sera formée aux aspects techniques, méthodologiques et relationnels du métier afin de devenir progressivement autonome dans ses interventions auprès de nos clients.
Profil recherché
Nous recherchons une personne qui :
-Est passionnée par l'informatique et les nouvelles technologies.
-Souhaite faire de l'informatique son métier.
-Aime aider les autres et résoudre des problèmes.
-Est curieuse et a envie d'apprendre en permanence.
-Fait preuve de sérieux, de rigueur et de ponctualité.
-Est à l'écoute et sait communiquer avec professionnalisme.
-Présente bien et inspire confiance.
-
Aime travailler en équipe tout en étant capable de gagner en autonomie.
-Apprécie le contact humain et le service aux utilisateurs.
-Maîtrise le français à l'oral et à l'écrit.
-Possède idéalement quelques connaissances de base en informatique (PC, Windows, matériel informatique, réseaux, Microsoft 365, etc.).
Missions
Après sa période d'intégration, la personne participera progressivement à :
-L'assistance et au support des utilisateurs.
-L'installation et la configuration de postes de travail.
-Les interventions sur site chez nos clients.
-L'administration de solutions Microsoft 365.
-Les projets d'infrastructure informatique et de cybersécurité.
-L'accompagnement et la formation des utilisateurs.
Conditions du poste
-Contrat CDI.
-Période d'essai de 3 mois.
-Poste basé à Genève (Suisse).
-Déplacements réguliers chez les clients.
-Permis de conduire et véhicule personnel souhaités.
-Frais professionnels remboursés.
-Abonnement téléphonique suisse pris en charge par l'entreprise.
-Casier judiciaire compatible avec l'obtention d'un permis frontalier G.
-Résidence située à une distance raisonnable de Genève afin de faciliter les déplacements quotidiens.
Rémunération
La rémunération sera adaptée au niveau de connaissances et d'expérience du candidat, avec une progression liée à l'acquisition des compétences tout au long du parcours de formation de 12 mois.
Notre objectif est de recruter une personne motivée, de l'accompagner, de la faire grandir et de lui permettre de construire une carrière durable dans les métiers du service informatique aux entreprises.

jobs.title: Teleradiologi från Tokyo, Japan mot svenska sjukhus
jobs.description:
Dignus Medical är specialister på rekrytering och bemanning av specialistläkare och sjuksköterskor till hälsosektorn i Skandinavien. Vi bidrar till att lösa bemanningsutmaningarna genom att matcha rätt personal med rätt uppdragsgivare – vid rätt tidpunkt. I år firar vi 20 år. Se vår jubileumsfilm (https://vimeo.com/1114155105?share=copy) och följ med på resan!

Arbeta som radiolog i Tokyo och rapportera akut radiologi mot svenska sjukhus

Vill du kombinera kliniskt arbete inom svensk akutsjukvård med ett liv i Japan?

Vi söker specialistläkare i radiologi till ett 6 månaders uppdrag i Tokyo där du rapporterar akuta fall för svenska sjukhus.

Tidsskillnaden mellan Sverige och Japan innebär att du arbetar med akuta fall för svenska sjukhus under dagtid i Tokyo.

Om uppdraget

Du arbetar med akut radiologi för svenska sjukhus i en strukturerad och kvalitetssäkrad miljö. Uppdraget är organiserat med tydliga processer, kollegial samverkan och hög teknisk standard.

Arbetet sker från en etablerad arbetsplats i Tokyo tillsammans med andra internationella radiologer.

Vi söker dig som

    Är specialistläkare i radiologi med svenskt specialistbevis
    Erfarenhet av akut radiologi är meriterande
    Är trygg i självständiga bedömningar i högt tempo
    Har mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska

Relocation och praktiskt stöd

    Relocation paketersättning ingår
    Stöd i visumprocess
    Hjälp med boende i Tokyo
    Strukturerad onboarding och introduktion
    Vägledning kring fakturering och löpande administrativa frågor

Tokyo erbjuder internationella skolor, hög säkerhet och välutvecklad infrastruktur.

Både du som flyttar ensam och du som flyttar med familj är välkommen.

Ersättning

    Generös och konkurrenskraftig ersättning
    Ersättningen är kopplad till produktionsvolym utan fast inkomsttak
    Transparent ersättningsmodell anpassad för konsultuppdrag
    Uppdrag på 6 månader med tydlig och förutsägbar omfattning

Varför Japan

Japan kombinerar hög livskvalitet, trygghet och modern infrastruktur med ett rikt kultur- och naturliv.

Tokyo är en global metropol där tradition möter innovation. Samtidigt finns närhet till skidåkning i norr, stränder i söder och en unik matkultur över hela landet.

Detta är en möjlighet att arbeta kliniskt aktivt med svensk akut radiologi samtidigt som du lever i en av världens mest dynamiska miljöer.

Om uppdragsgivaren

Internationell vårdgivare med strukturerad organisation och långsiktigt fokus på kvalitet inom radiologisk diagnostik. Du blir en del av ett internationellt team med gemensamma arbetsrutiner och tydliga processer för akut radiologi.

Verksamheten är organiserad för att säkerställa kvalitet, effektivitet och kollegial samverkan i det dagliga arbetet.

Detta är ett konsultuppdrag och förutsätter att du har eller är villig att starta eget aktiebolag.

Vad vi på Dignus Medical erbjuder dig

    Personlig och konfidentiell dialog från första kontakt
    Rådgivning och stöd genom processen från erfaren rekryterare
    Professionell matchning och stöd fram till uppdragsstart

Vill du veta mer om upplägget och möjligheten att arbeta från Tokyo?

Skicka in din ansökan idag så kontaktar vi dig för ett konfidentiellt och förutsättningslöst samtal.

Startdatum: Enligt överenskommelse

Du kan även registrera ditt CV (https://jobb.dignusmedical.se/sign-up) på eller anmäla dig till vårt nyhetsbrev (https://www.dignusmedical.no/sv/anmal-dig-till-vart-nyhetsbrev/) för att hålla dig uppdaterad om framtida möjligheter.

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
Carpenter Co. is the world's largest vertically integrated manufacturer of polyurethane foams, serving a diverse global marketplace with polyurethane chemical solutions, polyester fibers, and insulation materials through a network of more than 60 production facilities worldwide. Our Kouvola facility produces traditional comfort solutions, mattresses (both consumer & medical) and technical foams including rolls and bonded foam applications.

We are looking for an Account Manager to join our Finnish team. In this role, you will be responsible for developing sales and strengthening Carpenter's market position in Finland. You will work closely with existing customers while actively identifying new business opportunities within the manufacturing industry. This position offers the opportunity to take ownership of your customer portfolio, influence commercial strategy, and contribute directly to business growth in a global market-leading company.

What you'll do

- Drive the commercial growth of Carpenter Comfort Solutions in Finland.

- Develop and maintain strong relationships with existing customers and key stakeholders.

- Identify, pursue, and convert new business opportunities and market segments.

- Develop and execute sales plans aligned with business objectives.

- Monitor market developments, customer needs, and industry trends.

- Lead commercial negotiations, including pricing, contracts, and business terms.

- Support profitability by managing pricing strategies and commercial risks.

- Collaborate with internal teams to ensure excellent customer experience and business performance.

What we're looking for

- At least 5 years of experience selling materials, components, or technical solutions to manufacturing industry customers.

- Experience managing and developing your own customer portfolio.

- A proven track record in acquiring new customers and growing sales.

- Strong commercial acumen and experience negotiating pricing and contracts.

- Experience developing and implementing sales strategies and business plans.

- The ability to identify market trends and translate them into commercial opportunities.

- Fluency in both Finnish and English, written and spoken.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in technical sales.

- Experience in polyurethane, furniture or bedding industry.

- Experience managing distributors, dealers, or key accounts in the Nordic market.

- A background in B2B sales and business development.

Location & Travel

This role requires regular travel within Finland to meet customers, develop business opportunities, and support market growth. Our Finnish team is based in Kouvola, and monthly visits to the office are expected but you can work remotely anywhere in Finland,

Apply Now

To ensure a consistent recruitment process, all applications and CVs must be submitted in English through our recruitment system via [this link](https://ats.talentadore.com/apply/account-manager/ZlEGpp) no later than 20th September 2026. We review and interview candidates throughout the application period, and the position may be filled as soon as a suitable candidate is found.


Carpenter Engineered Foams Oy

Founded in 1950, Carpenter Co. is the worlds largest vertically integrated manufacturer of polyurethane foams. Carpenter also serves a diversified global marketplace with polyurethane chemical solutions, polyester fibers, and insulation materials through a network of more than 70 production locations. Our 6,500+ employees across the globe seek to provide the most innovative products and solutions with a focus on enhancing the quality of peoples lives while being a good steward of our resources.

At Carpenter, you'll find a rewarding career in a stable company, diverse experiences and an unwavering commitment to ethics and integrity. As part of our team, you'll collaborate with talented and dedicated colleagues whose sense of purpose complements your own.

Phone: 05 78451

jobs.title: Mekaniker søges til Solrød Autoland
jobs.description:
Automekaniker søges til Solrød Autoland

Er du uddannet mekaniker, og går du op i at levere et godt stykke arbejde? Har du samtidig lyst til en varieret hverdag, hvor du både arbejder med traditionelt værkstedsarbejde og autoophug? Så er det måske dig, vi søger hos Solrød Autoland.

Solrød Autoland driver både autoværksted og autoophug, og vi søger en dygtig og engageret automekaniker, som har lyst til at blive en del af vores team.

Hos os får du en alsidig hverdag, hvor opgaverne spænder bredt. Du kommer både til at arbejde med service og reparation af kundebiler samt opgaver i forbindelse med vores autoophug. Det betyder, at du får mulighed for at bruge dine mekaniske kompetencer på mange forskellige måder, og at to dage sjældent er ens.

Du får ansvar for dine egne opgaver, men bliver samtidig en del af et team, hvor vi hjælper hinanden og sparrer om de forskellige opgaver.

Dine arbejdsopgaver

Dine arbejdsopgaver vil blandt andet omfatte:

  • Service og reparation af person- og varebiler

  • Fejlsøgning og diagnosticering

  • Udbedring af mekaniske og elektriske fejl

  • Vedligeholdelse og reparation af biler

  • Montering og eftermontering af udstyr

  • Mekanisk ad hoc-arbejde

  • Klargøring og kontrol af køretøjer

  • Demontering af reservedele fra biler til autoophug

  • Vurdering og udtagning af brugbare reservedele

  • Håndtering og sortering af dele i forbindelse med autoophug

  • Generelle praktiske opgaver omkring vores autoophug

En del af stillingen vil således være relateret til autoophug, hvor du skal være med til at sikre, at brugbare reservedele bliver afmonteret korrekt og kan genanvendes eller sælges videre.

Vi lægger stor vægt på, at arbejdet bliver udført grundigt og professionelt – både på værkstedet og i autoophugget.

Hvem er du?

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Er uddannet automekaniker

jobs.title: Global Distribution Coordinator
jobs.description:
Company Description

Statistics show that women and underrepresented groups tend to apply to jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. Sobi encourages you to change that statistic and apply. Rarely do candidates meet 100% of the qualifications. We look forward to your application!

Key Responsibilities

    Customer Order administration incl. inter alia order taking, batch reservation, pick and pack ordering, shipment booking and monitoring, invoicing, crediting, returns and customer qualification.
    Month-end financial reporting in terms of Stock and Sales reconciliation of Sobi Consignment stock points and provide support to Sobi affiliates to complete the process with their stock points.
    Master Data management including pricing in operational ERP systems.
    Distribution network development and management including geographical expansions and new product/partner introductions. Mainly Finished Goods, but Drug Substance and Drug Product when applicable.
    Management of Sobi Logistic Service Providers (LSPs), through Business Review Meetings (BRMs) and performance monitoring (if applicable).

    Serial Number management in accordance with EU FMD; including Serial Number Alerts management, leading roles in Serialization Core Team activities and projects (incl. new product and/ or partner introduction)
    Process Continues Improvement

Qualifications

About you

You are a structured and analytical professional who enjoys working both independently and collaboratively. You take ownership of your work, show initiative when challenges arise, and have a strong sense of accountability. Your attention to detail, communication skills, and customer-centric mindset make you a trusted partner across functions and regions.



    You are a team player, structured, thorough, and professional and have a genuine customer service mindset.
    You appreciate and value working towards several different contact interfaces internal as well as external.
    You are independent and do not hesitate to take initiative when processes are not working efficiently.
    You have good cooperation and communication skills, ability to prioritize and have a burning interest in solving problems and delivering results.
    You have strong time management skills; able to plan short/ repetitive, mid-, and long-term due dates.
    You have a technology-driven mindset and are curious about how automation, digital tools, and AI-enabled solutions can improve ways of working.
    You are system-oriented, comfortable working with operational platforms, and motivated by finding smarter, more efficient solutions to recurring tasks and process challenges.



Here at Sobi we live by our core values: Care, Ambition, Urgency, Ownership and Partnership!

Additional Information

How to apply

We have an ongoing selection process in this recruitment and ask you to send your application as soon as possible. Click apply and include your resume in English.

Why Join Us?

We are differentiating ourselves through the passion of our people, the innovative products we bring to life, and the responsible business we operate.

To ensure that more patients benefit from our therapies now and in the future, and to align with the company’s ambitions for growth, we have five core values: Care, Ambition, Urgency, Ownership and Partnership.  

Our mission and purpose get us excited to come to work every day, but there are a few more reasons to join our team:

    Opportunities for professional growth
    Competitive compensation for your work
    Diversity and Inclusion
    A flexible workplace that supports work-life balance



About Sobi

Sobi is a global biopharma company unlocking the potential of breakthrough innovations, transforming everyday life for people living with rare diseases.

We are dedicated to capturing the scientific opportunities of our time. With our early roots in Sweden, we started as pioneers in Haemophilia. Today we are an innovate leader within rare diseases with a global reach.



    We are bringing brilliant ideas to life in rare disease areas with high unmet patient needs.
    We are experts on identifying breakthrough innovations, unlocking new therapies and levelling up global access to new treatments.
    Our global operational network and passionate team serve as the foundation for our success.

Sobi has approximately 2,000 employees across Europe, North America, the Middle East, Asia and Australia. In 2025, revenue amounted to SEK 28 billion. Sobi’s share (STO:SOBI) is listed on Nasdaq Stockholm. More about Sobi at sobi.com and LinkedIn.

jobs.title: Restaurant Manager
jobs.description:
Location: Gråbrødretorv 9, st.tv., 1154 København K
Position: Full-time
Start date: As soon as we find the right candidate

About Steam

Steam is a unique Chinese restaurant in the heart of Copenhagen. We share the flavours we love through handmade food, regional Chinese dishes, and fermentation—from comforting brunch favourites to warming copper-pot rice noodles and dishes made for sharing.

Our hospitality is personal, welcoming, and relaxed. We care about good food and the small details that make guests feel at home.

We are looking for a hands-on Restaurant Manager to lead our front-of-house team, take ownership of daily operations, and help Steam grow.

The Role

You will lead from the floor, work closely with the kitchen team, and keep service running smoothly. From supporting colleagues during busy shifts to organising schedules and special events, you will combine warm hospitality with confident, practical leadership.

We are looking for someone who notices what needs doing, takes initiative, and follows through.

Key Responsibilities

  • Service and guest experience: Lead daily service, manage reservations and table flow, and handle guest enquiries, special requests, and feedback with care.

  • Team leadership and scheduling: Train and motivate the FOH team, give constructive feedback, prepare schedules within agreed staffing budgets, and oversee shift coverage and recorded hours.

  • Menu knowledge and kitchen coordination: Ensure the team can confidently explain our food, drinks, and allergens, and maintain clear communication with the kitchen throughout service.

  • Operations and business awareness: Maintain opening, closing, and cleanliness standards; oversee stock, ordering, and cash reconciliation; and identify ways to reduce waste and improve sales and efficiency.

  • Events and collaborations: Help plan and deliver pop-ups, festivals, private bookings, and special events.

  • Social media: Capture everyday moments, food, and events for Steam’s social channels.

About You

You enjoy taking responsibility, making decisions independently, and helping the team do its best work. You bring:

  • At least 3 years of hospitality experience, ideally with supervisory or team leadership experience.

  • Strong organisational skills, a calm approach during busy service, and confidence in solving problems and giving and receiving feedback.

  • A warm, attentive approach to guests and a supportive attitude towards colleagues.

  • An interest in Chinese food and a willingness to learn about our ingredients, techniques, and stories.

  • Clear communication skills in English; Danish, Chinese, or Japanese are a plus.

  • Availability to work evenings, weekends, and peak service hours.

What We Offer

  • A competitive salary based on experience and responsibilities.

  • Real responsibility and room to shape daily operations.

  • A supportive international team with a passion for food and hospitality.

  • Opportunities to take part in food events, pop-ups, and creative collaborations.

How to Apply

Send your CV and a short introduction about yourself and why you would like to join Steam to steam@steamfusion.dk, with “Steam Restaurant Manager” in the subject line.

We review applications on an ongoing basis and will hire as soon as we find the right candidate.

jobs.title: Vært/Værtinde med lederansvar søges til SteakeRiet deltid
jobs.description:
Vært/Værtinde med lederansvar søges til SteakeRiet

Er du smilende, serviceminded og god til at skabe overblik – også når restauranten er fyldt?
Så er det måske dig, vi søger som vores nye vært/værtinde med lederansvar hos SteakeRiet.

Som vært/værtinde er du restaurantens ansigt udadtil. Du er den, vores gæster møder først, og du er med til at sikre, at de får en god oplevelse fra det øjeblik, de træder ind ad døren, til de går igen.

Om jobbet

Du får en central rolle i den daglige drift og bliver en del af vores lederteam. Du får blandt andet ansvar for at:

  • Byde vores gæster velkommen med et smil og sikre en god start på besøget

  • Have overblik over reservationer, bordplan og flow i restauranten

  • Koordinere og fordele gæster og borde

  • Sikre et godt samarbejde mellem værtskab, tjenere og køkken

  • Håndtere gæsternes spørgsmål og ønsker på en professionel og imødekommende måde

  • Tage ansvar for restauranten og medarbejderne på dine vagter

  • Bevare roen og overblikket – også når der er travlt

  • Være med til at sikre, at vores standarder for service og gæsteoplevelse bliver fulgt

Dine vagter

Stillingen er som udgangspunkt fast:

Hver 2. mandag & torsdag og hver 2. lørdag
samt som afløser i forbindelse med ferie og sygdom.

Arbejdstiden er fra kl. 15.30 og frem til restauranten lukker.
Der er tale om et deltidsjob, og der er rig mulighed for flere timer som tjener de andre dage... Perfekt som studiejob eller supplerende job.

Du vil derfor få en vigtig rolle på de aftener, hvor der er godt gang i restauranten, og hvor der er brug for en person, der kan tage ansvar og skabe struktur.

Vi forventer, at du:

  • Har naturligt flair for værtskab og god gæstekontakt

  • Er ansvarsbevidst og kan arbejde selvstændigt

  • Har et godt overblik og kan træffe beslutninger, når det går stærkt

  • Er tydelig og god til at kommunikere med både gæster og kolleger

  • Har lyst til at tage et lederansvar og gå forrest

  • Er fleksibel og mødestabil

  • Kan bidrage til den gode stemning – også på travle aftener

Det vigtigste for os er ikke nødvendigvis mange års erfaring, men at du har det rette drive, overblik og lysten til at tage ansvar.

Vi tilbyder

  • En spændende lederrolle i en restaurant med højt serviceniveau

jobs.title: Hyötyajoneuvomekaanikkoja
jobs.description:
Haemme Lahden Volvo Truck Centeriin hyötyajoneuvomekaanikkoja

Lahden Volvo Truck Centerissä huollamme ja korjaamme kuorma-, linja- ja pakettiautoja sekä teemme vauriokorjauksia. Korjaamomme muuttaa vuodenvaihteessa Kujalaan uusiin, nykyaikaisiin tiloihin, joissa pääset työskentelemään ajanmukaisilla työkaluilla entistäkin toimivammassa työympäristössä. Tukeaksemme tätä kasvua kaipaamme mekaanikkoporukkamme uusia työkavereita, joilla työhanskat pysyvät kädessä vaativammissakin tilanteissa ja huumori kukkii.

Jotta pääset tekemään työsi tehokkaasti ja turvallisesti, saat työsuhteen alussa kattavan perehdytyksen. Laadimme kanssasi myös koulutussuunnitelman ammatillisen kehittymisesi tueksi. Tarjoamme monipuolisia työtehtäviä, teknisiä haasteita ja mahdollisuuksia erikoistua. Tarvittaessa voit täydentää osaamistasi myös oppisopimuksella työn ohessa.

Mitä odotamme sinulta:

- teknistä pohjakoulutusta

- kokemusta raskaan kaluston huollosta ja korjauksesta

- kiinnostusta ajoneuvotekniikkaan - kokemus hyötyajoneuvon kuljettamisesta katsotaan eduksi

- Työ on kaksivuorotyötä sisältäen iltavuoroviikkoja sekä lauantaityövuoroja

- vahvaa työmoraalia ja ammattilaisen asennetta

- halua tuoda hyvää henkeä työyhteisöön.

- C-ajokortti katsotaan eduksi mutta koulutamme tarvittaessa

Mitä tarjoamme sinulle:

- kattavan perehdytyksen ja henkilökohtaisen koulutussuunnitelman

- monipuoliset tehtävät, erikoistumismahdollisuuksia ja alan vahvan koulutustarjonnan oman huoltokoulumme kautta

- kilpailukykyisen palkan sekä suuren talon edut, kuten liikunta-, kulttuuri- ja hierontaedun sekä kattavan työterveyshuollon

- mukavat ja ammattitaitoiset työkaverit sekä työtäsi arvostavat asiakkaat ja työnantajan

- vakaan työnantajan, joka on sitoutunut turvallisuuteesi ja terveyteesi

- mahdollisuuden työskennellä vuodenvaihteesta alkaen Lahden korjaamon uusissa, nykyaikaisissa tiloissa.

Meillä Volvolla monimuotoisuuden ja tasa-arvon vahvistaminen on yksi ydinarvoistamme. Uskomme monimuotoisen työyhteisön edistävän tehokkuutta ja innovatiivisuutta sekä tukevan asiakkaidemme menestystä ja hyvinvoivaa työpaikkaa.

Kiinnostuitko?

Jätä hakemuksesi vastaamalla ilmoituksen lopussa oleviin kysymyksiin mahdollisimman pian, viimeistään 27.9.2026. Huomioithan, että huomioimme vain rekrytointijärjestelmän kautta tulleet hakemukset.

Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa Lahden korjaamon huoltopäällikkö Jani Kemppainen jani.kemppainen@volvo.com tai puhelimitse viikolla 39 numerosta 010 655 6134.


Volvo Trucks

Volvo Trucks myy asiakkailleen kuljetusten kokonaisratkaisuja. Yritys tarjoaa täyden tuotevalikoiman keskiraskaista raskaisiin kuorma-autoihin, ja maailmanlaajuisesti sillä on 2 200 toimipisteen verkosto noin 130 maassa. Volvon kuorma-autoja valmistetaan 12 maassa eri puolilla maailmaa.

Vuonna 2023 toimitettiin maailmanlaajuisesti noin 145 000 Volvo kuorma-autoa. Volvo Trucks on osa Volvo Groupia, joka on maailman johtavia kuorma- ja linja-autojen, rakennuskoneiden sekä meri- ja teollisuusmoottorien valmistajia. Volvo Group tarjoaa myös kokonaisvaltaisia rahoitus- ja palveluratkaisuja. Volvo Trucksin työ perustuu yhtiön perusarvoihin, jotka ovat laatu, turvallisuus ja ympäristöstä huolehtiminen.

jobs.title: Join a leading radiology department in central Sweden
jobs.description:
Dignus Medical specializes in recruiting doctors, specialists and nurses for the healthcare sector across Scandinavia. Watch our anniversary film (https://vimeo.com/1114843079?share=copy) and join us on our journey!

Specialist in Radiology – Join a leading hospital in central Sweden

We are assisting a healthcare provider in central Sweden in recruiting a Specialist in Radiology.

About the Workplace

The department is a dynamic and technologically advanced unit covering radiology, mammography, and clinical physiology.

As a radiologist in the region, you will join a team of 25 consultants/senior specialists and 15 residents. The service is jointly organized with an overall manager, scheduler, and coordinator, creating excellent conditions for collaboration and knowledge exchange.

The hospital operates 24/7, handling both acute and elective examinations. The equipment includes CT scanners, MRI, fluoroscopy systems, conventional X-ray facilities, and ultrasound labs. There is close cooperation between departments and a strong team spirit among radiology, clinical departments, and the emergency unit.

The hospital is known for its strong collegial atmosphere and close interdisciplinary collaboration, where your expertise makes a real difference for patients.

The location allows you to combine a rewarding career with life close to nature. Forests, lakes, and mountains are nearby, and the town offers good schools, affordable housing, and a welcoming community.



Your Responsibilities

As a radiologist at the hospital, you will work broadly within general radiology, including image interpretation and examinations in conventional radiology, CT, and ultrasound.

The role is varied and also includes ward rounds, multidisciplinary conferences (MDT), continuing medical education, and supervision of residents and visiting colleagues. On-call duties during some evenings and weekends are part of the position.

Who We Are Looking For

    Willingness to learn Swedish - full support provided
    Experience in conventional radiology, CT, and ultrasound, including basic skills in ultrasound-guided interventions
    Experience in MRI is considered an advantage

Great importance is placed on personal qualities such as teamwork, commitment, and a positive, solution-oriented attitude. You are able to make decisions, work independently, and structure your tasks efficiently. You stay up to date within your specialty and contribute your expertise to colleagues.

What the Employer Offers

    At least 25 days of annual paid vacation, with paid leave accrued from day one (more than required by Swedish law)
    Opportunities for continuous learning and professional development
    Strong employee benefits and insurance schemes supporting long-term financial security
    Flexible working hours available in most departments

About the Region

The region is a proactive, creative, welcoming, and open place where you can enjoy a high quality of life. You will live and work surrounded by beautiful wilderness — deep forests, peaceful lakes, flowing rivers, and picturesque countryside — alongside an open and friendly community, international business sector, rich cultural life, sports, outdoor activities, and an innovative university environment.

Language and relocation

Swedish language training starts in your home country through individual online lessons with a private teacher. You study several hours per week alongside your current work.

Relocation to Sweden takes place once you have reached Swedish level C1.

Relocation and the language education is provided and financed. You get supportet from both us and the region.

You begin working fully as a radiographer once Swedish authorization has been obtained.



Application

Interviews are conducted on an ongoing basis, and the position may be filled before the final application date.

Submit your application today and include:

    CV / résumé
    Diploma and educational certificates/ Proof of professional license/registration
    Motivation letter
    References from at least one manager and one professional colleague

jobs.title: HR-udviklingskonsulent til udvikling af Absalon som attraktiv arbejdsplads
jobs.description:
Har du erfaring med HR-udvikling, og kan du drive større udviklingsopgaver fra idé til implementering? Så har vi en spændende stilling til dig på Professionshøjskolen Absalon. Vi søger en erfaren HR-udviklingskonsulent, der kan tage selvstændigt ansvar for centrale indsatser indenfor organisations- og lederudvikling og omsætte strategiske ambitioner til konkrete løsninger, der skaber værdi i praksis.

Hos Absalon har vi fokus på at være en attraktiv arbejdsplads, og du vil som vores nye kollega få en central rolle i at drive denne strategiske indsats. Samtidig er vi i afdelingen i gang med at styrke strategisk kompetenceudvikling, arbejdsmiljø og lederudvikling.

Din profil
Vi søger en HR-profil med erfaring fra en lignende stilling, gerne fra en politisk styret, eller større, kompleks organisation. Du har tidligere haft ansvar for at udvikle og implementere HR-koncepter, drive tværgående projekter og rådgive ledere. Du er vant til at arbejde selvstændigt, sikre fremdrift og levere gennemarbejdede løsninger med høj faglig kvalitet. Vi har desuden et ønske om, at du kan genkende dig selv i følgende:

Stærke relationelle kompetencer. Du forstår at navigere i en organisatorisk kontekst, hvor forskellige behov, interesser og perspektiver skal balanceres. Du er en stærk samarbejdspartner for både ledere og kolleger og formår at skabe tillid, fremdrift og fælles løsninger. Du inddrager relevante parter på de rigtige tidspunkter og bidrager til, at opgaver kvalificeres fagligt og forankres organisatorisk.

Struktureret med skarpt overblik. Du er vant til at håndtere komplekse opgaver med mange interessenter, detaljer og deadlines. Du arbejder systematisk, skaber struktur og fremdrift og tager ansvar for, at opgaverne bliver fulgt til dørs med høj kvalitet.

Sikker skriftlig formidler. Du formulerer dig klart, præcist og sikkert - også når emnerne er komplekse eller følsomme. Du kan omsætte fagligt indhold til tekster, der rammer målgruppen, hvad enten det gælder nyheder til intranettet eller sagsfremstillinger til direktionen. Du har sproglig kvalitetssans og sætter en ære i at levere gennemarbejdede produkter både indholdsmæssigt og sprogligt.

Vi forestiller os, at du har en relevant uddannelsesmæssig baggrund, fx cand.merc., HRM eller lign.

Dine arbejdsopgaver
Vi ønsker at være en attraktiv arbejdsplads med en sund arbejdskultur, kompetent ledelse og gode udviklingsmuligheder - og vi er godt på vej. Derfor arbejder vi strategisk med at styrke Absalon som arbejdsplads, og her får du en væsentlig rolle i at omsætte vores ambitioner til konkrete indsatser og resultater. Dine arbejdsopgaver vil blandt andet omfatte:

Onboarding. Gennem de seneste par år har vi arbejdet målrettet på at professionalisere vores onboarding af nye kollegaer, og du får en vigtig rolle i at videreudvikle konceptet med nye værktøjer og initiativer. Derudover skal dele af onboardingen understøttes systemmæssigt, da vi ønsker at samle relevant information ét sted.

Udvikling af øvrige HR-koncepter og ledelsesudvikling. Du kommer til at arbejde med udvikling og videreudvikling af HR-koncepter, der understøtter Absalon som attraktiv arbejdsplads. Det kan f.eks. handle om videreudvikling af MUS/LUS, vores personalepolitikker eller andre indsatser, der styrker ledelse, kompetenceudvikling og arbejdskultur. Vi forventer, at du kan bringe din erfaring i spil og være med til at forme løsningerne i takt med organisationens behov.

Projektansvar og tværgående samarbejde. Du får ansvar for dine egne opgaver og projekter, samtidig med at du bliver en del af et team, hvor sparring og samarbejde er en naturlig del af hverdagen. Sammen finder vi løsninger, der skaber værdi for organisationen.

Dine kolleger
Du bliver en del af afdelingen HR og Organisation. Vi er fordelt på to teams, Team Organisation og Team Løn og Personale, hvor vi i alt er 16 medarbejdere. Vi arbejder bl.a. med understøttelse af hovedsamarbejdsudvalget og arbejdsmiljøorganisationen, APV, løn, personalejura og -administration samt organisations- og ledelsesudvikling.

Du bliver en del af en fagligt stærk HR-afdeling med dygtige kolleger, der glæder sig til at få dig som kollega. Afdelingen er kendetegnet ved, at vi samarbejder på tværs, hjælper og sparrer med hinanden. Vi vender stort og småt og har en uformel omgangstone.

Vi holder til på vores Campus i Slagelse, som er nemt at komme til, da det er placeret lige ved stationen. Absalon har en dejlig frokostordning, adgang til motionscenter og en aktiv personaleforening. Der er gode muligheder for fleksibel arbejdstilrettelæggelse og hjemmearbejde.

Sådan ansøger du
  • Ansættelse sker ud fra kvalifikationer og efter gældende overenskomst på statens område. For en ansøger med den rette anciennitet og erfaring vil der være mulighed for ansættelse som special- eller chefkonsulent. Du kan forvente et lønniveau mellem 47.000-59.000 kr. inkl. pension alt efter indplacering.
  • Stillingen er på fuld tid og med forventet ansættelsesstart den 1. december 2026.
  • Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte teamleder for Team Organisation, Jette Vang, på telefon 7248 1243
  • Send CV som indeholder en motiveret besvarelse af nedenstående to spørgsmål, samt ansøgning via vores rekrutteringssystem her eller ved at klikke på 'Søg stillingen' til højre på denne side senest 4. oktober 2026: https://phabsalon.dk/job-i-absalon/ledige-stillinger
  • Spørgsmål 1: Hvilke erfaringer har du med at drive HR-udviklingsopgaver fra idé til implementering i en kompleks politisk styret organisation?
  • Spørgsmål 2: Hvordan har du konkret samarbejdet med ledere eller medarbejdere om at udvikle en HR-løsning, der blev anvendelig og skabte værdi i praksis?
  • Vi lægger vægt på konkrete eksempler baseret på din erfaring frem for en traditionel ansøgning.
  • Vi forventer at afholde 1. samtalerunde den 7. oktober og 2. samtalerunde den 19. oktober. Der vil indgå en case for de kandidater, der går videre til 2. samtale.

Vi ønsker, at medarbejderstaben afspejler det omgivende samfund, og vi opfordrer derfor alle interesserede uanset køn, kulturel og etnisk baggrund til at søge stillingen.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

Om Absalon
Professionshøjskolen Absalon er Region Sjællands største uddannelsesinstitution, hvor vi med vores 14 uddannelser uddanner mennesker, der med høj faglighed og professionalisme skaber værdi i det samfund, de er en del af. Vores uddannelser går tæt på den enkelte studerendes drømme og potentialer, tæt på den praksis de skal virke i og på de mennesker og fællesskaber, de skal gøre en mærkbar forskel for.

I en ny sjællandsk storregion er det afgørende at have blik for både de store linjer, det lokale og det nære. De mennesker, der uddanner sig på Absalon, løfter andre mennesker og skaber muligheder og udvikling dér, hvor de bor og arbejder.

Det er vores ambition at skabe praksisnære uddannelser af høj kvalitet og give de studerende de bedste forudsætninger for at udvikle sig til kompetente professionelle. Og vi vil styrke mulighederne for, at de kan skabe en karriere, der til enhver tid matcher deres faglige interesser og ambitioner - og det ansvar de tager i vores samfund.

Vi er 850 medarbejdere, vi har 8.000 studerende på vores grunduddannelser og vi efter- og videreuddanner 3.500 kursister hvert år.

jobs.title: Vær med til at give vores studerende den bedste start
jobs.description:
SEA søger en studiesekretær til optag og betjening af receptionen

Receptionen er et naturligt omdrejningspunkt på uddannelsesstedet, og du får en bred kontaktflade til studerende, medarbejdere og gæster til huset. Du vil samtidig indgå i et team på 12 administrative medarbejdere, hvor vi samarbejder tæt om at skabe en professionel, imødekommende og effektiv studieadministration.

Opgaver

Du får en varieret hverdag, hvor administrative opgaver inden for optag kombineres med en synlig og udadvendt rolle i receptionen. Dine opgaver vil blandt andet være:

  • Administration af optag, herunder behandling af ansøgninger og øvrige opgaver i forbindelse med optagelse af nye studerende

  • Arbejde i det studieadministrative system ESAS og andre IT-programmer

  • Bemanding af receptionen og modtagelse af studerende, medarbejdere og gæster til huset

  • Telefonisk og personlig vejledning samt hjælp til at finde den rette medarbejder eller information

  • Praktisk koordinering og understøttelse i forbindelse med møder, arrangementer, besøg og andre aktiviteter på uddannelsesstedet

  • At bidrage til, at receptionen fremstår indbydende og professionel.

Vi forventer, at du

  • Har en kontoruddannelse, akademisk uddannelse eller anden relevant uddannelse

  • Er fortrolig med skiftende IT-systemer og har gode IT-kundskaber

  • Er struktureret og kan bevare overblikket, når flere ting kræver din opmærksomhed

  • Er imødekommende og serviceminded og har et naturligt værtskab

  • Trives med mange daglige kontaktflader og har let ved at skabe gode relationer til studerende, kolleger og gæster

  • Er fleksibel og har lyst til at bidrage til møder, arrangementer og andre aktiviteter på uddannelsesstedet

  • Behersker dansk og engelsk i skrift og tale

  • Er omhyggelig, pålidelig og tager ansvar for dine opgaver

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt, men samtidig trives med at være en del af et team

AI som en del af vores hverdag

På SEA prioriterer vi brugen af AI i vores administrative arbejde. Vi bruger AI til at udvikle smartere arbejdsgange, styrke kvaliteten og frigive tid til de opgaver, hvor den personlige kontakt gør en forskel.

Vi forventer derfor, at du er nysgerrig på AI og har lyst til at lære, afprøve og anvende AI-værktøjer i dit arbejde. Du behøver ikke være ekspert – lysten til at lære og udforske mulighederne er det vigtigste.

Vi tilbyder

En videregående uddannelsesinstitution med praksisnære uddannelser i Esbjerg, Sønderborg, Tønder og online. Som en del af SEA bliver du en del af en arbejdsplads, hvor vi hver dag arbejder tæt på både studerende, undervisere og kolleger, og hvor samarbejde på tværs er en naturlig del af hverdagen.

Vi er en organisation i udvikling med et uformelt arbejdsmiljø, hvor vi lægger vægt på samarbejde, medansvar og lysten til at bidrage. Du får mulighed for at bringe dine idéer i spil og være med til at udvikle både vores arbejdsgange og den service, vi giver studerende, medarbejdere og gæster.

Hos os får du en varieret hverdag med mange forskellige mennesker og kontaktflader – og en arbejdsplads, hvor der er plads til engagement, initiativ og nye idéer.

Ansættelsesvilkår og tiltrædelse

Stillingen er en fast stilling på 31 timer om ugen med tiltrædelse 1. november 2026.

Du ansættes iht. Cirkulære af 14. maj 2025 om organisationsaftale for kontorfunktionærer, laboranter og It-medarbejdere mellem Finansministeriet og HK-Stat med virkning fra 1. april 2024 (Medst.nr. 087-25).

Alle interesserede med de nødvendige kvalifikationer opfordres til at søge uanset alder, køn, race, religion eller etnisk tilhørsforhold. Ansættelse er betinget af, at der foreligger tilfredsstillende straffeattest ved indgåelse af ansættelseskontrakt.

jobs.title: Hub Digital Technical Engineer
jobs.description:
The opportunity

Are you passionate about transformer technology, digitalization, and helping organizations unlock the value of intelligent monitoring solutions?

The Hub Digital Technical Engineer will be part of a team intended to provide senior expertise in our Digital Transformer Monitoring portfolio to the Hub in the fields of engineering, systems configuration, and technical requirements analysis. This role involves troubleshooting, supporting internal and external customers within the Hub, and acting as the vital technical link between customers and R&D.

This is a highly collaborative and international role where you will combine technical expertise, customer focus, and knowledge-sharing to support digital transformation initiatives across multiple countries and production units.

How you’ll make an impact

    Execute and deploy the global Digital Transformer Monitoring portfolio across the EUC HUB, ensuring consistent implementation and operational adoption.
    Support the integration of digital transformer monitoring solutions while adapting deployments to local standards and requirements.
    Provide Level 2 technical support for digital products, troubleshooting issues and recommending optimal technical solutions.
    Deliver technical training to engineering, manufacturing, and service teams, enabling greater self-sufficiency across HUB units.
    Share market insights, regional requirements, industry standards, and technology trends with product management and R&D teams.
    Support customer projects, pilot implementations, technical proposals, and detailed workshops focused on digital transformer strategies.
    Identify, track, and drive improvement opportunities based on field experience and customer feedback, supporting cost reduction and process optimization.
    Collaborate with Digital Technical Champions and Digital Technical Centers across different HUBs to exchange knowledge and continuously improve implementation practices.
    Contribute to the development and adoption of best practices for transformer monitoring technologies throughout the organization.

Your background

    Degree in Electrical Engineering, Automation Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent proven practical experience, with at least 2 years of experience in transformer engineering, control design, commissioning, or a similar technical role.
    Strong knowledge of transformer monitoring solutions, including DGA, bushing monitoring, partial discharge monitoring, TMS, alarm annunciators, oil dryers, and eDevices.
    Good understanding of transformer technologies (types, characteristics, main components, behavior, diagnostic methods, common issues), diagnostics, and industry standards such as IEC 60076-7; knowledge of IEEE C57.91 is an advantage.
    Ability to interpret and verify electrical control schematics, with basic knowledge of PLCs and software programming.
    Experience with commissioning and deployment of monitoring systems is considered an asset.
    Fluent in technical English, with strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively in international and multicultural environments.
    Proactive and collaborative team player with the ability to train, support, and coordinate colleagues across multiple locations.
    International experience and familiarity with AI tools for scripting, research, or data analysis are advantageous.

More about us

We believe great work thrives in an environment where people feel genuinely supported and fairly rewarded. Our benefits are designed to create real value for every individual – fueling engagement, performance, and growth. By prioritizing well‑being, we build a workplace where personal and organizational success grow together.​

Our benefits offering for our roles generally includes: ​

    Group life insurance and additional insurances.​
    Flex-time and shortening of working hours in time bank​
    Hybrid work & allowances for setting up a workplace at home (in agreement with line manager)​
    Health care and wellness allowance​
    Health insurance incl. dental, spectacles & contact lenses allowance (employee pay 140 sek/month via salary deduction)​
    Psychological support program​​
    Supplementary compensation for parental leave​
    Various trainings and education supporting employee development ​
    Internal career possibilities both within Sweden and globally​
    Employee Benefit Portal with thousands of discounts and perks​

The benefits listed above are an excerpt only and may vary depending on job grade, location and contract type. Eligibility is subject to local regulations.​

jobs.title: Sanitør til løsøre | Hjælp os med at passe på det, der betyder noget
jobs.description:
Det er ikke bare ting

Når en kunde bliver ramt af brand, vand eller en anden skade, kan hjemmets eller virksomhedens indbo også blive berørt.

Møbler, billeder, bøger, tøj og personlige ejendele kan ved første øjekast ligne almindelige ting – men for kunden kan de have stor både praktisk og personlig værdi.

Derfor kræver arbejdet med løsøre noget særligt.

Hos Ocab søger vi nu en sanitør, som har lyst til at arbejde med håndtering, rengøring og behandling af kundernes indbo og løsøre – både ude hos kunderne og på vores vaskelinje.

Om jobbet

Som sanitør til løsøre følger du kundens ejendele gennem forskellige dele af processen.

Det kan begynde ude på et skadested, hvor indbo skal sorteres, registreres, pakkes og transporteres. Andre dage arbejder du på vores vaskelinje med rengøring og behandling af løsøre, så mest muligt kan reddes og leveres tilbage til kunden.

Det kræver ikke bare praktisk sans. Det kræver også, at du arbejder systematisk, omhyggeligt og respektfuldt med de ting, du får mellem hænderne.

Dine arbejdsopgaver kan blandt andet være

  • Håndtering af indbo og løsøre efter brand-, vand- og andre skader

  • Sortering og registrering af kundernes ejendele

  • Pakning, mærkning og klargøring til transport og opbevaring

  • Rengøring og behandling af løsøre

  • Arbejde på vores vaskelinje

  • Flytning og håndtering af møbler og øvrigt indbo

  • Arbejde ude hos kunder i forbindelse med skadesager

  • Dokumentation af det udførte arbejde

  • Samarbejde med kolleger og projektledere gennem hele forløbet

Vi forestiller os, at du

Til denne stilling leder vi først og fremmest efter en person, der kan lide at gøre tingene grundigt og ordentligt.

Du forstår, at du arbejder med andre menneskers ejendele, og du behandler dem med den samme omhu, som du selv ville ønske.

Vi ser gerne, at du:

  • Er omhyggelig og detaljeorienteret

  • Arbejder struktureret og har styr på de ting, du håndterer

  • Har lyst til både praktisk arbejde og mere systematiske opgaver

  • Trives med at arbejde på vores vaskelinje såvel som ude hos kunderne

  • Er i god fysisk form, da flytning og håndtering af indbo kan være en del af arbejdsdagen

  • Arbejder selvstændigt og tager ansvar for dine opgaver

  • Trives med samarbejde og bidrager positivt til teamet

  • Møder kunderne ordentligt og med forståelse for den situation, de står i

  • Taler og forstår dansk

  • Har kørekort (kategori B)

Erfaring fra skadeservice, rengøring, flyttebranchen, lager eller lignende praktisk arbejde kan være en fordel, men det vigtigste er din tilgang til arbejdet og din lyst til at lære.

Det er en forudsætning, at du kan fremvise en straffeattest.

Hvem er Ocab?

Ocab er en af Nordens førende virksomheder inden for skadeservice og industriservice. Vi hjælper hvert år tusindvis af kunder efter blandt andet brand-, vand- og klimaskader. Hos Ocab bliver du en del af en virksomhed med høj faglighed og engagerede kolleger. Vi tror på, at de bedste resultater skabes gennem samarbejde, ordentlighed og en stærk holdånd.

Vi tilbyder

  • En varieret hverdag med både arbejde på vores vaskelinje og ude hos kunderne

  • Grundig oplæring og gode muligheder for faglig udvikling

  • Et arbejde, hvor omhu og kvalitet gør en reel forskel

  • Dygtige og hjælpsomme kolleger

  • 37 timers arbejdsuge

  • Ingen obligatorisk deltagelse i vagtordningen

Nogle dage følger planen. Andre dage gør den ikke. Det er en del af jobbet – og derfor skal du kunne bevare overblikket og være klar til at træde til, når der er brug for dig.


Om jobbet

Som sanitør hos Ocab arbejder du med mange forskellige typer skadeserviceopgaver hos både private, virksomheder og professionelle kunder.

Det er et praktisk og fysisk job. Du kan blandt andet komme til at flytte og håndtere kundernes indbo og løsøre, arbejde med nedrivning og sanering samt løse industriopgaver og opgaver i højden.

Du arbejder både selvstændigt og sammen med kolleger og projektledere. Uanset opgaven er målet det samme: at levere et professionelt stykke arbejde og møde kunden ordentligt i en situation, der ofte er både uventet og vanskelig.

  • Skimmelsanering

  • Industriopgaver

  • Dokumentation af opgaver fra start til slut

  • Tæt samarbejde med kolleger og projektledere

  • Har asbestbevis eller erfaring med asbestsanering – en fordel, men ikke et krav

  • Er i god fysisk form og trives med et aktivt arbejde, hvor løft og flytning kan være en del af arbejdsdagen

Hvem er Ocab?

Ocab er en af Nordens førende virksomheder inden for skadeservice og industriservice. Vi hjælper hvert år tusindvis af kunder efter blandt andet brand-, vand- og klimaskader.

Hos Ocab bliver du en del af en virksomhed med høj faglighed og engagerede kolleger. Vi tror på, at de bedste resultater skabes gennem samarbejde, ordentlighed og en stærk holdånd.

jobs.title: Junior Payroll Assistant
jobs.description:
Through proprietary software and AI, along with a focus on customer delight, Sleek makes the back-office easy for micro SMEs.

We give Entrepreneurs time back to focus on what they love doing - growing their business and being with customers. With a surging number of Entrepreneurs globally, we are innovating in a highly lucrative space.

We operate across 3 business segments:

Corporate Secretary: Automating the company incorporation, secretarial, filing, Nominee Director, mailroom and immigration processes via custom online robots and SleekSign. We are the market leaders in Singapore with ~5% market share of all new business incorporations

Accounting & Bookkeeping: Redefining what it means to do Accounting, Bookkeeping, Tax and Payroll thanks to our proprietary SleekBooks ledger, AI tools and exceptional customer service

FinTech payments: Overcoming a key challenge for Entrepreneurs by offering digital banking services to new businesses

Sleek launched in 2017 and now has around 17,500 customers across our offices in Singapore, Hong Kong, Australia and the UK. We have around 600 staff with an intact startup mindset. We have recently raised Series B financing off the back of >70% compound annual growth in Revenue over the last 5 years. Sleek has been recognised by The Financial Times, The Straits Times, Forbes and LinkedIn as one of the fastest growing companies in Asia. Backed by world-class investors, we are on track to be one of the few cash flow positive, tech-enabled unicorns based out of Asia Pacific.

Mission of the role

To ensure the accurate, timely, and compliant processing of payroll for multiple UK clients. The UK Payroll Executive will be responsible for managing payroll data, processing payroll transactions, supporting workplace pension auto-enrolment, responding to client queries, and ensuring all payroll activities are completed in line with UK labour laws, HMRC requirements, tax regulations, and agreed client timelines.

The role requires strong attention to detail, client service, ownership, and the ability to manage multiple payrolls and deadlines efficiently while continuously looking for ways to improve workflows through technology, AI, and automation.

Key outcomes In the first 6â12 monthsOutcome 1: UK Payroll Knowledge & Process Proficiency

Develop a strong foundational understanding of UK payroll regulations and processes and confidently apply the appropriate rules when preparing and processing client payrolls.

Become fully familiar with Sleek's internal payroll platforms and processes, including HMRC submissions such as RTI, FPS and EPS, workplace pension submissions, and year-end reporting requirements including P60s and P11Ds by the third month.

Outcome 2: Accurate & Compliant Payroll Processing

Process assigned client payrolls accurately and within agreed timelines, ensuring all payroll data is complete and correctly validated before submission.

Ensure 100% compliance with agreed payroll and statutory deadlines, including payroll runs, pension auto-enrolment submissions, and applicable HMRC requirements.

Identify discrepancies or potential issues early, take ownership of resolving them, and maintain high standards of confidentiality and data accuracy.

Outcome 3: Client Service & Responsiveness

Maintain a high level of client satisfaction by providing prompt, accurate, and professional responses to payroll-related queries.

Consistently achieve a CSAT target of at least 97% month-on-month while ensuring that client queries and emails are responded to within the agreed communication SLA, with no non-reply tickets or emails left unresolved at the end of the working day.

Build trusted relationships with clients by providing clear updates, proactively following up on outstanding information, and handling difficult conversations positively when required.

Outcome 4: Team Collaboration & Process Improvement

Work effectively with the UK Payroll team and other internal departments to ensure smooth payroll operations and timely resolution of client or processing issues.

Contribute to improving payroll processes and operational efficiency by identifying opportunities to use AI, automation, payroll technology, and improved workflows to reduce manual work, improve accuracy, and increase turnaround times.

Must-have experience

  • Minimum 1â2 years of hands-on UK payroll processing experience.
  • Experience working in a bureau, outsourced payroll environment, or shared services centre is preferred.
  • Experience managing multiple client payroll accounts is an advantage.
  • Working knowledge of UK payroll processes, HMRC requirements, tax regulations, and workplace pension processes.
  • Experience with payroll software such as BrightPay, Xero Payroll, or similar is an advantage.
  • Strong attention to detail and experience working with sensitive and confidential financial information.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple priorities and meet strict deadlines.
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Comfortable working with data and payroll-related reporting and metrics.
  • Practical experience or strong interest in using AI tools, automation, and IT applications to improve daily workflows.

Must-have attributes

Ownership & Accountability: Takes full responsibility for assigned payrolls and client accounts, follows through on tasks without constant supervision, and proactively resolves issues or roadblocks.

Humility: Open to feedback, willing to learn, and comfortable acknowledging knowledge gaps and seeking support when required.

Structured Thinking: Able to organise multiple client payrolls, deadlines, queries, and tasks in a clear and logical manner, while using sound judgement to prioritise competing requirements.

Data Driven & Attention to Detail: Comfortable working with numbers and payroll data, with a strong focus on accuracy. Able to identify discrepancies, missing information, or inconsistencies before they impact payroll processing or clients.

Can Have Tough Conversations in a Positive Way: Able to communicate clearly and professionally when dealing with sensitive payroll issues, missing information, delays, or difficult client situations while maintaining a constructive client relationship.

AI & Tech Savvy: Energetic about adopting new software, AI tools, automation, and technology to make payroll processes more efficient and effective.

Behavioural fit is also important at Sleek, and we will be looking for candidates that have a proven track record of embodying the below attributes in their recent roles:

We will be looking for candidates who have a proven track record of embodying the below attributes in their recent roles:

Ownership: This shows reliability and helps build trust within the team. We move fast and need to know that everyone will see things through to completion and proactively help to get things back on track when challenges arise. Accountability is really important to us.

Humility: There is so much we don't know. Humility allows for open-mindedness to feedback and a willingness to learn from others. It paves the way for collaboration and creates a positive work environment. It is a key ingredient of self-awareness and emotional intelligence.

Structured Thinking: Our business is complex with many layers (many services, many countries, many cultures). Regardless of whether you're more analytical or creative in nature, being able to show sound judgement is important to us. It ensures solutions are pragmatic and balance the needs of the organisation, team and customers.

Attention to detail: You'll be managing multiple client payrolls, deadlines, queries, and workstreams. It will be important for you to keep track of everything and notice when information is missing, inconsistent, or likely to cause an issue.

Excellent listener and clear communicator: We have a variety of nationalities and for many people, English isn't their first language. For you to excel, you'll need to be present in your calls and make sure you properly receive and thoughtfully send messages to others in the business.

The interview process

The successful candidate will participate in the following interview stages. We anticipate the process to last no more than 3 weeks from start to finish.

TA Screen / One-way Video Interview: Shortlisted candidates will be invited to complete a one-way video interview to assess spoken and written communication, relevant UK payroll experience, motivation, and initial background.

Technical Round: A 30-minute interview and practical assessment with the Hiring Team to assess UK payroll knowledge, payroll processing experience, attention to detail, ability to work with payroll data, and understanding of UK payroll processes and deadlines.

Soft Skills Round: A 30-minute chat with a member of the leadership team to evaluate real-world work scenarios against our core behavioural values, including ownership, humility, structured thinking, communication, and ability to handle challenging situations.

Reference Verification: Prior to final offer confirmation, we will conduct one professional reference check with your recent direct manager or supervisor. To keep the process moving smoothly, this step may be initiated during the final interview stages.

Requirement for background screening

Please be aware that Sleek is a regulated entity and as such is required to perform different levels of background checks on staff depending on their role. This may include using external vendors to verify:

  • Your education
  • Any criminal history
  • Any political exposure
  • Any bankruptcy or adverse credit history

We will ask for your consent before conducting these checks. Depending on your role at Sleek, an adverse result on one of these checks may prohibit you from passing probation.

By submitting a job application, you confirm that you have read and agree to our Data Privacy Statement for Candidates, found at Sleek.com.

Some other great things about working at Sleekâ¦

Humility and kindness: Humility is a core attribute we hire for, which means we have a culture of not taking ourselves too seriously and being able to laugh. Kindness is also incredibly important. We are committed to creating and nurturing a diverse and inclusive environment.Â 

Flexibility: Youâll be able to work remotely. If you need to start early or start late to cater to your family or other needs, we donât mind, so long as you get your work done and proactively communicate. You can also work fully remote from anywhere in the world for 1 month each year

Financial benefits: We pay competitive market salaries and provide staff with generous paid time off and holiday schedules. Certain staff at Sleek are also eligible for our employee share ownership plan and can share in the upside of our stellar growth trajectory as we work toward listing on a prominent stock exchange in the Asia Pacific region.

Personal growth: Youâll get a lot of responsibility and autonomy at Sleek - we move at a fast pace so youâll be making decisions, making mistakes and learning. Thereâs also a range of internal and external facing training programmes we run. Weâre also at the forefront of utilising AI in our space and are developing a regional centre of AI excellence. It is our intention that if you leave Sleek, you leave as a more well-rounded person and professional.

Sleek is also a proudly certified B Corp. Â Since we started our journey in 2017, weâve been committed to building Sleek as a force for good. In just over 5 years, weâve joined a community of industry leaders like Patagonia, Ben & Jerry's, and P&G who are building an inclusive, equitable, and a regenerative economy.

jobs.description:
About PFM
Prop Firm Match Global FZCO is a leading platform for discovering, comparing, and selecting top proprietary trading firms. We provide traders with tools and features to easily compare challenge details, read verified reviews, see accurate payout data, and much more. We're a fast-moving, fully remote team with members from all around the world caring deeply about the quality of what we build. Our culture values ownership, clear communication, and practical impact over fluff.

About the department
Customer Experience is the front line of PFM. We're the team traders turn to when something isn't working, when they need clarity on a firm, a promotion, or their loyalty rewards, or when a payout question needs a real answer. We work across Intercom, Discord, and email to keep response times fast without losing quality and every ticket we close well is a small deposit in the trust traders place in PFM and in the firms we work with.

About the role
Deliver timely, accurate, and empathetic support that enables traders to confidently use Prop Firm Match while maintaining trust with both customers and partner firms. This role ensures every customer interaction contributes to a positive experience and protects the reputation of PFM.

Success looks like
Customers receive consistent and up-to-date information regarding firms, promotions, loyalty rewards, and platform features.

Objective 4 -Â  Support continuous improvement

Typical tasks:

  • Report bugs and flag recurring issues to Product and Development.
  • Suggest workflow improvements based on patterns you notice.
  • Contribute to knowledge base updates and AI training data.

Success looks like
Customer feedback drives product and process improvements.


What we look for

Must have

  • Minimum 2 years of customer support or other client-facing experience, ideally in a remote, high-volume environment.
  • Strong written communication: able to explain things clearly and empathetically to non-technical customers.
  • Hands-on experience with Intercom or a similar helpdesk/ticketing platform.
  • High attention to detail: comfortable verifying specifics (promo codes, payout terms, policy language) before responding.
  • Strong time management, with the discipline to hit response-time and handling-time targets without cutting corners on quality.
  • Comfortable investigating and troubleshooting an issue independently before escalating it.
  • Professional, accountable, and collaborative: works well across teams without needing heavy oversight.
  • Available to work CET-aligned hours in a fully remote, async-first environment.

Nice to have

  • Familiarity with proprietary trading firms or the prop trading industry.
  • Experience using AI-assisted support tools (e.g., Intercom Fin AI or similar) -Â  kept here as a nice-to-have rather than dropped entirely, since it's still worth listing as a plus.
  • Experience managing or responding to public reviews (e.g., Trustpilot).
  • Background in fintech, SaaS, or another fast-paced digital consumer platform.

Compensation

Location & work setup

  • Â Remote, worldwide, with strong overlap with CET hours.
  • Â Employment type: Full-time.

Hiring stages
We keep our process simple, transparent, and respectful of your time. Here's what to expect:

  • Application screening
    We carefully review all applications to identify candidates whose background aligns with the role's requirements. You'll receive a timely and transparent update on your application status.
  • Video intro + role fit questionnaire
    A short async step -Â  no scheduling required. You'll record a brief video introduction and complete a written questionnaire, helping us understand your background and fit without either side committing to a live call upfront.
  • Discovery HR Interview
    A conversation with our HR team focused on company and culture match -Â  how PFM works, what remote ownership looks like day to day, and what success in this role looks like.
  • Real-world task
    A short, scoped exercise based on real PFM support scenarios, giving both sides a realistic view of the work before committing further.
  • Professional interview
    A conversation with the Head of Customer Experience focused on your support experience, problem-solving approach, and how you handle real user situations -Â  including firm-comparison neutrality and integrity judgment calls.
  • Peer & values conversation
    A conversation with a peer from across the team focused on values, culture, and how you work best. You'll have plenty of space to ask questions and get a real feel for life at PFM.

    • If there's a strong mutual match, we start with an informal conversation to align on expectations, then follow up with a formal written offer. Full transparency throughout, and time for you to make an informed decision.
    To keep things fully transparent and mutually fair, we complete a reference check before the formal offer is extended. No surprises - just part of how we make careful, informed decisions on both sides.

    â¸Â  Even if itâs not listed as a formal requirement, we truly value candidates who have clear familiarity with the prop trading industry and us, our mission and what we do.

    Not the right fit for this role?
    If this role isnât the right match but you have experience in trading operations, customer success, compliance, support, partnerships, or a related area - we still want to hear from you. jobs.description:
Legal Counsel - FTC (f/m/d)

Location: Luxembourg, LU

Your area of work:

We are looking for a Senior Legal Counsel to join our Corporate & Commercial Legal team on a fixed-term contract from 1 January 2027 to 31 December 2027.
Clearstream is a leading provider of post-trade services for the global securities and investment funds industry. As part of the Group Legal department, which operates across six jurisdictions, you will provide legal support to Clearstream Group entities in Luxembourg and abroad, with a particular focus on corporate law and corporate governance matters. Acting as a trusted business partner, you will advise senior stakeholders and contribute to strategic projects in a dynamic and highly regulated financial services environment.

Your responsibilities:

• Provide legal advice on corporate law and corporate governance matters to Clearstream Group entities in Luxembourg and internationally.
• Support boards of directors and senior management on legal and governance-related topics.
• Advise on regulatory matters and interactions with financial market authorities.
• Contribute to business initiatives, strategic projects and M&A transactions.
• Support the implementation of new legal and regulatory requirements.
• Draft, review and negotiate legal documentation and corporate resolutions.
• Collaborate closely with business, compliance, risk and other internal stakeholders.
• Select, instruct and oversee external legal counsel where required.

Your profile:

• Master's degree in Law (or equivalent) and qualification to practise law in a European jurisdiction.
• Minimum 8 years of professional experience in a law firm and/or in-house legal department.
• Strong expertise in Luxembourg corporate law and corporate governance.
• Good understanding of Luxembourg regulatory requirements applicable to financial institutions.
• Knowledge of civil, commercial, banking and securities law would be an advantage.
• Experience in securities services, capital markets or investment services is considered an asset.
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to interact confidently with senior decision-makers.
• Fluent in English; French and/or German would be an advantage.

jobs.title: Business Intelligence Engineer, SCOT - Automated Inventory Management (m/f)
jobs.description:
Description:

Business Intelligence Engineer, SCOT - Automated Inventory Management
Job ID: 10529667 | Amazon Europe Core Sarl

Description

The Supply Chain Optimization Technologies (SCOT) organization owns Amazon's global inventory management systems: we decide what, when, where, and how much we should buy to meet Amazon's business goals and to make our customers happy. We do this for millions of items, for hundreds of product lines worth billions of dollars of inventory world-wide. We foster new game-changing ideas, creating ever more intelligent and self-learning systems to maximize the efficiency of Amazon's inventory investment and placement decisions.
The Automated Inventory Management team within SCOT seeks an experienced and motivated Business Intelligence Engineer to develop analytical models and tools to automate the auditing of the SCOT systems. Such tools may include algorithms, metric bridges, dashboards, processes and workflow systems.

The successful candidate will have strong quantitative data mining and modeling skills and be comfortable working on new and sometimes ambiguous problems from concept through to execution. They will have strong communication and leadership skills, will be able to collaborate with other teams (e.g. software development, business owners, product managers) and to present findings to senior audiences to drive business improvements. As well we expect this candidate to raise the bar on any of the following categories: Data Warehousing, Data Architecture, Performant Self Service Toolsets and Data analytics. Candidate might be willing to work with the others BIEs in order to solve organizational problems at scale and setting the grounds of a healthy data products offer while delivering what is required by business.

Key job responsibilities

• Performing complex analysis to understand the behavior of automated inventory management systems, identify the root cause of system / process issues and provide insight on potential solutions.
• Building audits (analytical products) to identify trend breaks or defects at scale for millions of products and multiple Marketplaces globally
• Assessing the end-to-end suite of audits and identifying opportunities for enhancements and simplification, working with other audit owners
• Creating new solutions to automate the business process of identifying and resolving defects (e.g. through metric dashboards and automated alarms, self service dashboard, Single source of truth tables... )
• Supporting the improvement of the automated audit workflow system: integrating new audits and providing input on the future developments/roadmap
• Developing dashboards and insight products
• Fostering culture of continuous engineering improvement through blueprints, mentoring, feedback, and metrics

Basic Qualifications

• Experience in analyzing and interpreting data with Redshift, Oracle, NoSQL etc.
• Experience with data visualization using Tableau, Quicksight, or similar tools
• Experience with one or more industry analytics visualization tools (e.g. Excel, Tableau, QuickSight, MicroStrategy, PowerBI) and statistical methods (e.g. t-test, Chi-squared)
• Experience with scripting language (e.g., Python, Java, or R)
• Experience with SQL
• Experience in the data/BI space

Preferred Qualifications

• Master's degree, or Advanced technical degree
• Knowledge of data modeling and data pipeline design
• Experience with statistical analysis, co-relation analysis

jobs.title: Senior Financial Analyst, EU Operations FP&A (m/f)
jobs.description:
Description:

Senior Financial Analyst, EU Operations FP&A
Job ID: 10528196 | Amazon EU Sarl

Description

The right financial and business decisions have made Amazon what it is today. As a Senior Financial Analyst, you'll help us optimize our finances so that we can enhance our customer experience even more and navigate the fast-changing business environment. This role is an opportunity to act as the key finance leader and get really involved with shaping our business. You'll influence others and use insights to show senior stakeholders ways that we can move forward with our business ambitions.

Key job responsibilities

• Build financial models to drive business decisions and make judgement calls on challenges using your understanding of Amazon's cost structure
• Lead projects by overseeing timelines, priorities, auditing quality and resolving issues
• Generate insights from financial data, identify opportunities for greater efficiency, and communicate findings with the leadership team to drive business actions
• Own the financial reporting, create scalable processes and monitor teams for accuracy
• Onboard, develop and mentor team members in areas of financial reporting for accuracy, create best practice materials and promote knowledge sharing

A day in the life

Your typical day involves consolidating weekly or monthly financials for Cost-to-Serve initiatives, connecting with initiative owners to gather updates and validate data accuracy. You'll prepare insightful analyses for Management Business Reviews (MBRs) and Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs), focusing on trends and performance metrics. A significant portion of your time is dedicated to leading Quadrant reporting for Cost-to-Serve, requiring close partnership with Operations teams to ensure alignment and accurate representation of financial impacts.

About the team

Our team uniquely bridges Operations Finance and Stores organizations, owning Cost-to-Serve strategies and cost allocations that span multiple business units. We are the only team within Operations Finance that creates this valuable connection between these two critical organizations.
Our mission centers on providing financial clarity, driving cost efficiency, and enabling data-driven decision making across the business. We take pride in our ability to influence strategic decisions through robust financial analysis and cross-functional partnerships. By joining our team, you'll have the opportunity to make a significant impact while gaining exposure to multiple aspects of the business.

Basic Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree or above
• Experience in a finance role leading a project or program and partnering with multiple stakeholders within a business
• Experience working with Excel, reporting tools, and large-scale data mining tools, such as Power BI, Python, SQL, or Tableau
• Experience in financial modeling

Preferred Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Finance, Mathematics, or Economics
• Experience troubleshooting problems and offering solutions to streamline complex challenges
• Experience working in a large team or fast-paced corporate environment
• Experience making strategic business decisions and managing internal relationships
