jobs.title: Serviceleder søges til Palmgren
jobs.description:
Serviceleder søges til Palmgren Erhvervsrengøring

Palmgren Erhvervsrengøring er i vækst, og derfor søger vi en engageret og struktureret serviceleder til vores aktiviteter i Jylland.

Som serviceleder får du ansvar for den daglige drift på en række af vores kunder og bliver et vigtigt bindeled mellem kunder, medarbejdere og administration. Stillingen vil udvikle sig i takt med vores vækst, og du får mulighed for at være med til at opbygge dit eget team samt udvikle og koordinere blandt andet vores flyverteam.

Dine primære opgaver vil være:

  • Daglig kontakt med medarbejdere og kunder

  • Kvalitetskontrol og opfølgning

  • Oplæring og instruktion af medarbejdere

  • Planlægning og koordinering ved sygdom, ferie og ændringer

  • Opstart af nye kunder og medarbejdere

  • Opbygning og udvikling af eget team

  • Koordinering af flyverteam og øvrige driftsopgaver

  • Sikring af at aftaler, rengøringsplaner og kvalitetskrav bliver fulgt

Vi søger dig, der er ansvarsbevidst, løsningsorienteret og god til mennesker. Du skal kunne arbejde selvstændigt, bevare overblikket i en travl hverdag og have lyst til at tage ansvar i en virksomhed, hvor der sker meget.

Erfaring fra rengøringsbranchen eller serviceledelse er en fordel, men det vigtigste er, at du har den rette indstilling, er handlekraftig og trives med ansvar.

Vi tilbyder:

  • Firmabil

  • Pension

  • Løn efter kvalifikationer

  • En selvstændig og varieret hverdag

  • Mulighed for at opbygge og udvikle dit eget team

  • Spændende udfordringer i en virksomhed i vækst

  • Stor kontaktflade til både kunder og medarbejdere

  • Gode muligheder for ansvar og indflydelse på den daglige drift

Palmgren Erhvervsrengøring har kontorer i Odense, København og Aarhus og løser opgaver for erhvervskunder på tværs af landet. Dit arbejdsområde vil være Jylland

Send din ansøgning og CV – vi afholder samtaler løbende.

jobs.title: Technical Product Lead AI Finance App
jobs.description:
About KIRA

Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.

Â 

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Â 

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

KIRA is building a AI Finance Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

Â 

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

Â 

The Technical Product Lead owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

Â 

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

Â 

What You'll Own

  • Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

  • Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

  • Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

  • Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

  • Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

  • Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

  • Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

    Â 

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

  • Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

  • Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

  • Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

  • Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

  • Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

    Â 

Nice to have

  • Engineering or highly technical product background.

  • Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

  • Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

    Â 

Outcome

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

jobs.title: QA and Test Lead
jobs.description:
One of Nordic Investin’s partner companies is looking for a QA and Test Lead, with Nordic Investin leading the recruitment process. You can create a quality strategy that teams understand, own and use when delivery pressure rises.

The partner is delivering a complex platform change across several systems and suppliers. You will lead test planning, coordinate evidence and make sure critical user journeys are verified from component level through business acceptance.

The team works across disciplines and expects quality to be shaped throughout discovery and delivery. You will have space to challenge assumptions, make evidence visible and improve how decisions are made.

How you will work

You will join multidisciplinary delivery rather than operate as a final approval step. The partner expects early questions, rapid feedback and clear evidence about what users and systems need. You will help teams decide what to test, measure or prototype before committing to an expensive direction.

As a senior colleague, you will own substantial outcomes and help others make stronger decisions. You are expected to recognise risk early, communicate it without drama and move work forward with practical alternatives. The role still includes hands on delivery; seniority here means broader judgement, not distance from the work.

What you will do

    

Define the overall test strategy and risk based scope.

    

Connect requirements and use cases with verifiable test coverage.

    

Coordinate environments, data, teams and external dependencies.

    

Lead defect triage and readiness reporting.

    

Guide automation priorities and non functional testing.

    

Communicate quality risk clearly to project and business leadership.

What you will bring

    

Extensive test leadership in complex technology programmes.

    

Strong requirements, integration and acceptance testing experience.

    

Ability to plan across several teams and release stages.

    

Evidence based reporting and defect management.

    

Understanding of test automation and modern delivery methods.

    

Professional English; Swedish may be required for public partners.

Experience that would add value

    

Procurement or implementation of a major business system.

    

Performance, security or resilience test coordination.

    

Experience in healthcare, government or another regulated domain.

A background that can succeed here

You may come from hands on testing, business analysis or programme quality management. The partner needs someone who can discuss detail with engineers and provide a concise risk view to decision makers.

What makes the opportunity interesting

This role gives you a central position in a consequential change programme. You will shape how quality is demonstrated and help the organisation make release decisions based on evidence rather than optimism.

The exact partner, employment model, compensation, start date and working arrangement will be explained openly during the process. Nordic Investin will make sure you understand the context, expectations and decision path before you are asked to commit significant time.

The recruitment conversation

During the process, Nordic Investin will focus on concrete decisions you have made: the context you received, the alternatives you considered, the result you observed and what you would change today. You do not need every optional technology if your core experience transfers and you can explain how you would close the gap.

How to apply

Apply with your CV or LinkedIn profile and a short note describing the most relevant system, product or transformation you have helped deliver. Nordic Investin welcomes candidates with different routes into technology and assesses applicants on relevant capability, judgement and potential.

jobs.title: IT Service Delivery Manager
jobs.description:
Nordic Investin is recruiting an IT Service Delivery Manager on behalf of one of our partner companies. You know that dependable IT service comes from clear ownership, capable teams and honest performance data.

The partner needs a service delivery leader for business critical workplace and infrastructure services. You will manage performance, suppliers and continual improvement while keeping the experience of employees and business teams visible.

The work spans organisational boundaries and requires both technical understanding and disciplined communication. Decisions must remain useful when they reach delivery teams, suppliers and operational owners.

How you will work

You will work across teams with different incentives, technical histories and decision rights. The partner expects concise preparation, visible dependencies and follow through after meetings. Strong performance means that people understand what was decided, why it matters and what they now own.

As a senior colleague, you will own substantial outcomes and help others make stronger decisions. You are expected to recognise risk early, communicate it without drama and move work forward with practical alternatives. The role still includes hands on delivery; seniority here means broader judgement, not distance from the work.

What you will do

    

Own service performance, reviews and improvement plans.

    

Coordinate internal teams and external service providers.

    

Manage major incident communication and follow up.

    

Improve service levels, measures and operational reporting.

    

Oversee change, capacity, continuity and lifecycle risks.

    

Build trusted relationships with business service owners.

What you will bring

    

Senior IT service delivery or operations management experience.

    

Strong ITIL knowledge applied pragmatically.

    

Supplier, SLA and commercial management ability.

    

Experience leading major incident and problem management.

    

Clear reporting and stakeholder communication.

    

Professional English; Swedish may be required for local operations.

Experience that would add value

    

Workplace, network or cloud service responsibility.

    

Service transition after outsourcing or transformation.

    

Experience managing distributed or international delivery.

A background that can succeed here

You may have progressed through infrastructure operations, service management, supplier governance or technical support leadership. The partner values leaders who can discuss service evidence in detail and still keep attention on the people affected.

What makes the opportunity interesting

You will have the mandate to improve how services are run rather than only report their status. The role offers broad relationships, visible operational outcomes and meaningful influence over suppliers and future service design.

The exact partner, employment model, compensation, start date and working arrangement will be explained openly during the process. Nordic Investin will make sure you understand the context, expectations and decision path before you are asked to commit significant time.

During the process, Nordic Investin will focus on concrete decisions you have made: the context you received, the alternatives you considered, the result you observed and what you would change today. You do not need every optional technology if your core experience transfers and you can explain how you would close the gap.

jobs.title: Creative Director
jobs.description:
Agency-Based | Outdoor, Lifestyle & Active IndustriesPosition Overview

We are seeking an experienced, strategic, and highly collaborative Creative Director to lead the creative vision and execution of campaigns, content, and brand experiences for clients across the outdoor, lifestyle, wellness, fitness, sport, travel, and active industries.

This agency-based role will work across multiple client accounts, translating business objectives, audience insights, and brand positioning into compelling creative strategies and culturally relevant content. The Creative Director will lead projects from initial concept through production, delivery, and rollout, ensuring that every asset is strategically grounded, visually distinctive, operationally sound, and aligned with each client’s brand standards.

The ideal candidate is both a visionary creative leader and a strong operator—someone who can inspire teams, present and defend ideas, build trusted client relationships, and confidently manage the details required to deliver high-quality work across multiple channels and timelines.

Creative Leadership and Vision

Lead the conceptual, strategic, and visual direction of seasonal campaigns, evergreen content programs, product launches, brand initiatives, and ongoing client communications.

Establish and maintain a distinctive, consistent, and relevant visual identity for each client.

Influence the look, feel, tone, and overall creative expression of brand assets across regional, national, and global markets.

Translate strategic insights, marketing objectives, audience needs, and business goals into clear creative strategies and engaging content platforms.

Develop creative approaches that inspire, move, and connect with end users while authentically expressing each brand’s purpose, values, and point of view.

Set creative standards and provide direction across photography, video, graphic design, digital artwork, motion design, typography, copy integration, and branded experiences.

Stay current on emerging trends in culture, design, digital marketing, social media, technology, production, and the outdoor, lifestyle, and active industries.

Identify opportunities to evolve and strengthen client brands while maintaining consistency with established brand guidelines.

Concept Development:

Generate original ideas in response to creative briefs, strategic assignments, campaign objectives, and client needs.

Lead the development of creative concepts, campaign platforms, content series, product stories, and integrated brand experiences.

Create and oversee concept boards, mood boards, visual references, style guides, treatments, sketches, mockups, storyboards, and presentation materials.

Clearly communicate creative concepts, strategic rationale, intended audience impact, and production approach to clients and internal stakeholders.

Present, sell, and defend creative ideas with confidence, clarity, and sound strategic reasoning.

Develop custom content ideas and creative approaches for retail, ecommerce, wholesale, merchandising, sales, social, editorial, digital, and experiential channels.

Ensure creative ideas are scalable and adaptable across formats, markets, platforms, and stages of the customer journey.

Lead creative projects from concept development through pre-production, production, post-production, final delivery, and rollout.

Plan, strategize, and execute lifestyle and product photography and videography shoots.

Drive and direct global and regional campaign photo and video shoots, ensuring that the creative vision is consistently realized on set and through post-production.

Develop creative treatments, shot lists, storyboards, casting direction, location recommendations, styling direction, production schedules, and visual references.

Collaborate closely with photographers, directors, videographers, producers, stylists, set designers, editors, animators, retouchers, developers, and other production specialists.

Provide creative direction during casting, location scouting, pre-production meetings, shoots, editing sessions, color grading, retouching, sound design, animation, and final delivery.

Balance creative ambition with budget, schedule, logistics, production realities, client needs, and usage requirements.

Review and approve work at all stages to ensure quality, consistency, accuracy, and alignment with the approved creative direction.

Experience leading both in-house and external creative, production, and freelance teams.

As necessary, must be proficient shooting still imagery to lead or supplement campaigns, provide BTS imagery or conceptual imagery.

Team Leadership and Collaboration

Lead and manage in-house, freelance, outsourced, and partner creative teams across multiple client accounts.

Direct photographers, videographers, production teams, stylists, designers, developers, editors, agencies, and other external specialists.

Build and facilitate a highly motivated, collaborative, inclusive, and accountable creative environment.

Establish clear expectations, responsibilities, workflows, feedback processes, and quality standards for project teams.

Mentor and develop creative talent, supporting professional growth and encouraging new perspectives.

Assemble the right creative and production resources for each project based on scope, budget, timeline, and required expertise.

Manage contract and freelance production staff, including sourcing, briefing, scheduling, negotiating, onboarding, and evaluating external partners.

Foster strong relationships across creative, strategy, account management, production, marketing, digital, sales, merchandising, retail, and leadership teams.

Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to ensure creative work is strategically aligned and operationally effective.

jobs.title: DYGTIG HÅNDVÆRKER MED TØMRERBAGGRUND SØGES TIL EJENDOMSKONCERN
jobs.description:
DYGTIG HÅNDVÆRKER MED TØMRERBAGGRUND SØGES TIL EJENDOMSKONCERN

Er du en dygtig håndværker, der kan lide en alsidig arbejdsdag, hvor ikke to dage nødvendigvis er ens?

Vi søger en selvstændig og erfaren håndværker med tømrermæssig baggrund til vores ejendomskoncern.

Du bliver en del af vores interne drift og kommer til at arbejde på tværs af vores ejendomme med alt fra mindre reparationer til renoverings- og ombygningsopgaver.

Dine opgaver vil bl.a. være:
Tømrer- og snedkeropgaver
Renovering og istandsættelse af lejemål
Montering og justering af døre, låse, lister mv.
Opsætning af vægge, lofter og andre mindre byggeopgaver
Mindre maler- og vedligeholdelsesopgaver
Reparationer og løbende vedligeholdelse på vores ejendomme
Diverse praktiske ad hoc-opgaver

Vi leder efter dig, der har hænderne skruet rigtigt på, kan se hvad der skal gøres og ikke er bange for at tage fat – også når opgaven ligger lidt uden for det traditionelle tømrerfag.

Vi forestiller os, at du:
• Har en håndværksmæssig baggrund – gerne som tømrer
• Har erfaring med renovering og vedligeholdelse
• Kan arbejde selvstændigt og tage ansvar for dine opgaver
• Er løsningsorienteret og går op i at levere et ordentligt stykke arbejde
• Er fleksibel og trives med mange forskellige typer opgaver
• Har kørekort B

Til gengæld tilbyder vi:
• En alsidig stilling med stor frihed under ansvar
• En hverdag uden traditionelt byggepladsræs
• Arbejde på koncernens egne ejendomme
• Varierende opgaver og mulighed for selv at planlægge meget af arbejdsdagen
• Gode kolleger og en uformel omgangstone
• Løn efter kvalifikationer

Vi søger ikke nødvendigvis den, der har det flotteste CV – vi søger den, der kan sit håndværk, tager ansvar og får tingene gjort ordentligt.

Lyder det som noget for dig – eller kender du den helt rigtige?

Send os en kort ansøgning og lidt om din erfaring. Vi holder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette.

jobs.description:

Notre client recherche un/une Expert Flux / Business Analyst Support Applicatif (H/F) dans le cadre d'une mission freelance.

La mission s'inscrit au sein d'une équipe support en charge des flux (data marchés financiers) entre fournisseurs externes et applications internes.

L'intervention porte sur le maintien en conditions opérationnelles, la migration et la fiabilisation des flux, avec des enjeux techniques, d'architecture et de sécurité.

- Maintenir les flux existants en conditions opérationnelles ;

- Analyser et traiter les incidents et dysfonctionnements liés aux flux ;

- Contribuer aux migrations de flux vers de nouvelles solutions ;

- Réaliser ou adapter des shell scripts pour le traitement de fichiers et l'automatisation des traitements ;

- Assurer les échanges avec les équipes techniques, les providers et les équipes support ;

- Préparer et suivre les demandes d'ouverture de flux et la documentation associée ;

- Contribuer à la validation des schémas d'architecture et des dispositifs de sécurité ;

- Réaliser ponctuellement des activités de support applicatif ;

- Intervenir lors des mises à niveau des applications lorsque nécessaire ;

Participer aux astreintes et proposer des évolutions permettant de fiabiliser, simplifier ou optimiser l'existant.

Livrables :

- Documentation administrative et technique liée aux ouvertures de flux ;

- Scripts nécessaires au traitement des fichiers et à l'automatisation des traitements.

- Expérience en gestion et maintien en conditions opérationnelles de flux inter-applicatifs ;

- Expérience en support applicatif et traitement d'incidents liés aux flux ;

- Maîtrise opérationnelle des protocoles et technologies de flux SFTP, SSH, MQ, Webservices et NFS ;

- Expérience en scripting Shell et automatisation de traitements ;

- Bonne maîtrise des problématiques d'architecture et de sécurité des flux, notamment DMZ, Proxy et procédures d'ouverture de flux.

Compétences demandées dans la mission :

- Migration et fiabilisation de flux ;

- Sécurisation des échanges inter-applicatifs ;

- Traitement et automatisation des échanges de fichiers ;

- Documentation technique liée aux flux ;

- Continuité de service et maintenance de l'existant.

Astreintes régulières à prévoir et interventions ponctuelles lors des mises à niveau applicatives ;

Astreintes passives de nuit possible sur base volontariat

jobs.title: INGÉNIEUR DEVOPS / CLOUD H/F - CDI
jobs.description:

À propos de Neurones IT

Filiale du Groupe NEURONES, acteur majeur du conseil et des services numériques, Neurones IT accompagne ses clients dans leurs projets de transformation digitale, de modernisation des infrastructures et d'innovation technologique. Vos principales responsabilités :

*

   Concevoir, déployer et administrer des infrastructures Cloud.

*

   Automatiser les processus de déploiement et d'exploitation.

*

   Mettre en place et maintenir des pipelines CI/CD.

   Industrialiser les infrastructures grâce à l'Infrastructure as Code (IaC).

*

*

*

   Participer aux choix techniques et à l'évolution des architectures Cloud.

Le candidat devra maîtriser au moins l'un des principaux Cloud providers :

Azure / AWS / GCP

Une expérience sur plusieurs Cloud est un véritable plus.

Profil recherché :

*

*

   Vous avez une solide expérience sur Azure, AWS ou GCP.

*

   Vous maîtrisez les concepts d'automatisation et d'industrialisation.

*

   Vous avez déjà travaillé sur des environnements CI/CD.

*

   Vous maîtrisez idéalement Terraform et/ou Ansible.

*

   Vous avez une bonne compréhension des environnements Linux.

*

   Une expérience Kubernetes / Docker est appréciée.

*

   Vous êtes capable d'échanger avec des équipes techniques et de comprendre leurs problématiques.

jobs.title: Consultant Gouvernance Cyber - Cloud Security - Freelance (H/F)
jobs.description:
CONTEXTE

Le bénéficiaire souhaite une prestation d'accompagnement visant à renforcer les travaux de gouvernance cyber du Groupe, avec un focus principal sur les thématiques IT Continuity, Resilience, Backup & Restore et Cloud Security, ainsi que sur la formalisation d'exigences et de procédures cyber applicables aux entités du Groupe.

MISSIONS

*

   Rédaction, révision et structuration d'exigences cyber et de procédures Groupe, notamment sur les sujets IT Continuity, Resilience, Backup & Restore et Cloud Security

*

   Appui aux travaux Cloud Security, incluant l'interprétation et l'application des exigences de sécurité et de continuité dans les environnements cloud, en tenant compte des cloud types, des modèles de service IaaS/PaaS/CaaS/SaaS, du partage de responsabilités entre le Groupe et les Cloud Service Providers, ainsi que des enjeux de due diligence, de réversibilité et de conformité

*

   Appui à la gouvernance cyber : analyse des besoins, formalisation des livrables, préparation des supports de décision et suivi des actions avec les parties prenantes

*

   Animation et facilitation de workshops en anglais avec les entités et fonctions du Groupe, afin de cadrer les attendus, partager les livrables et recueillir les retours opérationnels

*

   Contribution à l'alignement des exigences avec les cadres de référence, les bonnes pratiques de continuité/résilience IT, de Cloud Security et les attentes de conformité applicables

CONDITIONS DE TRAVAIL

*

   Mission longue

*

   Anglais courant obligatoire, à l'oral comme à l'écrit, l'ensemble des workshops, échanges de cadrage et documents de travail étant principalement conduits en anglais

1.  Connaissances solides et expériences avérées sur IT Continuity et IT Resilience
2.  Maîtrise de Backup & Restore, incluant les principes de stratégie de sauvegarde, restauration, tests et exigences associées
3.  Expertise en Cloud Security, comprenant la compréhension des modèles cloud, des cloud types, des responsabilités partagées BNP Paribas / CSP, des exigences de sécurité applicables aux environnements cloud, ainsi que des enjeux de continuité, résilience, sauvegarde/restauration et réversibilité en contexte cloud
4.  Compétences en gouvernance cyber, y compris la rédaction d'exigences, de standards, de procédures et de livrables de cadrage
5.  Capacité à travailler avec des interlocuteurs cyber, IT, risques, production et entités métiers dans un environnement Groupe international
6.  Bonne compréhension des cadres de référence et bonnes pratiques cyber, sans nécessité d'être expert technique dans chaque domaine
7.  Expérience préalable dans la construction ou l'évolution de cadres de référence, procédures ou exigences cyber Groupe fortement souhaitée
8.  Expérience sur des procédures ou exigences Cloud Security, notamment autour de l'application des exigences cyber aux environnements IaaS, PaaS/CaaS et SaaS, particulièrement appréciée
9.  Rigueur, autonomie, bonne capacité de synthèse et aisance dans la coordination transverse
10. Anglais courant obligatoire, à l'oral comme à l'écrit

jobs.title: HR Operations Specialist
jobs.description:
Job Title: HR Operations SpecialistÂ 

Type: Independent ContractorÂ 

Location: Remote | South Africa

About Us

The Law Offices of Sabrina Li, P.C. is a leading, full-service U.S. immigration law firm with offices in Los Angeles, Pasadena, Santa Ana, and Dallas, as well as international operations across Asia, Africa, and Central and South America. We are dedicated to helping individuals, families, and businesses navigate complex legal challenges with skill, compassion, and integrity.

We are proud to be recognized as a 2025 Inc. Best Workplaces honoree, a distinction that reflects our intentional investment in our people and workplace culture. Our firm prioritizes professional development, clear career pathways, and a culture of accountability and respectâcreating a workplace where high performers can build meaningful, long-term careers.

The Opportunity

We are seeking a tech-savvy, proactive HR professional with excellent communication skills to support our HR team across recruitment, onboarding, compliance, and training. You'll work alongside firm leadership to keep day-to-day HR operations running smoothly and help identify smarter, more efficient ways to manage HR processes using AI and automation.

If you enjoy variety in your work, thrive on process and organization, adapt quickly to new tools, and want to grow with a firm that invests in its people, this role is a great fit.

Key Responsibilities

HR Operations & Compliance

  • Support the employee onboarding process, helping new hires get set up and proficient with the firm's technology stack within their first week.
  • Assist with HR document, process, and compliance audits, and monitor completion of required documentation, certifications, training, and policy acknowledgements.
  • Follow up with employees and managers on outstanding compliance items.
  • Maintain accurate HR records within Rippling and other HR systems.

Recruitment & Talent Support

  • Support sourcing for open roles, including candidate outreach and headhunting for hard-to-fill positions when standard applicant pipelines fall short.
  • Help manage candidate pipelines and keep hiring managers updated on status.
  • Assist with background and reference checks and credential verification.
  • Participate in candidate interviews alongside hiring managers.

Training & Development

  • Help maintain and update the firm's training curriculum, onboarding materials, and learning resources.
  • Assist in creating SOPs, workflow documentation, process maps, and training materials as needed.
  • Support the development of assessments and knowledge checks to track training completion.

Process Improvement & Automation

  • Identify opportunities to streamline HR workflows through automation and AI-powered tools.
  • Help maintain workflows within monday.com and other operational platforms.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Psychology, Human Resources, Business Administration, Management, or a related field (required).
  • Tech-savvy, with the ability to quickly learn and adapt to new tools, systems, and platforms (required).
  • Excellent written and spoken English with strong, proactive communication skills â comfortable flagging issues, asking questions, and following up without being prompted (required).
  • Proactive and self-directed, able to anticipate needs and take initiative in a fast-paced, fully remote environment (required).
  • Minimum of 2 years of experience in HR operations for a U.S.-based company, including onboarding, compliance, or employee lifecycle support (required).
  • Experience using monday.com and HRIS platforms such as Rippling (required).
  • Experience creating clear documentation, SOPs, or process materials.
  • Comfortable using AI tools to support content creation, documentation, and process efficiency.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities.
  • Preferred: recruitment or sourcing experience, including candidate outreach, vetting, and interviewing.
  • Preferred: experience with Canva or similar tools for training or communication materials.

Why Join Our Team?

  • Stable, remote opportunity to work with a well-established U.S.-based law firm that values continuous learning, innovation, and professional growth.
  • Competitive compensation with performance-based bonuses.
  • Fully remote role within a diverse global team.
  • Paid time off, including U.S. federal holidays, sick leave, and annual leave.
  • Pacific Time-aligned working hours with reasonable flexibility.
  • Opportunity to grow with the firm's HR function as it scales.
  • Structured onboarding and clear expectations from day one.
  • Stable, long-term opportunity with a growing U.S. law firm.
  • Supportive and collaborative work environment built on accountability and continuous improvement.
  • Thoughtful company culture, including birthday recognitions and team appreciation initiatives.

Working Hours

  • Full-time role, 8 hours per day (excluding a 1-hour break).Â 
  • Schedule details may be discussed during the final stages of the hiring process.Â 
  • Scheduling is flexible; however, team members are required to maintain a minimum of 5â6 hours of overlap with the firm's operating hours in Pacific Time (PT), subject to operational needs and team coordination.

Application Process

Candidates may be asked to complete the following during the recruitment process:

  • Most recent Resume/CV (required).
  • Communication and presentation assessment, including a practical assignment relevant to HR operations, recruitment, or training material creation.
  • Proof of qualifications and professional references. To ensure fairness and accuracy, compensation verification may be conducted for shortlisted candidates.

Additional Information

  • This is a fully remote, South Africa-based role.
  • Engagement is as an independent contractor; tax compliance is the contractor's responsibility.
  • A 3-month probationary period will apply to support onboarding and performance alignment.
  • We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds.

Due to the high volume of applications we receive, contacting our offices by phone, email, or social media regarding this position is strictly prohibited. Any inquiries about application status through these channels will result in automatic disqualification from the hiring process. Our hiring team carefully reviews every submission and will contact qualified candidates directly.

Uz vlastoručno potpisanu prijavu kandidati su dužni priložiti: - životopis (CV) sastavljen na hrvatskom i na talijanskom jeziku, - presliku diplome, odnosno dokaz o stečenoj stručnoj spremi, - dokaz o državljanstvu, - elektronički zapis ili potvrdu o podacima evidentiranim u bazi podataka Hrvatskog zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje i - uvjerenje da se protiv kandidata ne vodi kazneni postupak glede zapreka za zasnivanje radnog odnosa iz čl. 106. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (Narodne novine 121/17, 98/19, 84/21, 156/23), članku 48. f Zakona o zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata (Narodne novine broj 33/92, 77/92, 27/93, 58/93, 2/94, 76/94, 108/95, 108/96, 82/01, 103/03 i 148/13, 98/19), članku 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom (Narodne novine broj 157/13, 152/14, 39/18, 32/20) te članku 48. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (Narodne novine broj 84/21, 13/26), dužne su u prijavi na javni natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i uz prijavu priložiti svu propisanu dokumentaciju prema posebnom zakonu, a imaju prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima. Osobe koje ostvaruju pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (Narodne novine broj 121/17, 98/19, 84/21, 156/23), uz prijavu na natječaj dužne su priložiti i dokaze propisane člankom 103. stavak 1. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata. Poveznica na internetsku stranicu Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja s popisom dokaza potrebnih za ostvarivanje prava prednosti: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/dokumenti/Nikola/popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf Kandidati koji su dostavili potpune i pravovremene prijave i koji ispunjavaju formalne uvjete natječaja sudjeluju u daljnjem postupku te će biti pozvani na vrednovanje. Kandidat koji se ne odazove pozivu za bilo koju fazu vrednovanja, smatrat će se da je odustao od daljnjeg natječajnog postupka. Prijavom na natječaj kandidati daju privolu za obradu osobnih podataka navedenih u svim dostavljenim prilozima odnosno ispravama za potrebe provedbe natječajnog postupka. Škola će u roku od 8 dana od donošenja odluke o izboru kandidata obavijestiti sve kandidate o rezultatima natječaja objavom odluke na mrežnoj stranici Škole ili osobno putem elektroničke pošte. Condizioni previste dagli articoli 105 e 106 della Legge sull'educazione e l'istruzione elementare e media superiore (GU 87/08, 86/09, 92/10, 105/10-corr., 90/11, 5/12, 16/12, 86/12, 94/13, 152/14, 7/17, 68/18, 98/19, 64/20, 151/22, 155/23, 156/23) e in conformità al Regolamento sulla qualificha e preparazione psico-pedagogica dei docenti e collaboratori nell'istruzione elementare (GU 6/19, 75/20): - laurea - padronanza della lingua e della scrittura italiana 2. Condizioni specifiche in base alla Legge sull'educazione e l'istruzione nella lingua e scrittura delle minoranze nazionali (GU 51/00, 56/00-corr.). Al Concorso possono partecipare i candidati di entrambi i sessi come previsto dall'articolo 13 della Legge sulle pari opportunità dei sessi (GU n. 82/16, 69/17). I termini usati in questo Bando di concorso si riferiscono a persone di entrambi i sessi. Le domande firmate devono essere corredate dalla seguente documentazione: - dati biografici (Curriculum vitae) redatti in lingua croata e in lingua italiana, - il Diploma di laurea, ovvero la prova attestante il grado d'istruzione e la qualifica professionale, - la prova di cittadinanza, - il Certificato/estratto digitale di dati dalla banca dati dell'HZMO e - l'attestato comprovante l'assenza di condanne penali considerate ostacoli per l'assunzione indicate nell'art. 106 della Legge sull'educazione e l'istruzione elementare e media superiore (con data di scadenza negli ultimi 6 mesi dalla data di pubblicazione del concorso). La documentazione indicata deve pervenire all'indirizzo della scuola, consegnata personalmente o spedita per posta raccomandata, entro e non oltre il termine di 8 giorni dalla pubblicazione del presente Bando di Concorso sul sito web della Scuola e sul sito web dell'Ufficio collocamento croato. I documenti vanno consegnati in copia non autenticata. I candidati che usufruiscono del diritto di precedenza nell'impiego, a parità di condizioni, in base a leggi specifiche, devono evocare questo diritto esplicitamente nella domanda e fornire in allegato oltre ai documenti comprovanti l'idoneità secondo i requisiti richesti, pure i documenti comprovanti lo status riconosciuto. Le persone di cui all'art.102 della Legge sui veterani della guerra patriottica croata e dei loro familiari (GU 121/17, 98/19, 84/21, 156/23), art. 48. f della Legge sulla tutela degli invalidi di guerra militari e civili di (GU 33/92, 77/92, 27/93, 58/93, 2/94, 76/94, 108/95, 108/96, 82/01, 103/03, 148/13, 98/19), art. 9 della Legge sulla riabilitazione professionale e l'impiego di persone disabili (GU 157/13, 152/14, 39/18, 32/20) e l'art. 48 della Legge sugli invalidi civili della guerra patriottica croata (GU 84/21, 13/26), dovranno comprovare il loro status con la documentazione indicata nella Legge speciale, che usufruiscono del diritto di precedenza nei confronti degli altri candidati esclusivamente alle stesse condizioni. I candidati che usufruiscono del diritto di precedenza nell'impiego secondo l'art. 102 della Legge sui veterani della guerra patriottica croata e dei loro familiari (GU 121/17, 98/19, 84/21, 156/23), dovranno allegare anche le prove indicate nell'art. 103, comma 1 della Legge sui veterani della guerra patriottica croata e dei loro familiari, che si trova sul ipercollegamento-link del Ministero dei difensori: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/NG/12%20Prosinac/Zapo%C5%A1ljavanje/Popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju.pdf I candidati che usufruiscono del diritto di precedenza nell'impiego in base all'art. 48 della Legge sugli invalidi civili della guerra patriottica croata (GU 84/21, 13/26), dovranno indicare questo diritto ed allegare le prove indicate nell'art. 49, comma 1 della stessa Legge, indicate sul ipercollegamento-link del Ministero dei difensori: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/dokumenti/Nikola/popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf I candidati che hanno inoltrato le domande complete e tempestive e che soddisfano le condizioni formali del concorso partecipano nella procedura ulteriore e saranno invitati alla prova (test). La prova (test) include: test psicologici, verifiche della conoscenza della lingua italiana per coloro che non hanno finito almeno un ciclo di istruzione in lingua italiana, la stesura della lettera motivazionale ed il colloquio, tutto indicato ai sensi degli articoli 12 – 14 del Regolamento sulle modalità e sulla procedura di assunzione della OŠ-SE “San Nicolò”. Le domande incomplete e non pervenute entro il termine stabilito non verranno prese in considerazione. La Commissione che svolge le prove (test) per le assunzioni procederà secondo le regole stabilite dal Regolamento sulle modalità e procedure di assunzione dell'OŠ-SE »San Nicolò« con tutti i candidati che soddisferanno le condizioni formali richieste e che presenteranno domande complete, entro il termine previsto. Se il candidato non accede a una delle fasi della prova (test) si considererà come se avesse rinunciato alla procedura concorsuale ulteriore. Accedendo al Bando di concorso i candidati danno il proprio consenso all'elaborazione dei dati personali presenti in tutti i documenti allegati. La Scuola avviserà tutti i candidati riguardo ai risultati del concorso, entro 8 giorni dalla data della decisione sulla scelta del candidato, pubblicando la decisione sul sito web della Scuola oppure personalmente tramite posta elettronica. Il Bando di concorso è stato pubblicato sul sito web della Scuola e sul sito web dell'Ufficio collocamento croato il 10 settembre 2026.

jobs.title: UČITELJ/UČITELJICA KEMIJE NA TALIJANSKOM JEZIKU
jobs.description:
Na temelju članka 107. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi (NN 87/08, 86/09, 92/10,105/10-ispr., 90/11, 5/12, 16/12. 86/12, 94/13, 152/14, 7/17, 68/18, 98/19, 64/20, 151/22, 155/23 i 156/23) i sukladno Pravilniku o načinu i postupku zapošljavanja radnika u OŠ-SE „San Nicolò“ te čl. 7. Pravilnika o radu OŠ-SE „San Nicolò“, ravnateljica Osnovne škole-Scuola elementare „San Nicolò“ Rijeka, Mirka Čurbega 18, objavljuje N A T J E Č A J za popunjenje radnog mjesta 1 učitelj/učiteljica kemije na talijanskom jeziku na neodređeno i nepuno radno vrijeme (8 sati tjedno), uz uvjet probnog rada prema odredbama Temeljnog kolektivnog ugovora za službenike i namještenike u javnim službama TRAŽENI UVJETI:
  1. Prema čl. 105. i 106. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi (NN 87/08., 86/09., 92/10.,105/10.-ispr., 90/11., 5/12., 16/12., 86/12, 94/13, 152/14, 7/17 i 68/18, 98/19, 64/20, 151/22, 155/23, 156/23) i sukladno Pravilniku o odgovarajućoj vrsti obrazovanja učitelja i stručnih suradnika u osnovnoj školi (NN br. 6/19, 75/20):
- završen sveučilišni diplomski studij - potpuno vladanje talijanskim jezikom i pismom 2. Prema Zakonu o odgoju i obrazovanju na jeziku i pismu nacionalnih manjina (NN 51/00.,56/00-ispr.). Na oglašena radna mjesta mogu se javiti osobe oba spola, sukladno čl. 13. Zakona o ravnopravnosti spolova (NN 82/16, 69/17). Svi izrazi korišteni u natječaju odnose se na osobe oba spola. Uz vlastoručno potpisanu prijavu kandidati su dužni priložiti:
  • životopis (CV) sastavljen na hrvatskom i na talijanskom jeziku,
  • presliku diplome, odnosno dokaz o stečenoj stručnoj spremi,
  • dokaz o državljanstvu,
  • elektronički zapis ili potvrdu o podacima evidentiranim u bazi podataka Hrvatskog zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje i
  • uvjerenje da se protiv kandidata ne vodi kazneni postupak glede zapreka za zasnivanje radnog odnosa iz čl. 106. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi, ne starije od 6 mjeseci od dana objave ovog natječaja.
Navedenu dokumentaciju potrebno je dostaviti neposredno ili poštom preporučeno na adresu škole, u roku od 8 dana od dana objave ovog natječaja na mrežnoj stranici Škole i mrežnoj stranici Hrvatskog zavoda za zapošljavanje. Isprave se prilažu u neovjerenoj preslici. Kandidati koji ostvaruju prednost pri zapošljavanju prema posebnim propisima, dužni su u prijavi pozvati se na to pravo i priložiti sve dokaze o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta i priznatom statusu. Osobe koje se pozivaju na pravo prednosti sukladno članku 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (Narodne novine 121/17, 98/19, 84/21, 156/23), članku 48. f Zakona o zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata (Narodne novine broj 33/92, 77/92, 27/93, 58/93, 2/94, 76/94, 108/95, 108/96, 82/01, 103/03 i 148/13, 98/19), članku 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom (Narodne novine broj 157/13, 152/14, 39/18, 32/20) te članku 48. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (Narodne novine broj 84/21, 13/26), dužne su u prijavi na javni natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i uz prijavu priložiti svu propisanu dokumentaciju prema posebnom zakonu, a imaju prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima. Osobe koje ostvaruju pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (Narodne novine broj 121/17, 98/19, 84/21, 156/23), uz prijavu na natječaj dužne su priložiti i dokaze propisane člankom 103. stavak 1. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji. Poveznica na internetsku stranicu Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja s popisom dokaza potrebnih za ostvarivanje prava prednosti: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/NG/12%20Prosinac/Zapo%C5%A1ljavanje/Popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju.pdf Osobe koje ostvaruju pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 48. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (Narodne novine broj 84/21, 13/26), uz prijavu na natječaj dužne su u prijavi na natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i uz prijavu dostaviti i dokaze iz stavka 1. članka 49. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata. Poveznica na internetsku stranicu Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja s popisom dokaza potrebnih za ostvarivanje prava prednosti: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/dokumenti/Nikola/popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf Kandidati koji su dostavili potpune i pravovremene prijave i koji ispunjavaju formalne uvjete natječaja sudjeluju u daljnjem postupku te će biti pozvani na vrednovanje. Vrednovanje uključuje: psihologijsko testiranje, provjera poznavanja talijanskog jezika za kandidate koji nisu završili najmanje jedan obrazovni ciklus na talijanskom jeziku, sastav motivacijskog pisma i intervju, sve u skladu s odredbama članaka 12. – 14. Pravilnika o načinu i postupku zapošljavanja u Osnovnoj školi – Scuola elementare „San Nicolò“. Nepotpune i nepravovremene prijave neće se razmatrati. Povjerenstvo za provedbu testiranja će postupiti sukladno odredbama Pravilnika o načinu i postupku zapošljavanja u OŠ-SE „San Nicolò“ u odnosu na sve kandidate, koji udovoljavaju propisanim uvjetima, a podnijeli su potpune i pravovremene prijave. Škola će u roku od 8 dana od donošenja odluke o izboru kandidata obavijestiti sve kandidate o rezultatima natječaja objavom odluke na mrežnoj stranici Škole ili osobno putem elektroničke pošte. jobs.title: KONOBAR/ICA
jobs.description: Café Allegri - STENJEVEC Posjedujemo ugostiteljske objekte diljem Hrvatske, a koji su pozicionirani u sklopu supermarketa i radnim vremenom prilagođeni istima, te su ugodno i toplo uređeni. Velika pozornost pridaje se kvaliteti usluge i stručnosti osoblja s naglaskom na srdačnost! Visoku razinu kvalitete održavamo kontinuiranim ulaganjem u naše djelatnike, prostor i ponudu, što nam se višestruko vraća kroz zadovoljne djelatnike i stalne goste. Ukoliko i Vi želite postati dio našeg tima od 150 zadovoljnih djelatnika, javite se na naš natječaj! Ako i nemate radnog iskustva te bi Vam ovo bilo prvo zaposlenje, rado ćemo Vas uzeti u obzir kao potencijalnog kandidata, te Vam pomoći u stjecanju iskustva i usvajanju novih znanja i vještina! Za dodatne informacije o našoj ponudi i uvjetima rada možete se javiti na broj 099 4328260 ili posao@celka.hr. Naš tim proširujemo osobom koja ima želju za učenjem i kontinuiranim usavršavanjem na radnom mjestu: Ugostiteljski djelatnik (m/ž) Što ćete raditi? - posluživati goste sukladno propisanim pravilima i standardima - održavati čistoću i urednost radnog prostora i opreme - osiguravati primjenu propisanih i zadanih standarda u ugostiteljstvu - predstavljati organizaciju u najboljem svjetlu te izgrađivati prijateljske odnose sa gostima i kolegama Što nudimo? - stimulativne uvjete - rad u uspješnoj i stabilnoj tvrtki - dinamičnu i ugodnu radnu atmosferu.

Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom (Narodne novine broj 157/13, 152/14, 39/18, 32/20) te članku 48. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata. Kandidat koji se ne odazove pozivu za bilo koju fazu vrednovanja, smatrat će se da je odustao od daljnjeg natječajnog postupka. Prijavom na natječaj kandidati daju privolu za obradu osobnih podataka navedenih u svim dostavljenim prilozima odnosno ispravama za potrebe provedbe natječajnog postupka. Condizioni previste dagli articoli 105 e 106 della Legge sull'educazione e l'istruzione elementare e media superiore (GU 87/08, 86/09, 92/10, 105/10-corr., 90/11, 5/12, 16/12, 86/12, 94/13, 152/14, 7/17, 68/18, 98/19, 64/20, 151/22, 155/23, 156/23) e in conformità al Regolamento sulla qualificha e preparazione psico-pedagogica dei docenti e collaboratori nell'istruzione elementare (GU 6/19, 75/20): - laurea - padronanza della lingua e della scrittura italiana 2. Condizioni specifiche in base alla Legge sull'educazione e l'istruzione nella lingua e scrittura delle minoranze nazionali (GU 51/00, 56/00-corr.). Al Concorso possono partecipare i candidati di entrambi i sessi come previsto dall'articolo 13 della Legge sulle pari opportunità dei sessi (GU n. 82/16, 69/17). I termini usati in questo Bando di concorso si riferiscono a persone di entrambi i sessi. Le domande firmate devono essere corredate dalla seguente documentazione: - dati biografici (Curriculum vitae) redatti in lingua croata e in lingua italiana, - il Diploma di laurea, ovvero la prova attestante il grado d'istruzione e la qualifica professionale, - la prova di cittadinanza, - il Certificato/estratto digitale di dati dalla banca dati dell'HZMO e - l'attestato comprovante l'assenza di condanne penali considerate ostacoli per l'assunzione indicate nell'art. 106 della Legge sull'educazione e l'istruzione elementare e media superiore (con data di scadenza negli ultimi 6 mesi dalla data di pubblicazione del concorso). La documentazione indicata deve pervenire all'indirizzo della scuola, consegnata personalmente o spedita per posta raccomandata, entro e non oltre il termine di 8 giorni dalla pubblicazione del presente Bando di Concorso sul sito web della Scuola e sul sito web dell'Ufficio collocamento croato. I documenti vanno consegnati in copia non autenticata. I candidati che usufruiscono del diritto di precedenza nell'impiego, a parità di condizioni, in base a leggi specifiche, devono evocare questo diritto esplicitamente nella domanda e fornire in allegato oltre ai documenti comprovanti l'idoneità secondo i requisiti richesti, pure i documenti comprovanti lo status riconosciuto. Le persone di cui all'art.102 della Legge sui veterani della guerra patriottica croata e dei loro familiari (GU 121/17, 98/19, 84/21, 156/23), art. 48. f della Legge sulla tutela degli invalidi di guerra militari e civili di (GU 33/92, 77/92, 27/93, 58/93, 2/94, 76/94, 108/95, 108/96, 82/01, 103/03, 148/13, 98/19), art. 9 della Legge sulla riabilitazione professionale e l'impiego di persone disabili (GU 157/13, 152/14, 39/18, 32/20) e l'art. 48 della Legge sugli invalidi civili della guerra patriottica croata (GU 84/21, 13/26), dovranno comprovare il loro status con la documentazione indicata nella Legge speciale, che usufruiscono del diritto di precedenza nei confronti degli altri candidati esclusivamente alle stesse condizioni. I candidati che usufruiscono del diritto di precedenza nell'impiego secondo l'art. 102 della Legge sui veterani della guerra patriottica croata e dei loro familiari (GU 121/17, 98/19, 84/21, 156/23), dovranno allegare anche le prove indicate nell'art. 103, comma 1 della Legge sui veterani della guerra patriottica croata e dei loro familiari, che si trova sul ipercollegamento-link del Ministero dei difensori: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/NG/12%20Prosinac/Zapo%C5%A1ljavanje/Popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju.pdf I candidati che usufruiscono del diritto di precedenza nell'impiego in base all'art. 48 della Legge sugli invalidi civili della guerra patriottica croata (GU 84/21, 13/26), dovranno indicare questo diritto ed allegare le prove indicate nell'art. 49, comma 1 della stessa Legge, indicate sul ipercollegamento-link del Ministero dei difensori: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/dokumenti/Nikola/popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf I candidati che hanno inoltrato le domande complete e tempestive e che soddisfano le condizioni formali del concorso partecipano nella procedura ulteriore e saranno invitati alla prova (test). La prova (test) include: test psicologici, verifiche della conoscenza della lingua italiana per coloro che non hanno finito almeno un ciclo di istruzione in lingua italiana, la stesura della lettera motivazionale ed il colloquio, tutto indicato ai sensi degli articoli 12 – 14 del Regolamento sulle modalità e sulla procedura di assunzione della OŠ-SE “San Nicolò”. Le domande incomplete e non pervenute entro il termine stabilito non verranno prese in considerazione. La Commissione che svolge le prove (test) per le assunzioni procederà secondo le regole stabilite dal Regolamento sulle modalità e procedure di assunzione dell'OŠ-SE »San Nicolò« con tutti i candidati che soddisferanno le condizioni formali richieste e che presenteranno domande complete, entro il termine previsto. Se il candidato non accede a una delle fasi della prova (test) si considererà come se avesse rinunciato alla procedura concorsuale ulteriore. Accedendo al Bando di concorso i candidati danno il proprio consenso all'elaborazione dei dati personali presenti in tutti i documenti allegati. La Scuola avviserà tutti i candidati riguardo ai risultati del concorso, entro 8 giorni dalla data della decisione sulla scelta del candidato, pubblicando la decisione sul sito web della Scuola oppure personalmente tramite posta elettronica. Il Bando di concorso è stato pubblicato sul sito web della Scuola e sul sito web dell'Ufficio collocamento croato il 10 settembre 2026.

I candidati che usufruiscono del diritto di precedenza nell'impiego, a parità di condizioni, in base a leggi specifiche, devono evocare questo diritto esplicitamente nella domanda e fornire in allegato oltre ai documenti comprovanti l'idoneità secondo i requisiti richesti, pure i documenti comprovanti lo status riconosciuto. Le persone di cui all'art.102 della Legge sui veterani della guerra patriottica croata e dei loro familiari (GU 121/17, 98/19, 84/21, 156/23), art. 48. f della Legge sulla tutela degli invalidi di guerra militari e civili di (GU 33/92, 77/92, 27/93, 58/93, 2/94, 76/94, 108/95, 108/96, 82/01, 103/03, 148/13, 98/19), art. 9 della Legge sulla riabilitazione professionale e l'impiego di persone disabili (GU 157/13, 152/14, 39/18, 32/20) e l'art. 48 della Legge sugli invalidi civili della guerra patriottica croata (GU 84/21, 13/26), dovranno comprovare il loro status con la documentazione indicata nella Legge speciale, che usufruiscono del diritto di precedenza nei confronti degli altri candidati esclusivamente alle stesse condizioni. I candidati che usufruiscono del diritto di precedenza nell'impiego secondo l'art. 102 della Legge sui veterani della guerra patriottica croata e dei loro familiari (GU 121/17, 98/19, 84/21, 156/23), dovranno allegare anche le prove indicate nell'art. 103, comma 1 della Legge sui veterani della guerra patriottica croata e dei loro familiari, che si trova sul ipercollegamento-link del Ministero dei difensori: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/NG/12%20Prosinac/Zapo%C5%A1ljavanje/Popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju.pdf I candidati che usufruiscono del diritto di precedenza nell'impiego in base all'art. 48 della Legge sugli invalidi civili della guerra patriottica croata (GU 84/21, 13/26), dovranno indicare questo diritto ed allegare le prove indicate nell'art. 49, comma 1 della stessa Legge, indicate sul ipercollegamento-link del Ministero dei difensori: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/dokumenti/Nikola/popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf I candidati che hanno inoltrato le domande complete e tempestive e che soddisfano le condizioni formali del concorso partecipano nella procedura ulteriore e saranno invitati alla prova (test). La prova (test) include: test psicologici, verifiche della conoscenza della lingua italiana per coloro che non hanno finito almeno un ciclo di istruzione in lingua italiana, la stesura della lettera motivazionale ed il colloquio, tutto indicato ai sensi degli articoli 12 – 14 del Regolamento sulle modalità e sulla procedura di assunzione della OŠ-SE “San Nicolò”. Le domande incomplete e non pervenute entro il termine stabilito non verranno prese in considerazione. La Commissione che svolge le prove (test) per le assunzioni procederà secondo le regole stabilite dal Regolamento sulle modalità e procedure di assunzione dell'OŠ-SE »San Nicolò« con tutti i candidati che soddisferanno le condizioni formali richieste e che presenteranno domande complete, entro il termine previsto. Se il candidato non accede a una delle fasi della prova (test) si considererà come se avesse rinunciato alla procedura concorsuale ulteriore. Accedendo al Bando di concorso i candidati danno il proprio consenso all'elaborazione dei dati personali presenti in tutti i documenti allegati. La Scuola avviserà tutti i candidati riguardo ai risultati del concorso, entro 8 giorni dalla data della decisione sulla scelta del candidato, pubblicando la decisione sul sito web della Scuola oppure personalmente tramite posta elettronica. Il Bando di concorso è stato pubblicato sul sito web della Scuola e sul sito web dell'Ufficio collocamento croato il 10 settembre 2026.

jobs.title: KONOBAR/KONOBARICA
jobs.description:
Posjedujemo ugostiteljske objekte diljem Hrvatske, a koji su pozicionirani u sklopu supermarketa i radnim vremenom prilagođeni istima, te su ugodno i toplo uređeni. Velika pozornost pridaje se kvaliteti usluge i stručnosti osoblja s naglaskom na srdačnost! Visoku razinu kvalitete održavamo kontinuiranim ulaganjem u naše djelatnike, prostor i ponudu, što nam se višestruko vraća kroz zadovoljne djelatnike i stalne goste.  
Ukoliko i Vi želite postati dio našeg tima od 150 zadovoljnih djelatnika, javite se na naš natječaj!

Što ćete raditi?
- posluživati goste sukladno propisanim pravilima i standardima  
- održavati čistoću i urednost radnog prostora i opreme  
- osiguravati primjenu propisanih i zadanih standarda u ugostiteljstvu  
- predstavljati organizaciju u najboljem svjetlu te izgrađivati prijateljske odnose sa gostima i kolegama  

Što nudimo?  
- stimulativne uvjete  
- rad u uspješnoj i stabilnoj tvrtki  
- dinamičnu i ugodnu radnu atmosferu

jobs.title: Remote Office Assistant
jobs.description:
Coalition Technologies is seeking a reliable, detail-oriented, and highly organized Remote Office Assistant to support administrative, bookkeeping, billing, reporting, data entry, and internal operations tasks. This role is ideal for someone with strong communication skills, discretion, attention to detail, and a willingness to learn and grow within a fast-paced remote work environment.

As an Office Assistant, you will help support daily administrative operations, assist with entry-level bookkeeping, organize client documents, support internal reporting, and help maintain accurate company records. This position offers strong growth potential for the right candidate, including opportunities for advancement within the Accounting team or other departments.

We are looking for talented and diligent candidates who perform well on our skills assessments. Strong skills test performance may be considered even if a candidate does not meet every preferred experience or educational background requirement.

 

Why Join Coalition Technologies?

Coalition Technologies is committed to delivering high-quality work for our clients while providing our team with a fun, thriving, innovative, and growth-focused work environment. We offer:

  • 100% remote work with a company that has supported remote team members for more than a decade
  • Competitive profit-sharing bonus plan, with up to 50% of company profits paid to full-time employees each month
  • Competitive Paid Time Off plan that supports work-life balance
  • Subsidized gym memberships
  • Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance packages for eligible US-based team members
  • International Health Insurance Reimbursement Program for eligible international team members
  • Device upgrade and learning reimbursement programs
  • Career development plans with clearly defined goals and rewards
  • Additional job-specific incentives and bonuses

 

Office Assistant Responsibilities

As an Office Assistant, your duties will include:

  • Answering phones and emails
  • Completing entry-level bookkeeping tasks, including recording expenses, organizing receipts, and maintaining transaction records
  • Resolving billing issues with clients and internal team members
  • Providing account access, usage reports, data analysis, and other ad hoc support for team members
  • Supporting quality assurance checks for internal and client-facing reports
  • Organizing new client contracts, creating invoices, and processing client payments
  • Contributing to internal database maintenance, upkeep, and data entry
  • Researching, ordering, and distributing company-wide gifts two to three times per year
  • Organizing company events, competitions, and special projects throughout the year
  • Facilitating company holiday calendars, time-off calendars, and schedule variation calendars

 

Required Skills and Qualifications

The ideal candidate will have:

  • Willingness to learn, grow, and collaborate with the team and company as a whole
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • High level of discretion, ethics, and trustworthiness
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills
  • Ability to support administrative, bookkeeping, billing, reporting, and data entry tasks
  • Innovative thinking and willingness to challenge existing methods when improvement is possible
  • Availability to work 40 hours per week, Monday through Friday, 9:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. Pacific Time
  • Reliable remote workspace with a fast computer, quality internet, camera, microphone, and speakers

 

Preferred Skills

  • The following experience is preferred but not required:
  • Intermediate spreadsheet skills
  • Experience with bookkeeping or financial record keeping
  • Experience with Google Sheets, Microsoft Excel, QuickBooks Online, and Google Workspace
  • Experience supporting billing, invoicing, reporting, data entry, or administrative operations

 

Remote Work Environment

Coalition Technologies is a fully remote company. Our team works remotely with the support of time tracking software, structured communication, and a company culture designed to help remote team members succeed. We have supported remote team members for more than a decade and welcome qualified applicants from around the world.

 

Growth Opportunity

This position offers a strong opportunity for growth. Successful Office Assistants at Coalition Technologies have advanced quickly and earned promotions within the Accounting team and across other departments.

 

Compensation

For candidates located in California, New York, Washington, and Colorado, the starting base pay for this position ranges from $15 to $25 per hour. Compensation may vary based on factors such as experience, qualifications, skills test performance, geographic location, and seniority of the position offered. For candidates outside of California, New York, Washington, and Colorado, compensation may fall outside the listed range.

jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

As Notion’s product surface expands, we need a builder-teacher who can turn new capabilities into technically accurate education that helps customers confidently build with Notion. In this role, you’ll explore Notion’s newest capabilities, teach by showing, and ship as the product evolves. You’ll be the technical face of Notion Academy: leading workshops, recording walkthroughs, and building implementation guides.

 

This role is based in New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Expand Notion’s technical education library. Author technically rigorous Academy content, implementation guides, and Help Center resources that make our most complex capabilities easier to understand and adopt.

 - Become a trusted voice for Notion Academy. Teach customers through video, live webinars, and workshops, demonstrating real workflows and solving problems in real time.

 - Build with Notion’s newest capabilities. Get hands-on with new product features, use customer insights to identify high-value use cases, and determine top priority workflows for education to focus on.

 - Reimagine learning with AI. Experiment with adaptive, contextual learning experiences that respond to what customers are trying to build and where they need help.

 - Prove and scale the impact of technical education. Use product adoption signals to measure impact and improve what we teach, then build reusable standards to help the team deliver effective technical learning faster.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Builder mindset: You learn new product features by getting hands-on, experimenting, and building until you understand.

 - Comfort navigating technical content: you don’t need to write code, but you can read a technical architecture doc, identify what’s outdated, and work with engineers to fix it.

 - Customer-facing credibility: You’re comfortable teaching, building, and troubleshooting in front of customers.

 - AI experimentation: You actively use AI to build, learn, and teach technical proficiency.

 - Product expertise: You can quickly understand a new feature, identify where it creates meaningful customer value, and turn that into practical use cases.




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Notion product expertise

 - Experience in a customer-facing technical role, such as solutions architecture, sales engineering, developer relations, or technical enablement

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Identity & Authorization
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.




ABOUT THE TEAM

Product Platform builds and owns the shared foundations the rest of Replit is built on, spanning the full stack so every other team can ship features safely and quickly.

Identity & Authorization defines how people, agents, sandboxes, and services prove who they are and what they can do. These systems protect critical product and service interactions across Replit's web product, Agent, enterprise controls, and internal services.

Our work is high-leverage and horizontal: when identity and policy are clear, reliable, and easy to adopt, every other team can move faster without rebuilding security controls.

We are a small, collaborative team that values curiosity and clear thinking over pedigree, and we work in the open by bringing each other the problem rather than just the request. We care more about how you reason and build than the route you took to get here.




ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Software Engineer, you will design, build, and operate the identity and authorization systems that protect critical interactions on Replit, including Agent acting on behalf of a user or holding their own identity.

The work is guided by a few simple questions:

 - Can every protected request prove which workload made it, which principal it represents, and who is acting on that principal's behalf?

 - Can product teams express policy once and trust the same decision across web, mobile, Agent, and internal services?

 - Can enterprise administrators control who can access each workspace, app, connector, and Agent capability without navigating a permission maze as well as having a legible ledger of decisions?

 - Can Agent act for a user across long-running and durable work without receiving broad or long-lived credentials?

 - Are identity and authorization fast, reliable, highly available, and observable enough for the product flows that depend on them?




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Design and operate central authorization interfaces with typed principals, actions, resources, decisions, explainable deny reasons, privilege attenuation, delegations, and obligations

 - Evolve enterprise roles, groups, app access, entitlements, and workspace policy so common cases stay simple and advanced cases remain possible

 - Build and operate Replit's Security Token Service and workload identity using OAuth 2.0 token exchange, JWT/OIDC, SPIFFE/SPIRE, and mTLS

 - Threat-model delegation, confused-deputy risks, and cross-tenant movement, then make secure, fail-closed behavior the default

 - Lead compatible migrations with shadow evaluation, feature gates, telemetry, and rollback plans, and own the SLOs, incidents, and operational health of the systems you ship

 - Partner with Agent, Connectors, Enterprise, Security, and Infrastructure teams to turn product requirements into shared platform primitives

 - Research and develop new innovative approaches to Authx in the Agentic world




AREAS YOU MIGHT WORK IN

 - Authorization policy: evolve Replit's central policy decision point and migrate fragmented authorization checks to its typed contract.

 - Agent delegation: extend the current delegation foundation so the user is the subject and Agent is the authenticated actor, with continuous validation and dynamic permission envelopes as work runs.

 - Enterprise access control: evolve roles, groups, workspace policy, and app-level grants for both simple collaboration and complex organizations.

 - Agent and service identity and reliability: operate the token and workload-identity systems that protect service-to-service traffic.




REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

 - Experience shipping and operating security-sensitive backend or distributed systems in production, including reliability, performance, incidents, and observability

 - Depth in authentication, authorization, or identity systems, such as OAuth 2.0/OIDC, JWT, mTLS, Identity Federation, RBAC, ReBAC, PBAC, Zanzibar, Macaroons, Biscuits, Cedar, or policy engines. You do not need prior experience with every item

 - Strong understanding of multi-tenant security, least privilege, delegation, privilege attenuation, auditability, and threat modeling

 - Experience migrating security-sensitive systems without breaking callers. Approaches can include typed contracts, shadow evaluation, and staged enforcement

 - Fluent in at least one production backend stack. Our systems use TypeScript, Go, Rust, Postgres, gRPC/Protobuf, Kubernetes, Envoy, and Restate

 - Able to make and communicate tradeoffs across security, reliability, latency, product experience, delivery speed, and long-term maintainability
