Full-time, primarily onsite position in Tallinn. We welcome applications from both strong junior and mid-level Systems Engineers. Starting date as soon as possible or by agreement.

Work tasks: The Systems Engineer will support the definition, coordination, integration, verification and delivery of Golbriak Space’s optical communication systems.
Main responsibilities: * Capture, analyse, define and maintain system and subsystem requirements * Translate product and mission objectives into clear technical requirements, actions and deliverables * Allocate requirements across subsystems and maintain traceability throughout the product-development lifecycle * Coordinate interfaces between mechanical, optical, electronic, software, thermal, manufacturing and testing activities * Identify technical dependencies, assumptions, constraints, conflicts and risks * Develop system-level verification and validation plans and define appropriate acceptance criteria * Support system integration, testing, troubleshooting and qualification activities * Review test results and verification evidence against defined requirements * Coordinate the resolution of technical issues involving multiple engineering disciplines * Track technical activities, dependencies, risks, decisions and milestones * Prepare and support technical and design reviews * Maintain requirements specifications, interface documentation, verification plans, technical reports and engineering decision records * Support configuration management and the controlled implementation of engineering changes * Collaborate closely with founders, engineering leads, technical teams, suppliers, partners and customers * Contribute to the improvement of systems-engineering processes, documentation and development workflows

We offer: * A central engineering role with direct impact on advanced optical communication systems
* Meaningful technical ownership across requirements management, system integration, verification and engineering coordination * The opportunity to work across mechanical, optical, electronic, software, manufacturing and testing disciplines * Close collaboration with an international and multidisciplinary engineering team * The opportunity to develop your expertise in systems engineering, optical communications, telecommunications and aerospace * The ability to contribute to technical decisions, engineering processes and ways of working as the company grows * A gross monthly salary of €2100–€3000, depending on experience, skills and expected level of responsibility * Relocation support to Estonia if required * Reasonable flexibility in working hours, consistent with operational and team needs

Other requirements: We are looking for a candidate with strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills, technical curiosity and the ability to understand complex systems as a whole. The person should be able to identify dependencies, constraints and potential conflicts between different engineering disciplines.
The successful candidate will be organised, reliable and willing to take ownership. They should be able to coordinate multiple technical activities and priorities simultaneously. Strong communication and collaboration skills are required, together with the ability to explain complex technical information clearly. The company’s working language is English, so professional working proficiency in English is required. The candidate must be willing to work primarily onsite in Tallinn and be comfortable in a fast-moving environment where priorities and technical requirements may evolve.

Option to work from home: Yes

jobs.title: Mechanical Manufacturing Technician
jobs.description:

-Work according to technical drawings, assembly instructions and defined procedures -Use hand tools, power tools, drills and other workshop equipment safely and accurately -Set up and operate manufacturing equipment used for prototyping and production -Operate a laser cutter and prepare or adjust suitable production files -Support CNC machining activities, depending on your existing skills and experience -Carry out basic measurements, inspections and functional checks -Participate in the testing of assembled products and components -Identify assembly or manufacturing problems and report them to the engineering team -Support troubleshooting, rework and corrective activities -Work with adhesives and materials such as epoxy where required -Record completed work, measurements, issues and test results accurately -Maintain tools, equipment and work areas in good condition -Provide practical feedback on assembly methods and work instructions

Isto im vraćamo sa stimulativnim primanjima i korporativnom kulturom u kojoj se žive obiteljske vrijednosti. Želimo biti više od skupine timova u jednom poduzeću. jobs.title: AI Enablement & Automation Engineer (80-100%, f::m::d) - Remote (Softwareentwickler/in)
jobs.description:
Remote AI Enablement & Automation Engineer (80-100%, f::m::d) Salary: 65000 - 75000 EUR per year. At OnlineDoctor AG we are looking for a Machine-Learning engineer! Our tech stack: AI, AI Agents, Cloud, Confluence, Support, JIRA, Security, SharePoint. Requirements: - Professional experience in software engineering, automation engineering, systems integration, internal tooling, or a comparable hands-on technical role.

- Proven experience independently designing, building, and maintaining software, integrations, or automation solutions used in day-to-day operations.
- Strong practical programming or scripting skills and experience working with APIs, webhooks, data sources, business systems, and automation or integration tools.
- Practical familiarity with generative AI, AI assistants, or AI-supported workflows. Deep machine-learning or AI research expertise is not required.
- Understanding of authentication, authorization, secrets management, logging, monitoring, and basic cloud-security practices.
- Ability to understand operational problems and translate them into pragmatic, reliable, and maintainable technical solutions.
- Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.. Your responsibilities are: Process Automation & Solution Development
- Work closely with teams across the organization to understand workflows, identify bottlenecks, and uncover opportunities for process improvement and automation.
- Design and build internal automation and AI-enabled solutions, including assistants, agents, document workflows, extraction and classification, and knowledge search.
- Build and maintain integrations between AI services and systems such as SharePoint, Teams, Jira, Confluence, Zoho, and other internal tools using APIs, webhooks, scripting, and automation tools.

Solution Ownership & Operations

- Take ownership of solutions beyond the prototype stage, including testing, deployment, monitoring, documentation, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement.
- Maintain and further develop existing automation and AI solutions across the organization.
- Establish reusable standards for integrations, access controls, testing, monitoring, error handling, documentation, and human review.

AI Enablement & Governance

- Support teams in evaluating automation and AI ideas, developing suitable solutions, and using approved tools effectively.
- Identify and prioritize internal automation and AI use cases based on value, feasibility, effort, data sensitivity, risk, and expected adoption.
- Work closely with IT, Security, Privacy, Quality Management, Regulatory, Legal, and other relevant experts to translate agreed requirements into practical technical controls.
- Work closely with the responsible compliance, security, privacy, quality, AI, and regulatory experts.
- Translate agreed requirements into effective technical solutions and operational controls.. Category: Machine-Learning Developer / Engineer Location address: Waisenhaustrasse 15, Munich, Germany. Salary: 65000 - 75000 EUR per year. OnlineDoctor AG - More about us and the role:Join OnlineDoctor: Were Expanding!

We are a fast-growing telemedicine company focused on improving access to dermatological care. Our platform uses technology to connect patients with dermatologists, enabling them to receive diagnoses and treatment plans remotely and asynchronously.

Were looking for an AI Enablement & Automation Engineer to help us improve and automate internal processes across OnlineDoctor. You will work closely with teams across the organization to understand their workflows, and identify opportunities for automation, turning them into reliable technical solutions.

This is a hands-on software engineering role focused on solving real operational problems. You will build and maintain automations, integrations, internal tools, and AI-enabled workflows, while ensuring that solutions are reliable, maintainable, secure, and appropriate for a regulated healthcare environment.

You will work closely with the responsible compliance, security, privacy, quality, AI, and regulatory experts. You are not expected to make governance or regulatory decisions independently; your responsibility is to understand agreed requirements and translate them into effective technical solutions and operational controls.

What we offer:

- Flexibility: You decide if you want to work remote or if you prefer to visit one of our Offices (Hamburg, St. Gallen, Zürich). We offer you a flexible schedule and a working time model that suits you.
- Learning culture: We offer you a steep learning curve in your daily work and support you in your personal and professional development through regular retro and inspiration sessions as well as advanced training. We are open for ideas and impulses and help you with the implementation.
- Team events: Skiing in Switzerland, white water rafting in Vienna - we regularly get together with our entire team and thus increase our teamwork.
- Fair salary: An attractive salary is a matter of course for us.
- Additional benefits: Free choice of laptop, home office allowance, additional vacation day, etc.
- Our Values: Respect and tolerance are part of our DNA. We actively support diversity and inclusion, believing they are the keys to a successful and healthy company culture.

Work Location & Relocation:
Due to current legal and regulatory reasons, we can only hire team members who live in Germany or Switzerland. If youre based elsewhere but excited to join OnlineDoctor, were happy to discuss and support your relocation to either country.

Ready to Join Us?
If weve convinced you, get in touch to apply for this position. We look forward to meeting you soon!  last updated 35 week of 2026

jobs.title: Freelance Copywriter
jobs.description:
CT Marketing Agency is seeking skilled Freelance Copywriters to write high-quality, SEO-driven content for eCommerce and lead generation websites. This is a freelance, project-based writing role.

 

The ideal candidate has excellent English writing skills, strong research ability, and experience writing content that follows detailed, client-specific guidelines. Projects commonly include category pages, product descriptions, blog posts, SEO landing pages, and website copy.

 

About the Role

Our client base is constantly evolving, and writers may create content across a wide range of industries, including:

  • Fashion, including mass-market and luxury brands
  • Skincare and beauty
  • Tech and software
  • Finance and investing
  • Law, including family law, divorce, and product liability
  • Education
  • Home improvement
  • Automobiles and motorcycles
  • Health and wellness
  • Medical and clinical fields
  • Digital marketing
  • SEO, PR, advertising, and marketing

Writers with experience in highly specialized industries such as tech, finance, law, health, medical, SEO, PR, advertising, or marketing are strongly encouraged to apply.

Responsibilities
  • Write clear, engaging, SEO-friendly content for eCommerce and lead generation websites
  • Create category pages, product descriptions, blog posts, landing pages, and website copy
  • Research client industries, products, services, audiences, and competitors
  • Follow detailed client guidelines and adapt to different brand voices
  • Blend SEO best practices with brand priorities and conversion-focused writing
  • Complete assignments by deadline and communicate professionally with the team

Qualifications
  • Excellent English writing, grammar, editing, and proofreading skills
  • 2 to 4 years of professional, non-academic writing experience preferred
  • Strong understanding of SEO writing best practices
  • Ability to research unfamiliar industries and technical topics
  • Ability to write creative, engaging, accurate, and ROI-focused content
  • Portfolio featuring published work preferred
  • Experience in specialized industries strongly preferred

Compensation

Writers are paid on a per-word basis. Rates are assessed according to our KPI rubric.

Initial compensation is up to $0.06 per word, with $0.034 per word being the most typical rate

This equals approximately $30 or $17 per 500-word page

After 400 live pages, the top rate increases to $0.064 per word, with $0.038 per word being the most typical rate

After 800 live pages, the top rate increases to $0.07 per word, with $0.044 per word being the most typical rate

 

Application Process

Candidates should be prepared to provide a portfolio featuring published work. Once an offer is extended, writers will complete a brief training course.

jobs.title: Outcomes Architect Manager, Tokyo
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Notion is reimagining how customers adopt, expand, and realize value from software in an AI-native world. As a first-line leader directly managing a team of Outcomes Architects, you’ll own your team’s execution across workflow adoption, value realization, renewal readiness, expansion qualification, and at-risk account recovery — accountable for both the customer outcomes and the quality of execution that produces them.

This isn’t a traditional Customer Success management role. The best OA Managers are coaches first: they know what great workflow discovery looks like, can review a mutual success plan and identify where value realization is breaking down, can inspect an executive business review and sharpen the value narrative, and can help an OA turn account activity into measurable customer and commercial outcomes.

You’ll run an inspection cadence and cultivate a coaching culture that make consistent execution possible across the team. You’ll partner closely with Solutions Consultant leaders, Services, Support, Product, and RevOps to ensure customers move from workflow design to adoption, value realization, expansion, and renewal readiness.

If you’re a builder who loves developing people as much as driving customer impact — and you want to lead a team in a post-sales motion that’s being redefined for the AI era — this is the role




WHAT YOU’LL ACHIEVE

 - Own the Net Revenue Growth performance of your team’s book of business, accountable for both headline outcomes and the quality of execution that drives workflow adoption, value realization, renewal readiness, and expansion.

 - Coach OAs on the OA builder motion: AI Transformation Plans, build-beside workshops, value reviews, use-case consultations, and renewal processes.

 - Build and run the operating cadence for the team: metrics reviews, account support sessions, adoption and renewal-risk reviews, call coaching against the OA quality rubric, and forecast calls with senior leadership.

 - Hire, onboard, and certify new OAs to the GTM builder motion, driving readiness from ramp through consistent execution and managing performance with clarity when expectations are not met.

 - Partner closely with Solutions Consultant managers and leaders on strategy for expansion and renewal across shared accounts, ensuring clear ownership for flat and at-risk renewals.

 - Partner with Services leadership to identify complex implementation needs early, create clear handoffs, and ensure Services delivery accelerates workflow adoption and measurable value.

 - Set the standard for product, AI, and workflow fluency across the team so OAs can help customers navigate new ways of working and build durable systems in Notion.

 - Represent your team or region in leadership forums with clear signal on what's working, what needs investment, and where execution is breaking down

 - Uphold excellence by coaching to the global OA methodology, quality rubric, and activity KPIs.




SKILLS YOU’LL NEED TO BRING

 - Frontline management experience leading customer-facing GTM teams in B2B software, ideally across Customer Success, Solutions Consulting, Technical Account Management, Professional Services, Account Management, or post-sales strategy.

 - Direct experience coaching teams through customer discovery, workflow design, adoption planning, value realization, renewals, expansion, or technical/workflow implementation.

 - Strong coaching orientation: you can review a customer call, account plan, mutual success plan, or executive value narrative and identify specifically what needs to change — not just whether the outcome was good, but why and how to improve it.

 - Commercial instincts at the team level: able to read account health, renewal risk, adoption depth, expansion potential, and customer sentiment, then drive urgency without micromanaging every account.

 - Deep customer-facing discovery instincts, with the ability to understand business problems, map workflows, and translate goals into practical adoption and implementation plans.

 - Experience operating in a shared account ownership model with Sales, Solutions, Services, Support, or Implementation teams.

 - Operational rigor: you know how to build inspection cadences, coaching rituals, performance standards, and accountability systems that improve execution across a team.

 - Ability to develop talent from onboarding through consistent performance, including hiring to profile, setting clear expectations, coaching skill gaps, and managing performance with clarity.

 - Executive communication skills: able to synthesize account patterns, customer risks, team performance, and cross-functional asks into clear signal for leadership.

 - Technical fluency and presence as a trusted advisor. You do not need to build every workflow yourself, but you should be able to understand Notion systems, coach workflow design, and help your team troubleshoot adoption blockers.

 - You operate with agency, urgency, and customer empathy, bringing structure to ambiguous problems and helping teams move from ideas to working systems.

 - You don’t need to be an AI expert, but you’re curious, hands-on, and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter, coach better, and help customers deliver better outcomes.




NICE TO HAVES

 - Experience managing in a consumption, usage-based, or product-led business where adoption signals matter as much as renewal or expansion outcomes.

 - Track record building high-performing frontline teams from an early stage: hiring to profile, structured onboarding, certification, coaching, and performance management.

 - Experience leading teams through GTM motion changes, coverage-model shifts, or evolving commercial ownership.

 - Experience working with flat, at-risk, or complex renewal accounts and helping teams return customers to a clear value path.

 - Experience partnering closely with Solutions Consulting, Sales, Services, or Implementation teams in a shared customer lifecycle model.

 - Familiarity with AI transformation, workflow automation, agents, or collaboration/work management software.




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

jobs.title: Learning Experiences Creator
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.



ABOUT THE ROLE

Replit is where millions of people learn to build software - and our documentation and learning content are where they get going or give up. We're taking ownership of that experience, and we're looking for a Learning Experience Creator who can make it worthy of the product: someone who turns product knowledge into experiences people actually use - clear written docs, guided learning, short video, interactive experiences - findable at the moment of need, accurate every time, and genuinely enjoyable.

You're a learning-experience creator first. You understand how people actually learn a product - what they're trying to accomplish, where they get stuck, what format serves each moment - and you move fluidly between writing a crisp help article, designing a hands-on walkthrough, and producing a short video. Underneath it all, you're a storyteller: you know how to earn attention in the first few seconds, hold it against real-world attention spans, and make ideas stick - and sometimes make something people can't help but share. You're also a builder: unafraid to try new formats and experiment, you read the data and listen to customers, and you continually improve and evolve with speed as our product evolves. You'll turn complex things into simple, useful experiences, and you'll own how well they land.

The Mission: help every user - external customers and internal teams - self-serve to reach their creative and business goals, with content so good, so current, and so findable that they don't need to open a ticket. Success looks like real ticket deflection, faster activation, and high CSAT.

 


WHAT YOU'LL OWN

 - New documentation and learning content. You'll populate our documentation and learning surfaces with new, accurate, plain-language content - help articles, answer-first FAQs, goal-based tutorials, and rebuilt getting-started paths - prioritized by real reader and ticket data, made at volume with the help of our AI- native content tools.

 - The content lifecycle. Content isn't done when it ships. You'll keep the library current through every product launch - freshness reviews, launch-day updates, retiring what's stale - so nothing published contradicts the product. Our pipeline flags what's drifting; you own making it right.

 - Learning experiences across formats. Written first where reading serves best - plus short-form video, microlearning, interactive courses, quick walkthroughs, GIFs, and in-product tips. You pick the format that fits the job, not the other way around, and you bring a storyteller's instinct for attention and memorability to every one - learning content competes with everything else on someone's screen, and yours wins. You keep pushing into new, innovative experiences as our tools grow.

 - A content calendar built for effectiveness. You plan what gets made and when - covering the topics customers most need help with, sequenced for maximum impact, so the library actually answers the questions people are asking.

 - Findability. You make sure content is easy to discover - titled, tagged, and structured so people (and the AI assistants that read our docs) find the right answer through search, at the moment of need. Great content nobody can find doesn't deflect anything, and this is yours to own.

 - Engagement and outcomes. You care whether it worked - reader feedback, findability, completion and watch-through, self-serve resolution, deflection, CSAT - and you tune the calendar and the craft based on what the data and customers tell you.

 - A recognizable voice. A consistent, human style across docs, learning, and video that makes every piece feel like part of one connected experience, whether someone reads a single article or completes a whole course.

 


HOW YOU'LL WORK WITH THE TEAM

This role is a force-multiplier - it makes the whole team's knowledge reach people. You won't work alone:

• With our Technical Customer Education Specialist for accuracy and depth - they bring the technical truth; you turn it into clear, findable content people trust and enjoy.

• With our Sr. Learning Experience Lead on what content is needed and what's working - they own the learning platform, journeys, and measurement; you read the same effectiveness data to steer the calendar.

• With our docs and product partners on launches - so new features ship with accurate, ready content on day one, not weeks later.

• With the hiring manager and the wider team to scale our content capability together, so the sum is greater than the parts.

 


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

• A proven learning-content creator. A portfolio of documentation, tutorials, courses, or product education that people actually used and learned from - across at least two formats, with written content among them. You understand clarity, structure, and story, and you can prove it.

• A strong writer. You make complex or dry topics genuinely clear and engaging in plain language, with warmth and a point of view. Docs people want to read are your craft.

jobs.title: Commercial Counsel
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

We are looking for an experienced attorney to join our Commercial Counsel team. This senior role will help build and support Notion’s rapidly evolving Enterprise customer sales motions, bringing deep expertise in negotiating complex AI SaaS agreements with enterprise customers, as well as acting as an advisor and coach to our account teams and cross functional partners. Notion is scaling rapidly, and we need people who work well as a tight-knit team with a passion for driving revenue deals to conclusion. If you enjoy using your deep industry and technology transaction expertise to support revenue generating functions, this role is for you.


Our Commercial Legal team sits at the center of Notion’s growth. We simplify how customers contract with us, take clear and unambiguous positions on AI, privacy, and security, and drive revenue deals to a fast, predictable close. That means exercising real judgment and finding creative, pragmatic paths forward through complex customer requests and requirements.

 

This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Have broad responsibility for negotiating SaaS AI agreements and providing practical day-to-day commercial legal support - primarily in the Americas region - for the sales, marketing, channels, and customer success teams with a focus on supporting the Enterprise segment

 - Collaborate with Product Legal team on product and operational items that impact customer agreements and go-to-market initiatives

 - Draft and negotiate complex agreements regarding privacy, security, and AI regulatory matters

 - Identify and independently pursue process improvements for buy-side supporting motions

 - Develop and revise contract templates and playbooks as necessary, based on changes in our product offerings, organization, and law




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Admitted to the California State Bar, New York State Bar, or Registered In-House Counsel in good standing

 - 10+ years of combined experience practicing as a commercial attorney within a law firm or software technology company

 - 2+ years in-house experience at a SaaS and/or AI technology company

 - Privacy and artificial intelligence subject matter expertise, including privacy regulations (GDPR, e-Privacy Directive, CCPA, etc.) and AI regulations (EU AI Act) with the ability to incorporate evolving requirements into the customer facing agreements

 - Experience driving commercial transactions, SaaS, and enterprise B2B transactions

 - Strong negotiation skills, including ability to explain nuanced legal concepts to internal and external parties and tailor approach to the audience

 - Excellent drafting, written and verbal communication skills and ability to adapt legal requirements in balanced, creative and pragmatic ways to facilitate communication at all levels of the organization

 - Ability to directly interact and build meaningful relationships and trust with internal and external clients and leaders

 - Demonstrated curiosity about AI and a willingness to adopt AI tools to work smarter, move faster, and deliver better results. Developing your personal AI fluency is required for this role

 - Resilience, resourcefulness, and the ability to make recommendations and decisions with imperfect facts

 - Independent and strategic thought combined with excellent team player qualities and a willingness to take on additional responsibilities




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Certified Information Privacy Professional or equivalent

 - Prior experience with a fast growing technology company

 - Experience supporting channel and reseller partnerships

 - Experience supporting customers in the financial services industry

 - Familiarity using Notion



Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco or New York City, the estimated base salary range for this role is $280,000-340,000 per year.



By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550?pvs=74 and NYLL 144 https://notion.notion.site/Ashby-AI-Bias-Audit-2b0efdeead05803bbbfae159ec86c528.



#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

jobs.title: Technischer Vertriebsaußendienst (m/w/d) – Marktentwicklung Ungarn (Elektroniker/in - Automatisierungs- und Systemtechnik)
jobs.description:
Sie kennen den ungarischen Markt, sind gerne bei Kunden vor Ort und begeistern sich für technische Lösungen?

Dann übernehmen Sie den weiteren Ausbau unseres Vertriebsgebietes in Ungarn. Sie gewinnen neue Kunden, entwickeln bestehende Geschäftsbeziehungen weiter und beraten Unternehmen zu unseren Dienstleistungen und Produkten. Dabei sind Sie im gesamten Land unterwegs und werden von einem erfahrenen Vertriebsteam in unserer Zentrale in Deutschland unterstützt.

- Faire & leistungsgerechte Bezahlung mit Bonusregelung
- Moderne Arbeitsausstattung mit Notebook und Smartphone
- Ein erfahrenes Vertriebsteam in unserer Zentrale als Backoffice-Unterstützung
- Viel Eigenverantwortung, kurze Entscheidungswege und ein familiäres Arbeitsumfeld

Ihre Aufgaben - SPANNEND:

Sie…

- … gewinnen neue Kunden und bauen langfristige Geschäftsbeziehungen auf
- … betreuen und entwickeln Bestandskunden im gesamten Vertriebsgebiet
- … beraten Unternehmen zu unseren technischen Dienstleistungen und Lösungen
- … erkennen Marktpotenziale und erschließen neue Geschäftsmöglichkeiten
- … repräsentieren unser Unternehmen bei Kunden, Messen und Veranstaltungen

Ihre Qualifikationen - ÜBERZEUGEND:

- Ungarisch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau sowie gute Deutsch-, gerne auch Englischkenntnisse
- Erfahrung im technischen B2B-Vertrieb oder Außendienst
- Freude an der Neukundengewinnung und dem Ausbau langfristiger Kundenbeziehungen
- Technisches Verständnis für erklärungsbedürftige Produkte oder Dienstleistungen
- Selbstständige, strukturierte Arbeitsweise sowie hohe Reisebereitschaft innerhalb Ungarns

Darauf können Sie sich freuen - INFORMATIV:

- Intensive Einführungsphase in der Zentrale mit Abteilungsrotation & Tandembesuchen im Außendienst
- Spannende Projekte mit viel Gestaltungsspielraum und Eigenverantwortung
- Individuell abgestimmte Fort- und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten
- Langfristige Perspektive in einem international erfolgreichen Familienunternehmen

Seit 1987 sind wir löwenstark am Markt – innovativ, familiär und zukunftsorientiert.

Als familiengeführtes Unternehmen mit Sitz in Hanau gehören wir zu den führenden Spezialisten für Reparatur, Verkauf und Service von CNC-, SPS- und Robotertechnik sowie Elektronik für erneuerbare Energien, Maritimer Elektronik sowie Elektronik in der Gebäudetechnik. Wir halten Maschinen am Laufen – weltweit.

Werden Sie Teil unseres #löwenstarkenteams und gestalten Sie den Ausbau unseres Vertriebs in Ungarn aktiv mit.

Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Bewerbung!

Erweiterte Kenntnisse: CRM-Systeme, Vertrieb, Akquisition, Kundenberatung, -betreuung

jobs.title: Mid-Market Outcomes Architect
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Notion is reimagining how customers adopt, expand, and realize value from software in an AI-native world. As an Outcomes Architect, you’ll be the build-beside partner who helps customers turn AI ambition into working systems inside Notion. You’ll own workflow adoption, value delivery, and renewal outcomes for a book of named accounts, with a focus on customers that are flat, at-risk, or need a stronger path to measurable impact.

You’ll partner closely with Solutions Consultants on account strategy, expansion qualification, and planning, while directly shaping outcomes that strengthen customer partnerships and contribute to predictable revenue. If you’re someone who loves helping customers build workflows that solve real business problems—and you want to work at the intersection of AI, productivity, customer value, and revenue impact—this is the role.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE

 - Drive workflow adoption and value realization for a book of named accounts ensuring your customers know how to deliver outcomes with Notion

 - Contribute directly to NRR with predictable renewal and expansion pipeline and proactive product adoption for your book of business

 - Partner closely with Solutions Consultants on strategy for expansion and renewal for shared accounts, including owning the  opportunity for flat and at-risk renewals

 - Define and maintain mutual success plans that proactively guide customers through their AI Transformation and demonstrate ROI to executive-level stakeholders with periodic business reviews

 - Facilitate use-case consultations that guide customers through their continuous Solutions Design and identify new workflow opportunities that drive outcomes and increase value with Notion

 - Identify opportunities to engage Services for customers with complex or technical implementation needs and partner closely with the Services team throughout delivery to ensure successful outcomes and value delivered

 - Learn Notion’s product and the broader AI ecosystem inside and out so you can be best suited help customers navigate new ways of working and build durable systems in Notion as the underlying system

 - Help build and deliver OA programs that generate customer and business outcomes across Notion’s install base




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING

 - 5+ years of experience driving customer adoption, value realization, renewals, or expansion within a B2B software environment

 - Strong customer-facing discovery instincts, with the ability to understand business problems, map workflows, and translate goals into practical implementation plans

 - Technical fluency and presence as a trusted advisor—while you won't be building for your customers, you should be capable of co-design, configuring, and troubleshooting Notion workspaces and workflows

 - Commercial awareness and the ability to partner with account owners on renewal risk, expansion potential, and account strategy

 - Ability to design and help customers build workflows that drive usage based consumption, connecting adoption patterns to measurable commercial outcomes

 - Strong program and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to manage success plans, timelines, risks, and customer commitments across a book of accounts

 - You operate with agency, urgency, and customer empathy, bringing structure to ambiguous problems and helping teams move from ideas to working systems

 - You’re obsessed with AI, constantly building with the newest tools and learning new ways of working

 - Native level Japanese, business level English




NICE TO HAVES

 - Prior experience in customer success, solutions consulting, implementation, technical account management, or post-sales strategy for productivity, collaboration, or workflow software

 - Experience working with flat, at-risk, or complex renewal accounts and helping customers return to a clear value path

 - Experience partnering in a shared account ownership model with sales, solutions, support, or implementation teams

 - Experience designing repeatable customer programs, playbooks, or interventions that improve retention, expansion, and adoption at scale

A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. jobs.title: AI Agent Security Architect
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.

About the Role

We are looking for an AI Agent Security Architect to function as the primary technical authority for Replit’s autonomous and AI agent security blueprint. In this critical role, you will design, implement, and maintain the runtime defense systems, guardrail frameworks, and sandboxing architectures that govern AI agents executing code, invoking tools, and reasoning across our platform. You will be a key technical contributor—leading high-impact AI security initiatives and bridging the gap between non-deterministic AI behavior and rigorous cybersecurity controls for both engineering and executive leadership.



What You'll Do

 - AI Agent Security Strategy & Technical Execution

 - AI Agent Security Blueprint: Define the long-term vision and architectural patterns for securing autonomous agent workflows, Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations, multi-turn reasoning loops, and multi-agent coordination.

 - Runtime Guardrails & Policy Enforcement: Architect and deploy dynamic input/output guardrail systems, semantic firewalls, and real-time intent verification filters to prevent goal hijacking, system prompt leaks, and indirect prompt injections.

 - Agent Execution & Tool Sandboxing: Partner with Infrastructure and AppSec teams to design secure, short-lived, micro-isolated environments (e.g., microVMs, WebAssembly, container sandboxes) where agents can dynamically execute code, run shell commands, and interact with host operating systems safely.

 - Agentic Threat Modeling & Red Teaming: Conduct specialized threat modeling against non-deterministic systems. Lead automated and manual AI red-teaming initiatives to uncover vulnerabilities in RAG context pipelines, vector stores, and tool-calling interfaces.

 - Identity, Delegation & Least Privilege: Architect fine-grained permission models and step-up Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) authorization patterns for agents acting on behalf of users—ensuring agents never exceed the delegated privileges of the end user or misuse API keys.

 - Context & Memory Boundary Security: Design strict data isolation and poisoning prevention controls for vector databases, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines, and long-term conversation memories across multi-tenant workloads.

 - Risk Management & Cross-Functional Enablement

 - Maintain the AI Security Source of Truth: Define, document, and maintain authoritative secure design patterns and SDKs for engineering teams building internal or customer-facing AI agent capabilities.

 - Contribution to Risk Register: Identify, quantify, and document non-deterministic and agentic security risks (e.g., OWASP Top 10 for LLMs & AI Agents, MITRE ATLAS), ensuring they are accurately represented in the Cybersecurity Risk Register.

 - Auditability & Observability: Design tamper-evident logging and telemetry standards for agent reasoning chains, tool execution history, and context assembly to support incident response, forensics, and GRC requirements.

 - Compliance & Sales Enablement: Partner with GRC to translate complex AI security controls into enterprise-ready audit documentation (e.g., ISO 42001, NIST AI RMF, EU AI Act readiness) and support Sales on complex enterprise security inquiries regarding AI safety.

Required Skills & Experience

 - 6+ years of experience in security engineering or security architecture, with at least 2+ years dedicated specifically to AI/ML security, LLM application security, or securing agentic frameworks.

 - Deep understanding of agentic architectures and protocols (e.g., Model Context. Protocol (MCP), LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI, ReAct frameworks, and vector database technologies).

 - Hands-on expertise with threat vectors unique to agentic AI: Indirect Prompt

 - Injection, Goal Hijacking, Tool Parameter Tampering, Data Poisoning, and Context Contamination.

 - Strong background in applying safety standards and risk frameworks such as OWASP Top 10 for LLMs & AI Agents, NIST AI RMF, and MITRE ATLAS.

 - Proficiency in Python, Go, or TypeScript/JavaScript with a proven track record of reviewing code and building functional security tooling or guardrails.

 - Experience authoring, maintaining, and evangelizing technical security architecture documentation.

 - Exceptional ability to communicate complex non-deterministic AI risks to both deep technical engineers and executive stakeholders.

 - Proven track record of contributing to an enterprise Cybersecurity Risk Register.

Bonus Qualifications

 - Experience designing runtime sandboxing and isolation technologies (e.g., Firecracker, gVisor, Docker, WebAssembly) for dynamic code execution environments.





Full-Time Employee Benefits Include:

💰 Competitive Salary & Equity

💹 401(k) Program with a 4% match (US Only)

⚕️ Health, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance

🩼 Short Term and Long Term Disability

🚼 Paid Parental, Medical, Caregiver Leave

🏝 Flexible Time Off (FTO) + Holidays

🚗 Commuter Benefits  (In-Office & US Only)

📱 Monthly Wellness Stipend

🧑‍💻 Autonomous Work Environment

🖥 In Office Set-Up Reimbursement (In-Office Only)

🚀 Quarterly Team Gatherings

Your meticulous attention to detail and proactive approach will not just keep Legal running smoothly — it will make the whole company move faster.

jobs.title: VODITELJ/VODITELJICA ODRŽAVANJA
jobs.description:
Opis poslova:
  • Planiranje i organiziranje održavanja: izrada plana godišnjeg preventivnog održavanje, definira godišnje ciljeve i aktivnosti koji su uključeni u pripremu strategije tvrtke, sudjeluje u pripremi pokazatelja vrijednosti za ciljeve, sudjeluje u pripremi programa upravljanja okolišem koji su uključeni u planiranje i organiziranje investicijskih projekata, organiziranje provođenja redovitih mišljenja o stanju strojeva i opreme te otklanja pronađene pogreške.
  • Vodi i kontrolira provedbu investicijskih projekata i nadgleda provedbu redovitih preventivnih pregleda strojeva i uređaja, prati i daje izvješća o zastojima u radu i poteškoćama, kontrolira otklanjanje kvarova, potvrđuje interne naloge za održavanje, upravlja troškovima održavanja za postizanje ciljeva i maksimiziranje dobiti, priprema sve potrebne izvještaje.
  • Planira i izrađuje ciljeve za podređene zaposlenike, sudjeluje u izradi plana obrazovanja i osposobljavanja i osposobljavanja na radnom mjestu, utvrđuje učinkovitost obrazovanja i osposobljavanja, ocjenjuje rad i izvedbu podređenih zaposlenika, predlaže nagrade i promocije, organizira vođenje evidencije prisutnosti i odsutnosti s rada svojih podređenih, potiče zaposlenike na davanje korisnih prijedloga, organizira mentorstvo, potiče zaposlenike da prijavljuju eventualne opasnosti od nezgode i ozljede na radu.
  • Komunicira interno, te prema vani, voditelj je u procesu rada prema podređenim zaposlenicima i dobavljačima.
  • Sudjelovanje u procesu racionalizacije potrošnje energije.
  • Sudjelovanje u projektnim timovima, praćenje provedbe, kontrola projektne dokumentacije.
  • Poznavanje propisa i promjena u zakonodavstvu i njihovo uvođenje u provedbu postavljenih zadaća.
  • Za vrijeme svoje odsutnosti, iz bilo kojeg razloga, dužan je osigurati da se rad obavlja bez problema i osigurati zamjenu.
  • Obavlja i druge poslove po nalogu rukovoditelja.
  • Odgovornost za realizaciju planova održavanja u pogonu.
  • Odgovornost za funkcioniranje elektro i strojnog održavanja.
  • Odgovornost za rad u skladu sa Zakonom o radu, Zakonom o očuvanju okoliša i zahtjevima sustava ISO standarda.
  • Odgovornost za funkcionalnu i pouzdanu raspoloživost strojeva za proizvodnju.
  • Odgovornost za racionalno i učinkovito korištenje i naručivanje rezervnih dijelova.
  • Odgovornost za remonte i planirane zastoje stroja dogovara s voditeljem pogona i svojim nadređenim.
  • Odgovornost za upotrebu osobne zaštitne opreme i za poštovanje uputa za siguran rad svih podređenih.

jobs.title: UNUTARNJI REVIZOR / UNUTARNJA REVIZORICA
jobs.description:
Gradonačelnik Grada Umaga – Umago, pročelnica Upravnog odjela za financije i proračun i pročelnica Upravnog odjela za imovinskopravne poslove na temelju članka 19. Zakona o službenicima i namještenicima u lokalnoj i područnoj (regionalnoj) samoupravi („Narodne novine“, broj 86/08., 61/11., 4/18., 112/19. i 17/25. – u nastavku teksta: ZSN), raspisuju JAVNI NATJEČAJ za prijam u službu na sljedeća radna mjesta:
  1. unutarnji revizor (1 izvršitelj - m/ž), na neodređeno vrijeme, uz obvezni probni rad u trajanju od tri mjeseca.
Posebni uvjeti za prijam u službu:
  • sveučilišni diplomski studij ili sveučilišni integrirani prijediplomski i diplomski studij ili stručni diplomski studij ekonomske ili pravne struke,
  • stručno ovlaštenje ministra financija za obavljanje poslova unutarnje revizije u javnom sektoru,
  • najmanje pet godina radnog iskustva na odgovarajućim poslovima, od čega najmanje tri godine na poslovima unutarnje revizije ili revizije,
  • položen državni ispit za II. razinu.
Posebni uvjet za prijam u službu za gore navedena radna mjesta je i poznavanje rada na računalu. Kandidati moraju ispunjavati i opće uvjete za prijam u službu, propisane u članku 12. ZSN-a (punoljetnost, hrvatsko državljanstvo i zdravstvenu sposobnost za obavljanje poslova radnog mjesta na koje se osoba prima). Za prijam u službu osobe koja je strani državljanin ili osobe bez državljanstva, pored ispunjavanja uvjeta propisanih posebnim zakonom, potrebno je prethodno odobrenje tijela državne uprave nadležnog za službeničke odnose. Za dokumentaciju na stranom jeziku potrebno je dostaviti ovjereni prijevod. Radnim iskustvom na odgovarajućim poslovima razumijeva se radno iskustvo (služba u upravnim tijelima jedinica lokalne ili područne /regionalne/ samouprave, državna služba, javna služba, radni odnos kod privatnog poslodavca, samostalno obavljanje profesionalne djelatnosti u skladu s posebnim propisima ili obavljanje poslova u međunarodnim organizacijama) ostvareno na poslovima odgovarajuće razine obrazovanja i struke, sukladno članku 13. ZSN-a. Natjecati se mogu i kandidati koji nemaju položen državni ispit propisane razine, uz obvezu da ga, ako zadovolje na probnom radu, polože u roku godine dana od dana početka rada u službi utvrđenog rješenjem o rasporedu na radno mjesto. Kandidati koji nemaju certifikat, uvjerenje, svjedodžbu ili drugu odgovarajuću potvrdu o poznavanju rada na računalu, a ispunjavaju ostale natječajne uvjete, mogu biti primljeni u službu i raspoređeni na radno mjesto pod uvjetom da u roku određenom Pravilnikom o unutarnjem redu gradske uprave („Službene novine Grada Umaga – Umago“, broj 9/23., 13/23., 22/23., 5/24., 7/24., 11/24., 16/24., 17/24., 1/25., 7/25. i 7/26. – u nastavku teksta: Pravilnik) steknu odgovarajući certifikat, uvjerenje, svjedodžbu ili drugu odgovarajuću potvrdu. U službu ne može biti primljena osoba za čiji prijam postoje zapreke iz članka 15. i 16. ZSN-a. Kandidat koji ima pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema posebnom zakonu dužan je u prijavi na natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i priložiti odgovarajuće isprave kao dokaz o statusu te druge dokaze sukladno posebnom zakonu kojim je uređeno to pravo, a ima prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima. Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 101. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji („Narodne novine“, broj 121/17., 98/19., 84/21. i 156/23.), člankom 47. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata („Narodne novine“, broj 84/21. i 13/26), člankom 48.f Zakona o zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata („Narodne novine“, broj 33/92., 57/92., 77/92., 27/93., 58/93., 2/94., 76/94., 108/95., 108/96., 82/01., 103/03., 148/13. i 98/19.), člankom 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom („Narodne novine“, broj 157/13., 152/14., 39/18. i 32/20.) i člankom 22. Ustavnog zakona o pravima nacionalnih manjina („Narodne novine“, broj 155/02., 47/10., 80/10. i 93/11.) dužan se u prijavi na natječaj pozvati na to pravo te ima prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima. Prilikom pozivanja na pravo prednosti kod prijma u službu prema posebnom zakonu, kada pravo prednosti ovisi o načinu prestanka radnog odnosa kod posljednjeg poslodavca (primjerice: da radni odnos nije prestao krivnjom radnika ili sporazumnim raskidom), potrebno je dostaviti preslik dokaza o načinu prestanka prethodnog radnog odnosa. Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 101. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji i člankom 47. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata, uz prijavu na natječaj dužan je, osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, priložiti i sve potrebne dokaze dostupne na poveznicama Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages//dokumenti/Nikola//popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20ZOHBDR%202021.pdf odnosno https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/dokumenti/Nikola/popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti prilikom zapošljavanja u skladu s člankom 48.f Zakona o zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata uz prijavu na natječaj dužan je, osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, priložiti i rješenje o priznatom statusu odnosno potvrdu o priznatom statusu iz koje je vidljivo navedeno pravo. Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom uz prijavu na natječaj dužan je, osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, priložiti i dokaz o utvrđenom statusu osobe s invaliditetom. Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 22. Ustavnog zakona o pravima nacionalnih manjina uz prijavu na natječaj, osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, nije dužan dokazivati svoj status pripadnika nacionalne manjine. Prijavi na natječaj potrebno je priložiti:
  • životopis
  • dokaz o hrvatskom državljanstvu (presliku važeće osobne iskaznice, važeće putovnice, domovnice ili vojne iskaznice),
  • presliku diplome kojom se potvrđuje ispunjavanje uvjeta razine obrazovanja (stručne spreme) i struke određene ovim natječajem
  • elektronički zapis (u slučaju da je osiguranik podnio zahtjev u elektroničkom obliku preko korisničkih stranica Hrvatskoga zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje), odnosno potvrdu o podacima evidentiranim u matičnoj evidenciji Hrvatskoga zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje koju Zavod na osobno traženje osiguranika izdaje na šalterima područnih službi/ureda Hrvatskoga zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje (ne starije od trideset dana, računajući od dana objave natječaja u Narodnim novinama),
  • običnu presliku dokaza o radnom iskustvu na odgovarajućim poslovima za cijeli period koji je kao uvjet naveden u javnom natječaju (rješenje o rasporedu, ugovor o radu ili uvjerenje poslodavca o radnom iskustvu na odgovarajućim poslovima koje mora sadržavati: vrstu poslova koju je obavljao, koja struka i stupanj stručne spreme je zahtijevan za njih i vremensko razdoblje u kojem je kandidat obavljao navedene poslove), za radna mjesta pod rednim brojem 1, 2 i 3,
  • ako je u elektroničkom zapisu ili potvrdi o podacima evidentiranim u bazi podataka Hrvatskoga zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje (stvarna/potrebna stručna sprema / vrsta i razina obrazovanja) evidentiran radni staž, potrebno je priložiti dokaz da je osoba bez radnog iskustva ili s radnim iskustvom kraćim od 12 mjeseci na odgovarajućim poslovima u traženom zvanju i struci, koji mora sadržavati podatke o vrsti poslova koje je osoba obavljala, s kojim zvanjem i strukom te u kojem razdoblju (rješenje, ugovor o radu, potvrda poslodavca ili druga isprava kojom to dokazuje), za radno mjesto pod rednim brojem 4,
  • presliku dokaza o položenom državnom ispitu propisane razine (ako kandidat ima položen državni ispit propisane razine),
  • presliku stručnog ovlaštenja ministra financija za obavljanje poslova unutarnje revizije u javnom sektoru (za radno mjesto unutarnji revizor),
  • presliku dokaza o poznavanju rada na računalu (certifikat o poznavanju rada na računalu koji se priznaje u zemljama Europske unije ili uvjerenje o osposobljenosti za Računalnog operatera poslovne primjene računala ili svjedodžbu odgovarajućeg razreda srednje škole ili iskaz ocjena sveučilišnog ili stručnog studija (visokoškolske ustanove) iz koje je vidljivo da je uspješno položen predmet informatike ili drugu odgovarajuću potvrdu ovlaštenog organizatora tečaja informatike iz koje je vidljivo da je uspješno završen tečaj informatike u čijem su nastavnom sadržaju obuhvaćene osnove rada na računalu i operacijski sustav Windows, Microsoft Word, Microsoft Excel, Microsoft Outlook-elektronička pošta i rad na internetu,
  • vlastoručno potpisanu izjavu kandidata da kod njega ne postoje zapreke za prijam u službu iz članka 15. i članka 16. ZSN-a (izjavu nije potrebno ovjeravati).
Ako kandidat uz prijavu priloži isprave u kojima osobni podaci nisu istovjetni, dužan je dostaviti i dokaz o njihovoj promjeni (vjenčani list, rodni list i sl.). U prijavi na natječaj navode se osobni podaci podnositelja prijave (ime i prezime, adresa stanovanja, broj telefona, odnosno mobitela, po mogućnosti mail-adresa) i naziv radnog mjesta na koje se osoba prijavljuje. Prijavu je potrebno vlastoručno potpisati. Kandidati koji se istovremeno prijavljuju na više radnih mjesta dužni su za svako pojedino radno mjesto podnijeti posebnu prijavu sa svim traženim prilozima. Dopunu prijavi moguće je podnijeti zaključno do dana isteka natječajnog roka. Za ocjenu ispunjavaju li podnositelji prijave uvjete naznačene u natječaju, mjerodavan je posljednji dan roka za podnošenje prijava na natječaj (osim za prijam vježbenika, obzirom da kandidati ne smiju imati 12 ili više mjeseci radnog iskustva na odgovarajućim poslovima, stoga taj uvjet ispunjava podnositelj prijave koji potrebno radno iskustvo nije imao barem prvog dana roka za podnošenje prijava na javni natječaj za prijam u službu vježbenika). Prije donošenja rješenja o prijmu u službu izabrani kandidat pozvat će se da u primjerenom roku dostavi uvjerenje nadležnog suda da se protiv njega ne vodi kazneni postupak i uvjerenje o zdravstvenoj sposobnosti za obavljanje poslova radnog mjesta na koje se prima te dostavi na uvid izvornike dokaza o ispunjavanju formalnih uvjeta iz javnog natječaja, čije su preslike priložene uz prijavu na javni natječaj. Nedostavljanje traženih isprava smatrat će se odustankom od prijma u službu. Troškove izdavanja uvjerenja o zdravstvenoj sposobnosti snosi Grad (osim u slučaju odustanka kandidata od prijma u službu). Nakon izbora kandidata, a prije donošenja rješenja o prijmu u službu, provjerit će po službenoj dužnosti postoji li zapreka za prijam u službu zbog pravomoćne osuđivanosti izabranog kandidata za kazneno djelo iz članka 15. ZSN-a te zapreke iz članka 16. ZSNa. Uredna prijava je ona prijava koja sadrži sve podatke i priloge navedene u natječaju, u obliku navedenom u natječaju. Osoba koja nije podnijela pravodobnu i urednu prijavu ili ne ispunjava formalne uvjete iz natječaja, ne smatra se kandidatom prijavljenim na natječaj i njena prijava neće biti razmatrana, te će joj o tome biti dostavljena pisana obavijest. Osoba nema pravo podnošenja pravnog lijeka protiv te obavijesti. Osoba koja je podnijela nepotpunu prijavu, neće biti pozvana na dopunu prijave. Za kandidate prijavljene na javni natječaj, koji ispunjavaju formalne uvjete iz natječaja, bit će provedena prethodna provjera znanja i sposobnosti putem pisanog testiranja i intervjua. Ako kandidat ne pristupi prethodnoj provjeri znanja i sposobnosti, smatra se da je povukao prijavu na natječaj. Prijave s dokazima o ispunjavanju uvjeta natječaja podnose se u zatvorenim omotnicama na adresu: Grad Umag – Umago, Povjerenstvo za provedbu natječaja, Trg slobode 7, 52470 Umag, u roku od 15 dana od dana objave natječaja u „Narodnim novinama“, s obveznom naznakom „ZA NATJEČAJ ZA PRIJAM (upisati naziv radnog mjesta na koji se kandidat prijavljuje) – NE OTVARAJ“. Prijave se mogu neposredno predati i u pisarnicu Grada Umaga – Umago, Trg slobode 7 (prizemlje). Rješenje o prijmu u službu izabranog kandidata dostavlja se javnom objavom na mrežnoj stranici Grada Umaga – Umago (www.umag.hr) najkasnije 60 dana od isteka roka za podnošenje prijava na javni natječaj, a dostava se smatra obavljenom istekom osmoga dana od dana javne objave navedenog rješenja. Opis poslova i podaci o plaći radnog mjesta koje se popunjava ovim natječajem, način obavljanja prethodne provjere znanja i sposobnosti kandidata, područje provjere te pravni i drugi izvori za pripremanje kandidata za provjeru navedeni su na mrežnoj stranici Grada Umaga –Umago www.umag.hr (lokacija „Zapošljavanje“). Na oglasnoj ploči Grada Umaga – Umago i na mrežnoj stranici www.umag.hr (lokacija „Zapošljavanje“) objavit će se vrijeme održavanja prethodne provjere, najmanje pet dana prije održavanja provjere. KLASA: 112-01/26-02/04 GRADONAČELNIK URBROJ: 2163-9-03/02-26-1 Vili Bassanese Umag, 24. kolovoza 2026. PROČELNICA Barbara Krištofić Brenčić, dipl. oec. PROČELNICA Maja Galović, dipl. iur. I. OPIS POSLOVA Opis poslova naveden je u Pravilniku o unutarnjem redu gradske uprave („Službene novine Grada Umaga – Umago“, broj 9/23., 13/23., 22/23., 5/24., 7/24., 11/24., 16/24., 17/24., 1/25., 7/25. i 7/26.), sistematizaciji radnih mjesta, dostupno na mrežnoj stranici Grada Umaga – Umago www.umag.hr, poveznica: https://umag.hr/informacije/sluzbene-novine-grada-umaga-umago-90 II. PODACI O PLAĆI Temeljem Pravilnika o radu („Službene novine Grada Umaga – Umago“, broj 3/23., 9/23., 22/23., 20/24. i 14/25.), Odluke o koeficijentima za obračun plaće službenika i namještenika („Službene novine Grada Umaga – Umago“, broj 2/25., 11/25. i 11/26.) i Odluke o visini osnovice za obračun plaće za službenike i namještenike gradske uprave Grada Umaga – Umago („Službene novine Grada Umaga – Umago“, broj 13/25.), osnovna plaća je umnožak koeficijenta složenosti poslova radnog mjesta na koje je službenik raspoređen i osnovice za obračun plaće u visini od 800 eura bruto, uvećan za 0,5% za svaku navršenu godinu radnog staža. Koeficijent radnog mjesta unutarnjeg revizora iznosi 3,50, stručnog suradnika za isplate - saldakonti 2,60, višeg savjetnika za imovinskopravne poslove 3,50, višeg stručnog suradnika za imovinskopravne poslove 2,70 (uz napomenu da za vrijeme trajanja vježbeničkog staža vježbenik ima pravo na 85% plaće poslova radnog mjesta za koje se osposobljava). III. PROVJERA ZNANJA I SPOSOBNOSTI KANDIDATA Za kandidate prijavljene na natječaj, koji ispunjavaju formalne uvjete, provest će se prethodna provjera znanja i sposobnosti, sukladno članku 22. ZSN-a. Prethodna provjera znanja i sposobnosti kandidata obavlja se putem pisanog testiranja i intervjua. Smatra se da je kandidat, koji nije pristupio prethodnoj provjeri znanja, povukao prijavu na javni natječaj. Pravila provjere znanja i sposobnosti Po dolasku na provjeru znanja, od kandidata će biti zatraženo predočenje odgovarajuće identifikacijske isprave radi utvrđivanja identiteta. Po utvrđivanju identiteta i svojstva kandidata, kandidatima će biti podijeljena pitanja. Za svaki dio provjere znanja kandidatima se dodjeljuju bodovi od 1 do 10. Intervju se provodi samo s kandidatima koji su ostvarili najmanje 50% bodova na pisanom testiranju. Smatra se da je kandidat zadovoljio ako je na intervjuu ostvario najmanje 5 bodova. Za vrijeme provjere znanja i sposobnosti nije dopušteno: - koristiti se bilo kakvom literaturom odnosno bilješkama, - koristiti mobitel ili druga komunikacijska sredstva, - napuštati prostoriju u kojoj se provjera odvija, - razgovarati s ostalim kandidatima niti na bilo koji način remetiti koncentraciju kandidata. Ukoliko pojedini kandidat prekrši naprijed navedena pravila bit će udaljen s provjere znanja, a njegov rezultat Povjerenstvo neće priznati niti ocjenjivati. Mjesto i vrijeme održavanja provjere znanja i sposobnosti Mjesto i vrijeme održavanja prethodne provjere znanja i sposobnosti, kao i imena kandidata koji ispunjavaju formalne uvjete iz natječaja, bit će objavljeno na mrežnoj stranici Grada Umaga – Umago www.umag.hr (lokacija „Zapošljavanje), te na oglasnoj ploči zgrade gradske uprave na adresi Trg slobode 7, prizemlje, najmanje 5 dana prije testiranja. U Listi kandidata koja će biti objavljena zajedno s vremenom održavanja prethodne provjere znanja i sposobnosti, biti će navedeni inicijali kandidata, s godinom rođenja i mjestom prebivališta. Ukoliko se kandidat na koga se ti podaci odnose ne bi mogao identificirati u odnosu na jednake podatke drugog kandidata, dodat će se još jedna značajka koja će ih razlikovati. IV.
